-- QuantomHub V3 stability patch
local function QH_Protect(fn,...)
    local ok,res=pcall(fn,...)
    if not ok then
        warn("[QuantomHub] protected error:",res)
        return nil
    end
    return res
end

QH_Protect(function()
    local cg=game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local pl=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    if pl and not cg then
        local pg=pl:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        return pg
    end
end)

local QH_LOGO_ASSET = "rbxassetid://89075091621124"

local function QH_GetExecutorName()
    local name = "Unknown"
    pcall(function()
        if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
            name = tostring(identifyexecutor())
        elseif type(getexecutorname) == "function" then
            name = tostring(getexecutorname())
        elseif type(get_executor_name) == "function" then
            name = tostring(get_executor_name())
        end
    end)
    if name == "" or name == "nil" then name = "Unknown" end
    return name
end

local QH_EXECUTOR_NAME = QH_GetExecutorName()
local QH_EXECUTOR_LOWER = QH_EXECUTOR_NAME:lower()

local function QH_IsUnsupportedExecutor(name)
    name = tostring(name or ""):lower()
    return name:find("xeno", 1, true) ~= nil
        or name:find("solara", 1, true) ~= nil
end

local QH_UNSUPPORTED_EXECUTOR = QH_IsUnsupportedExecutor(QH_EXECUTOR_NAME)

local function QH_ExecutorStatus(name)
    if QH_IsUnsupportedExecutor(name) then
        return "NOT SUPPORTED", Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 105)
    elseif tostring(name):lower() == "unknown" then
        return "COMPATIBILITY MODE", Color3.fromRGB(255, 195, 95)
    end
    return "SUPPORTED", Color3.fromRGB(95, 255, 160)
end

end)

local dragging=false
local dragStart
local startPos
window.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging=true
        dragStart=input.Position
        startPos=window.Position
    end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local d=input.Position-dragStart
        local pos=UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale,startPos.X.Offset+d.X,startPos.Y.Scale,startPos.Y.Offset+d.Y)
        window.Position=pos
        -- Keep the decorative glow attached to the loader instead of leaving
        -- a purple rectangle behind when the window is moved.
        glow.Position=pos
    end
end)
UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

-- Loader-scope compiler: the MM2 source has its own local QH_Compile,
-- but the loader must have an independent compiler before MM2_SOURCE runs.
local function QH_LoaderCompile(source, chunkName)
    if type(loadstring) == "function" then
        local ok, fn, err = pcall(loadstring, source, chunkName)
        if ok and type(fn) == "function" then return fn end
        if ok and fn == nil then return nil, err end
        if not ok then return nil, fn end
    end
    if type(load) == "function" then
        local ok, fn, err = pcall(load, source, chunkName, "t")
        if ok and type(fn) == "function" then return fn end
        if ok and fn == nil then return nil, err end
        if not ok then return nil, fn end
    end
    return nil, "Lua compiler unavailable"
end

-- Project Real / executor compatibility layer.
local function QH_HttpGet(url)
    local ok, body = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(url)
    end)
    if ok and type(body) == "string" and #body > 0 then
        return body
    end

    local reqs = {}
    if syn and type(syn.request) == "function" then table.insert(reqs, syn.request) end
    if http and type(http.request) == "function" then table.insert(reqs, http.request) end
    if type(request) == "function" then table.insert(reqs, request) end

    for _, fn in ipairs(reqs) do
        local ok2, res = pcall(fn, {
            Url = url, Method = "GET",
            Headers = { ["User-Agent"] = "QuantomHub-V3" },
        })
        if ok2 and res then
            local text = res.Body or res.body or res.Text or res.text
            if type(text) == "string" and #text > 0 then
                return text
            end
        end
    end

    local hs = game:GetService("HttpService")
    if hs and type(hs.RequestAsync) == "function" then
        local ok3, res = pcall(function()
            return hs:RequestAsync({Url = url, Method = "GET"})
        end)
        if ok3 and res then
            local text = res.Body or res.body
            if type(text) == "string" and #text > 0 then
                return text
            end
        end
    end

    error("HTTP unavailable for: " .. tostring(url))
end

local function QH_Compile(source, chunkName)
    if type(loadstring) == "function" then
        return loadstring(source, chunkName)
    end
    if type(load) == "function" then
        return load(source, chunkName, "t")
    end
    return nil, "Lua compiler unavailable"
end

-- Early Angel Aura asset preload: starts before UI initialization so the wing model
-- is usually ready by the time Visuals -> Angel Aura is clicked.
task.spawn(function()
    if S._angelWingTemplate then return end
    pcall(function()
        local objects=game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://90816193741219")
        local candidate
        for _,obj in ipairs(objects) do
            if obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("Folder") or obj:IsA("Tool") then candidate=obj; break end
        end
        candidate=candidate or objects[1]
        if candidate then
            candidate.Parent=nil
            S._angelWingTemplate=candidate
            pcall(function() game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({candidate}) end)
        end
        for _,obj in ipairs(objects) do if obj~=candidate then pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end end
    end)
end)

-- ============================================================
--  PROFILE / CONFIG SYSTEM

local ConfigSystem={}
do
    ConfigSystem.folder="QuantomHubV3/MM2/Configs"
    ConfigSystem.ext=".json"
    ConfigSystem.busy=false
    ConfigSystem.version=6
    ConfigSystem.nativeSaveManager=nil

    local function fs()
        return type(isfolder)=="function"
            and type(makefolder)=="function"
            and type(isfile)=="function"
            and type(readfile)=="function"
            and type(writefile)=="function"
    end

    local function ensure()
        if not fs() then return false end
        local current = ""
        for part in string.gmatch(ConfigSystem.folder, "[^/]+") do
            current = current == "" and part or (current .. "/" .. part)
            if not isfolder(current) then
                pcall(function() makefolder(current) end)
            end
        end
        return isfolder(ConfigSystem.folder)
    end

    local function clean(n)
        n=tostring(n or "default")
        n=n:gsub("[^%w%-%_ ]",""):gsub("%s+","_")
        if n=="" then n="default" end
        return n:sub(1,40)
    end

    local function file(n)
        return ConfigSystem.folder.."/"..clean(n)..ConfigSystem.ext
    end

    local function en(v)
        return typeof(v)=="EnumItem" and v.Name or tostring(v or "")
    end

    local function c3(c)
        if typeof(c)~="Color3" then return nil end
        return {
            math.floor(c.R*255+.5),
            math.floor(c.G*255+.5),
            math.floor(c.B*255+.5)
        }
    end

    local function tc(v,f)
        if type(v)~="table" then return f end
        local r,g,b=tonumber(v[1]),tonumber(v[2]),tonumber(v[3])
        if not(r and g and b) then return f end
        return Color3.fromRGB(
            math.clamp(r,0,255),
            math.clamp(g,0,255),
            math.clamp(b,0,255)
        )
    end

    local function ud2(v)
        if typeof(v)~="UDim2" then return nil end
        return {v.X.Scale,v.X.Offset,v.Y.Scale,v.Y.Offset}
    end

    local function pos(v)
        if type(v)~="table" or #v<4 then return nil end
        return UDim2.new(
            tonumber(v[1]) or 0,
            tonumber(v[2]) or 0,
            tonumber(v[3]) or 0,
            tonumber(v[4]) or 0
        )
    end

    local function snapshot()
        local state={}

        for _,k in ipairs(boolKeys) do
            if S[k]~=nil then state[k]=S[k]==true end
        end

        for k,_ in pairs(numKeys) do
            if S[k]~=nil then state[k]=tonumber(S[k]) end
        end

        for _,k in ipairs(stringKeys) do
            if S[k]~=nil then state[k]=tostring(S[k]) end
        end

        for _,k in ipairs(colorKeys) do
            local value=c3(S[k])
            if value then state[k]=value end
        end

        -- Values that are not safely represented by the primitive lists above.
        state.goldJumpKeybind=en(S.goldJumpKeybind)
        state.crosshairSpin=S.crosshairSpin==true
        state.xAnimeImagePosition=ud2(S.xAnimeImagePosition)

        local kb={}
        for n,k in pairs(S.Keybinds or {}) do
            kb[n]=en(k)
        end

        return {
            version=ConfigSystem.version,
            revision=tonumber(S.configRevision) or 0,
            savedAt=os.time(),
            state=state,
            keybinds=kb,
            hudPositions={
                fps=ConfigSystem.fpsPosition and ud2(ConfigSystem.fpsPosition) or nil,
                ping=ConfigSystem.pingPosition and ud2(ConfigSystem.pingPosition) or nil,
                keybind=ConfigSystem.keybindPosition and ud2(ConfigSystem.keybindPosition) or nil,
                performance=ConfigSystem.performancePosition and ud2(ConfigSystem.performancePosition) or nil
            }
        }
    end

    function ConfigSystem.apply(d)
        if type(d)~="table" or type(d.state)~="table" then
            return false
        end

        local st=d.state

        for _,k in ipairs(boolKeys) do
            if st[k]~=nil then
                S[k]=st[k]==true
            end
        end

        for k,r in pairs(numKeys) do
            local v=tonumber(st[k])
            if v then
                S[k]=math.clamp(v,r[1],r[2])
            end
        end

        for _,k in ipairs(stringKeys) do
            if type(st[k])=="string" then
                S[k]=st[k]
            end
        end

        for _,k in ipairs(colorKeys) do
            if st[k]~=nil then
                S[k]=tc(st[k],S[k])
            end
        end

        if type(st.goldJumpKeybind)=="string" then
            local ok,k=pcall(function()
                return Enum.KeyCode[st.goldJumpKeybind]
            end)
            if ok and k then
                S.goldJumpKeybind=k
            end
        end

        if st.crosshairSpin~=nil then
            S.crosshairSpin=st.crosshairSpin==true
        end

        if st.xAnimeImagePosition~=nil then
            S.xAnimeImagePosition=pos(st.xAnimeImagePosition) or S.xAnimeImagePosition
        end

        if type(d.keybinds)=="table" then
            for n,v in pairs(d.keybinds) do
                if S.Keybinds and S.Keybinds[n] and type(v)=="string" then
                    local ok,k=pcall(function()
                        return Enum.KeyCode[v]
                    end)
                    if ok and k then
                        S.Keybinds[n]=k
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if type(d.hudPositions)=="table" then
            ConfigSystem.fpsPosition=
                pos(d.hudPositions.fps) or ConfigSystem.fpsPosition
            ConfigSystem.pingPosition=
                pos(d.hudPositions.ping) or ConfigSystem.pingPosition
            ConfigSystem.keybindPosition=
                pos(d.hudPositions.keybind) or ConfigSystem.keybindPosition
            ConfigSystem.performancePosition=
                pos(d.hudPositions.performance) or ConfigSystem.performancePosition
        end

        S.configRevision=(tonumber(d.revision) or 0)+1
        return true
    end

    -- Loading a profile changes state first, then reconstructs every runtime
    -- object that normally gets created by the corresponding UI callbacks.
    function ConfigSystem.reconcileRuntime()
        local function call(fn,...)
            if type(fn)=="function" then
                pcall(fn,...)
            end
        end

        call(Move and Move.apply)
        call(Move and Move.noclip,S.noclipEnabled)
        call(Move and Move.infJump,S.infJumpEnabled)
        call(Move and Move.godMode,S.godModeEnabled)
        call(Move and Move.invisible,S.invisibleEnabled)

        call(VisualFX and VisualFX.refresh)
        call(Crosshair and Crosshair.setEnabled,S.customCrosshairEnabled)
        call(QH_ApplyVisualQuality,S.visualQuality)
        call(HUD and HUD.applyTheme,S.hudTheme)
        call(HUD and HUD.applyAccent,S.hudAccentMode)

        if CurrentCamera then
            pcall(function()
                CurrentCamera.FieldOfView=S.currentFov
            end)
        end

        if SkySystem then
            if S.skyboxEnabled and S.skyboxId~="" then
                call(SkySystem.applySkybox,S.skyboxId)
            elseif not S.skyboxEnabled then
                call(SkySystem.removeSkybox)
            end
            call(SkySystem.applyAtmosphere)
            call(SkySystem.applyColorCorrection)
        end

        -- Extra visuals were previously only activated by their UI callbacks.
        -- Rebuild them after loading so saved settings are actually visible.
        if ExtraVisuals then
            call(ExtraVisuals.toggleHat,S.xHatEnabled)
            if S.xHatEnabled then
                call(ExtraVisuals.setHatStyle,S.xHatStyle)
            end

            call(ExtraVisuals.toggleTrail,S.xTrailEnabled)
            call(ExtraVisuals.toggleAuraTrailer,S.xAuraTrailerEnabled)
            call(ExtraVisuals.toggleForceField,S.xForceFieldEnabled)
            call(ExtraVisuals.toggleBodyProp,S.xBodyPropEnabled)
            call(ExtraVisuals.refreshClassicAura)
            call(ExtraVisuals.refreshParticleAura)
            call(ExtraVisuals.toggleJujuAura,S.xJujuAuraEnabled)
            call(ExtraVisuals.toggleWalkSteps,S.xWalkStepsEnabled)
            call(ExtraVisuals.toggleNebula,S.xNebulaEnabled)
            call(ExtraVisuals.toggleTextures,S.xMinecraftTextures)
            call(ExtraVisuals.characterRefresh)
        end

        call(NeonAuraToggle,S.neonAuraEnabled)
        call(AuraFX and AuraFX.toggle,S.proceduralAuraEnabled)

        if S.xTimeEnabled then
            pcall(function() Lighting.ClockTime=S.xTimeValue end)
        end

        if S.xFullBright then
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.Brightness=3
                Lighting.GlobalShadows=false
                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            end)
        end

        call(KeybindListUI and KeybindListUI.setVisible,S.keybindListEnabled)
        call(HUD and HUD.applyTheme,S.hudTheme or "Neon")
        call(HUD and HUD.applyAccent,S.hudAccentMode or "Auto")
        if HUD and HUD.performanceFrame then
            HUD.performanceFrame.Visible = S.watermarkEnabled ~= false
        end
        call(updateRoleNotify)

        -- Sync visible Obsidian controls with loaded custom state.
        pcall(function()
            local sync = rawget(_G, "__QH_SYNC_CONFIG_UI")
            if type(sync) == "function" then sync() end
        end)
    end

    function ConfigSystem.exportData()
        return snapshot()
    end

    function ConfigSystem.importData(data)
        local ok=ConfigSystem.apply(data)
        if ok then
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function() ConfigSystem.reconcileRuntime() end)
            end)
        end
        return ok
    end

    -- Hybrid profile: Obsidian serializes every UI control while QuantomHub
    -- serializes runtime-only state that is not represented by a UI element.
    function ConfigSystem.saveCombined(name)
        if ConfigSystem.busy then return false,"busy" end
        if not fs() or not ensure() then return false,"filesystem unavailable" end
        name=clean(name)
        ConfigSystem.busy=true
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            S.activeConfig=name
            S.configRevision=(tonumber(S.configRevision) or 0)+1
            local nativeJson=nil
            if ConfigSystem.nativeSaveManager and type(ConfigSystem.nativeSaveManager.SaveJSON)=="function" then
                local encoded,nativeOk,nativeErr=ConfigSystem.nativeSaveManager:SaveJSON(name)
                if not nativeOk then error("native settings encode failed: "..tostring(nativeErr)) end
                nativeJson=encoded
            end
            local payload={
                format="QuantomHubHybrid",
                version=6,
                savedAt=os.time(),
                custom=snapshot(),
                native=nativeJson,
            }
            writefile(file(name),HttpService:JSONEncode(payload))
        end)
        ConfigSystem.busy=false
        return ok,err
    end

    function ConfigSystem.loadCombined(name)
        if ConfigSystem.busy then return false,"busy" end
        if not fs() or not ensure() then return false,"filesystem unavailable" end
        name=clean(name)
        local f=file(name)
        if not isfile(f) then return false,"profile not found" end
        ConfigSystem.busy=true
        local ok,decoded=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(f)) end)
        if not ok or type(decoded)~="table" then
            ConfigSystem.busy=false
            return false,"invalid json"
        end
        local custom=decoded.custom
        if type(custom)~="table" and type(decoded.state)=="table" then custom=decoded end

        local nativeOk=true
        local nativeErr=nil
        if type(decoded.native)=="string" and ConfigSystem.nativeSaveManager and type(ConfigSystem.nativeSaveManager.LoadJSON)=="function" then
            nativeOk,nativeErr=ConfigSystem.nativeSaveManager:LoadJSON(decoded.native)
        end
        local customOk=true
        if type(custom)=="table" then customOk=ConfigSystem.apply(custom) end
        if customOk then
            S.activeConfig=name
            task.defer(function()
                task.wait(0.15)
                pcall(function() ConfigSystem.reconcileRuntime() end)
            end)
        end
        ConfigSystem.busy=false
        if not nativeOk then return false,"native settings load failed: "..tostring(nativeErr) end
        if not customOk then return false,"custom state load failed" end
        return true
    end

    function ConfigSystem.save(name)
        if ConfigSystem.busy then
            return false,"busy"
        end
        if not fs() or not ensure() then
            return false,"filesystem unavailable"
        end

        name=clean(name)
        ConfigSystem.busy=true

        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            S.activeConfig=name
            S.configRevision=(tonumber(S.configRevision) or 0)+1
            local data=HttpService:JSONEncode(snapshot())
            writefile(file(name),data)
        end)

        ConfigSystem.busy=false
        return ok,err
    end

    function ConfigSystem.load(name)
        if ConfigSystem.busy then
            return false,"busy"
        end
        if not fs() or not ensure() then
            return false,"filesystem unavailable"
        end

        name=clean(name)
        local f=file(name)

        if not isfile(f) then
            return false,"profile not found"
        end

        ConfigSystem.busy=true

        local ok,d=pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(f))
        end)

        if not ok or type(d)~="table" then
            ConfigSystem.busy=false
            return false,"invalid json"
        end

        local applied=ConfigSystem.apply(d)
        if applied then
            S.activeConfig=name
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function()
                    ConfigSystem.reconcileRuntime()
                end)
            end)
        end

        ConfigSystem.busy=false
        return applied,applied and nil or "invalid profile"
    end

    function ConfigSystem.delete(name)
        if not fs() or not ensure() then return false end
        local f=file(name)
        if not isfile(f) then return false end
        local ok=pcall(function() delfile(f) end)
        return ok and not isfile(f)
    end

    function ConfigSystem.list()
        local out={}
        if not fs() or not ensure() then return out end

        local ok,files=pcall(function()
            return listfiles(ConfigSystem.folder)
        end)
        if not ok or type(files)~="table" then
            return out
        end

        for _,path in ipairs(files) do
            local name=tostring(path):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
            if name and name~="" and name~="autoload" then
                table.insert(out,name)
            end
        end

        table.sort(out)
        return out
    end

    function ConfigSystem.setAutoload(name)
        if not fs() or not ensure() then return false,"filesystem unavailable" end
        name=clean(name)
        if not isfile(file(name)) then return false,"profile not found" end
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            writefile(ConfigSystem.folder.."/autoload.json", HttpService:JSONEncode({name=name}))
        end)
        return ok,err
    end

    function ConfigSystem.getAutoload()
        if not fs() or not ensure() then return nil end
        local f=ConfigSystem.folder.."/autoload.json"
        if not isfile(f) then return nil end
        local ok,d=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(f)) end)
        if ok and type(d)=="table" and type(d.name)=="string" then return d.name end
        return nil
    end

    function ConfigSystem.clearAutoload()
        if not fs() or not ensure() then return false end
        local f=ConfigSystem.folder.."/autoload.json"
        if not isfile(f) then return true end
        local ok=pcall(function() delfile(f) end)
        return ok and not isfile(f)
    end

    function ConfigSystem.loadAutoload()
        local name=ConfigSystem.getAutoload()
        if not name or name=="" then return false,"autoload not set" end
        return ConfigSystem.loadCombined(name)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
--  UTILITIES
-- ============================================================
local U = {}

function U.gradient(text, c1, c2)
    local s = ""
    local len = #text
    for i = 1, len do
        local f = (i - 1) / math.max(len - 1, 1)
        local r = math.floor((c1.R + (c2.R - c1.R) * f) * 255)
        local g = math.floor((c1.G + (c2.G - c1.G) * f) * 255)
        local b = math.floor((c1.B + (c2.B - c1.B) * f) * 255)
        s = s .. string.format('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">%s</font>', r, g, b, text:sub(i, i))
    end
    return s
end

function U.clipboard(text)
    pcall(function()
        if setclipboard then setclipboard(text)
        elseif toclipboard then toclipboard(text) end
    end)
end

function U.notify(title, content, icon, dur)
    pcall(function()
        if S.v2 then
            S.v2:Notify({Title=title, Content=content, Icon=icon or "info", Duration=dur or 3})
        end
    end)
end

function U.post(url, headers, body)
    local encoded = HttpService:JSONEncode(body)
    local fns = {}
    if syn and syn.request then table.insert(fns, syn.request) end
    if http and http.request then table.insert(fns, http.request) end
    if request then table.insert(fns, request) end
    if fluxus and fluxus.request then table.insert(fns, fluxus.request) end
    for _, fn in ipairs(fns) do
        local ok, res = pcall(fn, {Url=url, Method="POST", Headers=headers, Body=encoded})
        if ok and res then return ok, res end
    end
    return false, nil
end


-- ============================================================
--  PERFORMANCE CORE / PLAYER CACHE
-- ============================================================
local QHPerf = {
    players = {},
    playerIndex = {},
    mode = "Balanced",
    enabled = true,
}
do
    local function rebuild()
        table.clear(QHPerf.players)
        table.clear(QHPerf.playerIndex)
        for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            QHPerf.playerIndex[pl] = #QHPerf.players + 1
            QHPerf.players[#QHPerf.players + 1] = pl
        end
    end
    rebuild()
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(pl)
        if not QHPerf.playerIndex[pl] then
            QHPerf.playerIndex[pl] = #QHPerf.players + 1
            QHPerf.players[#QHPerf.players + 1] = pl
        end
    end)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(pl)
        local idx = QHPerf.playerIndex[pl]
        if idx then
            local last = QHPerf.players[#QHPerf.players]
            QHPerf.players[idx] = last
            QHPerf.players[#QHPerf.players] = nil
            QHPerf.playerIndex[pl] = nil
            if last then QHPerf.playerIndex[last] = idx end
        end
    end)
    function QHPerf.getPlayers() return QHPerf.players end
    function QHPerf.rebuild() rebuild() end
    QHPerf.dynamicScale = 1
    QHPerf.fps = 60

    function QHPerf.wait(base)
        base = tonumber(base) or 0.1
        if not QHPerf.enabled then return base end

        local modeMult =
            QHPerf.mode == "Performance" and 1.55
            or (QHPerf.mode == "Balanced" and 1.0 or 0.78)

        -- Mobile devices get a little more breathing room for heavy loops.
        -- This does not affect input responsiveness; it only stretches
        -- background polling intervals.
        local mobileMult = 1
        local touch = false
        pcall(function()
            touch = UserInputService.TouchEnabled == true
                and UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled ~= true
        end)
        if touch and S.mobileOptimizationEnabled then
            mobileMult = math.clamp(tonumber(S.mobileLoopScale) or 1.35, 1.0, 2.5)
        end

        local adaptive = QHPerf.dynamicScale or 1
        return math.max(0.035, base * modeMult * adaptive * mobileMult)
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local last = os.clock()
        local frames = 0
        while game.Parent do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            frames += 1
            local now = os.clock()
            if now-last >= 2 then
                local fps = frames / math.max(now-last, 0.001)
                QHPerf.fps = fps
                if QHPerf.enabled then
                    if fps < 35 then
                        QHPerf.dynamicScale = 1.75
                    elseif fps < 45 then
                        QHPerf.dynamicScale = 1.45
                    elseif fps < 55 then
                        QHPerf.dynamicScale = 1.20
                    elseif fps > 58 then
                        QHPerf.dynamicScale = 1.0
                    end
                else
                    QHPerf.dynamicScale = 1
                end
                frames = 0
                last = now
            end
        end
    end)
    S._QHPerf = QHPerf
    S.optimizationMode = S.optimizationMode or "Balanced"
    QHPerf.mode = S.optimizationMode

    -- Touch devices start in a more conservative background-loop budget.
    pcall(function()
        if UserInputService.TouchEnabled
            and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
            and S.mobileOptimizationEnabled
        then
            S.mobileLoopScale = math.clamp(tonumber(S.mobileLoopScale) or 1.35, 1.15, 2.0)
            if S.optimizationMode == "High" then
                S.optimizationMode = "Balanced"
            end
            QHPerf.mode = S.optimizationMode
        end
    end)
end

local function QH_Players()
    return S._QHPerf and S._QHPerf.getPlayers() or Players:GetPlayers()
end

local QH_RoundTransition = { active = false, generation = 0, untilTime = 0 }

local function QH_IsRoundTransition()
    return QH_RoundTransition.active or os.clock() < (QH_RoundTransition.untilTime or 0)
end

local function QH_BeginRoundTransition()
    QH_RoundTransition.generation += 1
    QH_RoundTransition.active = true
    QH_RoundTransition.untilTime = os.clock() + 1.35
end

local function QH_EndRoundTransition()
    QH_RoundTransition.active = false
    QH_RoundTransition.untilTime = os.clock() + 0.20
end




-- ============================================================
--  EXECUTOR COMPATIBILITY NOTICE
--  Xeno/Solara are intentionally treated as untested: the loader shows
--  a warning but does not block execution. Unsupported APIs are guarded
--  inside the feature code so the module can continue where possible.
-- ============================================================
local function QH_GetExecutorName()
    local name = "Unknown"
    pcall(function()
        if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
            name = tostring(identifyexecutor())
        elseif type(getexecutorname) == "function" then
            name = tostring(getexecutorname())
        elseif type(get_executor_name) == "function" then
            name = tostring(get_executor_name())
        end
    end)
    if name == "nil" or name == "" then name = "Unknown" end
    return name
end

local function QH_IsXenoOrSolara(name)
    name = tostring(name or ""):lower()
    return name:find("xeno", 1, true) ~= nil or name:find("solara", 1, true) ~= nil
end

local QH_EXECUTOR_NAME = QH_GetExecutorName()
local QH_UNTESTED_EXECUTOR = QH_IsXenoOrSolara(QH_EXECUTOR_NAME)

--  QUANTOMHUB V3 CUSTOM UI CORE (NO WINDUI)
--  v23 performance pass: expensive UI/visual maintenance is throttled
--  instead of running every Heartbeat.
-- ============================================================
do
    local UIS = UserInputService
    local Theme = {
        name = "Aurora",
        accent = Color3.fromRGB(125, 92, 255),
        secondary = Color3.fromRGB(38, 198, 218),
        bg = Color3.fromRGB(10, 12, 19),
        panel = Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 29),
        panel2 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 23, 37),
        text = Color3.fromRGB(242, 244, 255),
        sub = Color3.fromRGB(148, 154, 177),
    }

    local Themes = {
        {"Aurora", Color3.fromRGB(125,92,255), Color3.fromRGB(38,198,218)},
        {"Ocean", Color3.fromRGB(0,170,255), Color3.fromRGB(0,90,210)},
        {"Purple", Color3.fromRGB(177,84,255), Color3.fromRGB(92,40,190)},
        {"Emerald", Color3.fromRGB(38,210,135), Color3.fromRGB(18,120,80)},
        {"Rose", Color3.fromRGB(255,80,150), Color3.fromRGB(150,30,100)},
        {"Sunset", Color3.fromRGB(255,156,52), Color3.fromRGB(245,68,68)},
        {"Ice", Color3.fromRGB(205,235,255), Color3.fromRGB(85,145,220)},
        {"Cyber", Color3.fromRGB(0,255,200), Color3.fromRGB(110,0,255)},
    }

    local function applyTheme(name, a, b)
        local old = {
            accent=Theme.accent, secondary=Theme.secondary, bg=Theme.bg,
            panel=Theme.panel, panel2=Theme.panel2, text=Theme.text, sub=Theme.sub,
        }

        local function dark(c, amount)
            amount = math.clamp(tonumber(amount) or 0.82, 0, 1)
            return Color3.new(c.R*amount, c.G*amount, c.B*amount)
        end
        local function tint(c, amount)
            amount = math.clamp(tonumber(amount) or 0.08, 0, 1)
            return Color3.new(
                math.clamp(c.R + (1-c.R)*amount,0,1),
                math.clamp(c.G + (1-c.G)*amount,0,1),
                math.clamp(c.B + (1-c.B)*amount,0,1)
            )
        end

        Theme.name = name
        Theme.accent = a
        Theme.secondary = b
        -- Each theme gets its own complete dark palette derived from its colors.
        Theme.bg = dark(a, 0.075)
        Theme.panel = dark(a, 0.115)
        Theme.panel2 = dark(a, 0.17)
        Theme.text = Color3.fromRGB(242,244,255)
        Theme.sub = tint(b, 0.18)

        if not Gui or not Gui.Parent then return end

        local function same(c, x)
            return typeof(c)=="Color3" and typeof(x)=="Color3" and c==x
        end
        local function recolor(obj)
            if obj:IsA("UIStroke") then
                if same(obj.Color, old.accent) or same(obj.Color, old.secondary) then
                    obj.Color = same(obj.Color, old.accent) and Theme.accent or Theme.secondary
                end
                return
            end
            if obj:IsA("UIGradient") then
                obj.Color = ColorSequence.new(
                    tint(Theme.panel2, 0.08),
                    dark(Theme.bg, 0.70)
                )
                return
            end
            if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox") then
                if same(obj.TextColor3, old.text) then
                    obj.TextColor3=Theme.text
                elseif same(obj.TextColor3, old.sub) then
                    obj.TextColor3=Theme.sub
                end
            end
            if obj:IsA("GuiObject") then
                local c=obj.BackgroundColor3
                if same(c,old.bg) then
                    obj.BackgroundColor3=Theme.bg
                elseif same(c,old.panel) then
                    obj.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel
                elseif same(c,old.panel2) then
                    obj.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel2
                elseif same(c,old.accent) then
                    obj.BackgroundColor3=Theme.accent
                elseif same(c,old.secondary) then
                    obj.BackgroundColor3=Theme.secondary
                elseif c==Color3.fromRGB(45,48,60) then
                    obj.BackgroundColor3=dark(Theme.panel2,0.82)
                end
            end
        end

        -- Recolor the complete interface, including pages and controls created earlier.
        for _,obj in ipairs(Gui:GetDescendants()) do
            recolor(obj)
        end

        Main.BackgroundColor3=Theme.bg
        MainStroke.Color=Theme.accent
        AccentLine.BackgroundColor3=Theme.accent
        Sidebar.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel
        Content.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel
        MinBtn.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel2
        CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel2
        StatusPill.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel2
        Title.TextColor3=Theme.text
        Subtitle.TextColor3=Theme.sub
        Grad.Color=ColorSequence.new(tint(Theme.panel2,0.05), dark(Theme.bg,0.65))

        for _,btn in pairs(tabs) do
            btn.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel2
            local m=tabMeta[btn]
            if m then
                if m.text then m.text.TextColor3=Theme.sub end
                if m.icon then m.icon.TextColor3=Theme.sub end
                if m.indicator then m.indicator.BackgroundColor3=Theme.accent end
                if m.stroke then m.stroke.Color=Theme.accent end
            end
        end
        if currentPage then
            local active
            for _,btn in pairs(tabs) do
                local m=tabMeta[btn]
                if m and m.page==currentPage then active=btn break end
            end
            if active then showPage(currentPage,active) end
        end
    end

    _G.__QH_CustomApplyTheme = applyTheme

    local Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    Gui.Name = "QuantomHubV3_CustomUI"
    Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    Gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    Gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

    local pages = {}
    local tabs = {}
    local tabMeta = {}
    local currentPage

    local function makePage(title)
        local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
        page.Name = title
        page.Parent = PageHolder
        page.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
        page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        page.BorderSizePixel = 0
        page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
        page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
        page.Visible = false

        local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding", page)
        padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,4)
        padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,4)
        padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,8)
        padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,10)
        local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout", page)
        list.Padding = UDim.new(0,8)
        list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        pages[title] = page
        return page
    end

    local function showPage(page, btn)
        for _, p in pairs(pages) do p.Visible = false end
        for _, b in pairs(tabs) do
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.panel2
            b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            local m = tabMeta[b]
            if m and m.text then m.text.TextColor3 = Theme.sub end
            if m and m.icon then m.icon.TextColor3 = Theme.sub end
            if m and m.indicator then m.indicator.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
            if m and m.stroke then m.stroke.Transparency = 1 end
        end
        page.Visible = true
        if btn then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.accent
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.06
            local m = tabMeta[btn]
            if m and m.text then m.text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) end
            if m and m.icon then m.icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) end
            if m and m.indicator then m.indicator.BackgroundTransparency = 0 end
            if m and m.stroke then m.stroke.Transparency = 0.65 end
        end
        currentPage = page
    end

    local function stripRichText(text)
        text = tostring(text or "")
        text = text:gsub("<font[^>]*>", ""):gsub("</font>", "")
        text = text:gsub("%s+", " ")
        return text
    end

    local iconMap = {
        house="⌂", swords="⚔", shield="◈", ["user-check"]="✓",
        package="▣", eye="◉", cloud="☁", ["trending-up"]="↗", user="●",
        wind="≋", sliders="☷", refresh="↻", smile="☺", server="▤",
        palette="✦", monitor="▥", flame="◆", crosshair="⊙",
    }

    local function addTab(name, icon)
        local cleanName = stripRichText(name)
        local page = makePage(cleanName)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", TabScroll)
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,46)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.panel2
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.Text = ""
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        Instance.new("UICorner",btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12)
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
        stroke.Color = Theme.accent
        stroke.Transparency = 1
        stroke.Thickness = 1

        local indicator = Instance.new("Frame", btn)
        indicator.Size = UDim2.new(0,3,1,-16)
        indicator.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,8)
        indicator.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.accent
        indicator.BorderSizePixel = 0
        indicator.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Instance.new("UICorner",indicator).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)

        local iconLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
        iconLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        iconLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14,0)
        iconLbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24,46)
        iconLbl.Text = iconMap[icon] or tostring(icon or "•")
        iconLbl.TextColor3 = Theme.sub
        iconLbl.TextSize = 15
        iconLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        iconLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center

        local textLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
        textLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        textLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(46,0)
        textLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-58,1,0)
        textLbl.Text = cleanName
        textLbl.TextColor3 = Theme.sub
        textLbl.TextSize = 12
        textLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
        textLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        textLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd

        tabs[cleanName]=btn
        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if currentPage ~= page then
                TweenService:Create(btn,TweenInfo.new(.14),{BackgroundTransparency=.0}):Play()
            end
        end)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if currentPage ~= page then
                TweenService:Create(btn,TweenInfo.new(.14),{BackgroundTransparency=.08}):Play()
            end
        end)
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showPage(page,btn) end)
        tabMeta[btn] = {indicator=indicator, icon=iconLbl, text=textLbl, stroke=stroke}
        return page, btn
    end

        dot.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(22,22)

        dot.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(245,245,250)
        dot.BorderSizePixel=0
        Instance.new("UICorner",dot).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
        local state=opts.Default==true
        local function refresh()
            sw.BackgroundColor3=state and Theme.accent or Color3.fromRGB(45,48,60)
            dot.Position=state and UDim2.new(1,-25,0,3) or UDim2.fromOffset(3,3)
        end
        sw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            state=not state
            refresh()
            pcall(function() opts.Callback(state) end)
        end)
        refresh()
        return {Get=function() return state end, Set=function(v) state=not not v; refresh(); pcall(function() opts.Callback(state) end) end}

    local function addSlider(page, opts)
        local f=card(page,60)
        local title=Instance.new("TextLabel",f)
        title.BackgroundTransparency=1
        title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,7)
        title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-90,0,18)
        title.Text=opts.Title or "Slider"
        title.TextColor3=Theme.text
        title.TextSize=11
        title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
        title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        local val=opts.Value or {}; local min=val.Min or 0; local max=val.Max or 1; local cur=val.Default or min
        local num=Instance.new("TextLabel",f)
        num.BackgroundTransparency=1
        num.Position=UDim2.new(1,-78,0,7)
        num.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(64,18)
        num.Text=tostring(cur)
        num.TextColor3=Theme.text
        num.TextSize=11
        num.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
        num.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
        local bar=Instance.new("Frame",f)
        bar.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,33)
        bar.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,8)
        bar.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(45,48,60)
        bar.BorderSizePixel=0
        Instance.new("UICorner",bar).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
        local fill=Instance.new("Frame",bar)
        fill.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)
        fill.BackgroundColor3=Theme.accent
        fill.BorderSizePixel=0
        Instance.new("UICorner",fill).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
        local draggingSlider=false
        local function setFromX(x)
            local pct=math.clamp((x-bar.AbsolutePosition.X)/bar.AbsoluteSize.X,0,1)
            local raw=min+(max-min)*pct
            local step=opts.Step or 1
            cur=math.floor(raw/step+0.5)*step
            cur=math.clamp(cur,min,max)
            local p=(cur-min)/(max-min == 0 and 1 or max-min)
            fill.Size=UDim2.new(p,0,1,0)
            num.Text=tostring(cur)
            pcall(function() opts.Callback(cur) end)
        end
        bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then draggingSlider=true; setFromX(i.Position.X) end end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i) if draggingSlider and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then setFromX(i.Position.X) end end)
        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then draggingSlider=false end end)
        local initialP=(cur-min)/(max-min==0 and 1 or max-min)
        fill.Size=UDim2.new(math.clamp(initialP,0,1),0,1,0)
        return {Get=function() return cur end, Set=function(v) cur=v; setFromX(bar.AbsolutePosition.X+bar.AbsoluteSize.X*((cur-min)/(max-min==0 and 1 or max-min))) end}
    end

    local function addDropdown(page, opts)
        local holder=Instance.new("Frame",page)
        holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,44)
        holder.BackgroundTransparency=1
        local btn=Instance.new("TextButton",holder)
        btn.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
        btn.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel2
        btn.BorderSizePixel=0
        btn.AutoButtonColor=false
        btn.Text=(opts.Title or "Dropdown").."   ▾"
        btn.TextColor3=Theme.text
        btn.TextSize=12
        btn.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
        btn.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        local pad=Instance.new("UIPadding",btn); pad.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,14)
        Instance.new("UICorner",btn).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10)
        local menu=nil
        local function close()
            if menu then menu:Destroy(); menu=nil end
        end
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if menu then close(); return end
            menu=Instance.new("Frame",Gui)
            menu.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel2
            menu.BorderSizePixel=0
            menu.ZIndex=500
            menu.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(180,btn.AbsoluteSize.X), math.min(240, 34*math.max(1,#(opts.Values or {}))))
            local pos=btn.AbsolutePosition
            menu.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X,pos.Y+btn.AbsoluteSize.Y+4)
            Instance.new("UICorner",menu).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10)
            local layout=Instance.new("UIListLayout",menu); layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,2)
            for _,v in ipairs(opts.Values or {}) do
                local item=Instance.new("TextButton",menu)
                item.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,30)
                item.BackgroundTransparency=1
                item.Text=tostring(v)
                item.TextColor3=Theme.text
                item.TextSize=11
                item.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
                item.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    btn.Text=(opts.Title or "Dropdown")..": "..tostring(v)
                    close()
                    pcall(function() opts.Callback(v) end)
                end)
            end
        end)
        return btn
    end

    local function addKeybind(page, opts)
        local b=Instance.new("TextButton",page)
        b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,42)
        b.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel2
        b.BorderSizePixel=0
        b.Text=(opts.Title or "Keybind").."  ["..tostring(opts.Value or "None").."]"
        b.TextColor3=Theme.text
        b.TextSize=12
        b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
        Instance.new("UICorner",b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10)
        local waiting=false
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            waiting=true; b.Text=(opts.Title or "Keybind").."  [PRESS KEY]"
        end)
        UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i,gp)
            if waiting and i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and not gp then
                waiting=false
                b.Text=(opts.Title or "Keybind").."  ["..i.KeyCode.Name.."]"
                pcall(function() opts.Callback(i.KeyCode) end)
            end
        end)
        return b
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- OBSIDIAN UI ADAPTER
    -- ============================================================
    -- The feature code below still uses the original QuantomHub UI API:
    --   Sect:Tab(), t:Section(), t:Toggle(), t:Button(), t:Slider(),
    --   t:Dropdown(), t:Input(), t:Keybind(), t:Space().
    -- This adapter maps that API to Obsidian without removing feature code.
    -- ============================================================
    local ObsidianLibrary
    local ObsidianThemeManager
    local ObsidianSaveManager

    -- pcall returns: success, lib, theme, save.
    -- The previous version captured only the first returned object and then
    -- indexed it as an array, leaving ObsidianLibrary nil.
    local okObsidian, loadedLibrary, loadedThemeManager, loadedSaveManager = pcall(function()
        local repo = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deividcomsono/Obsidian/main/'
        local libSource = QH_HttpGet(repo .. 'Library.lua')
        local libChunk, libErr = QH_Compile(libSource, '@Obsidian/Library.lua')
        if not libChunk then error(libErr) end
        local lib = libChunk()

        local themeSource = QH_HttpGet(repo .. 'addons/ThemeManager.lua')
        local themeChunk, themeErr = QH_Compile(themeSource, '@Obsidian/ThemeManager.lua')
        if not themeChunk then error(themeErr) end
        local theme = themeChunk()

        local saveSource = QH_HttpGet(repo .. 'addons/SaveManager.lua')
        local saveChunk, saveErr = QH_Compile(saveSource, '@Obsidian/SaveManager.lua')
        if not saveChunk then error(saveErr) end
        local save = saveChunk()

        return lib, theme, save
    end)

    if not okObsidian then
        error('[QuantomHub V3] Obsidian failed to load: ' .. tostring(loadedLibrary))
    end

    ObsidianLibrary = loadedLibrary
    ObsidianThemeManager = loadedThemeManager
    ObsidianSaveManager = loadedSaveManager
    ConfigSystem.nativeSaveManager = ObsidianSaveManager

    if type(ObsidianLibrary) ~= 'table'
        or type(ObsidianLibrary.CreateWindow) ~= 'function'
    then
        error('[QuantomHub V3] Obsidian Library loaded, but CreateWindow is unavailable')
    end

    pcall(function()
        ObsidianThemeManager:SetLibrary(ObsidianLibrary)
        ObsidianSaveManager:SetLibrary(ObsidianLibrary)
        ObsidianSaveManager:IgnoreThemeSettings()
        ObsidianSaveManager:SetIgnoreIndexes({'MenuKeybind'})
        ObsidianThemeManager:SetFolder('QuantomHubV3/MM2')
        ObsidianSaveManager:SetFolder('QuantomHubV3/MM2')
        pcall(function() ObsidianSaveManager:BuildFolderTree() end)
        ObsidianLibrary.ShowToggleFrameInKeybinds = true
    end)

    local Adapter = {}

    function Adapter:Notify(data)
        -- Keep QuantomHub's notification call compatible while using Obsidian
        -- for the actual interface. Obsidian versions differ in Notify fields,
        -- so use the common API first and fall back to a tiny toast.
        local ok = pcall(function()
            ObsidianLibrary:Notify({
                Title = data.Title or 'QuantomHub V3',
                Description = tostring(data.Content or ''),
                Time = data.Duration or 3,
            })
        end)
        if ok then return end

        local toast = Instance.new('Frame', Gui)
        toast.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
        toast.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
        toast.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 66)
        toast.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.panel2
        toast.BorderSizePixel = 0
        toast.ZIndex = 900
        Instance.new('UICorner', toast).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
        local stroke = Instance.new('UIStroke', toast)
        stroke.Color = Theme.accent
        stroke.Transparency = .25
        local title = Instance.new('TextLabel', toast)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 8)
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 20)
        title.Text = data.Title or 'QuantomHub V3'
        title.TextColor3 = Theme.text
        title.TextSize = 12
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        local content = Instance.new('TextLabel', toast)
        content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 29)
        content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 28)
        content.Text = tostring(data.Content or '')
        content.TextWrapped = true
        content.TextColor3 = Theme.sub
        content.TextSize = 10
        content.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        content.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        content.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
        task.delay(data.Duration or 3, function()
            if toast.Parent then toast:Destroy() end
        end)
    end

    function Adapter:Popup(data)
        -- Keep the existing QuantomHub popup contract. The main interface is
        -- Obsidian; this is only a compatibility modal for the startup prompt.
        local modal = Instance.new('Frame', Gui)
        modal.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 220)
        modal.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
        modal.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5)
        modal.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.panel
        modal.BorderSizePixel = 0
        modal.ZIndex = 700
        Instance.new('UICorner', modal).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
        local stroke = Instance.new('UIStroke', modal)
        stroke.Color = Theme.accent
        stroke.Thickness = 1.5
        local title = Instance.new('TextLabel', modal)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 18)
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 30)
        title.Text = data.Title or 'QuantomHub V3'
        title.TextColor3 = Theme.text
        title.TextSize = 19
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.ZIndex = 701
        local content = Instance.new('TextLabel', modal)
        content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 58)
        content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 70)
        content.Text = data.Content or ''
        content.TextWrapped = true
        content.TextColor3 = Theme.sub
        content.TextSize = 12
        content.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        content.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        content.ZIndex = 701
        local row = Instance.new('Frame', modal)
        row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -58)
        row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 40)
        row.ZIndex = 701
        local buttons = data.Buttons or {}
        local width = 1 / math.max(#buttons, 1)
        for i, info in ipairs(buttons) do
            local b = Instance.new('TextButton', row)
            b.Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) * width, (i - 1) * 5, 0, 0)
            b.Size = UDim2.new(width, -5, 1, 0)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = (i == #buttons) and Theme.accent or Theme.panel2
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.Text = info.Title or 'OK'
            b.TextColor3 = Theme.text
            b.TextSize = 11
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            b.ZIndex = 702
            Instance.new('UICorner', b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                pcall(info.Callback)
                if modal.Parent then modal:Destroy() end
            end)
        end
    end

    function Adapter:SetTheme(name)
        -- QuantomHub has its own palette system. Obsidian ThemeManager is kept
        -- available for standard Obsidian themes but custom QH palettes remain
        -- controlled by QH_ApplyScriptTheme.
        local ok = pcall(function()
            if ObsidianThemeManager and ObsidianThemeManager.SetTheme then
                ObsidianThemeManager:SetTheme(tostring(name))
            end
        end)
        return ok
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- QH GLASS / OBSIDIAN SKIN
    -- Compact dark-glass layout inspired by the supplied reference:
    -- narrow left navigation, graphite cards, violet/blue active state.
    -- Installed before CreateWindow so every control inherits the skin.
    -- ============================================================
    local QH_GlassTheme = {
        FontColor = Color3.fromRGB(235,238,248),
        MainColor = Color3.fromRGB(17,19,28),
        AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(92,126,255),
        BackgroundColor = Color3.fromRGB(9,11,17),
        OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(48,51,67),
    }

    pcall(function()
        if ObsidianThemeManager and type(ObsidianThemeManager.SetDefaultTheme) == "function" then
            ObsidianThemeManager:SetDefaultTheme(QH_GlassTheme)
        end
    end)

    function Adapter:CreateWindow(opts)
        -- Use the official Obsidian CreateWindow contract and keep the options
        -- intentionally conservative. This avoids partially-created windows on
        -- builds where an optional field is rejected during validation.
        local windowOptions = {
            Title = opts.Title or 'QuantomHub V3',
            Footer = opts.Author or 'QuantomHub V3',
            Icon = 89075091621124,
            NotifySide = 'Right',
            ShowCustomCursor = false,
            Center = true,
            AutoShow = true,
            Resizable = false,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(680, 540),
            CornerRadius = 14,
            Animations = {
                ToggleWindow = false,
                TabSwitch = false,
                Groupbox = false,
                Dropdown = false,
                KeyPicker = false,
            },
            TabTransitionTime = 0,
            TabSwipeOffset = 1,
            TabSwipeFrom = 'bottom',
            EnableSidebarResize = false,
            MinSidebarWidth = 184,
            SidebarCompactWidth = 52,
        }

        local okCreate, window = pcall(function()
            return ObsidianLibrary:CreateWindow(windowOptions)
        end)

        -- Some executor/library combinations can finish constructing the UI
        -- before surfacing a validation error. In that case use the instance
        -- already registered by Obsidian instead of returning nil.
        if (not okCreate or not window) and type(ObsidianLibrary.Window) == 'table' then
            window = ObsidianLibrary.Window
        end

        if type(window) ~= 'table' or type(window.AddTab) ~= 'function' then
            error('[QuantomHub V3] Obsidian window creation failed: AddTab unavailable')
        end

        -- Keep Obsidian's original Settings tab. The library places it at the bottom.

        local W = {}
        W._controls = {}

        function W:SetTheme(name, palette)
            if palette and _G.__QH_CustomApplyTheme then
                pcall(_G.__QH_CustomApplyTheme, name, palette.primary, palette.secondary)
            end
            return Adapter:SetTheme(name)
        end

        function W:SetToggleKey(key)
            local k = typeof(key) == 'EnumItem' and key or Enum.KeyCode[key]
            if not k then return end
            ObsidianLibrary.ToggleKeybind = k
        end

        local featureTabOrder = 0

        function W:Section(_)
            local Sec = {}

            function Sec:Tab(tabOpts)
                local title = tabOpts.Title or 'Tab'
                local icon = tabOpts.Icon
                -- Keep the original per-tab Lucide icon.
                -- The QuantomHub logo is reserved for the window/open-button branding,
                -- never for feature-tab icons.
                if icon == nil or icon == '' then
                    icon = nil
                end
                featureTabOrder += 1
                local page = window:AddTab(title, icon, nil, featureTabOrder)
                local T = { _page = page, _left = nil, _right = nil }

                function T:Section(o)
                    local boxTitle = o.Title or 'Section'
                    self._left = self._page:AddLeftGroupbox(boxTitle)
                    return self._left
                end

                function T:Space(_)
                    -- Obsidian groupboxes provide their own spacing.
                end

                local function activeBox(self)
                    if not self._left then
                        self._left = self._page:AddLeftGroupbox('Options')
                    end
                    return self._left
                end

                function T:Toggle(o)
                    local box = activeBox(self)
                    local idx = o.Flag or o.Title or ('Toggle_' .. tostring(math.random(1, 999999)))
                    local handle = box:AddToggle(idx, {
                        Text = o.Title or 'Toggle',
                        Default = o.Default == true,
                        Tooltip = o.Desc,
                        Callback = function(v) pcall(o.Callback, v) end,
                    })
                    W._controls[idx] = {type="toggle", object=handle}
                    return handle
                end

                function T:Button(o)
                    local box = activeBox(self)
                    return box:AddButton(o.Title or 'Button', function()
                        pcall(o.Callback)
                    end)
                end

                function T:Paragraph(o)
                    local box = activeBox(self)
                    return box:AddLabel({
                        Text = tostring((o and (o.Content or o.Text or o.Title)) or ''),
                        DoesWrap = true,
                        Size = tonumber(o and o.TextSize) or 13,
                    })
                end

                function T:Input(o)
                    local box = activeBox(self)
                    if type(box.AddInput) ~= 'function' then return nil end
                    local idx = o.Flag or o.Title or ('Input_' .. tostring(math.random(1, 999999)))
                    local handle = box:AddInput(idx, {
                        Text = o.Title or 'Input',
                        Default = tostring(o.Value or o.Default or ''),
                        PlaceholderText = o.Placeholder or '',
                        Numeric = false,
                        Finished = false,
                        Callback = function(v) pcall(o.Callback, v) end,
                    })
                    W._controls[idx] = {type="input", object=handle}
                    return handle
                end

                function T:Slider(o)
                    local box = activeBox(self)
                    local value = o.Value or {}
                    if type(box.AddSlider) ~= 'function' then return nil end
                    local idx = o.Flag or o.Title or ('Slider_' .. tostring(math.random(1, 999999)))
                    local handle = box:AddSlider(idx, {
                        Text = o.Title or 'Slider',
                        Default = value.Default or 0,
                        Min = value.Min or 0,
                        Max = value.Max or 100,
                        Rounding = 3,
                        Compact = false,
                        Callback = function(v) pcall(o.Callback, v) end,
                    })
                    W._controls[idx] = {type="slider", object=handle}
                    return handle
                end

                function T:Dropdown(o)
                    local box = activeBox(self)
                    local values = o.Values or {}
                    if type(box.AddDropdown) ~= 'function' then return nil end
                    local idx = o.Flag or o.Title or ('Dropdown_' .. tostring(math.random(1, 999999)))
                    local handle = box:AddDropdown(idx, {
                        Values = values,
                        Default = o.Value or o.Default,
                        Multi = o.Multi == true,
                        Searchable = o.Search == true,
                        Text = o.Title or 'Dropdown',
                        Callback = function(v) pcall(o.Callback, v) end,
                    })
                    W._controls[idx] = {type="dropdown", object=handle}
                    return handle
                end

                function T:Keybind(o)
                    local box = activeBox(self)
                    local defaultKey = o.Value

                    -- Obsidian's AddKeyPicker accepts the key name string
                    -- (the reference script uses Default = 'RightShift').
                    if typeof(defaultKey) == 'EnumItem' then
                        defaultKey = defaultKey.Name
                    elseif defaultKey ~= nil then
                        defaultKey = tostring(defaultKey)
                    end

                    local label = box:AddLabel(o.Title or 'Keybind')
                    if not label or type(label.AddKeyPicker) ~= 'function' then
                        return label
                    end

                    local idx = o.Flag or o.Title or ('Keybind_' .. tostring(math.random(1, 999999)))
                    local picker = label:AddKeyPicker(
                        idx,
                        {
                            Default = defaultKey,
                            SyncToggleState = false,
                            Mode = 'Toggle',
                            Text = o.Title or 'Keybind',
                            Callback = function(v)
                                pcall(o.Callback, v)
                            end,
                        }
                    )
                    W._controls[idx] = {type="keybind", object=picker}
                    return picker
                end

                return T
            end

            return Sec
        end

        W._library = ObsidianLibrary
        W._window = window
        Adapter._currentWindow = W

        -- ============================================================
local __QH_ANIME_B64 = table.concat({
'',
'',
'',

'',
''
})

        -- QH GITHUB ANIME BANNER • GIF-LIKE FRAME ANIMATION / LOW-OVERHEAD FOLLOW [FIX-GIF-OBS-TABS-OPT4]
        -- Disable the banner on touch-only/mobile devices.
        local QH_MOBILE_ONLY = false
        pcall(function()
            QH_MOBILE_ONLY = UserInputService.TouchEnabled == true
                and UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled ~= true
        end)
        if not QH_MOBILE_ONLY then
        -- Uses the GitHub 00000001.jpg..00000026.jpg sequence as an animated banner.
        -- One ImageLabel is reused; frames are swapped at a fixed interval.
        -- Position/visibility are sampled at low frequency to avoid FPS loss.
        -- ============================================================
        pcall(function()
            local guiParent = CoreGui
            if type(gethui) == "function" then
                local ok, hui = pcall(gethui)
                if ok and hui then guiParent = hui end
            end

            local old = guiParent:FindFirstChild("QH_LocalAnimeBanner")
            if old then old:Destroy() end

            if type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then
                warn("[QuantomHub V3] getcustomasset/writefile unavailable; GitHub anime banner disabled")
                return
            end

            local screen = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            screen.Name = "QH_LocalAnimeBanner"
            screen.ResetOnSpawn = false
            screen.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            screen.DisplayOrder = 2147483647
            screen.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            screen.Parent = guiParent

            local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            image.Name = "AnimeGirl"
            image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            image.BorderSizePixel = 0
            image.Active = false
            image.Selectable = false
            image.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
            image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 220)
            image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
            image.ImageTransparency = 0
            image.Visible = false
            image.ZIndex = 2147483647
            image.Parent = screen

            local BANNER_W, BANNER_H = 220, 220
            local POSITION_INTERVAL = 0.10
            local FRAME_FPS = math.clamp(tonumber(S.animeBannerFPS) or 10, 6, 15)
            local FRAME_INTERVAL = 1 / FRAME_FPS
            local FRAME_COUNT = 26
            local FRAME_DIR = "QuantomHub_AnimeFrames"
            local frames = {}
            local frameReady = {}
            local currentFrame = 1
            local mainFrame = nil
            local alive = true

            pcall(function()
                if not isfolder(FRAME_DIR) then makefolder(FRAME_DIR) end
            end)

            local function downloadBytes(url)
                local requestFns = {}
                if syn and type(syn.request) == "function" then requestFns[#requestFns + 1] = syn.request end
                if http and type(http.request) == "function" then requestFns[#requestFns + 1] = http.request end
                if type(request) == "function" then requestFns[#requestFns + 1] = request end
                for _, fn in ipairs(requestFns) do
                    local ok, res = pcall(fn, {
                        Url = url, Method = "GET",
                        Headers = { ["User-Agent"] = "QuantomHub-V3" },
                    })
                    if ok and type(res) == "table" then
                        local body = res.Body or res.body
                        if type(body) == "string" and #body > 256 then return body end
                    end
                end
                local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
                if ok and type(body) == "string" and #body > 256 then return body end
                return nil
            end

            local function ensureFrame(idx)
                if frameReady[idx] ~= nil then return frameReady[idx] end
                frameReady[idx] = false
                task.spawn(function()
                    local filename = string.format("%s/%08d.jpg", FRAME_DIR, idx)
                    local exists = false
                    pcall(function() exists = isfile(filename) end)
                    if not exists then
                        local url = string.format("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vaibcode228/777/main/%08d.jpg", idx)
                        local bytes = downloadBytes(url)
                        if bytes then pcall(writefile, filename, bytes) end
                    end
                    local okAsset, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, filename)
                    if okAsset and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
                        frames[idx] = asset
                        frameReady[idx] = true
                    else
                        frameReady[idx] = nil
                    end
                end)
                return false
            end

            local function getMainFrame()
                if mainFrame and mainFrame.Parent then return mainFrame end
                -- Obsidian exposes both ScreenGui and WindowContainer; the real
                -- draggable window is the direct child named Main.
                local sg = ObsidianLibrary and ObsidianLibrary.ScreenGui
                if sg then
                    local direct = sg:FindFirstChild("Main")
                    if direct and direct:IsA("GuiObject") then
                        mainFrame = direct
                        return mainFrame
                    end
                end
                if ObsidianLibrary and ObsidianLibrary.WindowContainer then
                    local parent = ObsidianLibrary.WindowContainer.Parent
                    local direct = parent and parent:FindFirstChild("Main")
                    if direct and direct:IsA("GuiObject") then
                        mainFrame = direct
                        return mainFrame
                    end
                end
                return nil
            end

            ensureFrame(1)
            ensureFrame(2)
            ensureFrame(3)

            task.spawn(function()
                local deadline = os.clock() + 8
                while alive and not frames[1] and os.clock() < deadline do
                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
                if alive and frames[1] then
                    image.Image = frames[1]
                end
            end)

            local function syncWindow()
                if not alive or not screen.Parent then return false end
                local win = getMainFrame()
                if not win or not win.Parent then
                    image.Visible = false
                    return false
                end

                local visible = win.Visible == true and ObsidianLibrary.Toggled ~= false
                image.Visible = visible and frames[currentFrame] ~= nil
                if not visible then return true end

                local p = win.AbsolutePosition
                local s = win.AbsoluteSize
                image.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
                    p.X + 18 + BANNER_W * 0.5,
                    math.max(BANNER_H - 8, p.Y + 6)
                )
                return true
            end

            task.spawn(function()
                while alive and screen.Parent do
                    pcall(syncWindow)
                    task.wait(POSITION_INTERVAL)
                end
            end)

            -- GIF-like animation: swap actual GitHub frames instead of scaling the same image.
            task.spawn(function()
                local nextFrame = 1
                local lastSwap = os.clock()
                while alive and screen.Parent do
                    local now = os.clock()
                    if now - lastSwap >= FRAME_INTERVAL then
                        lastSwap = now
                        nextFrame += 1
                        if nextFrame > FRAME_COUNT then nextFrame = 1 end
                        ensureFrame(nextFrame)
                        ensureFrame(nextFrame % FRAME_COUNT + 1)
                        if frames[nextFrame] then
                            currentFrame = nextFrame
                            image.Image = frames[nextFrame]
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait(0.035)
                end
            end)

            -- Frames are loaded on demand by the rolling preloader above.
            screen.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                if not parent then alive = false end
            end)
        end)
        end

        -- IMPORTANT: return the adapter window so the legacy MM2 source can
        -- continue with `Win:Section(...)` and build all feature tabs.
        return W
    end

    -- Obsidian is now the active interface. The old custom renderer remains
    -- instantiated only as a hidden compatibility container for legacy code.
    pcall(function() Gui.Enabled = false end)
    S.v2 = Adapter

    -- Configure Obsidian's standard theme/config helpers on a Settings tab.
    pcall(function()
        local settingsTab = ObsidianLibrary.__QHSettingsTab
        if not settingsTab then
            -- Stored by CreateWindow below through the library's window object.
        end
    end)
    -- Obsidian owns the visible theme/config UI.
    -- Dragging.
    local dragging=false; local ds; local dp
    Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging=true; ds=i.Position; dp=Main.Position
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d=i.Position-ds
            Main.Position=UDim2.new(dp.X.Scale,dp.X.Offset+d.X,dp.Y.Scale,dp.Y.Offset+d.Y)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging=false end
    end)

    local minimized=false
    MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        minimized=not minimized
        Sidebar.Visible=not minimized
        Content.Visible=not minimized
        Main.Size=minimized and UDim2.fromOffset(1060,78) or UDim2.fromOffset(1060,690)
    end)
    CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Main.Visible=false end)

    local Open=Instance.new("TextButton",Gui)
    Open.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(170,40)
    Open.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-85,0.055,0)
    Open.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel2
    Open.BorderSizePixel=0
    Open.AutoButtonColor=false
    Open.Text="QuantomHub V3"
    Open.TextColor3=Theme.text
    Open.TextSize=12
    Open.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Instance.new("UICorner",Open).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10)
    local os=Instance.new("UIStroke",Open); os.Color=Theme.accent; os.Transparency=.25
    Open.Visible=false
    Open.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Main.Visible=true; Open.Visible=false end)

    local oldClose=CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() Open.Visible=true end)

    -- Theme-adaptive updates for already-created controls.
    task.spawn(function()
        while Gui.Parent do
            task.wait(2)
            MainStroke.Color=Theme.accent
            AccentLine.BackgroundColor3=Theme.accent
            Open.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel2
            os.Color=Theme.accent
        end
    end)
end
