local TagSystem = {}
do
    local function buildTag(player)
        local data = TAGS[player.Name:lower()]
        if not data then return end

        local function attach(character)
            task.wait(1)
            local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
            if not head then return end
            local existing = head:FindFirstChild("qhTag")
            if existing then existing:Destroy() end

            local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bg.Name = "qhTag"
            bg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 26)
            bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)
            bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
            bg.Parent = head

            local frame = Instance.new("Frame", bg)
            frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 5, 25)
            frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
            frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

            local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
            stroke.Color = data.color
            stroke.Thickness = 1.4
            stroke.Transparency = 0.2

            local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
            lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            lbl.Text = data.label
            lbl.TextColor3 = data.color
            lbl.TextSize = 14
            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = data.stroke
            lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1

            task.spawn(function()
                local t = 0
                while lbl.Parent do
                    t = t + 0.03
                    local v = 0.85 + math.sin(t * 2) * 0.15
                    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(
                        data.color.R * v,
                        data.color.G * v,
                        data.color.B * v
                    )
                    task.wait(0.04)
                end
            end)
        end

        if player.Character then
            task.spawn(function() attach(player.Character) end)
        end
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
            task.spawn(function() attach(ch) end)
        end)
    end

    for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
        task.spawn(function() buildTag(pl) end)
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(pl)
        task.spawn(function() buildTag(pl) end)
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
--  SHARED QUANTOMHUB V3 USERS / VISUALS
-- ============================================================
local SharedHub = {}
do
    local active = {}
    local latestState = {}
    local cache = {}
    local lastState = ""
    local lastSent = 0
    local textChat = game:GetService("TextChatService")

    local function colorToHex(c)
        c = c or Color3.fromRGB(173,92,255)
        return string.format("%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c.R*255), math.floor(c.G*255), math.floor(c.B*255))
    end

    local function hexToColor(hex)
        local r=tonumber(hex:sub(1,2),16) or 173
        local g=tonumber(hex:sub(3,4),16) or 92
        local b=tonumber(hex:sub(5,6),16) or 255
        return Color3.fromRGB(r,g,b)
    end

    local function pack(tbl)
        local ok, raw = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(tbl) end)
        return ok and raw or nil
    end

    local function unpack(raw)
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
        return ok and type(data)=="table" and data or nil
    end

    local function sendText(message)
        local sent = false
        pcall(function()
            local channels = textChat:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
            local general = channels and (channels:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral") or channels:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextChannel"))
            if general and general.SendAsync then
                general:SendAsync(message)
                sent = true
            end
        end)
        if not sent then
            pcall(function()
                local legacy = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
                local req = legacy and legacy:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
                if req then
                    req:FireServer(message, "All")
                    sent = true
                end
            end)
        end
        return sent
    end

    local function serializeState()
        local st = {
            v = 3,
            uid = LocalPlayer.UserId,
            name = LocalPlayer.Name,
            label = "Playing with QuantomHub V3",
            tagColor = colorToHex(SHARED_QH.color),
            aura = {
                classic = S.xClassicAuraEnabled == true,
                classicName = S.xClassicAura,
                particle = S.xParticleAuraEnabled == true,
                particleName = S.xParticleAura,
                particleColor = S.xParticleAuraColor,
                angel = S.angelAuraEnabled == true,
                hat = S.xHatEnabled == true,
                trail = S.xTrailEnabled == true,
                trailer = S.xAuraTrailerEnabled == true,
                force = S.xForceFieldEnabled == true,
            },
        }
        return pack(st)
    end

    function SharedHub.send(force)
        if not SHARED_QH.enabled then return end
        local now=tick()
        local raw=serializeState()
        if not raw then return end
        if not force and raw==lastState and now-lastSent<SHARED_QH.interval then return end
        local msg=SHARED_QH.beacon..raw
        -- Keep the beacon compact and infrequent; other QuantomHub clients consume it.
        if sendText(msg) then
            lastState=raw
            lastSent=now
        end
    end

    local function destroyRemote(userId)
        local rec=active[userId]
        if not rec then return end
        for _,obj in ipairs(rec.objects or {}) do pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
        active[userId]=nil
    end

    local function getTargetPart(character)
        return character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function makeTag(character, color)
        local head=character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return nil end
        local old=head:FindFirstChild("qhSharedTag")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        local bg=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bg.Name="qhSharedTag"; bg.Size=UDim2.new(0,190,0,24); bg.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3.25,0)
        bg.AlwaysOnTop=true; bg.Parent=head
        local f=Instance.new("Frame",bg); f.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); f.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(12,7,24); f.BackgroundTransparency=.15; f.BorderSizePixel=0
        Instance.new("UICorner",f).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)
        local st=Instance.new("UIStroke",f); st.Color=color; st.Thickness=1.2; st.Transparency=.2
        local tx=Instance.new("TextLabel",f); tx.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); tx.BackgroundTransparency=1; tx.Text="Playing with QuantomHub V3"; tx.TextColor3=color; tx.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; tx.TextSize=11
        return bg
    end

    local function applyHighlight(character, color)
        local h=character:FindFirstChild("qhSharedHighlight")
        if not h then h=Instance.new("Highlight"); h.Name="qhSharedHighlight"; h.Adornee=character; h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop; h.Parent=character end
        h.FillColor=color; h.OutlineColor=color; h.FillTransparency=.88; h.OutlineTransparency=.18
        return h
    end

    local function loadAsset(id)
        if cache[id] then return cache[id] end
        local ok,obj=pcall(function() return game:GetObjects(id)[1] end)
        if ok and obj then cache[id]=obj; return obj end
        return nil
    end

    local function applyClassic(character, auraName, out)
        local ids={
            Godly="rbxassetid://16699750981", ["Super Sayien"]="rbxassetid://116109508364297",
            ["North Star"]="rbxassetid://83945069652732", ["Blue Lord"]="rbxassetid://10974316799",
            ["Pink Aura"]="rbxassetid://115980859615239", ["Sweet Heart"]="rbxassetid://91724768175470",
            ["Ethereal Aura"]="rbxassetid://97041568674250", ["Angel Wing"]="rbxassetid://90022969696073",
        }
        local src=loadAsset(ids[auraName] or ids.Godly); if not src then return end
        local root=getTargetPart(character); if not root then return end
        local folder=Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name="qhSharedClassicAura"; folder.Parent=root; table.insert(out,folder)
        for _,obj in ipairs(src:GetDescendants()) do
            if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                pcall(function()
                    local c=obj:Clone(); c.Parent=root; table.insert(out,c)
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function applyParticle(character, auraName, colorName, out)
        local ids={
            starlight="rbxassetid://134645216613107", heavenly="rbxassetid://139300897520961",
            ribbon="rbxassetid://132069507632161", sakura="rbxassetid://81755778619404",
            wind="rbxassetid://80694081850877", flow="rbxassetid://119913533725648",
            star="rbxassetid://73754563740680", neon="rbxassetid://18498709246",
        }
        local src=loadAsset(ids[auraName] or ids.starlight); if not src then return end
        local root=getTargetPart(character); if not root then return end
        local colNames={Cyan=Color3.fromRGB(0,255,255),Blue=Color3.fromRGB(0,86,255),Purple=Color3.fromRGB(170,70,255),Pink=Color3.fromRGB(255,80,180),Green=Color3.fromRGB(90,255,140),Yellow=Color3.fromRGB(255,215,0),White=Color3.new(1,1,1)}
        local color=colNames[colorName] or colNames.Cyan
        local n=0
        for _,obj in ipairs(src:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
                n+=1
                local att=Instance.new("Attachment"); att.Name="qhSharedParticleAtt"..n; att.Parent=root
                local em=obj:Clone(); em.Enabled=true; em.Color=ColorSequence.new(color); em.Parent=att
                table.insert(out,att)
            end
        end
    end

    local function applyHat(character, out)
        local head=character and character:FindFirstChild("Head"); if not head then return end
        local p=Instance.new("Part"); p.Name="qhSharedHat"; p.Size=Vector3.new(3.2,.4,3.2); p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder; p.Material=Enum.Material.Neon; p.Color=SHARED_QH.color
        p.Transparency=.25; p.CanCollide=false; p.CanQuery=false; p.CanTouch=false; p.Massless=true; p.Parent=character
        local w=Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); w.Part0=head; w.Part1=p; w.Parent=p; p.CFrame=head.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1.45,0)
        table.insert(out,p)
    end

    local function applyTrail(character, out, trailer)
        local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not root then return end
        local a0=Instance.new("Attachment",root); a0.Position=Vector3.new(0,2,0)
        local a1=Instance.new("Attachment",root); a1.Position=Vector3.new(0,-2,0)
        local tr=Instance.new("Trail"); tr.Name=trailer and "qhSharedAuraTrailer" or "qhSharedTrail"; tr.Attachment0=a0; tr.Attachment1=a1; tr.Lifetime=.45; tr.Color=ColorSequence.new(SHARED_QH.color); tr.Parent=character
        table.insert(out,a0); table.insert(out,a1); table.insert(out,tr)
    end

    local function applyRemote(userId, state)
        if state.uid==LocalPlayer.UserId then return end
        local pl=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(state.uid)
        if not pl or not pl.Character then return end
        destroyRemote(state.uid)
        local rec={objects={},expires=tick()+SHARED_QH.timeout}
        active[state.uid]=rec
        local c=hexToColor(state.tagColor or colorToHex(SHARED_QH.color))
        local tag=makeTag(pl.Character,c)
        if tag then table.insert(rec.objects,tag) end
        local hl=applyHighlight(pl.Character,c)
        if hl then table.insert(rec.objects,hl) end
        latestState[state.uid]=state
        local a=state.aura or {}
        if a.hat then applyHat(pl.Character,rec.objects) end
        if a.trail then applyTrail(pl.Character,rec.objects,false) end
        if a.trailer then applyTrail(pl.Character,rec.objects,true) end
        if a.classic then applyClassic(pl.Character,a.classicName,rec.objects) end
        if a.particle then applyParticle(pl.Character,a.particleName,a.particleColor,rec.objects) end
        if a.force then
            local h=pl.Character:FindFirstChild("qhSharedHighlight")
            if h then h.FillTransparency=.72; h.OutlineTransparency=.05 end
        end
    end

    function SharedHub.processMessage(message)
        local text=message
        if type(message)=="table" then text=message.Text end
        if type(text)~="string" then return end
        if text:sub(1,#SHARED_QH.beacon)~=SHARED_QH.beacon then return end
        local state=unpack(text:sub(#SHARED_QH.beacon+1))
        if state and state.v==3 and tonumber(state.uid) then
            applyRemote(state.uid,state)
        end
    end

    function SharedHub.bind()
        pcall(function()
            textChat.MessageReceived:Connect(function(msg)
                SharedHub.processMessage(msg)
            end)
        end)
        pcall(function()
            for _,pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
                pl.Chatted:Connect(function(msg) SharedHub.processMessage(msg) end)
                pl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                    task.delay(.6,function()
                        local state=latestState[pl.UserId]
                        if state then applyRemote(pl.UserId,state) end
                    end)
                end)
            end
            Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(pl)
                pl.Chatted:Connect(function(msg) SharedHub.processMessage(msg) end)
                pl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                    task.delay(.6,function()
                        local state=latestState[pl.UserId]
                        if state then applyRemote(pl.UserId,state) end
                    end)
                end)
            end)
            Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(pl)
                destroyRemote(pl.UserId)
                latestState[pl.UserId]=nil
            end)
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
                task.wait(5)
                for uid,rec in pairs(active) do
                    if tick()>rec.expires or not Players:GetPlayerByUserId(uid) then destroyRemote(uid) end
                end
            end
        end)
        task.delay(2,function() SharedHub.send(true) end)
    end

    function SharedHub.clearAll()
        for uid in pairs(active) do destroyRemote(uid) end
    end

    function SharedHub.refresh() SharedHub.send(true) end
end

SHARED_QH.enabled = true
SharedHub.bind()

    local currentSkybox = nil

    function SkySystem.applySkybox(id)
        id = tonumber(id)
        if not id then return false end

        local sky = nil
        pcall(function()
            local objects = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id))
            for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
                if obj:IsA("Sky") then
                    sky = obj
                    break
                end
                local nested = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sky", true)
                if nested then
                    sky = nested
                    break
                end
            end
        end)

        if not sky then
            pcall(function()
                local pack = game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(id)
                if pack then
                    for _, obj in ipairs(pack:GetDescendants()) do
                        if obj:IsA("Sky") then
                            sky = obj
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    pack:Destroy()
                end
            end)
        end

        if not sky then return false end

        if currentSkybox then
            pcall(function() currentSkybox:Destroy() end)
            currentSkybox = nil
        end

        currentSkybox = sky:Clone()
        currentSkybox.Name = "qhCustomSkybox"
        currentSkybox.Parent = Lighting
        pcall(function() sky:Destroy() end)

        S.skyboxEnabled = true
        for _, entry in ipairs(SkySystem.SKYBOXES) do
            if entry.Id == id then
                S.skyboxId = entry.Name
                break
            end
        end
        return true
    end

    function SkySystem.removeSkybox()
        if currentSkybox then
            pcall(function() currentSkybox:Destroy() end)
            currentSkybox = nil
        end
        local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChild("qhCustomSkybox")
        if existing then existing:Destroy() end
        S.skyboxEnabled = false
    end

    local function getAtm()
        local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
        if not atm then atm = Instance.new("Atmosphere", Lighting) end
        return atm
    end

    local function getCC()
        local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("ColorCorrectionEffect")
        if not cc then cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting) end
        return cc
    end

    function SkySystem.applyPreset(name)
        local preset = nil
        for _, p in ipairs(SkySystem.PRESETS) do
            if p.name == name then preset = p break end
        end
        if not preset then return end
        S.currentSkyId = name
        if not S.customSkyEnabled then return end
        TweenService:Create(Lighting, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
            Ambient        = preset.ambient,
            OutdoorAmbient = preset.outAmbient,
            FogColor       = preset.fogColor,
            FogEnd         = preset.fogEnd,
            FogStart       = preset.fogStart,
        }):Play()
    end

    function SkySystem.removeSky()
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        Lighting.FogStart = 0
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(127,127,127)
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(127,127,127)
    end

    function SkySystem.applyAtmosphere()
        if not S.customAtmosphereEnabled then
            local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atm then atm:Destroy() end
            local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("ColorCorrectionEffect")
            if cc then cc:Destroy() end
            return
        end
        local atm = getAtm()
        atm.Density = S.atmDensity
        atm.Offset  = S.atmOffset
        atm.Color   = S.atmColor
        atm.Decay   = S.atmDecay
        atm.Glare   = S.atmGlare
        atm.Haze    = S.atmHaze
    end

    function SkySystem.applyColorCorrection()
        if not S.customAtmosphereEnabled then return end
        local cc = getCC()
        local cs = SkySystem.ccState
        cc.Brightness = cs.brightness
        cc.Contrast   = cs.contrast
        cc.Saturation = cs.saturation
        cc.TintColor  = Color3.new(
            math.clamp(cs.tintR / 255, 0, 1),
            math.clamp(cs.tintG / 255, 0, 1),
            math.clamp(cs.tintB / 255, 0, 1)
        )
    end
end

        "Illumina_K_0045","Fang_K_0046","Star_K_0047","Heartblade_K_0048",
        "Amerilaser_K_0049","Classy_K_0050",
        "Chroma_Luger_G_0001","Chroma_Blaster_G_0002","Chroma_Badger_G_0003",
        "Luger_G_0004","Blaster_G_0005","Badger_G_0006","Laser_G_0007",
        "Fade_G_0008","Tides_G_0009","Solar_G_0010","Finisher_G_0011",
        "Glacier_G_0012","Party_G_0013","Gemstone_G_0014","Singularity_G_0015",
        "Darkbringer_G_0016","Illumina_G_0017","Amerilaser_G_0018","Rainbow_G_0019",
        "Fang_G_0020","Eternal_G_0021","Blossom_G_0022","Lava_G_0023"
    }

    local function notify(title, text, icon, duration)
        pcall(function()
            U.notify(title, text, icon, duration)
        end)
    end

    local function cleanId(id)
        return tostring(id or "")
            :lower()
            :gsub("_g_%d+", "")
            :gsub("_k_%d+", "")
            :gsub("_", " ")
    end

    local function normalizeQuery(q)
        return tostring(q or "")
            :lower()
            :gsub("^%s+", "")
            :gsub("%s+$", "")
            :gsub(" ", "_")
            :gsub("_g_%d+", "")
            :gsub("_k_%d+", "")
    end

    local function getRemote()
        if Spawner.ShopRem and Spawner.ShopRem.Parent then
            return Spawner.ShopRem
        end

        local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        if not remotes then
            return nil
        end

        Spawner.Remotes = remotes

        local shop = remotes:FindFirstChild("Shop")
        if not shop then
            return nil
        end

        local box = shop:FindFirstChild("BoxController")
        if box then
            Spawner.ShopRem = box
        end

        return box
    end

    local function buildInitialList()
        Spawner.WeaponsList = {}

        for _, id in ipairs(Spawner.WEAPON_IDS) do
            table.insert(Spawner.WeaponsList, {
                Title = cleanId(id),
                ID = id,
                Rarity = Spawner.Rarity[id]
            })
        end
    end

    buildInitialList()

    local function blockedItem(name, data)
        local flat = tostring(name or ""):lower():gsub("[^%a%d]", "")
        if flat == "" or tostring(name or ""):find("?", 1, true) then
            return true
        end

        local blockedFamilies = {
            "reaver", "gingerscythe", "icecrusher", "synthwave"
        }

        for _, family in ipairs(blockedFamilies) do
            if flat:find(family, 1, true) then
                return true
            end
        end

        if type(data) == "table" then
            local rarity = data.Rarity or "Common"

            if rarity == "Unique" and flat ~= "corrupt" then
                return true
            end

            if data.Tradable == false
                or data.CanTrade == false
                or data.Untradable == true
                or data.NonTradable == true
                or data.Locked == true
                or data.Evo == true
                or data.Evolution == true
                or data.IsEvo == true
                or data.EvoTier ~= nil then
                return true
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    local function loadDatabase()
        pcall(function()
            local db = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Database")
            local sync = db and db:FindFirstChild("Sync")
            local item = sync and sync:FindFirstChild("Item")

            if item then
                Spawner.DB_Item = require(item)
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            local mods = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
            local profile = mods and mods:FindFirstChild("ProfileData")

            if profile then
                Spawner.DB_Prof = require(profile)
            end
        end)

        if type(Spawner.DB_Item) ~= "table" then
            return
        end

        local existing = {}
        for _, id in ipairs(Spawner.WEAPON_IDS) do
            existing[id] = true
        end

        for id, data in pairs(Spawner.DB_Item) do
            if type(data) == "table" and (data.Type == "Knife" or data.Type == "Gun") then
                local title = data.ItemName or id
                local rarity = data.Rarity or "Common"

                Spawner.Rarity[id] = rarity

                if blockedItem(title, data) then
                    Spawner.Blocked[id] = true
                elseif not existing[id] then
                    existing[id] = true
                    table.insert(Spawner.WEAPON_IDS, id)
                    table.insert(Spawner.WeaponsList, {
                        Title = title,
                        ID = id,
                        Rarity = rarity,
                        Type = data.Type,
                        Chroma = data.Chroma == true
                    })
                end
            end
        end

        for _, entry in ipairs(Spawner.WeaponsList) do
            entry.Rarity = entry.Rarity or Spawner.Rarity[entry.ID] or "Common"
        end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            Spawner.Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 12)
            getRemote()
        end)

        pcall(loadDatabase)

        Spawner.Ready = true
    end)

    function Spawner.resolveId(query)
        local qnorm = normalizeQuery(query)
        if qnorm == "" then
            return nil
        end

        -- Exact ID.
        for _, id in ipairs(Spawner.WEAPON_IDS) do
            if not Spawner.Blocked[id] then
                if id == query or id:lower() == tostring(query):lower() then
                    return id
                end
            end
        end

        -- Normalized name.
        for _, id in ipairs(Spawner.WEAPON_IDS) do
            if not Spawner.Blocked[id] then
                local normalized = id:lower()
                    :gsub("_g_%d+", "")
                    :gsub("_k_%d+", "")

                if normalized == qnorm then
                    return id
                end
            end
        end

        -- Display-name match.
        for _, entry in ipairs(Spawner.WeaponsList) do
            if not Spawner.Blocked[entry.ID] then
                local title = tostring(entry.Title or ""):lower()
                    :gsub("%s+", "_")

                if title == qnorm then
                    return entry.ID
                end
            end
        end

        -- Partial match.
        for _, id in ipairs(Spawner.WEAPON_IDS) do
            if not Spawner.Blocked[id] then
                local normalized = id:lower()
                    :gsub("_g_%d+", "")
                    :gsub("_k_%d+", "")

                if normalized:find(qnorm, 1, true) then
                    return id
                end
            end
        end

        for _, entry in ipairs(Spawner.WeaponsList) do
            if not Spawner.Blocked[entry.ID] then
                local title = tostring(entry.Title or ""):lower()

                if title:find(tostring(query):lower(), 1, true) then
                    return entry.ID
                end
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function fireSpawn(id)
        local remote = getRemote()

        if not remote then
            pcall(function()
                Spawner.Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 4)
            end)
            remote = getRemote()
        end

        if not remote then
            return false, "BoxController not found"
        end

        -- MM2 currently exposes Shop.BoxController as a BindableEvent in
        -- this client. The previous build blindly called FireServer(), which
        -- only exists on RemoteEvent and caused:
        --   "FireServer is not a valid member of BindableEvent"
        --
        -- Support the actual class first, while retaining compatibility with
        -- older builds where BoxController was a RemoteEvent/RemoteFunction.
        local class = remote.ClassName

        if class == "BindableEvent" then
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                remote:Fire("KnifeBox4", id)
            end)

            if ok then
                return true
            end

            return false, tostring(err)
        end

        if class == "RemoteEvent" then
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                remote:FireServer("KnifeBox4", id)
            end)

            if ok then
                return true
            end

            return false, tostring(err)
        end

        if class == "BindableFunction" then
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                return remote:Invoke("KnifeBox4", id)
            end)

            if ok then
                return true, result
            end

            return false, tostring(result)
        end

        if class == "RemoteFunction" then
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                return remote:InvokeServer("KnifeBox4", id)
            end)

            if ok then
                return true, result
            end

            return false, tostring(result)
        end

        return false, "Unsupported BoxController class: " .. tostring(class)
    end

    local function findTool(id)
        local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character

        local clean = cleanId(id)

        local function scan(container)
            if not container then return nil end

            for _, obj in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("Tool") then
                    local objClean = cleanId(obj.Name)

                    if obj.Name == id
                        or obj.Name:lower() == id:lower()
                        or objClean == clean then
                        return obj
                    end
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        return scan(backpack) or scan(character)
    end

    local function equipWhenAvailable(id, timeout)
        local deadline = os.clock() + (timeout or 8)

        while os.clock() < deadline do
            local tool = findTool(id)

            if tool then
                local character = LocalPlayer.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                if humanoid then
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
                    end)
                end

                return true
            end

            task.wait(0.15)
        end

        return false
    end

    local function refreshProfile(id)
        pcall(function()
            local owned = Spawner.DB_Prof
                and Spawner.DB_Prof.Weapons
                and Spawner.DB_Prof.Weapons.Owned

            if type(owned) == "table" then
                owned[id] = (owned[id] or 0) + 1
            end
        end)
    end

    local NO_VIRTUALIZE =
        (type(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE) == "function")
        and LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE
        or function(fn) return fn end

    Spawner.spawn = NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(itemName)
        if not itemName or tostring(itemName):gsub("%s+", "") == "" then
            notify("Spawner", "Enter an item name or ID", "x", 3)
            return false
        end

        local id = Spawner.resolveId(itemName)

        if not id then
            notify("Spawner", "Not found: " .. tostring(itemName), "x", 3)
            return false
        end

        if Spawner.Blocked[id] then
            notify("Spawner", "Blocked item: " .. cleanId(id), "x", 3)
            return false
        end

        Spawner.SpawnSerial += 1
        local serial = Spawner.SpawnSerial
        Spawner.LastSpawn = id

        local ok, err = fireSpawn(id)

        if not ok then
            notify(
                "Spawner",
                "Spawn failed: " .. tostring(err),
                "x",
                4
            )
            warn(
                "[QuantomHub Spawner] BoxController = "
                .. tostring(Spawner.ShopRem)
                .. " class="
                .. tostring(Spawner.ShopRem and Spawner.ShopRem.ClassName)
                .. " error="
                .. tostring(err)
            )
            return false
        end

        -- Do not modify the local profile optimistically. The profile cache
        -- is only updated after a real Tool is observed.
        notify(
            "Spawner",
            "Spawn request sent: " .. cleanId(id),
            "package",
            1.25
        )

        -- Do not create a second full-screen/modal notification while the
        -- inventory is updating. Some WindUI builds dim the viewport for
        -- transient notifications, which made the spawner appear to freeze.
        -- Just wait briefly for the actual Tool and equip it if it arrives.
        task.spawn(function()
            local equipped = equipWhenAvailable(id, 2.5)

            -- An older spawn must never report/equip after a newer request.
            if serial ~= Spawner.SpawnSerial then
                return
            end

            if equipped then
                refreshProfile(id)
                pcall(function()
                    notify("Spawner", "Equipped " .. cleanId(id), "check", 1.5)
                end)
            end
        end)

        return true
    end)

    function Spawner.spawnMany(idOrName, amount)
        amount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 1), 1, 100)

        local id = Spawner.resolveId(idOrName)
        if not id then
            notify("Spawner", "Not found: " .. tostring(idOrName), "x", 3)
            return 0
        end

        local sent = 0

        for _ = 1, amount do
            if Spawner.spawn(id) then
                sent += 1
            end
            task.wait(0.08)
        end

        return sent
    end

    function Spawner.getEntriesByRarity(allowed)
        local out = {}

        for _, entry in ipairs(Spawner.WeaponsList) do
            if not Spawner.Blocked[entry.ID]
                and allowed[entry.Rarity] then
                table.insert(out, entry)
            end
        end

        return out
    end

    function Spawner.purgeBlocked()
        local removed = 0

        pcall(function()
            local owned = Spawner.DB_Prof
                and Spawner.DB_Prof.Weapons
                and Spawner.DB_Prof.Weapons.Owned

            if type(owned) ~= "table" then
                return
            end

            for id in pairs(Spawner.Blocked) do
                if owned[id] ~= nil then
                    owned[id] = nil
                    removed += 1
                end
            end

            local rem = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
            local inv = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
            local changed = inv and inv:FindFirstChild("InventoryDataChanged")

            if changed then
                pcall(function()
                    changed:Fire()
                end)
            end
        end)

        notify(
            "Spawner",
            "Removed " .. tostring(removed) .. " blocked entries",
            "trash-2",
            3
        )

        return removed
    end
end

-- ============================================================
--  END SPAWNER

-- ============================================================
--  TRADE HELPER
--  Directly decorates the real MM2 trade window.
-- ============================================================
-- Imported MM2 currency database fallback from "отображение валют.lua".
local QH_MM2PriceDB = {}
local QH_MM2PriceDBReady = false
do
    local PRICE_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kenderlike/mm2-prices/refs/heads/main/prices.json"
    local function normalizeQHPriceName(v)
        v=tostring(v or ""):gsub("%s*%b()%s*$","")
        return v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower()
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,body=pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(PRICE_URL) end)
        if not ok or not body or body=="" then return end
        local decodedOk,data=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
        if not decodedOk or type(data)~="table" then return end

        local colors={
            common=true, uncommon=true, rare=true, legendary=true,
            godly_chroma=true, vintage=true, ancient_evo=true,
        }

        local function walk(node)
            for key,value in pairs(node) do
                if type(value)=="table" then
                    local hasPrice=false
                    for k in pairs(value) do
                        if colors[tostring(k):lower()] then hasPrice=true break end
                    end
                    if hasPrice then
                        for variant,price in pairs(value) do
                            local full=tostring(key).."_"..tostring(variant)
                            local n=tonumber(price)
                            if n then
                                QH_MM2PriceDB[normalizeQHPriceName(full)]={number=n,text=tostring(price)}
                            end
                        end
                        local first
                        for _,price in pairs(value) do
                            if tonumber(price) then first=tonumber(price) break end
                        end
                        if first then
                            QH_MM2PriceDB[normalizeQHPriceName(key)]={number=first,text=tostring(first)}
                        end
                    else
                        walk(value)
                    end
                else
                    local n=tonumber(value)
                    if n then
                        QH_MM2PriceDB[normalizeQHPriceName(key)]={number=n,text=tostring(n)}
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        walk(data)
        QH_MM2PriceDBReady=true
    end)
end

local TradeHelper = {}
do
    TradeHelper.cache = {}
    TradeHelper.cacheTime = {}
    TradeHelper.CACHE_TTL = 600
    TradeHelper.enabled = false
    TradeHelper.connections = {}
    TradeHelper.lastTradeRoot = nil
    TradeHelper.valueInFlight = {}

    local VALUE_PAGES = {
        "godlies",
        "chromas",
        "ancients",
        "legendaries",
        "rares",
        "commons",
        "pets",
        "misc",
        "sets",
    }

    local function normalizeName(name)
        name = tostring(name or "")
        name = name:gsub("<[^>]->", "")
        name = name:gsub("[%[%]%(%){}]", " ")
        name = name:gsub("_g_%d+", "")
        name = name:gsub("_k_%d+", "")
        name = name:gsub("_", " ")
        name = name:gsub("%s+", " ")
        name = name:lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        return name
    end

    local function parseValue(text)
        if type(text) == "number" then
            return text, tostring(text)
        end
        text = tostring(text or ""):gsub(",", ""):gsub("%s+", " ")
        local k = tonumber(text:match("([%d%.]+)%s*[kK]"))
        if k then return k * 1000, tostring(k * 1000) end
        local m = tonumber(text:match("([%d%.]+)%s*[mM]"))
        if m then return m * 1000000, tostring(m * 1000000) end
        local x = text:match("([xX]%s*[%d%.]+.-)$")
        if x then return nil, x end
        local n = tonumber(text:match("([%d%.]+)"))
        if n then return n, tostring(n) end
        return nil, nil
    end

    local function cacheValue(name, num, text)
        local key = normalizeName(name)
        if key == "" or not text then return end
        TradeHelper.cache[key] = {number = num, text = text}
        TradeHelper.cacheTime[key] = tick()
    end

    local function parseItemPage(html)
        if not html or html == "" then return nil, nil end
        local valueText =
            html:match("Value%s*%-%s*([^<\r\n]+)")
            or html:match("Value%s*:%s*([^<\r\n]+)")
        if not valueText then return nil, nil end
        valueText = valueText:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        valueText = valueText:gsub("%s+Range.*$", "")
        local num, text = parseValue(valueText)
        return num, text or valueText
    end

    local function fetchItemValue(itemName)
        -- First use the imported MM2 price database from отображение валют.lua.
        if QH_MM2PriceDBReady then
            local key = normalizeName(itemName)
            local direct = QH_MM2PriceDB[key]
            if direct then
                return direct.number, direct.text
            end
            local simplified = normalizeName(tostring(itemName):gsub("[%[%]%(%){}]", " "))
            direct = QH_MM2PriceDB[simplified]
            if direct then
                return direct.number, direct.text
            end
            for dbName,entry in pairs(QH_MM2PriceDB) do
                if dbName:find(key,1,true) or key:find(dbName,1,true) then
                    return entry.number, entry.text
                end
            end
        end

        local encoded = HttpService:UrlEncode(itemName)
        for _, page in ipairs(VALUE_PAGES) do
            local html
            local ok = pcall(function()
                html = QH_HttpGet("https://supremevalues.com/mm2/" .. page .. "?item=" .. encoded)
            end)
            if ok and html and html ~= "" then
                local num, text = parseItemPage(html)
                if text then
                    return num, text
                end
            end
        end
        return nil, nil
    end

    function TradeHelper.getItemValue(itemName)
        local key = normalizeName(itemName)
        if key == "" then return nil, nil end

        local now = tick()
        local cached = TradeHelper.cache[key]
        if cached and (now - (TradeHelper.cacheTime[key] or 0)) < TradeHelper.CACHE_TTL then
            return cached.number, cached.text
        end

        if TradeHelper.valueInFlight[key] then
            return nil, "..."
        end

        TradeHelper.valueInFlight[key] = true
        local num, text = fetchItemValue(itemName)
        TradeHelper.valueInFlight[key] = nil

        if text then
            cacheValue(itemName, num, text)
            return num, text
        end

        return nil, nil
    end

    local function isVisibleGui(obj)
        if not obj or not obj:IsA("GuiObject") then return false end
        local p = obj
        while p and p ~= LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") do
            if p:IsA("GuiObject") and not p.Visible then return false end
            p = p.Parent
        end
        return true
    end

    local function textEquals(text, wanted)
        return normalizeName(text) == normalizeName(wanted)
    end

    local function commonAncestor(a, b)
        if not a or not b then return nil end
        local seen = {}
        local x = a
        for _ = 1, 12 do
            if not x then break end
            seen[x] = true
            x = x.Parent
        end
        local y = b
        for _ = 1, 12 do
            if not y then break end
            if seen[y] then return y end
            y = y.Parent
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function findTradeRoot()
        local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if not pg then return nil end

        local yourHeader, theirHeader
        for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
            if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) and d:IsDescendantOf(pg) then
                local txt = tostring(d.Text or "")
                if isVisibleGui(d) then
                    if textEquals(txt, "YOUR OFFER") then yourHeader = d end
                    if textEquals(txt, "THEIR OFFER") then theirHeader = d end
                    if yourHeader and theirHeader then break end
                end
            end
        end

        if yourHeader and theirHeader then
            local root = commonAncestor(yourHeader, theirHeader)
            if root and root:IsA("GuiObject") then
                return root
            end
        end

        -- Fallback: find the smallest visible GUI object that contains both labels.
        local candidate
        for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("GuiObject") and isVisibleGui(d) then
                local hasYour, hasTheir = false, false
                for _, x in ipairs(d:GetDescendants()) do
                    if x:IsA("TextLabel") or x:IsA("TextButton") then
                        local t = normalizeName(x.Text)
                        if t == "your offer" then hasYour = true end
                        if t == "their offer" then hasTheir = true end
                        if hasYour and hasTheir then break end
                    end
                end
                if hasYour and hasTheir then
                    if not candidate or (#d:GetDescendants() < #candidate:GetDescendants()) then
                        candidate = d
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return candidate
    end

    local function findSlotFromLabel(label)
        local node = label
        for _ = 1, 8 do
            if not node then break end
            if node:IsA("GuiObject") and node ~= label then
                local s = node.AbsoluteSize
                if s.X >= 60 and s.X <= 180 and s.Y >= 55 and s.Y <= 180 then
                    return node
                end
            end
            node = node.Parent
        end
        return label.Parent
    end

    local function ensureBadge(slot, text)
        if not slot or not slot:IsA("GuiObject") then return end
        local badge = slot:FindFirstChild("QH_TradeValue")
        if not badge then
            badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            badge.Name = "QH_TradeValue"
            badge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1)
            badge.Position = UDim2.new(1, -3, 1, -3)
            badge.Size = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 17)
            badge.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 12, 28)
            badge.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            badge.BorderSizePixel = 0
            badge.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 80)
            badge.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
            badge.TextSize = 10
            badge.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            badge.ZIndex = 500
            badge.Parent = slot
            Instance.new("UICorner", badge).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
        end
        badge.Text = text and ("V: " .. tostring(text)) or "V: ?"
        badge.Visible = TradeHelper.enabled
    end

    local function removeOverlay(root)
        if not root then return end
        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            if (d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Name == "QH_TradeValue") or d.Name == "QH_TradeTotals" then
                pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end

    local function ensureTotals(root, offerTotal, receiveTotal)
        local totals = root:FindFirstChild("QH_TradeTotals")
        if not totals then
            totals = Instance.new("Frame")
            totals.Name = "QH_TradeTotals"
            totals.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
            totals.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -4)
            totals.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 28)
            totals.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(13, 7, 24)
            totals.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
            totals.BorderSizePixel = 0
            totals.ZIndex = 490
            totals.Parent = root
            Instance.new("UICorner", totals).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

            local you = Instance.new("TextLabel", totals)
            you.Name = "You"
            you.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
            you.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            you.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 245, 120)
            you.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            you.TextSize = 11
            you.ZIndex = 491

            local them = Instance.new("TextLabel", totals)
            them.Name = "Them"
            them.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
            them.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
            them.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            them.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 170, 255)
            them.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            them.TextSize = 11
            them.ZIndex = 491
        end

        local you = totals:FindFirstChild("You")
        local them = totals:FindFirstChild("Them")
        if you then you.Text = "YOU: " .. tostring(math.floor(offerTotal or 0)) end
        if them then them.Text = "THEM: " .. tostring(math.floor(receiveTotal or 0)) end
    end

    function TradeHelper.clearOverlay()
        if TradeHelper.lastTradeRoot and TradeHelper.lastTradeRoot.Parent then
            removeOverlay(TradeHelper.lastTradeRoot)
        end
        local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if pg then
            for _, d in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
                if d.Name == "QH_TradeValue" or d.Name == "QH_TradeTotals" then
                    pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end
        TradeHelper.lastTradeRoot = nil
    end

    function TradeHelper.refreshOverlay()
        if not TradeHelper.enabled then
            TradeHelper.clearOverlay()
            return
        end

        local root = findTradeRoot()
        if not root then
            TradeHelper.clearOverlay()
            return
        end
        TradeHelper.lastTradeRoot = root

        local headers = {}
        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
                local t = normalizeName(d.Text)
                if t == "your offer" then headers.your = d end
                if t == "their offer" then headers.their = d end
            end
        end

        local topY = headers.your and headers.your.AbsolutePosition.Y or root.AbsolutePosition.Y
        local splitY = headers.their and headers.their.AbsolutePosition.Y or (root.AbsolutePosition.Y + root.AbsoluteSize.Y * 0.5)
        local totals = {offer = 0, receive = 0}
        local seen = {}

        for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
            if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) and isVisibleGui(d) then
                local text = tostring(d.Text or "")
                local norm = normalizeName(text)
                if norm ~= "" and not seen[d] and norm ~= "your offer" and norm ~= "their offer" then
                    -- Only treat reasonably small labels as item-name candidates.
                    if #text <= 36 and not norm:find("please wait", 1, true) and not norm:find("decline", 1, true)
                       and not norm:find("accept", 1, true) and not norm:find("search", 1, true) then
                        local key = normalizeName(text)
                        local cached = TradeHelper.cache[key]
                        local num, valueText
                        if cached and (tick() - (TradeHelper.cacheTime[key] or 0)) < TradeHelper.CACHE_TTL then
                            num, valueText = cached.number, cached.text
                        else
                            num, valueText = TradeHelper.getItemValue(text)
                        end

                        if valueText then
                            seen[d] = true
                            local slot = findSlotFromLabel(d)
                            ensureBadge(slot, valueText)
                            if d.AbsolutePosition.Y < splitY then
                                if num then totals.offer += num end
                            elseif d.AbsolutePosition.Y > splitY then
                                if num then totals.receive += num end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        ensureTotals(root, totals.offer, totals.receive)
    end

    function TradeHelper.toggle(v)
        TradeHelper.enabled = v == true
        if not TradeHelper.enabled then
            TradeHelper.clearOverlay()
            return
        end
        task.defer(TradeHelper.refreshOverlay)
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(0.5)
            if TradeHelper.enabled then
                pcall(TradeHelper.refreshOverlay)
            end
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        local pg = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        pg.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if not TradeHelper.enabled then return end
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(TradeHelper.refreshOverlay)
            end)
        end)
        pg.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function()
            if not TradeHelper.enabled then return end
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(TradeHelper.refreshOverlay)
            end)
        end)
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
--  ROLE DETECTION
-- ============================================================
local Roles = {}
do
    -- MM2 exposes role information through GetPlayerData. Tool-based detection
    -- is kept as a fallback for the short period when the remote has not updated.
    local roleCache = {}
    local lastRoleRefresh = 0
    local roleRefreshBusy = false

    function Roles.refreshData(force)
        if roleRefreshBusy then return roleCache end
        if not force and tick() - lastRoleRefresh < 0.35 then
            return roleCache
        end

        roleRefreshBusy = true
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("GetPlayerData", true)
            if not remote or typeof(remote.InvokeServer) ~= "function" then
                return nil
            end
            return remote:InvokeServer()
        end)

        if ok and type(result) == "table" then
            roleCache = result
            lastRoleRefresh = tick()
        else
            lastRoleRefresh = tick()
        end

        roleRefreshBusy = false
        return roleCache
    end

    local function dataRole(pl)
        if not pl then return nil end
        local data = roleCache[pl.Name] or roleCache[tostring(pl.UserId)]
        if type(data) == "table" then
            local role = data.Role
            if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" or role == "Innocent" then
                return role
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    function Roles.getRole(pl)
        local role = dataRole(pl)
        if role then return role end

        if pl and pl.Character then
            local attr = pl.Character:GetAttribute("Role") or pl:GetAttribute("Role")
            if attr == "Murderer" or attr == "Sheriff" or attr == "Hero" or attr == "Innocent" then
                return attr
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    function Roles.getMurderer()
        Roles.refreshData(false)
        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and Roles.getRole(pl) == "Murderer" then
                return pl
            end
        end

        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer then
                local bp = pl:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                local ch = pl.Character
                if bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Knife") then return pl end
                if ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Knife") then return pl end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    function Roles.getSheriff()
        Roles.refreshData(false)

        -- Do not let a dropped gun hide the sheriff when GetPlayerData already
        -- knows the actual role during intermission / pre-round.
        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and Roles.getRole(pl) == "Sheriff" then
                return pl
            end
        end

        if workspace:FindFirstChild("GunDrop", true) then return nil end
        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Character then
                local bp = pl:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                if pl.Character:FindFirstChild("Gun") then return pl end
                if bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Gun") then return pl end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    function Roles.getHero()
        Roles.refreshData(false)
        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and Roles.getRole(pl) == "Hero" then
                return pl
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
end

-- ============================================================
--  FLING
-- ============================================================
local Fling = {}
do
    function Fling.execute(TP)
        if not TP or not TP.Character then return end
        local Ch = LocalPlayer.Character
        local Hm = Ch and (Ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or Ch:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"))
        local RP = Ch and (Ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or Ch.PrimaryPart)
        local TC = TP.Character
        local TH, TR, THd, Acc, Hdl
        if TC then TH = TC:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end
        if TH then TR = TC:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or TC.PrimaryPart or TH.RootPart end
        if TC then THd = TC:FindFirstChild("Head") Acc = TC:FindFirstChildOfClass("Accessory") end
        if Acc then Hdl = Acc:FindFirstChild("Handle") end
        if not (Ch and Hm and RP) then return end
        if RP.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then S.OldPos = RP.CFrame end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if THd then cam.CameraSubject = THd
        elseif Hdl then cam.CameraSubject = Hdl
        elseif TH and TR then cam.CameraSubject = TH end
        if not (TC and TC:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")) then return end

        local function FP(B, P, A)
            RP.CFrame = CFrame.new(B.Position) * P * A
            pcall(function()
                if Ch and Ch.PrimaryPart then Ch:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(B.Position) * P * A) end
            end)
            RP.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e7, 9e8, 9e7)
            RP.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
        end

        local function SF(B)
            local TW = 2 local T = tick() local An = 0
            repeat
                if RP and TH then
                    if B.Velocity.Magnitude < 50 then
                        An = An + 100
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,1.5,0) + TH.MoveDirection*B.Velocity.Magnitude/1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(An),0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,-1.5,0) + TH.MoveDirection*B.Velocity.Magnitude/1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(An),0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(2.25,1.5,-2.25) + TH.MoveDirection*B.Velocity.Magnitude/1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(An),0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(-2.25,-1.5,2.25) + TH.MoveDirection*B.Velocity.Magnitude/1.25, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(An),0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,1.5,0) + TH.MoveDirection, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(An),0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,-1.5,0) + TH.MoveDirection, CFrame.Angles(math.rad(An),0,0)) task.wait()
                    else
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,1.5,TH.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90),0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,-1.5,-TH.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(0,0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,1.5,TH.WalkSpeed), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90),0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,1.5, TR and TR.Velocity.Magnitude/1.25 or 0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90),0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,-1.5, -(TR and TR.Velocity.Magnitude/1.25 or 0)), CFrame.Angles(0,0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,-1.5,0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90),0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,-1.5,0), CFrame.Angles(0,0,0)) task.wait()
                        FP(B, CFrame.new(0,-1.5,0), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90),0,0)) task.wait()
                    end
                else break end
            until B.Velocity.Magnitude > 500
                or B.Parent ~= TP.Character
                or TP.Parent ~= Players
                or TP.Character ~= TC
                or (TH and TH.Sit)
                or (Hm and Hm.Health <= 0)
                or tick() > T + TW
        end

        if not S.FPDH then S.FPDH = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight end
        workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
        local BV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        BV.Name = "EpixVel" BV.Parent = RP
        BV.Velocity = Vector3.new(9e8, 9e8, 9e8)
        BV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1/0, 1/0, 1/0)
        Hm:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, false)
        if TR and THd then
            if (TR.CFrame.p - THd.CFrame.p).Magnitude > 5 then SF(THd) else SF(TR) end
        elseif TR then SF(TR)
        elseif THd then SF(THd)
        elseif Acc and Hdl then SF(Hdl) end
        if BV and BV.Parent then BV:Destroy() end
        Hm:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
        cam.CameraSubject = Hm
        local lim = tick() + 5
        repeat
            if S.OldPos then
                RP.CFrame = S.OldPos * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0)
                pcall(function()
                    if Ch and Ch.PrimaryPart then Ch:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(S.OldPos * CFrame.new(0,0.5,0)) end
                end)
            end
            Hm:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
            for _, x in ipairs(Ch:GetChildren()) do
                if x:IsA("BasePart") then x.Velocity = Vector3.new() x.RotVelocity = Vector3.new() end
            end
            task.wait()
        until not S.OldPos or (RP.Position - S.OldPos.p).Magnitude < 25 or tick() > lim
        if S.FPDH then workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = S.FPDH end
    end

    function Fling.murderer()
        local m = Roles.getMurderer()
        if m and m.Character then U.notify("Fling","Flinging "..m.Name,"zap",3) task.spawn(function() Fling.execute(m) end) return true end
        U.notify("Fling","No murderer","x-circle",3) return false
    end
    function Fling.sheriff()
        local s = Roles.getSheriff()
        if s and s.Character then U.notify("Fling","Flinging "..s.Name,"zap",3) task.spawn(function() Fling.execute(s) end) return true end
        U.notify("Fling","No sheriff","x-circle",3) return false
    end
    function Fling.hero()
        local h = Roles.getHero()
        if h and h.Character then task.spawn(function() Fling.execute(h) end) return true end
        return false
    end
    function Fling.selected()
        if S.selectedFlingPlayer and S.selectedFlingPlayer.Character then
            task.spawn(function() Fling.execute(S.selectedFlingPlayer) end)
        end
    end
    function Fling.all()
        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Character then
                task.spawn(function() Fling.execute(pl) end)
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end
    end
end
