-- ============================================================
--  COMBAT
-- ============================================================
local QH_PlayMurderKillSound

local Combat = {}
do
    -- Stable target tracking. The previous version derived acceleration from
    -- replicated samples; in MM2 that can spike for one frame and push the
    -- shot past a strafing target. Keep the lead conservative and smooth.
    local aimHistory = {}
    local sizeHistory = {}

    function Combat.getPingSeconds()
        local ping = 0
        pcall(function() ping = LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing() or 0 end)
        if type(ping) ~= "number" or ping < 0 then ping = 0 end
        if ping > 1 then ping = ping / 1000 end
        return math.clamp(ping, 0, 1)
    end

    local function safeMagnitude(v)
        return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.Magnitude or 0
    end

    local function getAimPart(character)
        if not character then return nil end

        -- Prefer a stable torso part. Head is deliberately only a fallback:
        -- smaller hit regions are more sensitive to replication jitter.
        return character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    end

    local function getCharacterProfile(character)
        if not character then
            return {
                class = "unknown",
                size = Vector3.new(2, 5, 2),
                height = 5,
                width = 2,
                depth = 2,
                horizontal = 2,
                ratio = 1,
            }
        end

        local ok, box = pcall(function()
            local _, sz = character:GetBoundingBox()
            return sz
        end)

        local size = (ok and typeof(box) == "Vector3" and box)
            or Vector3.new(2, 5, 2)

        local height = math.max(size.Y, 0.1)
        local width = math.max(size.X, 0.1)
        local depth = math.max(size.Z, 0.1)
        local horizontal = math.max(width, depth)
        local ratio = horizontal / height

        -- Relative classification rather than fixed part names:
        -- works across R6/R15 and avatar scale packages.
        local isSmall = height < 4.20 or size.Magnitude < 5.45
        local isLarge = height > 6.30 or size.Magnitude > 8.40
        local isThin = ratio < 0.40
        local isFat = ratio > 0.58

        local class = "normal"
        if isSmall and isThin then
            class = "small_thin"
        elseif isSmall and isFat then
            class = "small_fat"
        elseif isLarge and isThin then
            class = "large_thin"
        elseif isLarge and isFat then
            class = "large_fat"
        elseif isSmall then
            class = "small"
        elseif isLarge then
            class = "large"
        elseif isThin then
            class = "thin"
        elseif isFat then
            class = "fat"
        end

        return {
            class = class,
            size = size,
            height = height,
            width = width,
            depth = depth,
            horizontal = horizontal,
            ratio = ratio,
        }
    end

    function Combat.getModelProfile(target)
        if not target or not target.Character then return nil end
        return getCharacterProfile(target.Character)
    end

    local function profileOffset(profile)
        if not profile then return Vector3.zero end

        -- Larger/fatter characters have more forgiving torso volume, so stay
        -- close to torso center. Small/thin avatars get a conservative center
        -- offset that avoids aiming above the actual collision volume.
        local y
        if profile.class == "small_thin" then
            y = -0.14
        elseif profile.class == "small_fat" then
            y = -0.08
        elseif profile.class == "small" then
            y = -0.10
        elseif profile.class == "large_thin" then
            y = 0.02
        elseif profile.class == "large_fat" then
            y = 0.05
        elseif profile.class == "large" then
            y = 0.03
        elseif profile.class == "thin" then
            y = -0.04
        elseif profile.class == "fat" then
            y = 0.04
        else
            y = 0
        end

        local widthWeight = math.clamp(profile.horizontal - 2, -0.8, 1.8)
        return Vector3.new(0, y + widthWeight * 0.01, 0)
    end

    local function getTrackedMotion(target, hrp)
        local key = target.UserId or target.Name
        local now = os.clock()
        local pos = hrp.Position
        local reported = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
        local old = aimHistory[key]

        local measured = reported
        local dt = 1/60
        local previousVelocity = reported

        if old then
            dt = math.clamp(now - old.t, 1/240, 0.15)
            local delta = pos - old.p
            if delta.Magnitude <= 30 then
                measured = delta / dt
            end
            previousVelocity = old.v or reported
        end

        -- Measured horizontal motion reacts better to strafes; replicated
        -- velocity remains useful for vertical movement.
        local horizontal = Vector3.new(
            measured.X * 0.62 + reported.X * 0.23 + (hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X) * 0.15,
            0,
            measured.Z * 0.62 + reported.Z * 0.23 + (hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z) * 0.15
        )
        local vertical = reported.Y * 0.80 + measured.Y * 0.20
        local velocity = Vector3.new(horizontal.X, vertical, horizontal.Z)

        if velocity.Magnitude > 120 then
            velocity = velocity.Unit * 120
        end

        local acceleration = Vector3.zero
        if old then
            acceleration = (velocity - previousVelocity) / dt
            acceleration *= 0.34
            if acceleration.Magnitude > 300 then
                acceleration = acceleration.Unit * 300
            end
        end

        local directionStability = 1
        local prevH = Vector3.new(previousVelocity.X, 0, previousVelocity.Z)
        local curH = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)

        if prevH.Magnitude > 3 and curH.Magnitude > 3 then
            local dot = prevH.Unit:Dot(curH.Unit)
            if dot < -0.35 then
                -- Direction reversal: do not over-lead into the old direction.
                directionStability = 0.50
            elseif dot < 0.20 then
                directionStability = 0.72
            elseif dot > 0.85 then
                directionStability = 1.08
            end
        end

        aimHistory[key] = {
            p = pos,
            v = velocity,
            a = acceleration,
            t = now,
            stability = directionStability,
        }

        return velocity, acceleration, directionStability, dt
    end

    function Combat.resolvedPos(target)
        if not target or not target.Character then return nil end
        local part = getAimPart(target.Character)
        local hrp = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not part or not hrp then return nil end

        S.lastKnownPositions[target.Name] = hrp.Position
        return part.Position
    end

    function Combat.predictPosition(target, manualMs)
        if not target or not target.Character then return Vector3.zero end

        local hrp = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local aimPart = getAimPart(target.Character)
        if not hrp or not aimPart then return Vector3.zero end

        local profile = getCharacterProfile(target.Character)
        local base = aimPart.Position + profileOffset(profile)
        local velocity, acceleration, directionStability = getTrackedMotion(target, hrp)
        local ping = Combat.getPingSeconds()
        local configured = math.clamp(tonumber(manualMs) or 0, 0, 500) / 1000

        local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
        local lead = 0.030 + ping * 0.34 + configured

        if speed > 65 then
            lead += math.clamp((speed - 65) / 1150, 0, 0.06)
        elseif speed < 8 then
            lead *= 0.80
        end

        if profile then
            local sizeBonus = math.clamp((profile.horizontal - 2.0) * 0.008, -0.012, 0.028)
            lead += sizeBonus
        end

        lead *= directionStability
        lead = math.clamp(lead, 0.018, 0.205)

        local hum = target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
            lead *= 0.84
        end

        local horizontalVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
        local verticalVelocity = Vector3.new(0, velocity.Y, 0)
        local horizontalAcceleration = Vector3.new(acceleration.X, 0, acceleration.Z)

        local predicted = base
            + horizontalVelocity * lead
            + horizontalAcceleration * (0.5 * lead * lead)
            + verticalVelocity * (lead * 0.42)

        if typeof(predicted) ~= "Vector3"
            or predicted.X ~= predicted.X
            or predicted.Y ~= predicted.Y
            or predicted.Z ~= predicted.Z
        then
            return base
        end

        local delta = predicted - base
        local maxLeadDistance =
            math.clamp(2.0 + speed * lead * 1.45 + profile.horizontal * 0.35, 2.0, 14.5)

        if delta.Magnitude > maxLeadDistance then
            predicted = base + delta.Unit * maxLeadDistance
        end

        return predicted
    end

    -- NOMISS:
    -- 1) estimates true movement from replicated + measured velocity;
    -- 2) estimates acceleration for curved/strafing movement;
    -- 3) classifies avatar dimensions;
    -- 4) chooses a torso-centered point with a size-aware offset;
    -- 5) smooths aim between the current and predicted point to avoid
    --    frame-to-frame jumps when replication spikes.
    function Combat.nomiss(target)
        if not target or not target.Character then return nil end

        local character = target.Character
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return nil end

        local part = getAimPart(character)
        if not part then return nil end

        local profile = getCharacterProfile(character)
        local base = part.Position + profileOffset(profile)
        local velocity, acceleration, stability, dt = getTrackedMotion(target, root)

        local ping = Combat.getPingSeconds()
        local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude

        -- Adaptive lead. The server/player latency contributes a smaller term
        -- than raw speed so close fast strafes do not get dramatically over-led.
        local lead = 0.045 + ping * 0.40
        lead += math.clamp(speed * 0.00115, 0, 0.095)

        if stability < 0.65 then
            lead *= 0.62
        elseif stability > 1.02 then
            lead *= 1.06
        end

        if profile then
            local sizeDelta = math.clamp(profile.horizontal - 2.0, -1.0, 2.5)
            lead += sizeDelta * 0.0065
        end

        lead = math.clamp(
            lead,
            tonumber(S.nomissMinLead) or 0.045,
            tonumber(S.nomissMaxLead) or 0.205
        )

        local horizontalVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
        local horizontalAcceleration = Vector3.new(acceleration.X, 0, acceleration.Z)
        local vertical = Vector3.new(0, velocity.Y, 0)

        local predicted = base
            + horizontalVelocity * lead
            + horizontalAcceleration * (0.5 * lead * lead)
            + vertical * (lead * 0.38)

        -- Reject pathological points caused by a transient replicated sample.
        local maxDistance =
            math.clamp(
                2.0
                    + speed * lead * 1.50
                    + (profile and profile.horizontal or 2) * 0.30,
                2.0,
                15.0
            )

        local delta = predicted - base
        if delta.Magnitude > maxDistance then
            predicted = base + delta.Unit * maxDistance
        end

        -- Adaptive smoothing: when dt is large, reduce the correction so a
        -- mobile frame hitch cannot produce a giant one-frame aim jump.
        local configuredSmooth = math.clamp(tonumber(S.nomissSmoothing) or 0.68, 0.35, 0.90)
        local frameFactor = math.clamp(dt * 60, 0.55, 1.40)
        local alpha = math.clamp(
            configuredSmooth / frameFactor,
            0.32,
            0.82
        )

        local key = target.UserId or target.Name
        local previousPoint = sizeHistory[key] and sizeHistory[key].point
        if previousPoint then
            predicted = previousPoint:Lerp(predicted, alpha)
        end

        sizeHistory[key] = {
            point = predicted,
            class = profile and profile.class or "normal",
            size = profile and profile.size or Vector3.new(2,5,2),
            t = os.clock(),
        }

        return predicted
    end

    -- Aimbot V2: stable Osiris-compatible prediction.
    -- The important fix here is to avoid using a single raw replicated velocity
    -- sample for a running/strafe target. We blend the target part velocity with
    -- measured root motion, then apply the supplied 0.165 lead.
    -- ============================================================
    -- AIM V4
    -- ============================================================
    -- Motion history and final aim history are kept separately. This prevents
    -- the final-point smoothing from being accidentally overwritten by the
    -- next motion sample.
    local AimV4 = {
        Motion = {},
        FinalPoint = {},
        Confidence = {},
    }

    local Osiriscc = {
        Prediction = 0.165,
        MaxLeadDistance = 18,
        History = {},
        Accel = {},
    }

    local function qhAimVelocity(target, root, part)
        local key = target.UserId or target.Name
        local now = os.clock()
        local pos = root.Position
        local reported = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
        local partVelocity = part and (part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero) or Vector3.zero
        local prev = AimV4.Motion[key]

        local dt = 1 / 60
        local displacementVelocity = reported

        if prev then
            dt = math.clamp(now - prev.t, 1 / 240, 0.075)
            local delta = pos - prev.p
            -- Reject implausible single-frame replication jumps.
            if delta.Magnitude <= math.max(8, reported.Magnitude * dt * 1.8 + 4) then
                displacementVelocity = delta / dt
            end
        end

        local velocity = Vector3.new(
            displacementVelocity.X * 0.58 + reported.X * 0.24 + partVelocity.X * 0.18,
            reported.Y * 0.86 + partVelocity.Y * 0.14,
            displacementVelocity.Z * 0.58 + reported.Z * 0.24 + partVelocity.Z * 0.18
        )

        if velocity.Magnitude > 180 then
            velocity = velocity.Unit * 180
        end

        local acceleration = Vector3.zero
        local turnRate = 0

        if prev and prev.v then
            acceleration = (velocity - prev.v) / dt
            acceleration = Vector3.new(acceleration.X, 0, acceleration.Z)

            if acceleration.Magnitude > 240 then
                acceleration = acceleration.Unit * 240
            end

            local oldH = Vector3.new(prev.v.X, 0, prev.v.Z)
            local newH = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
            if oldH.Magnitude > 2 and newH.Magnitude > 2 then
                local dot = math.clamp(oldH.Unit:Dot(newH.Unit), -1, 1)
                turnRate = math.acos(dot) / dt
            end
        end

        local confidence = 1
        if prev then
            local d = (pos - prev.p).Magnitude
            if d > 8 then
                confidence = 0.35
            elseif dt > 0.055 then
                confidence = 0.55
            elseif dt > 0.038 then
                confidence = 0.78
            end
        end

        AimV4.Motion[key] = {p = pos, v = velocity, t = now}
        AimV4.Confidence[key] = confidence
        Osiriscc.History[key] = {p = pos, t = now, v = velocity}
        Osiriscc.Accel[key] = acceleration

        return velocity, acceleration, confidence, dt, turnRate
    end

    local function qhAirState(hum)
        local state = hum:GetState()
        local airborne =
            hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
            or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown

        local rising = state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or hum.Jump == true
        local falling = state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall and hum.Jump ~= true

        return airborne, rising, falling
    end

    local function qhPredictPoint(base, velocity, acceleration, horizon, airborne, rising, falling)
        local gravity = math.clamp(workspace.Gravity or 196.2, 100, 300)

        local horizontal = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
            * horizon
            + Vector3.new(acceleration.X, 0, acceleration.Z)
            * (0.5 * horizon * horizon)

        local y = velocity.Y * horizon
        if airborne then
            y -= 0.5 * gravity * horizon * horizon
            if rising then
                y += math.clamp(velocity.Y * 0.035, 0, 0.8)
            elseif falling then
                y -= math.clamp(math.abs(velocity.Y) * 0.018, 0, 0.6)
            end
        end

        return base + Vector3.new(horizontal.X, y, horizontal.Z)
    end

    function Combat.aimV2(target)
        if not target or not target.Character then return nil end

        local character = target.Character
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local part =
            character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            or root

        if not root or not part or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return nil
        end

        local profile = getCharacterProfile(character)
        local velocity, acceleration, confidence, dt, turnRate =
            qhAimVelocity(target, root, part)

        local ping = math.clamp(Combat.getPingSeconds(), 0, 0.45)
        local horizontal = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
        local speed = horizontal.Magnitude
        local airborne, rising, falling = qhAirState(hum)

        -- Core horizon: latency + a controlled speed term.
        local lead =
            0.050
            + ping * 0.36
            + math.clamp(speed * 0.00130, 0, 0.115)

        if airborne then
            lead += rising and 0.018 or 0.028
        end

        -- A fast direction change is more dangerous than a high ping: reduce
        -- extrapolation rather than firing far ahead of the target.
        if turnRate > 8 then
            lead *= 0.60
        elseif turnRate > 4 then
            lead *= 0.77
        elseif turnRate < 1.0 and speed > 14 then
            lead *= 1.045
        end

        lead *= math.clamp(0.76 + confidence * 0.24, 0.76, 1.0)
        lead = math.clamp(lead, 0.045, airborne and 0.30 or 0.255)

        local base = part.Position + profileOffset(profile)

        -- Three independent horizons.  Using the center point plus consensus
        -- keeps high-speed strafes from overshooting while preserving enough lead
        -- for ordinary running targets.
        local h1 = math.clamp(lead * 0.42, 0.032, 0.115)
        local h2 = lead
        local h3 = math.clamp(lead * 1.14, h2 + 0.018, 0.335)

        local p1 = qhPredictPoint(base, velocity, acceleration, h1, airborne, rising, falling)
        local p2 = qhPredictPoint(base, velocity, acceleration, h2, airborne, rising, falling)
        local p3 = qhPredictPoint(base, velocity, acceleration, h3, airborne, rising, falling)

        local spread = (p3 - p1).Magnitude
        local w1 = spread > 8 and 0.50 or (spread > 5 and 0.40 or 0.32)
        local w3 = math.clamp(0.18 + confidence * 0.10, 0.18, 0.28)
        local w2 = math.max(0.22, 1 - w1 - w3)

        local predicted = p1 * w1 + p2 * w2 + p3 * w3

        -- Temporal correction. This finally uses the previous final aim point,
        -- not the just-overwritten motion sample.
        local key = target.UserId or target.Name
        local previous = AimV4.FinalPoint[key]

        if previous then
            local jump = (predicted - previous).Magnitude
            local alpha
            if turnRate > 7 or confidence < 0.55 then
                alpha = 0.45
            elseif jump > 7 then
                alpha = 0.76
            else
                alpha = 0.68
            end
            predicted = previous:Lerp(predicted, alpha)
        end

        local maxDistance = math.clamp(
            2.6
            + speed * lead * 1.75
            + (profile and profile.horizontal or 2) * 0.38,
            2.6,
            18.0
        )

        local delta = predicted - base
        if delta.Magnitude > maxDistance then
            predicted = base + delta.Unit * maxDistance
        end

        if predicted.X ~= predicted.X
            or predicted.Y ~= predicted.Y
            or predicted.Z ~= predicted.Z
        then
            predicted = base
        end

        AimV4.FinalPoint[key] = predicted
        return predicted
    end

    function Combat.stdPred(target)
        return Combat.predictPosition(target, S.predictionMs)
    end

    -- Shot sound bank.  All entries are local/client-side sound assets.
    -- "Random" picks one of the listed variations on every shot.
    local ShootSoundPresets = {
        ["MM2 Default"] = {id="__GAME_GUN_SOUND__", speed=1.00},
        ["Pulse"]       = {id="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", speed=1.05},
        ["Impact"]      = {id="rbxasset://sounds/collide.wav", speed=1.20},
        ["Arc"]         = {id="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", speed=1.35},
        ["Retro"]       = {id="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", speed=0.82},
        ["Heavy"]       = {id="rbxasset://sounds/collide.wav", speed=0.72},
        ["Plasma"]      = {id="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", speed=1.65},
        ["Dense"]       = {id="rbxasset://sounds/collide.wav", speed=1.55},
        ["Random"]      = {
            {id="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", speed=1.05},
            {id="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", speed=1.35},
            {id="rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav", speed=0.82},
            {id="rbxasset://sounds/collide.wav", speed=1.20},
            {id="rbxasset://sounds/collide.wav", speed=0.72},
            {id="rbxasset://sounds/collide.wav", speed=1.55},
        },
        ["Off"]         = {id="", speed=1.00},
    }

    -- Merge the complete hit-sound bank into Shot Sounds so every hit preset
    -- can also be used as a local shot sound. Keep existing shot names intact.
    for name, id in pairs(hitsounds) do
        if not ShootSoundPresets[name] then
            ShootSoundPresets[name] = {id=id, speed=1.00}
        end
    end
    ShootSoundPresets["Random Hit"] = (function()
        local pool = {}
        for name, id in pairs(hitsounds) do
            if name ~= "Default" and type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then
                pool[#pool+1] = {id=id, speed=1.00}
            end
        end
        return pool
    end)()

    local MURDER_KILL_SOUNDS = {}
    for name, id in pairs(hitsounds) do
        if type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then
            MURDER_KILL_SOUNDS[#MURDER_KILL_SOUNDS+1] = {name=name, id=id}
        end
    end

    QH_PlayMurderKillSound = function(targetCharacter)
        if not S.murderKillSoundEnabled then return end
        local root = targetCharacter and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        root = root or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        if not root then return end

        local chosen
        local preset = tostring(S.murderKillSoundPreset or "Random")
        if preset == "Random" then
            chosen = MURDER_KILL_SOUNDS[math.random(1, math.max(1, #MURDER_KILL_SOUNDS))]
        elseif hitsounds[preset] then
            chosen = {name=preset, id=hitsounds[preset]}
        end
        if not chosen then return end

        pcall(function()
            local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
            snd.Name = "QH_MurderKillSound"
            snd.SoundId = chosen.id
            snd.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(S.murderKillSoundVolume) or 0.8, 0, 2)
            snd.PlaybackSpeed = 1
            snd.Parent = root
            snd:Play()
            task.delay(5, function()
                if snd and snd.Parent then snd:Destroy() end
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- ORIGINAL + CUSTOM SHOT SOUND LAYER
    -- ============================================================
    local OriginalGunSound = {
        template=nil,
        soundId="",
        scanned=false,
        muted={},
        mutedById={},
    }

    local function soundScore(obj)
        if not obj or not obj:IsA("Sound") then return -math.huge end
        local id = tostring(obj.SoundId or "")
        if id == "" then return -math.huge end

        local name = obj.Name:lower()
        local parentName = obj.Parent and obj.Parent.Name:lower() or ""
        local score = 0

        if name:find("shoot", 1, true) then score += 30 end
        if name:find("shot", 1, true) then score += 24 end
        if name:find("gun", 1, true) then score += 22 end
        if name:find("fire", 1, true) then score += 18 end
        if parentName:find("gun", 1, true) then score += 20 end
        if parentName:find("weapon", 1, true) then score += 10 end
        if parentName:find("revolver", 1, true) then score += 16 end

        return score
    end

    local function scanOriginalGunSound()
        local best, bestScore = nil, -math.huge

        local function scan(container)
            if not container then return end
            for _, obj in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("Sound") then
                    local score = soundScore(obj)
                    if score > bestScore then
                        best = obj
                        bestScore = score
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        scan(character)
        scan(LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack"))

        local gun = character and (
            character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Revolver")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
        )
        scan(gun)

        if best then
            OriginalGunSound.template = best
            OriginalGunSound.soundId = tostring(best.SoundId or "")
        end

        OriginalGunSound.scanned = true
        return best
    end

    local function findGameGunSoundObject()
        if OriginalGunSound.template and OriginalGunSound.template.Parent then
            return OriginalGunSound.template
        end
        OriginalGunSound.scanned = false
        return scanOriginalGunSound()
    end

    local function findGameGunSoundId()
        local obj = findGameGunSoundObject()
        if obj then
            return tostring(obj.SoundId or "")
        end
        return OriginalGunSound.soundId
    end

    local function muteOriginalObject(obj)
        if not obj or not obj:IsA("Sound") then return end
        local id=tostring(obj.SoundId or "")
        if id=="" then return end
        if OriginalGunSound.soundId=="" or id~=OriginalGunSound.soundId then return end
        if OriginalGunSound.muted[obj]==nil then
            OriginalGunSound.muted[obj]=obj.Volume
        end
        obj.Volume=0
        OriginalGunSound.mutedById[id]=true
    end

    local function muteOriginalGunSound()
        local template=findGameGunSoundObject()
        if template then
            OriginalGunSound.soundId=tostring(template.SoundId or OriginalGunSound.soundId or "")
            muteOriginalObject(template)
        end

        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local backpack=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        local function scan(root)
            if not root then return end
            pcall(function()
                for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                    if obj:IsA("Sound") then muteOriginalObject(obj) end
                end
            end)
        end
        scan(char); scan(backpack)
    end

    local function playOriginalGameShotSound()
        -- Original MM2 shot is deliberately suppressed when a custom preset is selected.
        muteOriginalGunSound()
    end

    local function resolveShootSound()
        if S.shootSoundPreset == "Custom" and S.customShootSound ~= "" then
            return {id=S.customShootSound, speed=1.00}
        end

        local preset = ShootSoundPresets[S.shootSoundPreset]
        if type(preset) ~= "table" then
            return {id="", speed=1.00}
        end

        if #preset > 0 and preset[1] and preset[1].id then
            return preset[math.random(1, #preset)]
        end

        local soundId = preset.id or ""
        if soundId == "__GAME_GUN_SOUND__" then
            soundId = findGameGunSoundId()
        end

        return {
            id = soundId,
            speed = tonumber(preset.speed) or 1.00,
        }
    end

    function Combat.playShoot()
        -- Suppress the original weapon sound, then play only the selected preset.
        playOriginalGameShotSound()

        -- CUSTOM SHOT SOUND
        local info = resolveShootSound()
        if type(info) ~= "table" then return end

        local soundId = tostring(info.id or "")
        if soundId == ""
            or S.shootSoundPreset == "Off"
        then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            local hrp =
                LocalPlayer.Character
                and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if not hrp then return end

            local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
            snd.Name = "QH_ShotSound"
            snd.SoundId = soundId
            snd.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(S.customShootVolume) or 0.5, 0, 2)
            snd.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(info.speed) or 1, 0.25, 3)
            snd.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
            snd.RollOffMaxDistance = 90
            snd.Parent = hrp
            snd:Play()

            task.delay(3, function()
                if snd and snd.Parent then
                    snd:Destroy()
                end
            end)
        end)
    end

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        OriginalGunSound.template=nil
        OriginalGunSound.soundId=""
        OriginalGunSound.scanned=false
        table.clear(OriginalGunSound.muted)
        table.clear(OriginalGunSound.mutedById)
        task.defer(function()
            muteOriginalGunSound()
        end)
        character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if obj:IsA("Sound") then
                task.defer(function() muteOriginalObject(obj) end)
            end
        end)
    end)
    do
        local backpack=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if backpack then
            backpack.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if obj:IsA("Sound") then task.defer(function() muteOriginalObject(obj) end) end
            end)
        end
    end

    task.defer(function()
        muteOriginalGunSound()
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while game.Parent do
            if S.shootSoundPreset ~= "Off" then
                pcall(muteOriginalGunSound)
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)

    -- ------------------------------------------------------------
    -- SHOT TRACER
    -- Lightweight 3D beam that shows the projected shot path.
    -- The tracer is purely visual and does not alter the firing path.
    -- ------------------------------------------------------------
    local ShotTracer = {
        folder = nil,
    }

    local function tracerFolder()
        if ShotTracer.folder and ShotTracer.folder.Parent then
            return ShotTracer.folder
        end

        local f = Instance.new("Folder")
        f.Name = "QuantomHubShotTracers"
        f.Parent = workspace
        ShotTracer.folder = f
        return f
    end

    local function getShotOrigin(gun, fallback)
        if gun then
            local handle = gun:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
                local muzzle = handle:FindFirstChild("Muzzle", true)
                if muzzle and muzzle:IsA("Attachment") then
                    return muzzle.WorldPosition
                end
                local fire = handle:FindFirstChild("FirePoint", true)
                if fire and fire:IsA("Attachment") then
                    return fire.WorldPosition
                end
                return handle.Position
            end

            local rootPart = gun:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
            if rootPart then
                return rootPart.Position
            end
        end

        return fallback
    end

    local function traceEndpoint(origin, requestedPoint)
        if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end

        local direction = nil
        if typeof(requestedPoint) == "Vector3" then
            direction = requestedPoint - origin
        end

        if not direction or direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam then
                direction = cam.CFrame.LookVector * (tonumber(S.shotTracerRange) or 1000)
            else
                direction = Vector3.new(0,0,-1) * (tonumber(S.shotTracerRange) or 1000)
            end
        end

        local maxRange = math.max(50, tonumber(S.shotTracerRange) or 1000)
        if direction.Magnitude > maxRange then
            direction = direction.Unit * maxRange
        end

        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character}
        params.IgnoreWater = false

        local ok, hit = pcall(function()
            return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
        end)

        if ok and hit then
            return hit.Position
        end

        return origin + direction
    end

    function Combat.showBulletTracer(origin, requestedPoint)
        if not S.shotTracerEnabled then return end
        if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then return end

        local endpoint = traceEndpoint(origin, requestedPoint)
        if typeof(endpoint) ~= "Vector3" then return end

        pcall(function()
            local rootFolder = tracerFolder()

            local aPart = Instance.new("Part")
            aPart.Name = "QHTracerA"
            aPart.Anchored = true
            aPart.CanCollide = false
            aPart.CanQuery = false
            aPart.CanTouch = false
            aPart.Transparency = 1
            aPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.05,0.05,0.05)
            aPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(origin)
            aPart.Parent = rootFolder

            local bPart = Instance.new("Part")
            bPart.Name = "QHTracerB"
            bPart.Anchored = true
            bPart.CanCollide = false
            bPart.CanQuery = false
            bPart.CanTouch = false
            bPart.Transparency = 1
            bPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.05,0.05,0.05)
            bPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(endpoint)
            bPart.Parent = rootFolder

            local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            a0.Name = "A0"
            a0.Parent = aPart

            local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
            a1.Name = "A1"
            a1.Parent = bPart

            local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
            beam.Name = "QHShotTracer"
            beam.Attachment0 = a0
            beam.Attachment1 = a1
            beam.FaceCamera = true
            beam.LightEmission = 1
            beam.LightInfluence = 0
            beam.Segments = 1
            beam.Width0 = math.max(0.01, tonumber(S.shotTracerThickness) or 0.075)
            beam.Width1 = math.max(0.01, tonumber(S.shotTracerThickness) or 0.075) * 0.72
            beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(math.clamp(tonumber(S.shotTracerTransparency) or 0.08, 0, 1))
            beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(S.shotTracerColor or Color3.fromRGB(255,245,95))
            beam.Parent = aPart

            local life = math.clamp(tonumber(S.shotTracerLifetime) or 0.28, 0.05, 2)
            task.delay(life, function()
                pcall(function() aPart:Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() bPart:Destroy() end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    function Combat.playHit()
        local preset = tostring(S.hitSoundPreset or "Off")
        local soundId = hitsounds[preset] or tostring(S.customHitSound or "")
        if preset == "Off" or soundId == "" then return end
        pcall(function()
            local character = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then return end
            local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
            snd.Name = "QH_HitSound"
            snd.SoundId = soundId
            snd.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(S.customHitVolume) or 0.5, 0, 2)
            snd.Parent = hrp
            snd:Play()
            task.delay(4, function() if snd and snd.Parent then snd:Destroy() end end)
        end)
    end

    function Combat.inFOV(worldPos)
        if not S.fovCircleEnabled then return true end
        local sp, onScreen = CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
        if not onScreen then return false end
        return (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - CurrentCamera.ViewportSize / 2).Magnitude <= S.fovRadius
    end

    function Combat.hasLOS(lHrp, mHrp, targetChar)
        local rp = RaycastParams.new()
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character}
        rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            return workspace:Raycast(lHrp.Position, mHrp.Position - lHrp.Position, rp)
        end)
        if not ok or not res then return true end
        if res.Instance and targetChar and res.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetChar) then return true end
        return false
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- TARGET INTEGRITY / ANTI-OVERLAP
    -- Prevents firing when the predicted point belongs to another player
    -- who is physically overlapping the intended target. This is especially
    -- important for stacked autofarm clients.
    -- ============================================================
    local function pointInsideBoundingBox(point, boxCFrame, boxSize, padding)
        if typeof(point) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
        if typeof(boxCFrame) ~= "CFrame" or typeof(boxSize) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
        padding = tonumber(padding) or 0
        local localPoint = boxCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
        local half = boxSize * 0.5 + Vector3.new(padding, padding, padding)
        return math.abs(localPoint.X) <= half.X
            and math.abs(localPoint.Y) <= half.Y
            and math.abs(localPoint.Z) <= half.Z
    end

    local function getOtherCharacterAtPoint(point, target)
        if not S.targetIntegrityEnabled then return nil end
        local padding = tonumber(S.targetIntegrityPadding) or 0.08
        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl ~= target and pl.Character then
                local hum = pl.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local ok, cf, size = pcall(function()
                        local c, s = pl.Character:GetBoundingBox()
                        return c, s
                    end)
                    if ok and pointInsideBoundingBox(point, cf, size, padding) then
                        return pl
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function rayHitsCharacter(origin, point, character)
        if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(point) ~= "Vector3" or not character then
            return false, nil
        end
        local direction = point - origin
        if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then return false, nil end

        local rp = RaycastParams.new()
        rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character}
        rp.IgnoreWater = false

        local ok, hit = pcall(function()
            return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, rp)
        end)
        if not ok or not hit then
            return true, nil
        end
        return hit.Instance and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character) or false, hit.Instance
    end

    local function firstCharacterOnRay(origin, point, target)
        if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(point) ~= "Vector3" then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local direction = point - origin
        if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then return nil, nil end
        local rp = RaycastParams.new()
        rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character}
        rp.IgnoreWater = true
        local ok, hit = pcall(function()
            return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, rp)
        end)
        if not ok or not hit or not hit.Instance then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local model = hit.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        local pl = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
        if not pl or pl == LocalPlayer then
            return nil, hit.Instance
        end
        if target and pl == target then
            return target, hit.Instance
        end
        return pl, hit.Instance
    end

    local function getAimPartCandidates(target, origin, predictedPoint)
        local character = target and target.Character
        local part = character and getAimPart(character)
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not part or not root then return {} end

        local profile = getCharacterProfile(character)
        local w = math.max(profile and profile.horizontal or 2.0, 1.4)
        local h = math.max(profile and profile.height or 5.0, 3.0)
        local aimSize = part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Size or Vector3.new(w, math.min(h, 3), w)
        local half = aimSize * 0.5
        local toOrigin = origin - part.Position
        local flat = Vector3.new(toOrigin.X, 0, toOrigin.Z)
        if flat.Magnitude < 0.01 then flat = Vector3.new(0,0,1) else flat = flat.Unit end
        local right = Vector3.new(-flat.Z, 0, flat.X)
        local up = Vector3.new(0,1,0)
        local face = math.clamp(math.min(half.X, half.Z) * 0.70, 0.25, 0.75)
        local vert = math.clamp(half.Y * 0.28, 0.15, 0.60)
        local side = math.clamp(math.max(half.X, half.Z) * 0.34, 0.20, 0.65)

        local out = {
            predictedPoint,
            part.Position,
            part.Position + flat * face,
            part.Position + flat * face + right * side,
            part.Position + flat * face - right * side,
            part.Position + flat * face + up * vert,
            part.Position + flat * face - up * vert,
            root.Position + flat * math.clamp(w * 0.26, 0.25, 0.70),
            root.Position - flat * math.clamp(w * 0.20, 0.20, 0.55),
        }
        return out
    end

    function Combat.safeAimPoint(target, predictedPoint, origin, requireLOS)
        if not target or not target.Character then return nil end
        local character = target.Character
        local part = getAimPart(character)
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not part or not root then return nil end

        if not S.targetIntegrityEnabled then
            return predictedPoint
        end

        local candidates = getAimPartCandidates(target, origin, predictedPoint)
        local seen = {}
        for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
            if typeof(candidate) == "Vector3" then
                local key = string.format("%.3f|%.3f|%.3f", candidate.X, candidate.Y, candidate.Z)
                if not seen[key] then
                    seen[key] = true

                    -- First reject points that physically sit inside another
                    -- player's avatar. This catches stacked autofarm clients.
                    local occupant = getOtherCharacterAtPoint(candidate, target)
                    if not occupant then
                        -- Then verify that the first player model hit along the
                        -- shot path is the intended target. This catches the
                        -- harder case where another character is between the gun
                        -- and the chosen target point.
                        local firstPlayer = nil
                        if typeof(origin) == "Vector3" then
                            firstPlayer = select(1, firstCharacterOnRay(origin, candidate, target))
                        end

                        if firstPlayer == target then
                            return candidate
                        end

                        if not firstPlayer and not requireLOS then
                            return candidate
                        end

                        if requireLOS then
                            local hitTarget = rayHitsCharacter(origin, candidate, character)
                            if hitTarget and firstPlayer == nil then
                                return candidate
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    function Combat.targetIntegrity(target, predictedPoint)
        if not target or not target.Character then return false, nil end
        if not S.targetIntegrityEnabled then return true, predictedPoint end
        local other = getOtherCharacterAtPoint(predictedPoint, target)
        if other then
            return false, other
        end
        return true, nil
    end

    -- WallShot: the reference implementation temporarily moves the local
    -- character to the target's rear side, fires through the normal MM2 gun
    -- pipeline, then restores the exact original position.
    function Combat.wallShootMurderer(target, predPos, gun, lHrp)
        if not target or not target.Character or not gun or not lHrp then return false end
        local targetRoot = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not targetRoot or not character then return false end
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then return false end

        local oldCFrame = lHrp.CFrame
        local oldLinear = lHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local oldAngular = lHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity
        local point = (typeof(predPos) == "Vector3") and predPos or targetRoot.Position
        local fired = false

        local ok = pcall(function()
            -- Move temporarily behind the murderer so the normal MM2 shot validation
            -- sees the target as unobstructed.
            lHrp.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 6)
            lHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            lHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

            local freshChar = target.Character
            local freshRoot = freshChar and freshChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local freshPart = freshChar and getAimPart(freshChar)
            if freshPart then
                point = freshPart.Position
                if freshRoot then
                    local lead = math.clamp(0.018 + Combat.getPingSeconds() * 0.22, 0.018, 0.095)
                    point = point + (freshRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero) * lead
                end
            elseif freshRoot then
                point = freshRoot.Position
            end

            local activeGun = character:FindFirstChild("Gun") or gun
            if not activeGun then return end

            -- Use the exact same firing routes as the normal Shoot Murderer path.
            local gunServer = activeGun:FindFirstChild("GunServer")
            local shootStart = gunServer and gunServer:FindFirstChild("ShootStart")
            if shootStart and shootStart:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                shootStart:FireServer(point)
                fired = true
            end

            if not fired then
                local knifeLocal = activeGun:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                local createBeam = knifeLocal and knifeLocal:FindFirstChild("CreateBeam")
                local rf = createBeam and createBeam:FindFirstChild("RemoteFunction")
                if rf and typeof(rf.InvokeServer) == "function" then
                    rf:InvokeServer(1, point, "AH2")
                    fired = true
                end
            end

            if not fired then
                local shoot = activeGun:FindFirstChild("Shoot")
                local hand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or character:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") or character.PrimaryPart
                if shoot and hand and typeof(shoot.FireServer) == "function" then
                    shoot:FireServer(CFrame.new(hand.Position), CFrame.new(point))
                    fired = true
                end
            end

            if not fired and typeof(activeGun.Activate) == "function" then
                activeGun:Activate()
                fired = true
            end
        end)

        pcall(function()
            lHrp.CFrame = oldCFrame
            lHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = oldLinear
            lHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = oldAngular
        end)

        if ok and fired then
            Combat.playHit()
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    function Combat.shootMurderer()
        if S.shootKeyBusy then return false end
        S.shootKeyBusy = true
        local success = false
        local function finish() S.shootKeyBusy = false end

        local ok = pcall(function()
            local character = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
            if not character then return end
            local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not humanoid then return end

            local target = Roles.getMurderer()
            if not target or not target.Character then
                U.notify("Shoot", "No murderer", "x-circle", 2)
                return
            end

            local targetCharacter = target.Character
            local mHrp = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local lHrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not mHrp or not lHrp then return end

            local predPos = mHrp.Position
            if S.nomissEnabled then
                local p = Combat.nomiss(target)
                if typeof(p) == "Vector3" then
                    predPos = p
                end
            elseif S.aimbotV2Enabled then
                local p = Combat.aimV2(target)
                if typeof(p) == "Vector3" then predPos = p end
            elseif S.predictionEnabled then
                local p = Combat.stdPred(target)
                if typeof(p) == "Vector3" then predPos = p end
            end

            local requireLOS = not S.wallShotEnabled
            local safePoint = Combat.safeAimPoint(
                target,
                predPos,
                lHrp.Position,
                requireLOS
            )
            if S.targetIntegrityEnabled and typeof(safePoint) ~= "Vector3" then
                U.notify("Shoot", "Target blocked by another player", "shield-off", 2)
                return
            end
            if typeof(safePoint) == "Vector3" then
                predPos = safePoint
            end

            if S.fovCircleEnabled and not Combat.inFOV(predPos) and not Combat.inFOV(mHrp.Position) then
                U.notify("Shoot", "Target is outside FOV", "crosshair", 2)
                return
            end

            local blocked = not Combat.hasLOS(lHrp, mHrp, targetCharacter)
            if blocked and not S.wallShotEnabled then
                U.notify("Shoot", "No line of sight", "eye-off", 2)
                return
            end

            local gun = character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
            local function findGun(container)
                if not container then return nil end
                for _, tool in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                    if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                        local n = tool.Name:lower()
                        if n:find("gun") or n:find("revolver") or n:find("pistol") then
                            return tool
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not gun or not gun:IsA("Tool") then
                gun = findGun(LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
                if gun then
                    pcall(function() humanoid:EquipTool(gun) end)
                    task.wait(0.12)
                    gun = character:FindFirstChild(gun.Name) or gun
                end
            end
            if not gun then
                U.notify("Shoot", "No gun equipped", "x-circle", 2)
                return
            end

            Combat.playShoot()
            if S.shotTracerEnabled then
                pcall(function()
                    local origin = getShotOrigin(gun, lHrp.Position)
                    Combat.showBulletTracer(origin, predPos)
                end)
            end

            if blocked and S.wallShotEnabled then
                local wallPoint = Combat.safeAimPoint(target, predPos, lHrp.Position, false)
                if S.targetIntegrityEnabled and typeof(wallPoint) ~= "Vector3" then
                    U.notify("Shoot", "Target overlaps another player", "shield-off", 2)
                    return
                end
                if typeof(wallPoint) == "Vector3" then predPos = wallPoint end
                success = Combat.wallShootMurderer(target, predPos, gun, lHrp)
                if success then return end
            end

            -- Preferred sheriff firing path.
            local gunServer = gun:FindFirstChild("GunServer")
            local shootStart = gunServer and gunServer:FindFirstChild("ShootStart")
            if shootStart and shootStart:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                -- Use the exact V2 predicted point calculated above.
                -- The previous path discarded predPos and added a second
                -- velocity lead, which could double-predict and miss moving
                -- targets, especially when Auto Shoot was enabled.
                local point = predPos
                if typeof(point) ~= "Vector3" then
                    local livePart = getAimPart(targetCharacter)
                    point = livePart and livePart.Position or mHrp.Position
                end
                if pcall(function() shootStart:FireServer(point) end) then
                    success = true
                    Combat.playHit()
                    return
                end
            end

            -- Fallback for older MM2 implementations.
            local knifeLocal = gun:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
            local createBeam = knifeLocal and knifeLocal:FindFirstChild("CreateBeam")
            local rf = createBeam and createBeam:FindFirstChild("RemoteFunction")
            if rf and typeof(rf.InvokeServer) == "function" then
                if pcall(function() rf:InvokeServer(1, predPos, "AH2") end) then
                    success = true
                    Combat.playHit()
                    return
                end
            end

            local shoot = gun:FindFirstChild("Shoot")
            if shoot and typeof(shoot.FireServer) == "function" then
                local hand = character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or character:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") or character.PrimaryPart
                if hand and pcall(function()
                    shoot:FireServer(CFrame.new(hand.Position), CFrame.new(predPos))
                end) then
                    success = true
                    Combat.playHit()
                    return
                end
            end

            if typeof(gun.Activate) == "function" and pcall(function() gun:Activate() end) then
                success = true
                Combat.playHit()
            end
        end)

        finish()
        if not ok then
            U.notify("Shoot", "Shot failed", "x-circle", 2)
            return false
        end
        return success
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        pcall(function()
            if S.autoShootEnabled and Roles.getSheriff() == LocalPlayer then
                Combat.shootMurderer()
            end
        end)
        task.wait(S._QHPerf and S._QHPerf.wait(0.06) or 0.06)
    end
end)

do
    local circle
    pcall(function()
        if Drawing then
            circle = Drawing.new("Circle")
            circle.Thickness    = 1.5
            circle.Color        = S.fovColor
            circle.Filled       = false
            circle.Transparency = S.fovTransparency
            circle.NumSides     = 60
            circle.Radius       = S.fovRadius
            circle.Visible      = false
        end
    end)
    if circle then
        local mobileAccumulator = 0
        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not S.fovCircleEnabled then
                if circle.Visible then circle.Visible = false end
                return
            end

            local isTouch = false
            pcall(function()
                isTouch = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
            end)

            mobileAccumulator += dt
            if isTouch and S.mobileOptimizationEnabled and mobileAccumulator < 0.05 then
                return
            end
            mobileAccumulator = 0

            circle.Visible      = true
            circle.Position     = CurrentCamera.ViewportSize / 2
            circle.Radius       = S.fovRadius
            circle.Color        = S.fovColor
            circle.Transparency = S.fovTransparency
        end)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
--  JUMPS
-- ============================================================
local Jumps = {}
do
    function Jumps.bomb()
        if S.bombJumpCooldown then return end
        local ch = LocalPlayer.Character if not ch then return end
        local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return end
        if hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then return end
        S.bombJumpCooldown = true
        local e = Instance.new("Explosion")
        e.Position = hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        e.BlastRadius = S.bombJumpRadius e.BlastPressure = 0
        e.DestroyJointRadiusPercent = 0
        e.ExplosionType = Enum.ExplosionType.NoCraters
        e.Parent = workspace
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X*0.6, S.bombJumpPower, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z*0.6)
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bv.P = math.huge bv.Parent = hrp
        task.delay(0.08, function() bv:Destroy() end)
        task.delay(0.6,  function() S.bombJumpCooldown = false end)
    end

    function Jumps.gold()
        if S.goldJumpCooldown then return end
        local ch = LocalPlayer.Character if not ch then return end
        local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return end
        S.goldJumpCooldown = true
        local look = CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
        local lat  = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        if lat.Magnitude > 0 then lat = lat.Unit else lat = Vector3.new(0,0,-1) end
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(lat.X*S.goldJumpPower*0.6, S.goldJumpPower, lat.Z*S.goldJumpPower*0.6)
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bv.P = math.huge bv.Parent = hrp
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        task.delay(0.12, function() bv:Destroy() end)
        task.delay(S.goldJumpCooldownTime, function() S.goldJumpCooldown = false end)
    end
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    S.goldJumpCooldown   = false
    S.bombJumpCooldown   = false
    S.lastKnownPositions = {}
end)

-- ============================================================
--  KILL / AURA / THROW
-- ============================================================
local Kill = {}
do
    function Kill.killAll()
        local ch = LocalPlayer.Character if not ch then return end
        local knife = ch:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        if not knife then
            local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            if bp then
                local k = bp:FindFirstChild("Knife")
                if k then k.Parent = ch knife = k end
            end
        end
        if not knife then return end
        local events = knife:FindFirstChild("Events") if not events then return end
        local ht = events:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched") if not ht then return end
        -- Send the hit request for every current player in the same pass.
        -- There is deliberately no per-player cooldown here.
        local targets = {}
        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Character then
                local p = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = pl.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if p and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    targets[#targets + 1] = p
                end
            end
        end

        for i = 1, #targets do
            local p = targets[i]
            pcall(function()
                ht:FireServer(p)
            end)
        end
    end

    function Kill.toggle()
        S.killAllActive = not S.killAllActive
        if S.killAllActive then
            task.spawn(function()
                while S.killAllActive do
                    Kill.killAll()
                    if S.killAllDelay > 0 then
                        task.wait(S.killAllDelay)
                    else
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end
            end)
            U.notify("Kill All","Started","check",2)
        else
            U.notify("Kill All","Stopped","x-circle",2)
        end
    end

    function Kill.equip()
        local ch = LocalPlayer.Character if not ch then return false end
        if ch:FindFirstChild("Knife") then return true end
        local k = LocalPlayer.Backpack and LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        if k then k.Parent = ch return true end
        return false
    end

    local function getPlayerFromInstance(inst)
        if not inst then return nil end
        local model = inst:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if not model then return nil end
        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Character == model then
                local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 then return pl end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function getCrosshairTarget()
        if not S.autoThrowUseCrosshair then return nil end
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not cam then return nil end
        local vp = cam.ViewportSize
        local center = Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y * 0.5)
        local best, bestScore
        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Character then
                local hum = pl.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local root = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 and root then
                    local screen, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
                    if onScreen and screen.Z > 0 then
                        local score = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
                        if not bestScore or score < bestScore then
                            bestScore, best = score, pl
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local function resolveAutoThrowTarget()
        local target = getCrosshairTarget()
        if target then return target end
        local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
        local fromMouse = mouse and getPlayerFromInstance(mouse.Target)
        if fromMouse then return fromMouse end

        local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local nearest, dist = nil, math.huge
        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Character then
                local er = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hm = pl.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if er and hm and hm.Health > 0 then
                    local d=(hrp.Position-er.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < dist then dist, nearest=d, pl end
                end
            end
        end
        return nearest
    end

    function Kill.throw()
        if Roles.getMurderer() ~= LocalPlayer then return false end
        local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
        local knife = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Knife")
        if not knife then
            local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            knife = bp and bp:FindFirstChild("Knife")
            if knife then
                local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(knife) end) task.wait(0.08) end
                knife = ch:FindFirstChild("Knife")
            end
        end
        if not knife or not knife:FindFirstChild("Throw") then return false end
        local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return false end

        local targetPlayer = resolveAutoThrowTarget()
        if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then return false end
        local targetChar = targetPlayer.Character
        local targetRoot = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetHum = targetChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not targetRoot or not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then return false end

        local aimPoint = targetRoot.Position
        if Combat and type(Combat.aimV2) == "function" then
            local ok, predicted = pcall(function() return Combat.aimV2(targetPlayer) end)
            if ok and typeof(predicted) == "Vector3" then aimPoint = predicted end
        end

        -- When wall-shot mode is enabled, deliberately keep the predicted point
        -- instead of rejecting it on a local line-of-sight test. Server-side MM2
        -- validation still determines whether the throw is accepted.
        if S.silentThrowWallShotEnabled then
            local ok, safePoint = pcall(function()
                return Combat.safeAimPoint(targetPlayer, aimPoint, hrp.Position, false)
            end)
            if ok and typeof(safePoint) == "Vector3" then aimPoint = safePoint end
        end

        local direction = (aimPoint - hrp.Position)
        if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then return false end

        -- Arm the death observer BEFORE the throw so an immediate server-side
        -- elimination cannot race past the listener.
        local observed = targetHum
        local deathConn
        pcall(function()
            deathConn = observed.Died:Connect(function()
                if deathConn then deathConn:Disconnect() end
                if S._lastAutoThrowTarget == targetPlayer and (os.clock() - (S._lastAutoThrowAt or 0)) < 4 then
                    if QH_PlayMurderKillSound then QH_PlayMurderKillSound(targetChar) end
                end
            end)
        end)

        local fired = false
        local ok = pcall(function()
            knife.Throw:FireServer(CFrame.new(hrp.Position, aimPoint), aimPoint)
            fired = true
        end)
        if not ok or not fired then
            if deathConn then deathConn:Disconnect() end
            return false
        end

        S._lastAutoThrowTarget = targetPlayer
        S._lastAutoThrowAt = os.clock()
        if type(Combat.playShoot) == "function" then pcall(Combat.playShoot) end

        task.delay(4.5, function()
            if deathConn then deathConn:Disconnect() end
        end)

        return true
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        pcall(function()
            if S.knifeAuraEnabled then
                local ch    = LocalPlayer.Character
                local knife = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("Knife")
                if knife and knife:IsA("Tool") then
                    local events = knife:FindFirstChild("Events")
                    local ht     = events and events:FindFirstChild("HandleTouched")
                    local hrp    = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if ht and hrp then
                        for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
                            if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Character then
                                local hum = pl.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                local er  = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                if hum and hum.Health > 0 and er then
                                    if (er.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= S.knifeAuraRadius then
                                        pcall(function() ht:FireServer(er) end)
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        pcall(function()
            if S.silentThrowEnabled and Roles.getMurderer() == LocalPlayer then
                Kill.throw()
            end
        end)
        task.wait(0.8)
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
--  MOVEMENT
-- ============================================================
local Move = {}
do
    function Move.apply()
        local ch = LocalPlayer.Character if not ch then return end
        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if not hum then return end
        if not S.walkSpeedLocked then hum.WalkSpeed = S.walkSpeedValue end
        if not S.jumpPowerLocked then hum.JumpPower  = S.jumpPowerValue end
    end

    function Move.noclip(enable)
        S.noclipEnabled = enable
        if enable then
            local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
            if ch then
                for _, p in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then S.savedCanCollide[p] = p.CanCollide p.CanCollide = false end
                end
            end
            if S.noclipConn then S.noclipConn:Disconnect() end
            S.noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
                local c = LocalPlayer.Character if not c then return end
                for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
                end
            end)
        else
            if S.noclipConn then S.noclipConn:Disconnect() S.noclipConn = nil end
            for p, sv in pairs(S.savedCanCollide) do
                if p and p.Parent then p.CanCollide = sv end
            end
            S.savedCanCollide = {}
        end
    end

    function Move.infJump(enable)
        S.infJumpEnabled = enable
        if enable then
            if S.infJumpConn then S.infJumpConn:Disconnect() end
            S.infJumpConn = UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
                local ch  = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
            end)
        else
            if S.infJumpConn then S.infJumpConn:Disconnect() S.infJumpConn = nil end
        end
    end

    -- Hold Space to bunny-hop. While Space remains held and the player is moving,
    -- horizontal speed ramps up over successive hops. Releasing Space smoothly
    -- returns WalkSpeed to the value it had before Bhop was enabled.
    function Move.bhop(enable)
        S.bhopEnabled = enable == true
        if S.bhopConn then
            S.bhopConn:Disconnect()
            S.bhopConn = nil
        end
        if not S.bhopEnabled then
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and S.bhopBaseSpeed then
                hum.WalkSpeed = S.bhopBaseSpeed
            end
            S.bhopBaseSpeed = nil
            S.bhopSpeed = nil
            return
        end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        S.bhopBaseSpeed = hum and hum.WalkSpeed or 16
        S.bhopSpeed = S.bhopBaseSpeed
        local accumulator = 0
        local jumpCooldown = 0

        S.bhopConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            accumulator += dt
            jumpCooldown = math.max(0, jumpCooldown - dt)
            if accumulator < 0.025 then return end
            accumulator = 0
            if not S.bhopEnabled then return end

            local c = LocalPlayer.Character
            local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not h or not root or h.Health <= 0 then return end

            -- The speed only builds while Space is physically held.
            local holdingSpace = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
            local moving = h.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05

            if not holdingSpace or not moving then
                if S.bhopBaseSpeed then
                    S.bhopSpeed = S.bhopBaseSpeed
                    h.WalkSpeed = S.bhopBaseSpeed
                end
                return
            end

            -- Gradual acceleration: each held hop adds speed, with a sane cap.
            S.bhopSpeed = math.min((S.bhopSpeed or S.bhopBaseSpeed or 16) + 18 * 0.025, 90)
            h.WalkSpeed = S.bhopSpeed

            local state = h:GetState()
            if jumpCooldown <= 0 and (state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
                or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics
                or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed) then
                h.Jump = true
                jumpCooldown = 0.08
            end
        end)
    end


    -- Bhop 2: hold Space to accelerate; release Space to restore the normal speed.
    function Move.bhop2(enable)
        S.bhop2Enabled=enable==true
        if S.bhop2Conn then S.bhop2Conn:Disconnect(); S.bhop2Conn=nil end
        if S._bhop2SpaceBegan then S._bhop2SpaceBegan:Disconnect(); S._bhop2SpaceBegan=nil end
        if S._bhop2SpaceEnded then S._bhop2SpaceEnded:Disconnect(); S._bhop2SpaceEnded=nil end
        S._bhop2SpaceHeld=false

        local function resetSpeed()
            local char=LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then hum.WalkSpeed=S.walkSpeedValue or 16 end
        end

        if not S.bhop2Enabled then
            resetSpeed()
            return
        end

        local hopCooldown=0
        S._bhop2SpaceBegan=UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
            if processed then return end
            if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Space then
                S._bhop2SpaceHeld=true
            end
        end)
        S._bhop2SpaceEnded=UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Space then
                S._bhop2SpaceHeld=false
                resetSpeed()
            end
        end)

        S.bhop2Conn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            if not S.bhop2Enabled then return end
            local char=LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hum or not root or hum.Health<=0 then return end

            local moving=hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude>0.05
