            if not S._bhop2SpaceHeld or not moving then
                hum.WalkSpeed=S.walkSpeedValue or 16
                local v=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(v.X, v.Y, v.Z)
                return
            end

            local baseSpeed = math.max(1, tonumber(S.walkSpeedValue) or 16)
            local maxSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(S.bhop2Speed) or 300, baseSpeed + 1, 300)
            local speed = math.min(maxSpeed, (hum.WalkSpeed or baseSpeed) + math.max(1, dt * 240))
            hum.WalkSpeed=speed
            hopCooldown=math.max(0,hopCooldown-dt)

            local state=hum:GetState()
            local grounded=state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
                or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics
                or state==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed

            local v=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            local dir=hum.MoveDirection
            local target=dir.Magnitude>0 and dir.Unit*speed or Vector3.zero
            local horizontal=Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z)
            local steered=horizontal:Lerp(target,math.clamp(dt*10,0,1))
            if steered.Magnitude>speed then steered=steered.Unit*speed end
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(steered.X,v.Y,steered.Z)

            if grounded and hopCooldown<=0 then
                hopCooldown=.08
                hum.Jump=true
                local nv=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(nv.X,math.max(nv.Y,18),nv.Z)
            end
        end)
    end

    local godVisualHighlight = nil
    local godVisualParts = {}

    local function setInvincibleVisual(enabled)
        local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not ch then return end

        if enabled then
            if not godVisualHighlight or not godVisualHighlight.Parent then
                local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
                h.Name = "QuantomInvincibleIndicator"
                h.Adornee = ch
                h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
                h.FillTransparency = 0.68
                h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
                h.OutlineTransparency = 0.15
                h.Parent = ch
                godVisualHighlight = h
            end

            table.clear(godVisualParts)
            for _, obj in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    godVisualParts[obj] = obj.LocalTransparencyModifier
                    obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = math.max(obj.LocalTransparencyModifier, 0.42)
                end
            end
        else
            if godVisualHighlight then
                godVisualHighlight:Destroy()
                godVisualHighlight = nil
            end
            for part, oldTransparency in pairs(godVisualParts) do
                if part and part.Parent then
                    part.LocalTransparencyModifier = oldTransparency or 0
                end
            end
            table.clear(godVisualParts)
        end
    end

    function Move.godMode(enable)
        S.godModeEnabled = enable
        if S.godModeConn then S.godModeConn:Disconnect() S.godModeConn = nil end

        setInvincibleVisual(enable)
        if not enable then return end

        local function protect(h)
            if not h then return end
            local hc = h.HealthChanged:Connect(function(nh)
                if S.godModeEnabled and nh < h.MaxHealth then
                    h.Health = h.MaxHealth
                end
            end)

            task.spawn(function()
                while S.godModeEnabled and h and h.Parent do
                    if h.Health < h.MaxHealth then h.Health = h.MaxHealth end
                    if h:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
                        h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                        h.Health = h.MaxHealth
                    end
                    task.wait(0.2)
                end
                if hc then hc:Disconnect() end
            end)
        end

        local ch = LocalPlayer.Character
        if ch then
            protect(ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
            setInvincibleVisual(true)
        end

        S.godModeConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
            local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or c:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 2)
            if h and S.godModeEnabled then
                task.wait(0.35)
                protect(h)
                setInvincibleVisual(true)
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- LOCAL INVISIBLE: hides the local character without touching UI/world visuals.
local function applyInvisibleState(enabled)
    S.invisibleEnabled=enabled==true
    if S.invisibleConn then S.invisibleConn:Disconnect(); S.invisibleConn=nil end

    local function applyCharacter(char)
        if not char then return end
        for _,obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            pcall(function()
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = S.invisibleEnabled and 1 or 0
                elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
                    obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = S.invisibleEnabled and 1 or 0
                    obj.Transparency = S.invisibleEnabled and 1 or 0
                elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam") then
                    obj.Enabled = not S.invisibleEnabled
                elseif obj:IsA("Highlight") then
                    obj.Enabled = not S.invisibleEnabled
                elseif obj:IsA("BillboardGui") or obj:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                    obj.Enabled = not S.invisibleEnabled
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    applyCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)

    local charWatch
    local function watchCharacter(char)
        if charWatch then pcall(function() charWatch:Disconnect() end) end
        charWatch = char and char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if not S.invisibleEnabled then return end
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                        obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                    elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
                        obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                        obj.Transparency = 1
                    elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam") then
                        obj.Enabled = false
                    elseif obj:IsA("Highlight") or obj:IsA("BillboardGui") or obj:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                        obj.Enabled = false
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    watchCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if S.invisibleEnabled then
            task.wait(.15)
            applyCharacter(char)
        end
        watchCharacter(char)
    end)
end

function Move.invisible(enable)
    applyInvisibleState(enable)
end

-- Anti-fling does not need a 60 FPS full character scan.
-- Run it at a modest interval to avoid micro-stutters when many players are present.
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if S.antiFlingEnabled then
            for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
                if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Character then
                    for _, d in ipairs(pl.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.CanCollide then
                            d.CanCollide = false
                            if d.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
                                d.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                                d.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.15)
        else
            task.wait(0.35)
        end
    end
end)
-- Apply movement settings when they actually matter instead of every frame.
-- The sliders/toggles call Move.apply() themselves; this only covers respawns.
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.defer(function()
        pcall(Move.apply)
        if S.bhopEnabled then pcall(Move.bhop, true) end
        if S.bhop2Enabled then pcall(Move.bhop2, true) end
    end)
end)

-- ============================================================
--  FARM
-- ============================================================
-- AutoFarm core adapted from message (15):
--   * Underground / Sit modes
--   * nearest Coin_Server targeting
--   * ignored-target cooldown
--   * murderer proximity avoidance
--   * Auto Reset at the configured bag limit
--   * controlled Tween movement
--   * touch collection while travelling
-- The existing QuantomHub UI/state names are retained.
-- ============================================================
local Farm = {}
do
    -- Imported AutoFarm radar/picker behavior from autofarm.lua.txt.
    local coinSet={}
    local trackedContainers={}
    local deadCoins=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local coinHadVisual=setmetatable({}, {__mode="k"})
    local detectedPickupNames={}
    local lenientContainers={}
    local lastRadarSweep=0
    local lastDetect=0
    local lastPickTime=-math.huge
    local lastPickCoin=nil
    local lastPickScore=math.huge
    local lastPickHadResult=false
    local CLUSTER_RADIUS=24
    local CLUSTER_BONUS=7
    local MAX_FARM_DISTANCE=600

    local function registerCoin(coin)
        if not coin or not coin:IsA("BasePart") then return end
        if coin.Name:find("Server",1,true) or detectedPickupNames[coin.Name]
            or lenientContainers[coin.Parent]==true then
            coinSet[coin]=true
        end
    end

    local function unregisterCoin(coin)
        coinSet[coin]=nil
        deadCoins[coin]=nil
        coinHadVisual[coin]=nil
    end

    local function watchContainer(container)
        if not container or trackedContainers[container] then return end
        trackedContainers[container]=true
        pcall(function() container.ChildAdded:Connect(registerCoin) end)
        pcall(function() container.ChildRemoved:Connect(unregisterCoin) end)
        for _,coin in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do registerCoin(coin) end
    end

    local function radarSweep(force)
        if not force and os.clock()-lastRadarSweep<2.5 then return end
        lastRadarSweep=os.clock()
        for container in pairs(trackedContainers) do
            if not container.Parent then trackedContainers[container]=nil end
        end
        for coin in pairs(coinSet) do
            if not coin.Parent then unregisterCoin(coin) end
        end
        for _,map in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            local container=map:FindFirstChild("CoinContainer")
            if container then watchContainer(container) end
            for _,child in ipairs(map:GetChildren()) do
                if (child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Model"))
                    and child.Name:lower():find("container",1,true) then
                    local sample=child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if sample and (sample.Name:find("Server",1,true)
                        or sample:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter")) then
                        watchContainer(child)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local pickupHints={"coin","candy","token","egg","snow","gift","present","pickup","collect","drop","orb","shell","star","gem"}
    local parentHints={"container","coin","drop","pickup","spawn","collect"}

    local function hasHint(name,hints)
        local lower=tostring(name or ""):lower()
        for _,hint in ipairs(hints) do
            if lower:find(hint,1,true) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function autoDetectPickups()
        if os.clock()-lastDetect<5 then return end
        lastDetect=os.clock()
        local groups={}
        for _,map in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if map:IsA("Model") or map:IsA("Folder") then
                for _,part in ipairs(map:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Anchored and not part.CanCollide and part.Size.Magnitude<=8 then
                        local parent=part.Parent
                        groups[parent]=groups[parent] or {}
                        local byName=groups[parent]
                        if byName[part.Name] then
                            byName[part.Name].count+=1
                        else
                            byName[part.Name]={count=1,sample=part}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local bestParent,bestName,bestScore,bestCount=nil,nil,0,0
        for parent,byName in pairs(groups) do
            for name,info in pairs(byName) do
                if info.count>=5 then
                    local sample=info.sample
                    local score=0
                    if sample:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter") then score+=4 end
                    if hasHint(name,pickupHints) then score+=2 end
                    if parent and hasHint(parent.Name,parentHints) then score+=2 end
                    if sample:IsA("MeshPart") or sample:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") then score+=1 end
                    if info.count<=80 then score+=1 end
                    if score>=4 and (score>bestScore or (score==bestScore and info.count>bestCount)) then
                        bestParent,bestName,bestScore,bestCount=parent,name,score,info.count
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if bestParent then
            detectedPickupNames[bestName]=true
            watchContainer(bestParent)
            for _,part in ipairs(bestParent:GetChildren()) do registerCoin(part) end
        end
    end

    function Farm.getChar()
        return LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    end

    function Farm.getRoot()
        local char=Farm.getChar()
        return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function pick(root,candyOnly)
        if not root then return nil,math.huge,math.huge end
        local now=os.clock()
        if now-lastPickTime<.12 then
            local cached=lastPickCoin
            if cached and cached.Parent and not S.farmIgnoredCoins[cached] and not deadCoins[cached] then
                return cached,(cached.Position-root.Position).Magnitude,lastPickScore
            elseif not lastPickHadResult then
                return nil,math.huge,math.huge
            end
        end
        lastPickTime=now
        radarSweep(false)

        local candidates={}
        for coin in pairs(coinSet) do
            if coin.Parent and not S.farmIgnoredCoins[coin] and not deadCoins[coin] then
                local isCandy=tostring(coin:GetAttribute("CoinID")):lower()=="candy"
                    or tostring(coin.Name):lower():find("candy",1,true)~=nil
                if not candyOnly or isCandy then
                    local childCount=#coin:GetChildren()
                    if childCount>0 then coinHadVisual[coin]=true end
                    if childCount>0 or not coinHadVisual[coin] then candidates[#candidates+1]=coin end
                end
            end
        end

        if #candidates==0 then
            autoDetectPickups()
            radarSweep(true)
            for coin in pairs(coinSet) do
                if coin.Parent and not S.farmIgnoredCoins[coin] and not deadCoins[coin] then
                    local isCandy=tostring(coin:GetAttribute("CoinID")):lower()=="candy"
                        or tostring(coin.Name):lower():find("candy",1,true)~=nil
                    if not candyOnly or isCandy then candidates[#candidates+1]=coin end
                end
            end
        end

        if #candidates==0 then
            lastPickCoin=nil
            lastPickHadResult=false
            return nil,math.huge,math.huge
        end

        local positions=table.create(#candidates)
        local distances=table.create(#candidates)
        local order=table.create(#candidates)
        for i,coin in ipairs(candidates) do
            positions[i]=coin.Position
            distances[i]=(coin.Position-root.Position).Magnitude
            order[i]=i
        end
        table.sort(order,function(a,b) return distances[a]<distances[b] end)

        local best,bestDistance,bestScore=nil,math.huge,math.huge
        for _,index in ipairs(order) do
            local distance=distances[index]
            if distance>MAX_FARM_DISTANCE then break end
            if distance-CLUSTER_BONUS*6>=bestScore then break end
            local neighbors=0
            for j=1,#candidates do
                if j~=index and (positions[j]-positions[index]).Magnitude<=CLUSTER_RADIUS then
                    neighbors+=1
                    if neighbors>=6 then break end
                end
            end
            local score=distance-neighbors*CLUSTER_BONUS
            if score<bestScore then
                best,bestDistance,bestScore=candidates[index],distance,score
            end
        end

        lastPickCoin=best
        lastPickScore=bestScore
        lastPickHadResult=best~=nil
        return best,bestDistance,bestScore
    end

    function Farm.nearestCoin()
        return pick(Farm.getRoot(),false)
    end

    function Farm.nearestCandy()
        return pick(Farm.getRoot(),true)
    end

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        lastPickCoin=nil
        lastPickHadResult=false
        task.delay(.35,function()
            if S.farmActive then radarSweep(true) end
        end)
    end)
end

do
    local remGplay = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        and ReplicatedStorage.Remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
    local remStart = remGplay and remGplay:FindFirstChild("RoundStart")
    local remEnd = remGplay and remGplay:FindFirstChild("RoundEndFade")

    if remStart then
        remStart.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
            local root = Farm.getRoot()
            S.roundActive = true
            S.roundReturnPos = root and root.CFrame or nil

            -- Keep the currently selected action animation/emote across rounds.
            pcall(function()
                if QH_AnimPersistence then
                    QH_AnimPersistence.active = QH_AnimPersistence.active or QH_AnimPersistence.animationId ~= nil
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR then
                    _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR()
                end
            end)
            task.delay(0.05, function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR then
                        _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR()
                    end
                end)
            end)
            task.delay(0.20, function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR then
                        _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR()
                    end
                end)
            end)
            task.delay(.55, function()
                pcall(QH_ApplySavedActionAnimation)
            end)
        end)
    end

    if remEnd then
        remEnd.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
            S.roundActive = false

            -- Do not clear the selected action animation when the round ends.
            QH_AnimPersistence.active = QH_AnimPersistence.animationId ~= nil
            pcall(function()
                if _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR then
                    _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR()
                end
            end)
            task.delay(0.05, function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR then
                        _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR()
                    end
                end)
            end)
            task.delay(0.20, function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR then
                        _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR()
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    local function getTorso(char)
        if not char then return nil end
        return char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            or char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
            or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function getCurrentCoins()
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            local gui = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
            local gameGui = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Game")
            local coinBags = gameGui and gameGui:FindFirstChild("CoinBags")
            local container = coinBags and coinBags:FindFirstChild("Container")
            local coin = container and container:FindFirstChild("Coin")
            local currencyFrame = coin and coin:FindFirstChild("CurrencyFrame")
            local icon = currencyFrame and currencyFrame:FindFirstChild("Icon")
            local coinsText = icon and icon:FindFirstChild("Coins")
            return coinsText and coinsText.Text or 0
        end)
        return ok and (tonumber(res) or 0) or 0
    end

    local function isRoundOver()
        local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        local victoryGui = pGui and pGui:FindFirstChild("Victory")
        if victoryGui then
            for _, child in ipairs(victoryGui:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function isBagFull()
        local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        local mainGui = pGui and pGui:FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
        local lobby = mainGui and mainGui:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
        local dock = lobby and lobby:FindFirstChild("Dock")
        local coinBags = dock and dock:FindFirstChild("CoinBags")
        local notification = coinBags and coinBags:FindFirstChild("FullBagNotification")
        return notification ~= nil and notification.Visible == true
    end

    local function hasNearbyMurderer()
        if not S.farmAvoidMurder then return false end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return false end

        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
                local otherHRP = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local backpack = player:FindFirstChild("Backpack")

                if otherHRP and (otherHRP.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= 10 then
                    if player.Character:FindFirstChild("Knife")
                        or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife"))
                    then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    local function applyFlightPhysics(char)
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0) end

        local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("FarmBV")
        if not bv then
            bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "FarmBV"
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
            bv.Parent = hrp
        end

        local bg = hrp:FindFirstChild("FarmBG")
        if not bg then
            bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            bg.Name = "FarmBG"
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bg.P = 50000
            bg.Parent = hrp

            local _, rotY, _ = hrp.CFrame:ToOrientation()
            bg.CFrame =
                CFrame.new(hrp.Position)
                * CFrame.Angles(0, rotY, 0)
                * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
        end

        return bg.CFrame.Rotation
    end

    local function removePhysics()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end

        local bv = hrp:FindFirstChild("FarmBV")
        local bg = hrp:FindFirstChild("FarmBG")
        if bv then bv:Destroy() end
        if bg then bg:Destroy() end
        hrp.Anchored = false
    end

    local function setupNoclip()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end

        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = true
        end

        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    local function collectCoin(coin)
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp or not coin or not coin.Parent then return end

        if firetouchinterest then
            pcall(function()
                firetouchinterest(hrp, coin, 0)
                task.wait(0.05)
                firetouchinterest(hrp, coin, 1)
            end)
        end
    end

    local function flyToPoint(targetPos, targetCoin, hrp, torso, lockedRotation)
        local dist = (torso.Position - targetPos).Magnitude
        local speed = math.max(S.farmSpeed, 1)
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(
            math.max(dist / speed, 0.05),
            Enum.EasingStyle.Linear
        )
        local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos) * lockedRotation

        local tween = TweenService:Create(hrp, tweenInfo, {CFrame = targetCFrame})
        S._farmTween = tween
        local reached = false

        tween:Play()

        local connection
        connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not S.farmActive
                or not targetCoin
                or not targetCoin:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
            then
                pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end)
                if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
                return
            end

            if firetouchinterest then
                pcall(function()
                    firetouchinterest(torso, targetCoin, 0)
                    firetouchinterest(torso, targetCoin, 1)
                end)
            end

            if (torso.Position - targetPos).Magnitude <= 1.5 then
                reached = true
                pcall(function() tween:Cancel() end)
                if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            end
        end)

        while connection and connection.Connected and S.farmActive do
            RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end

        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
        return reached
    end

    local function tweenToCoin(coin)
        if not coin
            or not coin.Parent
            or not coin:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest")
        then
            return false
        end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum then return false end

        local target = coin.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)

        if (hrp.Position - target).Magnitude < 5 then
            collectCoin(coin)
            return true
        end

        if S._farmTween then
            pcall(function() S._farmTween:Cancel() end)
        end

        local speed = math.max(S.farmSpeed, 1)
        hum.Sit = true

        local started = tick()
        local reached = false

        while S.farmActive and hum.Health > 0 and coin.Parent do
            local current = hrp.Position
            local delta = target - current
            local dist = delta.Magnitude

            if dist <= 2.0 then
                reached = true
                break
            end

            -- Limit each movement segment so the client never attempts
            -- a large instantaneous position change.
            local stepDistance = math.min(dist, math.max(speed * 0.08, 3))
            local nextPos = current + delta.Unit * stepDistance

            if math.abs(nextPos.X) > 10000
                or math.abs(nextPos.Y) > 10000
                or math.abs(nextPos.Z) > 10000
            then
                break
            end

            local segmentTime = math.max(stepDistance / speed, 0.08)

            S._farmTween = TweenService:Create(
                hrp,
                TweenInfo.new(segmentTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
                {CFrame = CFrame.new(nextPos)}
            )
            S._farmTween:Play()

            local segmentDone = false
            local connection
            connection = S._farmTween.Completed:Connect(function()
                segmentDone = true
                if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            end)

            while not segmentDone and S.farmActive do
                if not coin:FindFirstChild("TouchInterest") then
                    pcall(function() S._farmTween:Cancel() end)
                    break
                end

                if tick() - started > 30 then
                    pcall(function() S._farmTween:Cancel() end)
                    break
                end

                task.wait(0.03)
            end

            if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
            S._farmTween = nil

            if not S.farmActive or not coin.Parent then
                break
            end
        end

        hum.Sit = false

        if reached and S.farmActive and hum.Health > 0 then
            collectCoin(coin)
        end

        return reached
    end

    local function markIgnored(coin)
        S.farmIgnoredCoins[coin] = true
        task.delay(5, function()
            S.farmIgnoredCoins[coin] = nil
        end)
    end

    local function resetCharacter()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            pcall(function()
                humanoid.Health = 0
            end)
        end
    end

    function Farm.stop()
        S.farmActive = false

        if S._farmTween then
            pcall(function() S._farmTween:Cancel() end)
            S._farmTween = nil
        end

        removePhysics()

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            humanoid.Sit = false
        end

        table.clear(S.farmIgnoredCoins)
    end

    function Farm.start()
        if S.farmActive then return end
        S.farmActive = true
        table.clear(S.farmIgnoredCoins)

        task.spawn(function()
            while S.farmActive do
                local success = pcall(function()
                    -- Only the actual round-state signal gates collection.
                    -- Do not use the Victory GUI here: it can remain in PlayerGui
                    -- after a round and would permanently block the next round.
                    if not S.roundActive then
                        S._farmTarget = nil
                        removePhysics()
                        task.wait(0.25)
                        return
                    end

                    if hasNearbyMurderer() then
                        S._farmTarget = nil
                        removePhysics()

                        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if hum then
                            hum.PlatformStand = false
                            hum.Sit = false
                        end

                        task.wait(1)
                        return
                    end

                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local torso = getTorso(char)
                    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                    if not hrp or not torso or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
                        S._farmTarget = nil
                        removePhysics()
                        task.wait(1)
                        return
                    end

                    if S.autoResetEnabled and S.farmResetPending then
                        -- Wait until the freshly spawned character is usable.
                        local currentHum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if currentHum and currentHum.Health > 0 then
                            S.farmResetPending = false
                        end
                    end

                    if S.autoResetEnabled then
                        local coins = getCurrentCoins()
                        if coins >= (S.bagCap or 40) or isBagFull() then
                            S.farmResetPending = true
                            S._farmTarget = nil
                            S.coinCount = 0
                            S.candyCount = 0
                            table.clear(S.farmIgnoredCoins)
                            removePhysics()
                            humanoid.Health = 0
                            task.wait(1)
                            return
                        end
                    end

                    local targetCoin, targetDistance
                    if S.candyFarmEnabled and not S.coinFarmEnabled then
                        targetCoin, targetDistance = Farm.nearestCandy()
                    else
                        targetCoin, targetDistance = Farm.nearestCoin()
                    end

                    if not targetCoin or not targetCoin:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
                        S._farmTarget = nil
                        removePhysics()
                        humanoid.Sit = false
                        task.wait(0.25)
                        return
                    end

                    S._farmTarget = targetCoin

                    local reachedTarget = false

                    if S.farmMode == "Underground" then
                        setupNoclip()
                        local lockedRotation = applyFlightPhysics(char)
                        -- Keep the underground offset small and bounded.
                        -- Large Y offsets can trigger the game's position validation.
                        -- Stay only slightly below the coin. A 4-stud
                        -- offset puts the character well below the map on
                        -- many MM2 maps and causes deaths/position correction.
                        local safeOffset = math.clamp(
                            tonumber(S.farmUndergroundOffset) or 1.25,
                            0.75,
                            1.5
                        )
                        local targetPos =
                            targetCoin.Position
                            - Vector3.new(0, safeOffset, 0)

                        -- Never send the character to an extreme world coordinate.
                        if math.abs(targetPos.X) > 10000
                            or math.abs(targetPos.Y) > 10000
                            or math.abs(targetPos.Z) > 10000
                        then
                            S._farmTarget = nil
                            task.wait(0.2)
                            return
                        end

                        reachedTarget = flyToPoint(
                            targetPos,
                            targetCoin,
                            hrp,
                            torso,
                            lockedRotation
                        )
                    else
                        reachedTarget = tweenToCoin(targetCoin)
                    end

                    if reachedTarget and S.farmActive and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                        collectCoin(targetCoin)
                        markIgnored(targetCoin)
                        task.wait(0.15)
                    end

                    S._farmTarget = nil
                end)

                if not success then
                    S._farmTarget = nil
                    removePhysics()
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end

                task.wait()
            end
        end)
    end

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        S._farmTarget = nil
        S._farmTween = nil
        S.farmResetPending = false
        table.clear(S.farmIgnoredCoins)

        -- CharacterAdded is a respawn, not an AutoFarm toggle-off event.
        -- The existing Farm.start() worker remains responsible for resuming.

        task.defer(function()
            -- Do not stack two 8-second WaitForChild calls after a death.
            -- MM2 can replace the character several times during the lobby transition;
            -- polling briefly avoids the ~12-16s freeze caused by synchronous waits.
            local hum, root
            local deadline = os.clock() + 2.25
            while os.clock() < deadline and character.Parent do
                hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hum and root then break end
                task.wait(.05)
            end
            if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
                hum.PlatformStand = false
                hum.Sit = false
                if S.roundActive then
                    S.roundReturnPos = root.CFrame
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- Underground mode only needs periodic maintenance; scanning every frame caused
    -- unnecessary allocations/work and was a common source of micro-freezes.
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            if S.farmActive and S.farmMode == "Underground" then
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if char then
                    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                    if root and (math.abs(root.Position.X) > 10000
                        or math.abs(root.Position.Y) > 10000
                        or math.abs(root.Position.Z) > 10000) then
                        if S._farmTween then
                            pcall(function() S._farmTween:Cancel() end)
                            S._farmTween = nil
                        end
                        Farm.stop()
                    else
                        if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = true end
                        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                                part.CanCollide = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.08)
            else
                task.wait(0.25)
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Preserve the existing collection counters/config compatibility.
    local remCoin = remGplay and remGplay:FindFirstChild("CoinCollected")
    if remCoin then
        remCoin.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, amount)
            pcall(function()
                local normalized = tostring(kind or ""):lower()
                local n = tonumber(amount)
                if normalized:find("candy", 1, true) then
                    if n then S.candyCount = n end
                elseif n then
                    S.coinCount = n
                end
            end)
        end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(
                LocalPlayer.UserId,
                S.gamePassId
            )
        end)
        S.bagCap = (ok and res) and 50 or 40
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
--  GRAB GUN
-- ============================================================
local Grab = {}
do
    function Grab.update()
        S.activeGunDrops = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(S.mapNames) do
            local node = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
            if node then
                local gd = node:FindFirstChild("GunDrop")
                if gd then table.insert(S.activeGunDrops, gd) end
            end
        end
        local gd = workspace:FindFirstChild("GunDrop")
        if gd then table.insert(S.activeGunDrops, gd) end
    end

    function Grab.gun(target)
        if not target then
            Grab.update()
            if #S.activeGunDrops == 0 then U.notify("Grab Gun","No guns","x",3) return false end
            local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
            if hrp then
                for _, gd in ipairs(S.activeGunDrops) do
                    local d = (hrp.Position - gd.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bestD then best = gd bestD = d end
                end
            end
            target = best
        end
        if target and LocalPlayer.Character then
            local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local orig = hrp.CFrame
                hrp.CFrame = target.CFrame
                task.wait(0.3)
                local pp = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
                if pp then
                    pcall(function() fireproximityprompt(pp) end)
                    task.wait(0.15) hrp.CFrame = orig
                    U.notify("Grab Gun","Grabbed","check",3)
                    return true
                end
                hrp.CFrame = orig
            end
        end
        return false
    end
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if S.autoGrabEnabled then
            Grab.update()
            if #S.activeGunDrops > 0 and LocalPlayer.Character then
                local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
                    for _, gd in ipairs(S.activeGunDrops) do
                        local d = (hrp.Position - gd.Position).Magnitude
                        if d < bestD then best = gd bestD = d end
                    end
                    if best then
                        local orig = hrp.CFrame
                        hrp.CFrame = best.CFrame
                        task.wait(0.3)
                        local pp = best:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
                        if pp then
                            pcall(function() fireproximityprompt(pp) end)
                            task.wait(0.15) hrp.CFrame = orig task.wait(1)
                        else
                            hrp.CFrame = orig
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(S.gunDropCheckInterval)
    end
end)

workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
    if not S.notifyGunDrop then return end
    if desc.Name == "GunDrop" and desc:IsA("BasePart") then
        if S.lastNotifiedGun == desc then return end
        S.lastNotifiedGun = desc
        U.notify("Gun Dropped","A gun was dropped","crosshair",5)
    end
end)

local function updateRoleNotify()
    if S.roleMonitorTask then task.cancel(S.roleMonitorTask) S.roleMonitorTask = nil end
    if not S.notifyMurderer and not S.notifySheriff then return end
    S.roleMonitorTask = task.spawn(function()
        while S.notifyMurderer or S.notifySheriff do
            local ok, sec = pcall(function()
                return ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Extras.GetTimer:InvokeServer()
            end)
            if not ok or (type(sec) == "number" and sec <= 1) then
                S.notifiedMurd = false S.notifiedSher = false
            elseif ok and type(sec) == "number" and sec > 1 then
                if S.notifyMurderer and not S.notifiedMurd then
                    local p = Roles.getMurderer()
                    if p then S.notifiedMurd = true U.notify("Murderer",p.Name,"skull",8) end
                end
                if S.notifySheriff and not S.notifiedSher then
                    local p = Roles.getSheriff()
                    if p then S.notifiedSher = true U.notify("Sheriff",p.Name,"shield",8) end
                end
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
--  DUPE / REPLACER
-- ============================================================
local Dupe = {}
do
    function Dupe.match(name, query)
        local clean = name:gsub("_G_%d%d%d%d",""):gsub("_K_%d%d%d%d","")
        return clean:lower():find(query:lower(), 1, true) ~= nil
    end

    function Dupe.weapon()
        wait(math.random(1,3))
        if not S.inventoryRoot then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, c in pairs(S.inventoryRoot.Weapons.Items.Container:GetChildren()) do
                for _, c3 in pairs(c.Container:GetChildren()) do
                    if c3.Name == "Christmas" or c3.Name == "Halloween" then
                        for _, c4 in pairs(c3.Container:GetChildren()) do
                            if c4:IsA("Frame") and c4.ItemName.Label.Text == S.dupeName then
                                local at = c4.Container.Amount.Text
                                if at == "" or at == "None" then c4.Container.Amount.Text = "x2"
                                else local n = tonumber(at:match("x(%d+)")) if n then c4.Container.Amount.Text = "x"..tostring(n+1) end end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        if c3:IsA("Frame") and c3.ItemName.Label.Text == S.dupeName then
                            local at = c3.Container.Amount.Text
                            if at == "" or at == "None" then c3.Container.Amount.Text = "x2"
                            else local n = tonumber(at:match("x(%d+)")) if n then c3.Container.Amount.Text = "x"..tostring(n+1) end end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    function Dupe.all()
        wait(math.random(3,5))
        if not S.inventoryRoot then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, c1 in pairs(S.inventoryRoot.Weapons.Items.Container:GetChildren()) do
                for _, c2 in pairs(c1.Container:GetChildren()) do
                    if c2.Name == "Christmas" or c2.Name == "Halloween" then
                        for _, c3 in pairs(c2.Container:GetChildren()) do
                            if c3:IsA("Frame") and c3.ItemName.Label.Text ~= "Default Knife" and c3.ItemName.Label.Text ~= "Default Gun" then
                                local at = c3.Container.Amount.Text
                                if at == "" or at == "None" then c3.Container.Amount.Text = "x2"
                                else local n = tonumber(at:match("x(%d+)")) if n then c3.Container.Amount.Text = "x"..tostring(n*2) end end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        if c2:IsA("Frame") and c2.ItemName.Label.Text ~= "Default Knife" and c2.ItemName.Label.Text ~= "Default Gun" then
                            local at = c2.Container.Amount.Text
                            if at == "" or at == "None" then c2.Container.Amount.Text = "x2"
                            else local n = tonumber(at:match("x(%d+)")) if n then c2.Container.Amount.Text = "x"..tostring(n*2) end end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

pcall(function()
    local mg = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("MainGUI")
    if mg then
        local gs = mg:FindFirstChild("Game")
        local ls = mg:FindFirstChild("Lobby")
        if gs and gs:FindFirstChild("Inventory") then
            S.inventoryRoot = gs.Inventory.Main
        elseif ls and ls:FindFirstChild("Screens") and ls.Screens:FindFirstChild("Inventory") then
            S.inventoryRoot = ls.Screens.Inventory.Main
        end
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
--  MISC
-- ============================================================
local Misc = {}
do
    local CustomEmoteAliases = {
        ["griddy"] = "griddy",
        ["the griddy"] = "griddy",
        ["rampage"] = "rampage",
        ["floss"] = "floss",
        ["take the l"] = "take_the_l",
        ["take-the-l"] = "take_the_l",
        ["orange justice"] = "orange_justice",
        ["shuffle"] = "shuffle",
        ["default dance"] = "default_dance",
        ["boogie"] = "boogie",
        ["laugh"] = "laugh",
        ["wave"] = "wave",
        ["dance"] = "dance",
        ["cheer"] = "cheer",
    }

    -- Optional local animation IDs. A blank value means "use the game's
    -- replicated PlayEmote route only". This table is intentionally editable:
    -- public animation ownership/availability can change independently of MM2.
    local CustomEmoteIds = {
        griddy = "",
        rampage = "",
        floss = "",
        take_the_l = "",
        orange_justice = "",
        shuffle = "",
        default_dance = "",
        boogie = "",
    }

    local function qhNormalizeEmoteName(name)
        local raw = tostring(name or "")
        local lower = raw:lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
        return CustomEmoteAliases[lower] or lower:gsub("%s+", "_")
    end

    local function qhPlayLocalEmote(assetId)
        if not assetId or assetId == "" then
            return false
        end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return false end

        local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then
            animator = Instance.new("Animator")
            animator.Parent = hum
        end

        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId):gsub("^rbxassetid://", "")

        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
        end)

        if not ok or not track then
            anim:Destroy()
            return false
        end

        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        track.Looped = true
        track:Play(0.12, 1, 1)

        task.delay(0.15, function()
            if anim and anim.Parent == nil then
                -- Keep the animation object alive through the track lifetime.
                anim.Parent = char
            end
        end)

        return true
    end

    function Misc.getCustomEmotes()
        local names = {}
        for name in pairs(CustomEmoteAliases) do
            names[#names + 1] = name
        end
        table.sort(names)
        return names
    end

    local function qhFindResolvedEmoteId(alias)
        local map = rawget(_G, "__QH_EMOTE_ID_BY_NAME")
        if type(map) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local id = map[alias] or map[alias:gsub("_", " ")]
        return tonumber(id)
    end

    local function qhPlayEmoteId(id)
        id = tonumber(id)
        if not id or id <= 0 then return false end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return false end
        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            return hum:PlayEmoteAndGetAnimTrackById(id)
        end)
        if ok and track and track:IsA("AnimationTrack") then
            return true
        end
        local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then return false end
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
        local ok2, loaded = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
        if not ok2 or not loaded then
            anim:Destroy()
            return false
        end
        loaded.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        loaded.Looped = true
        loaded:Play(0.12, 1, 1)
        task.delay(2, function()
            if anim and anim.Parent then anim:Destroy() end
        end)
        return true
    end

    function Misc.emote(name)
        if not name then return false end
        local alias = qhNormalizeEmoteName(name)

        -- Do NOT send arbitrary aliases to MM2's PlayEmote remote. The server
        -- rejects unsupported names with "Game did not accept this emote".
        -- First resolve the alias against the real emote catalog loaded by the
        -- embedded emote module, then ask Humanoid to play the real asset.
        local resolvedId = qhFindResolvedEmoteId(alias)
        if resolvedId then
            -- Prefer the game's replicated route for an emote that has a real
            -- catalog entry. Only fall back to local playback when the server
            -- does not expose a compatible route.
            local replicated = false
            pcall(function()
                local rem = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                local play = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("PlayEmote")
                if play and play:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    play:FireServer(alias)
                    replicated = true
                elseif play and play:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    play:InvokeServer(alias)
                    replicated = true
                end
            end)
            if replicated then return true end
            return qhPlayEmoteId(resolvedId)
        end

        -- Only use the game's replicated route for names that are actually
        -- known to the stock emote wheel. Unknown custom names must never be
        -- sent blindly because that is what caused the popup in the screenshot.
        local allowed = rawget(_G, "__QH_STOCK_EMOTES")
        if type(allowed) == "table" and allowed[alias] then
            local replicated = false
            pcall(function()
                local rem = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                local play = rem and rem:FindFirstChild("PlayEmote")
                if play and play:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    play:FireServer(alias)
                    replicated = true
                elseif play and play:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
                    play:InvokeServer(alias)
                    replicated = true
                end
            end)
            return replicated
        end

        -- Last local fallback for an explicitly configured animation asset.
        local id = CustomEmoteIds[alias]
        if id and id ~= "" then
            return qhPlayLocalEmote(id)
        end

        return false
    end

    function Misc.rejoin()
        pcall(function() TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, LocalPlayer) end)
    end

    function Misc.serverHop()
        local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/"..game.PlaceId.."/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"
        local ok, raw = pcall(function() return QH_HttpGet(url) end)
        if not ok then return end
        local ok2, res = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
        if ok2 and res and res.data then
            for _, sv in ipairs(res.data) do
                if sv.id ~= game.JobId and sv.playing < sv.maxPlayers then
                    pcall(function() TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, sv.id, LocalPlayer) end)
                    return
                end
            end
        end
        pcall(function() TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer) end)
    end

    function Misc.chatRoles()
        local m = Roles.getMurderer() local s = Roles.getSheriff()
        local msg = "QuantomHub V3 >> Murderer: "..(m and m.Name or "Unknown").." | Sheriff: "..(s and s.Name or "Unknown")
        pcall(function()
            if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
                local chan = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
                if chan and chan:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral") then chan.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(msg) end
            else
                local es = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
                if es and es:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest") then
                    es.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "Normal")
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

local Mobile = {}
do
    Mobile.gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

    Mobile.gui.DisplayOrder = 50
    Mobile.gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    Mobile.gui.Parent = CoreGui

    function Mobile.make(name, text, iconAsset, color, ix, iy, cb)
        if Mobile.active[name] then return Mobile.active[name] end
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", Mobile.gui)
        btn.Name = name btn.Size = UDim2.new(0,108,0,38)
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(0,ix,1,iy)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = color btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
        btn.Text = iconAsset and "" or text
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        btn.TextSize = 12 btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0 btn.ZIndex = 100 btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local sk = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
        sk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) sk.Thickness = 1.2 sk.Transparency = 0.55
        if iconAsset then
            local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", btn)
            img.Size = UDim2.new(0,24,0,24) img.Position = UDim2.new(0,6,0.5,-12)
            img.BackgroundTransparency = 1 img.Image = iconAsset img.ZIndex = 101
            local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
            lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-30,1,0) lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,30,0,0)
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1 lbl.Text = text
            lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255) lbl.TextSize = 11
            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left lbl.ZIndex = 101
        end
        local drag, ds, sp, mv = false, nil, nil, false
        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                drag = true mv = false ds = i.Position sp = btn.Position btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
            end
        end)
        btn.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if not drag then return end
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local d = i.Position - ds
                if math.abs(d.X) + math.abs(d.Y) > 8 then mv = true end
                btn.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset+d.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset+d.Y)
            end
        end)
        btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
                if drag and not mv then task.spawn(cb) end
                drag = false
            end
        end)
        Mobile.active[name] = btn
        return btn
    end

        if Mobile.active[name] then return Mobile.active[name] end

        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", Mobile.gui)
        btn.Name = name

        btn.ZIndex = 100

        btn.Active = true
        Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 140, 255)
        stroke.Thickness = 1.4
        stroke.Transparency = 0.18

        local holder = Instance.new("Frame", btn)
        holder.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        holder.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
        holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        holder.ZIndex = 101

        local ring = Instance.new("Frame", holder)
        ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(27, 27)
        ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ring.ZIndex = 101
        local rs = Instance.new("UIStroke", ring)
        rs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 240, 255)
        rs.Thickness = 2
        rs.Transparency = 0.08
        rs.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        Instance.new("UICorner", ring).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local dot = Instance.new("Frame", holder)
        dot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        dot.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 4)
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
        dot.ZIndex = 103
        Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local segs = {}
        local segDefs = {
            {0,-13,4,10}, {0,13,4,10}, {-13,0,10,4}, {13,0,10,4}
        }
        for _, d in ipairs(segDefs) do
            local seg = Instance.new("Frame", holder)
            seg.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
            seg.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,d[1],0.5,d[2])
            seg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d[3],d[4])
            seg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            seg.BorderSizePixel = 0
            seg.ZIndex = 102
            Instance.new("UICorner", seg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1,0)
            segs[#segs+1] = seg
        end

        local rotating = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local angle = 0
            while btn.Parent and rotating do
                angle = (angle + 3) % 360
                holder.Rotation = angle
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
        end)

        local drag, ds, sp, moved = false, nil, nil, false
        btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                drag = true; moved = false; ds = input.Position; sp = btn.Position
                btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
            end
        end)
        btn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not drag then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local d = input.Position - ds
                if math.abs(d.X) + math.abs(d.Y) > 8 then moved = true end
                btn.Position = UDim2.new(sp.X.Scale, sp.X.Offset + d.X, sp.Y.Scale, sp.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end)
        btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
                if drag and not moved then task.spawn(cb) end
                drag = false
            end
        end)

        Mobile.active[name] = btn
        return btn
    end

    end
end

local function QH_BuildWindTheme(name, palette)
    local p = palette or ScriptThemePalettes.Aurora
    local primary = p.primary
    local secondary = p.secondary

    local function mix(c, amount)
        return Color3.new(
            math.clamp(c.R + (1-c.R)*amount, 0, 1),
            math.clamp(c.G + (1-c.G)*amount, 0, 1),
            math.clamp(c.B + (1-c.B)*amount, 0, 1)
        )
    end

    return {
        Name = name,
        Accent = primary,
        Background = Color3.fromRGB(8,10,16),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.04,
        Outline = Color3.fromRGB(30,34,48),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(242,244,255),
        Placeholder = Color3.fromRGB(120,126,145),
        Button = Color3.fromRGB(18,21,32),
        Icon = primary,
        Hover = mix(primary, 0.18),

        WindowBackground = Color3.fromRGB(10,12,19),
        WindowShadow = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0),

        DialogBackground = Color3.fromRGB(12,14,22),
        DialogTitle = Color3.fromRGB(242,244,255),
        DialogContent = Color3.fromRGB(174,180,198),
        DialogIcon = secondary,

        WindowTopbarButtonIcon = primary,
        WindowTopbarTitle = Color3.fromRGB(242,244,255),
        WindowTopbarIcon = secondary,

        TabTitle = Color3.fromRGB(230,234,248),
        TabIcon = primary,

        ElementBackground = Color3.fromRGB(17,20,31),
        ElementTitle = Color3.fromRGB(240,243,255),
        ElementDesc = Color3.fromRGB(145,151,170),
        ElementIcon = primary,

        Toggle = Color3.fromRGB(27,31,45),
        ToggleBar = primary,

        Slider = Color3.fromRGB(27,31,45),
        SliderThumb = secondary,
    }
end

local function QH_ApplyScriptTheme(name)
    name = tostring(name or "Aurora")
    local p = ScriptThemePalettes[name] or ScriptThemePalettes.Aurora
    if not ScriptThemePalettes[name] then name = "Aurora" end
    S.scriptTheme = name

    -- The active UI is our custom renderer. Apply the palette to its background,
    -- panels, controls, text, borders and gradients as one operation.
    local applied = false
    if _G.__QH_CustomApplyTheme then
        local ok = pcall(_G.__QH_CustomApplyTheme, name, p.primary, p.secondary)
        applied = ok
    end

    -- Keep compatibility with the adapter if it exposes a theme API.
    pcall(function()
        if Win and type(Win.SetTheme)=="function" then
            Win:SetTheme(name, p)
            applied = true
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if S.v2 and type(S.v2.SetTheme)=="function" then
            S.v2:SetTheme(name)
            applied = true
        end
    end)

    if S.hudAccentMode == "Auto" and HUD and HUD.applyAccent then
        HUD.applyAccent("Auto")
    end

    U.notify("Theme", (applied and "Script theme: " or "Theme fallback: ")..name, "palette", 2)
end

function DeepCopy(original)
    if type(original) ~= 'table' then
        return original
    end

    local copy = {}

    for k, v in pairs(original)do
        if type(v) == 'table' then
            v = DeepCopy(v)
        end

        copy[k] = v
    end

    return copy
end
function ColorToTable(color)
    return {
        color.R,
        color.G,
        color.B,
    }
end
function TableToColor(tbl)
    if not tbl or type(tbl) ~= 'table' or #tbl < 3 then
        return Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    end

    return Color3.new(tbl[1], tbl[2], tbl[3])
end
function loadAnimationCache()
    if isfile and isfile(State.AnimationCachePath) then
        local success, decoded = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(State.AnimationCachePath))
        end)

        if success and type(decoded) == 'table' then
            State.AnimationCache = decoded
        end
    end
end
function saveAnimationCache()
    if writefile then
        pcall(function()
            if not isfolder('7yd7') then
                makefolder('7yd7')
            end

            writefile(State.AnimationCachePath, HttpService:JSONEncode(State.AnimationCache))
        end)
    end
end
function resolveAnimationMappings(bundledItems)
    -- Safe resolver shared by the legacy embedded animation engine.
    -- The original routine synchronously walked every bundled asset and could
    -- freeze Roblox for a long time when a large bundle was selected.
    if type(bundledItems) ~= 'table' then return {} end

    local mappings = {}
    local seen = {}
    local processed = 0
    local MAX_ASSETS = 4
    local MAX_MAPPINGS = 12
    local MAX_DEPTH = 5

    local function addAnim(obj, category)
        if #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS or not obj:IsA('Animation') then return end
        local id = tostring(obj.AnimationId or '')
        if id == '' then return end
        local key = tostring(category):lower() .. '|' .. id
        if seen[key] then return end
        seen[key] = true
        mappings[#mappings+1] = {
            category = tostring(category),
            name = obj.Name,
            animationId = id,
            weights = {},
        }
    end

    local function walk(root, category, depth)
        if not root or depth > MAX_DEPTH or #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS then return end
        for _, child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA('Animation') then
                addAnim(child, category)
            elseif #child:GetChildren() > 0 then
                walk(child, child.Name, depth + 1)
            end
            if #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS then return end
        end
    end

    for _, assetIds in pairs(bundledItems) do
        if type(assetIds) == 'table' then
            for _, assetId in pairs(assetIds) do
                if processed >= MAX_ASSETS then break end
                processed += 1
                local id = tostring(assetId):match('%d+')
                if id then
                    task.wait()
                    local ok, objects = pcall(function()
                        return game:GetObjects('rbxassetid://' .. id)
                    end)
                    if ok and type(objects) == 'table' then
                        for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
                            walk(obj, obj.Name, 0)
                            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                            if #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS then break end
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait()
            end
        end
        if processed >= MAX_ASSETS or #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS then break end
    end

    return mappings
end

function buildCustomSetMappings(setName)
    if type(setName) == 'string' then
        setName = setName:gsub('%s*%-.*$', '')
    end

    local set = State.CustomAnimations and State.CustomAnimations.Sets and State.CustomAnimations.Sets[setName]

    if not set then
        return {}
    end

    local mappings = {}

    for cat, anims in pairs(set)do
        if cat ~= '__meta' then
            for name, id in pairs(anims)do
                if tostring(id) ~= '0' then
                    table.insert(mappings, {
                        category = cat,
                        name = name,
                        animationId = 'rbxassetid://' .. id,
                    })
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return mappings
end
