                    UI.CustomFrames[name] = nil
                end
            else
                if HUD.DefaultPositions[name] then
                    el.Position = HUD.DefaultPositions[name]
                end
                if HUD.DefaultSizes[name] then
                    el.Size = HUD.DefaultSizes[name]
                end

                for internal, friendly in pairs(HUD.FriendlyNames)do
                    if name == friendly then
                        if internal:match('^Under%.') then
                            el.Parent = UI.Under
                        elseif internal:match('^Top%.') then
                            el.Parent = UI.Top
                        end

                        break
                    end
                end

                el.ZIndex = (name == 'Top' or name == 'Under') and 3 or (el:IsA('ImageButton') and 4 or 3)

                if name == 'Under' then
                    el.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                else
                    el.BackgroundTransparency = (name == 'Top' or name == 'Reload' or name == 'Changepage' or name == 'EmoteWalkButton' or name == 'SpeedBox' or name == 'SpeedEmote' or name == 'Favorite') and 0.4 or 1
                end
                if el:IsA('ImageButton') or el:IsA('ImageLabel') then
                    el.ImageTransparency = 0
                end
                if el:IsA('TextLabel') or el:IsA('TextBox') then
                    el.TextTransparency = 0.4

                    if HUD.DefaultTexts and HUD.DefaultTexts[name] then
                        el.Text = HUD.DefaultTexts[name]
                    end
                    if el:IsA('TextBox') and HUD.DefaultPlaceholders and HUD.DefaultPlaceholders[name] then
                        el.PlaceholderText = HUD.DefaultPlaceholders[name]
                    end
                end

                local cR = el:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('UICorner')

                if cR then
                    cR.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
                end
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            updateGUIColors()
        end)

        HUD.SelectedElement = nil

        for _, h in pairs(HUD.ResizeHandles)do
            pcall(function()
                h:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        HUD.ResizeHandles = {}

        for _, c in pairs(HUD.ResizeConnections)do
            pcall(function()
                c:Disconnect()
            end)
        end

        rebuildHUDOverlays()
        updateHUDLayouts()
        ApplyUIVisibility()

        State.totalPages = calculateTotalPages()

        if State.currentPage > State.totalPages then
            State.currentPage = State.totalPages
        end

        updatePageDisplay()
        getgenv().Notify({
            Title = '7yd7 | HUD Editor',
            Content = '\u{1f504} All designs and frames have been fully reset',
            Duration = 3,
        })
    end))

    local function parseUDim2(text)
        local s1, o1, s2, o2 = text:match('{%s*([%d%.%-]+)%s*,%s*([%d%.%-]+)%s*}%s*,%s*{%s*([%d%.%-]+)%s*,%s*([%d%.%-]+)%s*}')

        if s1 and o1 and s2 and o2 then
            return tonumber(s1), tonumber(o1), tonumber(s2), tonumber(o2)
        end

        local a, b = text:match('([%d%.%-]+)%s*,%s*([%d%.%-]+)')

        if a and b then
            local va, vb = tonumber(a), tonumber(b)

            if va and vb then
                return 0, va, 0, vb
            end
        end

        return nil
    end
    local function formatUDim2(udim)
        return string.format('{%g, %g},{%g, %g}', udim.X.Scale, udim.X.Offset, udim.Y.Scale, udim.Y.Offset)
    end

    table.insert(HUD.Connections, propertiesBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        propertiesPanel.Visible = not propertiesPanel.Visible
    end))

    local function formatUDim(udim)
        return string.format('{%g, %g}', udim.Scale, udim.Offset)
    end
    local function formatRGB(c)
        return string.format('%d, %d, %d', math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
    end
    local function parseRGB(text)
        local a, b, c = text:match('([%d%.%-]+)%s*,%s*([%d%.%-]+)%s*,%s*([%d%.%-]+)')

        if not a then
            return nil
        end

        local r, g, b2 = tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c)

        if not r or not g or not b2 then
            return nil
        end

        local maxv = math.max(r, g, b2)

        if maxv <= 1 then
            r, g, b2 = r * 255, g * 255, b2 * 255
        end

        r = math.clamp(r, 0, 255)
        g = math.clamp(g, 0, 255)
        b2 = math.clamp(b2, 0, 255)

        return r, g, b2
    end

    table.insert(HUD.Connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not propertiesPanel.Visible then
            return
        end

        local e = HUD.LastTouchedElement
        local eName = HUD.LastTouchedName

        if e and e.Parent then
            title.Text = string.format('[%s] %s', e.ClassName, eName or 'Unknown')

            if not posBox:IsFocused() then
                posBox.Text = formatUDim2(e.Position)
            end
            if not sizeBox:IsFocused() then
                sizeBox.Text = formatUDim2(e.Size)
            end

            zRow.Visible = true

            if not zBox:IsFocused() then
                zBox.Text = tostring(e.ZIndex)
            end

            bgRow.Visible = true

            if not bgBox:IsFocused() then
                bgBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(e.BackgroundTransparency * 100) / 100)
            end
            if e:IsA('ImageLabel') or e:IsA('ImageButton') then
                imgRow.Visible = true

                if not imgBox:IsFocused() then
                    imgBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(e.ImageTransparency * 100) / 100)
                end
            else
                imgRow.Visible = false
            end

            bgcRow.Visible = true

            if not bgcBox:IsFocused() then
                bgcBox.Text = formatRGB(e.BackgroundColor3)
            end
            if e:IsA('ImageLabel') or e:IsA('ImageButton') then
                imgcRow.Visible = true

                if not imgcBox:IsFocused() then
                    imgcBox.Text = formatRGB(e.ImageColor3)
                end
            else
                imgcRow.Visible = false
            end
            if e:IsA('TextLabel') or e:IsA('TextBox') then
                ttrRow.Visible = true

                if not ttrBox:IsFocused() then
                    ttrBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(e.TextTransparency * 100) / 100)
                end

                txtRow.Visible = true

                if not txtBox:IsFocused() then
                    txtBox.Text = e.Text
                end

                txtcRow.Visible = true

                if not txtcBox:IsFocused() then
                    txtcBox.Text = formatRGB(e.TextColor3)
                end
                if e:IsA('TextBox') then
                    phRow.Visible = true

                    if not phBox:IsFocused() then
                        phBox.Text = e.PlaceholderText
                    end
                else
                    phRow.Visible = false
                end
            else
                ttrRow.Visible = false
                txtRow.Visible = false
                phRow.Visible = false
                txtcRow.Visible = false
            end

            deleteRow.Visible = (eName and eName:match('^CustomFrame_')) and true or false

            local cR = e:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('UICorner')

            if cR then
                radRow.Visible = true

                if not radBox:IsFocused() then
                    radBox.Text = formatUDim(cR.CornerRadius)
                end
            else
                radRow.Visible = false
            end
        else
            title.Text = 'No Element Selected'
            zRow.Visible = false
            bgRow.Visible = false
            imgRow.Visible = false
            bgcRow.Visible = false
            imgcRow.Visible = false
            radRow.Visible = false
            ttrRow.Visible = false
            txtRow.Visible = false
            phRow.Visible = false
            txtcRow.Visible = false
            deleteRow.Visible = false

            if not posBox:IsFocused() then
                posBox.Text = ''
            end
            if not sizeBox:IsFocused() then
                sizeBox.Text = ''
            end
        end

        local totalH = propLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10

        propContent.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, totalH)

        local vpY = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y or 800
        local maxH = math.floor(vpY * 0.55)

        propertiesPanel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, math.min(maxH, totalH + 40))
    end))

    local function saveHUDProp(eName, propKey, val)
        if not Config.HUDProperties then
            Config.HUDProperties = {}
        end
        if not Config.HUDProperties[eName] then
            Config.HUDProperties[eName] = {}
        end

        Config.HUDProperties[eName][propKey] = val

        SaveConfig()
    end

    table.insert(HUD.Connections, posBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local e, eName = HUD.LastTouchedElement, HUD.LastTouchedName

        if not e or not e.Parent or not eName then
            return
        end

        local s1, o1, s2, o2 = parseUDim2(posBox.Text)

        if s1 then
            local prev = captureHUDState(eName, e)

            e.Position = UDim2.new(s1, o1, s2, o2)

            if prev and not sameUDim2(prev.pos, e.Position) then
                pushUndo(prev)
            end

            Config.HUDPositions[eName] = {
                s1,
                o1,
                s2,
                o2,
            }
        end
    end))
    table.insert(HUD.Connections, sizeBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local e, eName = HUD.LastTouchedElement, HUD.LastTouchedName

    table.insert(HUD.Connections, bgcBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local e, eName = HUD.LastTouchedElement, HUD.LastTouchedName

        if not e or not e.Parent or not eName then
            return
        end

        local r, g, b = parseRGB(bgcBox.Text)

        if r then
            if isThemeDefaultRGB(r, g, b) then
                if Config.HUDProperties and Config.HUDProperties[eName] then
                    Config.HUDProperties[eName].BgColor = nil

                    if next(Config.HUDProperties[eName]) == nil then
                        Config.HUDProperties[eName] = nil
                    end

                    SaveConfig()
                end

                pcall(function()
                    updateGUIColors()
                end)

                return
            end

            local prev = captureHUDState(eName, e)
            local c = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)

            pcall(function()
                e.BackgroundColor3 = c
            end)

            if prev and not sameColor(prev.bgColor, e.BackgroundColor3) then
                pushUndo(prev)
            end

            saveHUDProp(eName, 'BgColor', {r, g, b})
        end
    end))
    table.insert(HUD.Connections, imgcBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local e, eName = HUD.LastTouchedElement, HUD.LastTouchedName

        if not e or not e.Parent or not eName then
            return
        end
        if not (e:IsA('ImageLabel') or e:IsA('ImageButton')) then
            return
        end

        local r, g, b = parseRGB(imgcBox.Text)

        if r then
            if isThemeDefaultRGB(r, g, b) then
                if Config.HUDProperties and Config.HUDProperties[eName] then
                    Config.HUDProperties[eName].ImgColor = nil

                    if next(Config.HUDProperties[eName]) == nil then
                        Config.HUDProperties[eName] = nil
                    end

                    SaveConfig()
                end

                pcall(function()
                    updateGUIColors()
                end)

                return
            end

            local prev = captureHUDState(eName, e)
            local c = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)

            pcall(function()
                e.ImageColor3 = c
            end)

            if prev and prev.imgColor and not sameColor(prev.imgColor, e.ImageColor3) then
                pushUndo(prev)
            end

            saveHUDProp(eName, 'ImgColor', {r, g, b})
        end
    end))
    table.insert(HUD.Connections, radBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
        if not enter then
            return
        end

        local e, eName = HUD.LastTouchedElement, HUD.LastTouchedName

        if not e or not e.Parent or not eName then
            return
        end

        local a, b = radBox.Text:match('{%s*([%d%.%-]+)%s*,%s*([%d%.%-]+)%s*}')

        if not a and not b then
            a, b = radBox.Text:match('([%d%.%-]+)%s*,%s*([%d%.%-]+)')
        end
        if a and b then
            local va, vb = tonumber(a), tonumber(b)

            if va and vb then
                local cR = e:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('UICorner')

                if cR then
                    local prev = captureHUDState(eName, e)

                    if vb ~= 0 and va == 0 then
                        local minDim = math.min(e.AbsoluteSize.X, e.AbsoluteSize.Y)

                        if minDim > 0 then
                            va = vb / minDim
                            vb = 0
                        end
                    end

                    cR.CornerRadius = UDim.new(va, vb)

                    if prev and prev.radius and not sameUDim(prev.radius, cR.CornerRadius) then
                        pushUndo(prev)
                    end

                    saveHUDProp(eName, 'CornerRadius', {va, vb})
                end
            end
        end
    end))
    table.insert(HUD.Connections, txtBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
        if not enter then
            return
        end

        local e, eName = HUD.LastTouchedElement, HUD.LastTouchedName

        if not e or not e.Parent or not eName then
            return
        end
        if e:IsA('TextLabel') or e:IsA('TextBox') then
            local prev = captureHUDState(eName, e)

            e.Text = txtBox.Text

            if prev and prev.text ~= e.Text then
                pushUndo(prev)
            end

            saveHUDProp(eName, 'Text', txtBox.Text)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(HUD.Connections, phBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
        if not enter then
            return
        end

        local e, eName = HUD.LastTouchedElement, HUD.LastTouchedName

        if not e or not e.Parent or not eName then
            return
        end
        if e:IsA('TextBox') then
            local prev = captureHUDState(eName, e)

            e.PlaceholderText = phBox.Text

            if prev and prev.placeholder ~= e.PlaceholderText then
                pushUndo(prev)
            end

            saveHUDProp(eName, 'PlaceholderText', phBox.Text)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(HUD.Connections, ttrBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
        if not enter then
            return
        end

        local e, eName = HUD.LastTouchedElement, HUD.LastTouchedName

        if not e or not e.Parent or not eName then
            return
        end

        local v = tonumber(ttrBox.Text)

        if v and (e:IsA('TextLabel') or e:IsA('TextBox')) then
            local prev = captureHUDState(eName, e)

            e.TextTransparency = math.clamp(v, 0, 1)

            if prev and prev.textTrans ~= e.TextTransparency then
                pushUndo(prev)
            end

            saveHUDProp(eName, 'TextTransparency', e.TextTransparency)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(HUD.Connections, txtcBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local e, eName = HUD.LastTouchedElement, HUD.LastTouchedName

        if not e or not e.Parent or not eName then
            return
        end
        if not (e:IsA('TextLabel') or e:IsA('TextBox')) then
            return
        end

        local r, g, b = parseRGB(txtcBox.Text)

        if r then
            if isThemeDefaultRGB(r, g, b) then
                if Config.HUDProperties and Config.HUDProperties[eName] then
                    Config.HUDProperties[eName].TxtColor = nil

                    if next(Config.HUDProperties[eName]) == nil then
                        Config.HUDProperties[eName] = nil
                    end

                    SaveConfig()
                end

                pcall(function()
                    updateGUIColors()
                end)

                return
            end

            local prev = captureHUDState(eName, e)
            local c = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)

            pcall(function()
                e.TextColor3 = c
            end)

            if prev and prev.textColor and not sameColor(prev.textColor, e.TextColor3) then
                pushUndo(prev)
            end

            saveHUDProp(eName, 'TxtColor', {r, g, b})
        end
    end))

    if UI.Search then
        UI.Search.TextEditable = false
        UI.Search.Active = false

        pcall(function()
            UI.Search:ReleaseFocus()
        end)
    end
    if UI.SpeedBox then
        UI.SpeedBox.TextEditable = false
        UI.SpeedBox.Active = false

        pcall(function()
            UI.SpeedBox:ReleaseFocus()
        end)
    end
    if UI._2Routenumber then
        UI._2Routenumber.TextEditable = false
        UI._2Routenumber.Active = false

        pcall(function()
            UI._2Routenumber:ReleaseFocus()
        end)
    end

    local allMovable = getMovableElements()
    local snapGuideH = Instance.new('Frame')

    snapGuideH.Name = 'SnapGuide'
    snapGuideH.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
    snapGuideH.BorderSizePixel = 0

    snapGuideH.ZIndex = 6002
    snapGuideH.Visible = false
    snapGuideH.Parent = overlay

    local snapGuideV = Instance.new('Frame')

    snapGuideV.Name = 'SnapGuide'
    snapGuideV.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
    snapGuideV.BorderSizePixel = 0
    snapGuideV.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0)
    snapGuideV.ZIndex = 6002
    snapGuideV.Visible = false
    snapGuideV.Parent = overlay

    for name, element in pairs(allMovable)do
        setupElementDragging(name, element, getMovableElements(), snapGuideV, snapGuideH)
    end

    table.insert(HUD.Connections, addBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local nameIndex = 1

        while UI.CustomFrames and UI.CustomFrames['CustomFrame_' .. nameIndex] do
            nameIndex = nameIndex + 1
        end

        local newName = 'CustomFrame_' .. nameIndex

        cf.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)

        local corner = Instance.new('UICorner')

        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        corner.Parent = cf

        if not UI.CustomFrames then
            UI.CustomFrames = {}
        end

        UI.CustomFrames[newName] = cf
        HUD.DefaultSizes[newName] = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.3, 0)
        HUD.DefaultPositions[newName] = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        Config.HUDPositions[newName] = {
            0.5,
            0,
            0.5,
            0,
        }

        if not Config.HUDSizes then
            Config.HUDSizes = {}
        end

        Config.HUDSizes[newName] = {
            0.3,
            0,
            0.3,
            0,
        }

        if not Config.CustomFrames then
            Config.CustomFrames = {}
        end

        Config.CustomFrames[newName] = {ZIndex = 3}

        pcall(function()
            updateGUIColors()
        end)
        setupElementDragging(newName, cf, getMovableElements(), snapGuideV, snapGuideH)
        selectHUDElement(newName, cf)
        getgenv().Notify({
            Title = '7yd7 | HUD Editor',
            Content = '\u{2795} Custom Frame added!',
            Duration = 2,
        })
    end))
    getgenv().Notify({
        Title = '7yd7 | HUD Editor',
        Content = '\u{270f}\u{fe0f} Drag elements to reposition',
        Duration = 5,
    })
end

function checkAndRecreateGUI()
    local exists, emotesWheel = checkEmotesMenuExists()

    if not exists then
        State.isGUICreated = false

        return
    end
    if not emotesWheel:FindFirstChild('Under') or not emotesWheel:FindFirstChild('Top') or not emotesWheel:FindFirstChild('EmoteWalkButton') or not emotesWheel:FindFirstChild('Favorite') or not emotesWheel:FindFirstChild('SpeedEmote') or not emotesWheel:FindFirstChild('SpeedBox') or not emotesWheel:FindFirstChild('Changepage') or not emotesWheel:FindFirstChild('Reload') then
        State.isGUICreated = false

        if createGUIElements() then
            updatePageDisplay()
            updateEmotes()
            loadSpeedEmoteConfig()
        end
    end
end

local function QH_RunAnimationBundle()
    if _G.__QHAnimationBundleRunning then
        U.notify("Animation Bundle", "Already running", "alert-circle", 3)
        return
    end

    local compile = QH_LoaderCompile
    if type(compile) ~= "function" then
        U.notify("Animation Bundle", "Compiler unavailable", "x-circle", 3)
        return
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, fnOrErr = pcall(function()
            local fn, err = compile(QH_ANIMATION_BUNDLE_SOURCE, "@QuantomHubV3:AnimationBundle")
            if type(fn) ~= "function" then
                error(tostring(err or "compile failed"))
            end
            return fn
        end)

        if not ok or type(fnOrErr) ~= "function" then
            U.notify("Animation Bundle", "Load failed: "..tostring(fnOrErr), "x-circle", 4)
            return
        end

        local ran, err = pcall(fnOrErr)
        if not ran then
            U.notify("Animation Bundle", "Runtime error: "..tostring(err), "x-circle", 4)
            warn("[QuantomHub] Animation Bundle error:", err)
            return
        end

        U.notify("Animation Bundle", "Loaded: emotes & animation packs", "check-circle", 4)
    end)
end


-- ============================================================
-- QUANTOMHUB V3 • IMPORTED AURA MENU
-- Source: AuraMenu.txt
-- Integrated: Angel, Heavenly, Ribbon, Sakura, Wind, Flow.
-- Star and Starlight are intentionally omitted.
-- ============================================================
do
    local AuraMenu = {
        ids = {
            angel="97658130917593",
            heavenly="139300897520961",
            ribbon="132069507632161",
            sakura="81755778619404",
            wind="80694081850877",
            flow="119913533725648",
        },
        enabled = {angel=false, heavenly=false, ribbon=false, sakura=false, wind=false, flow=false},
        cache = {},
        created = {},
        color = Color3.fromRGB(174,112,255),
    }
    local order={"angel","heavenly","ribbon","sakura","wind","flow"}

    local function clearCreated()
        for i=#AuraMenu.created,1,-1 do
            local obj=AuraMenu.created[i]
            if obj and obj.Parent then pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
            AuraMenu.created[i]=nil
        end
    end

    local function loadAura(name)
        if AuraMenu.cache[name] then return AuraMenu.cache[name] end
        local id=AuraMenu.ids[name]
        if not id then return nil end
        local ok,objects=pcall(function()
            return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..id)
        end)
        if ok and type(objects)=="table" and objects[1] then
            AuraMenu.cache[name]=objects[1]
            return objects[1]
        end
        local loaded=nil
        pcall(function()
            local pack=game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(tonumber(id))
            if pack then
                loaded=pack:GetChildren()[1] or pack
                if loaded then AuraMenu.cache[name]=loaded end
                if pack~=loaded and pack.Parent then pack:Destroy() end
            end
        end)
        return loaded
    end

    local function colorAura(model)
        local seq=ColorSequence.new(AuraMenu.color)
        for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("PointLight") then
                d.Color=AuraMenu.color
            elseif d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") then
                d.Color=seq
            end
        end
    end

    function AuraMenu.apply()
        clearCreated()
        local character=LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then return 0 end
        local count=0
        for _,name in ipairs(order) do
            if AuraMenu.enabled[name] then
                local template=loadAura(name)
                if template then
                    count+=1
                    colorAura(template)
                    local cloned=template:Clone()
                    for _,part in ipairs(cloned:GetChildren()) do
                        local target=character:FindFirstChild(part.Name)
                        if target and target:IsA("BasePart") then
                            for _,child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                                child.Parent=target
                                AuraMenu.created[#AuraMenu.created+1]=child
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    pcall(function() cloned:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end
        return count
    end

    function AuraMenu.set(name,value)
        if AuraMenu.enabled[name]==nil then return end
        AuraMenu.enabled[name]=value==true
        AuraMenu.apply()
    end

    function AuraMenu.setColor(c)
        if typeof(c)=="Color3" then
            AuraMenu.color=c
            AuraMenu.apply()
        end
    end

    function AuraMenu.clear()
        for _,name in ipairs(order) do AuraMenu.enabled[name]=false end
        clearCreated()
    end

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(.45)
        pcall(AuraMenu.apply)
    end)

    _G.__QH_AURA_MENU=AuraMenu
end

-- ============================================================
-- QUANTOMHUB V3 • VISUAL BADGE / VERIFIED
-- Source: visual_badge (1).lua
-- Verified only. Starcode Creator is intentionally NOT included.
-- ============================================================
do
    local Badge = {
        enabled = false,
        tracked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        connections = {},
        loop = nil,
        oldIncoming = nil,
        characterConnection = nil,
        verified = " ✓",
        verifiedPrivate = utf8.char(0xE000),
    }

    local function disconnectAll()
        for i = #Badge.connections, 1, -1 do
            pcall(function()
                Badge.connections[i]:Disconnect()
            end)
            Badge.connections[i] = nil
        end
        if Badge.loop then
            pcall(task.cancel, Badge.loop)
            Badge.loop = nil
        end
        table.clear(Badge.tracked)
    end

    local function removeBadgeFromTree(root)
        pcall(function()
            for _, v in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextButton") then
                    local text = v.Text
                    if type(text) == "string" then
                        if text:find(Badge.verified, 1, true) then v.Text = text:gsub(Badge.verified, "") end
                        if text:find(Badge.verifiedPrivate, 1, true) then v.Text = v.Text:gsub(Badge.verifiedPrivate, "") end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function strip()
        removeBadgeFromTree(CoreGui)
        removeBadgeFromTree(LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer)
    end

    local function hasName(text)
        if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then
            return false
        end
        local display = tostring(LocalPlayer.DisplayName or "")
        local name = tostring(LocalPlayer.Name or "")
        return (display ~= "" and text:find(display, 1, true) ~= nil)
            or (name ~= "" and text:find(name, 1, true) ~= nil)
            or (name ~= "" and text:find("@" .. name, 1, true) ~= nil)
    end

    local function fix(label)
        if not Badge.enabled or not label or not label.Parent then return end
        local text = label.Text
        if type(text) ~= "string" or text == "" then return end
        if text:find(Badge.verified, 1, true) or text:find(Badge.verifiedPrivate, 1, true) then return end
        if not hasName(text) then return end

        local display = tostring(LocalPlayer.DisplayName or "")
        local name = tostring(LocalPlayer.Name or "")
        local replacement

        if display ~= "" and text:find(display, 1, true) then
            replacement = text:gsub(display, display .. Badge.verified, 1)
        elseif name ~= "" and text:find("@" .. name, 1, true) then
            replacement = text:gsub("@" .. name, "@" .. name .. Badge.verified, 1)
        elseif name ~= "" and text:find(name, 1, true) then
            replacement = text:gsub(name, name .. Badge.verified, 1)
        end

        if replacement and replacement ~= text then
            pcall(function()
                label.Text = replacement
            end)
        end
    end

    local function track(label)
        if not Badge.enabled or Badge.tracked[label] then return end
        if not (label:IsA("TextLabel") or label:IsA("TextButton")) then return end
        Badge.tracked[label] = true
        fix(label)
        local ok, conn = pcall(function()
            return label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                if Badge.enabled then
                    fix(label)
                end
            end)
        end)
        if ok and conn then
            Badge.connections[#Badge.connections + 1] = conn
        end
    end

    local function scanRoot(root)
        if not Badge.enabled or not root then return end
        pcall(function()
            for _, v in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("TextLabel") or v:IsA("TextButton") then
                    local text = v.Text
                    if hasName(text) then
                        track(v)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function scan()
        if not Badge.enabled then return end
        scanRoot(CoreGui)
        local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if pg then
            scanRoot(pg)
        end
    end

    local function makeChatPrefix(message)
        if not message or not message.TextSource then
            return nil
        end
        if message.TextSource.UserId ~= LocalPlayer.UserId then
            return nil
        end

        local prefix = message.PrefixText
        if type(prefix) ~= "string" or prefix == "" then
            prefix = tostring(LocalPlayer.DisplayName or LocalPlayer.Name) .. ":"
        end
        prefix = prefix:gsub(Badge.verified, ""):gsub(Badge.verifiedPrivate, "")
        prefix = prefix:gsub(":%s*$", "")
        return prefix .. Badge.verified .. ":"
    end

    local function updateWorldBadge()
        if not Badge.enabled then return end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
        if not head then return end
        local old = head:FindFirstChild("QHVerifiedBadge")
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "QHVerifiedBadge"
        bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(1.15, 2.15, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.MaxDistance = 100
        bb.Parent = head

        local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
        holder.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        holder.Parent = bb

        local circle = Instance.new("Frame")
        circle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
        circle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5)
        circle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22)
        circle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 90, 255)
        circle.BackgroundTransparency = .05
        circle.Parent = holder
        Instance.new("UICorner", circle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", circle)
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(225, 205, 255)
        stroke.Thickness = 1.5

        local check = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        check.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        check.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        check.Text = "✓"
        check.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        check.TextSize = 15
        check.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        check.Parent = circle
    end

    local function removeWorldBadge()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
        local old = head and head:FindFirstChild("QHVerifiedBadge")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
    end

    function Badge.enable()
        if Badge.enabled then
            scan()
            return
        end

        Badge.enabled = true
        Badge.oldIncoming = TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage

        TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(message)
            local props

            -- Preserve an existing chat formatter if one was already installed.
            if type(Badge.oldIncoming) == "function" then
                pcall(function()
                    props = Badge.oldIncoming(message)
                end)
            end

            if not props or not props:IsA("TextChatMessageProperties") then
                props = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
            end

            local prefix = makeChatPrefix(message)
            if prefix then
                props.PrefixText = prefix
            end

            return props
        end

        local function onAdded(obj)
            if not Badge.enabled then return end
            if obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
                task.defer(function()
                    if Badge.enabled then
                        track(obj)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end

        local ok1, c1 = pcall(function()
            return CoreGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(onAdded)
        end)
        if ok1 and c1 then
            Badge.connections[#Badge.connections + 1] = c1
        end

        local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if pg then
            local ok2, c2 = pcall(function()
                return pg.DescendantAdded:Connect(onAdded)
            end)
            if ok2 and c2 then
                Badge.connections[#Badge.connections + 1] = c2
            end
        end

        Badge.loop = task.spawn(function()
            while Badge.enabled do
                scan()
                task.wait(0.35)
            end
        end)

        scan()
        updateWorldBadge()
        if not Badge.characterConnection then
            Badge.characterConnection = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                task.wait(.35)
                if Badge.enabled then updateWorldBadge(); scan() end
            end)
        end
    end

    function Badge.disable()
        if not Badge.enabled then
            strip()
            return
        end

        Badge.enabled = false
        disconnectAll()

        if Badge.oldIncoming then
            pcall(function()
                TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = Badge.oldIncoming
            end)
        else
            pcall(function()
                TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = nil
            end)
        end
        Badge.oldIncoming = nil
        if Badge.characterConnection then pcall(function() Badge.characterConnection:Disconnect() end); Badge.characterConnection=nil end
        removeWorldBadge()
        strip()
    end

    function Badge.toggle(v)
        if v == true then
            Badge.enable()
        else
            Badge.disable()
        end
    end

    _G.__QH_VISUAL_BADGE = Badge
end

-- ANTI WATER
do
    local Terrain = workspace.Terrain
    local antiWaterZones = {}
    local antiWaterConnections = {}

    local function makeSwimmable(mapName, fakePart, clientScript)
        if not S.antiWaterEnabled then return end
        if not fakePart or not fakePart:IsA("BasePart") then return end

        if clientScript and clientScript:IsA("LocalScript") then
            clientScript.Enabled = false
        end

        fakePart.CanTouch = false

        if fakePart:GetAttribute("AguaTransformada") then
            return
        end

        fakePart:SetAttribute("AguaTransformada", true)

        local waterCFrame = fakePart.CFrame
        local waterSize = fakePart.Size

        pcall(function()
            Terrain:FillBlock(waterCFrame, waterSize, Enum.Material.Water)
        end)

        local visualWater = Instance.new("Part")
        visualWater.Name = "CustomWaterTexture"
        visualWater.Size = Vector3.new(waterSize.X + 0.1, waterSize.Y + 0.05, waterSize.Z + 0.1)
        visualWater.CFrame = waterCFrame
        visualWater.Anchored = true
        visualWater.CanCollide = false
        visualWater.CanQuery = false
        visualWater.CanTouch = false
        visualWater.CastShadow = false
        visualWater.Material = Enum.Material.Granite
        visualWater.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 227, 255)
        visualWater.Transparency = 0.85
        visualWater.Parent = fakePart.Parent
        fakePart.Transparency = 1

        table.insert(antiWaterZones, {
            mapa = mapName,
            cframe = waterCFrame,
            size = waterSize,
            parteFalsa = fakePart,
            parteVisual = visualWater,
        })
    end

    local function clearInjectedWater()
        for i = #antiWaterZones, 1, -1 do
            local zone = antiWaterZones[i]

            pcall(function()
                Terrain:FillBlock(zone.cframe, zone.size, Enum.Material.Air)
            end)

            if zone.parteVisual and zone.parteVisual.Parent then
                zone.parteVisual:Destroy()
            end

            if zone.parteFalsa and zone.parteFalsa.Parent then
                zone.parteFalsa:SetAttribute("AguaTransformada", nil)
                zone.parteFalsa.CanTouch = true
                zone.parteFalsa.Transparency = 0
            end

            table.remove(antiWaterZones, i)
        end
    end

    local mapAnalysisRunning = false
    local mapAnalysisQueued = false

    local function analyzeMaps()
        if not S.antiWaterEnabled or mapAnalysisRunning then
            mapAnalysisQueued = S.antiWaterEnabled and true or false
            return
        end
        mapAnalysisRunning = true

        local yacht = workspace:FindFirstChild("Yacht")
        if yacht then
            makeSwimmable(
                "Yacht",
                yacht:FindFirstChild("WaterPart", true),
                yacht:FindFirstChild("WaterClient", true)
            )
        end

        local pier = workspace:FindFirstChild("Pier")
        if pier then
            makeSwimmable(
                "Pier",
                pier:FindFirstChild("Respawn", true),
                pier:FindFirstChild("WaterClient", true)
            )
        end

        -- Scan in small chunks so a large map never stalls one frame.
        local descendants = workspace:GetDescendants()
        for i, v in ipairs(descendants) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                local name = string.lower(v.Name)
                if name:find("water")
                    or name:find("lava")
                    or name:find("acid")
                    or name:find("kill")
                    or name:find("death") then
                    pcall(function()
                        v.CanTouch = false
                    end)
                end
            end
            if i % 250 == 0 then
                task.wait()
            end
        end

        mapAnalysisRunning = false
        if mapAnalysisQueued and S.antiWaterEnabled then
            mapAnalysisQueued = false
            task.defer(analyzeMaps)
        else
            mapAnalysisQueued = false
        end
    end

    local pierProtectedParts = {}
    local function protectPier()
        local pier = workspace:FindFirstChild("Pier")
        if not pier then return end
        for _,v in ipairs(pier:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                local n=string.lower(v.Name)
                if n:find("water") or n:find("kill") or n:find("death") or n:find("respawn") or n:find("void") then
                    if pierProtectedParts[v] == nil then pierProtectedParts[v] = v.CanTouch end
                    pcall(function() v.CanTouch=false end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function restorePierProtection()
        for part,old in pairs(pierProtectedParts) do
            if part and part.Parent then pcall(function() part.CanTouch=old end) end
        end
        table.clear(pierProtectedParts)
    end

    local function isHazardPart(v)
        if not v or not v:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
        local name = string.lower(v.Name)
        return name:find("water") or name:find("lava") or name:find("acid")
            or name:find("kill") or name:find("death")
    end

    antiWaterConnections.hazardAdded = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
        if S.antiWaterEnabled and isHazardPart(v) then
            pcall(function() v.CanTouch = false end)
        end
    end)

    -- Optional water-walking controller. Roblox normally puts Humanoids in
    -- the Swimming state in Terrain water; this keeps that state disabled
    -- while the option is enabled and drives only horizontal movement.
    local waterWalkConnection = nil
    local waterWalkState = nil
    local antiWaterHealthConnection = nil
    local antiWaterHealthChanged = nil
    local antiWaterCharacterConnection = nil
    local antiWaterLastHealth = nil
    local isInTerrainWater

    local function hookAntiWaterHumanoid(char)
        if antiWaterHealthChanged then pcall(function() antiWaterHealthChanged:Disconnect() end); antiWaterHealthChanged=nil end
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return end
        antiWaterLastHealth = hum.Health
        antiWaterHealthChanged = hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(newHealth)
            if not S.antiWaterEnabled then return end
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then return end
            if isInTerrainWater(root) and antiWaterLastHealth and newHealth < antiWaterLastHealth then
                task.defer(function()
                    if hum.Parent and hum.Health > 0 and S.antiWaterEnabled then
                        pcall(function() hum.Health = antiWaterLastHealth end)
                    end
                end)
            else
                antiWaterLastHealth = newHealth
            end
        end)
    end

    local function startAntiWaterHealthGuard()
        if antiWaterHealthConnection then return end
        if antiWaterCharacterConnection then antiWaterCharacterConnection:Disconnect() end
        antiWaterCharacterConnection = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.wait(.15)
            if S.antiWaterEnabled then hookAntiWaterHumanoid(char) end
        end)
        hookAntiWaterHumanoid(LocalPlayer.Character)
        antiWaterHealthConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not S.antiWaterEnabled then return end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
            if isInTerrainWater(root) then
                if antiWaterLastHealth and hum.Health < antiWaterLastHealth then
                    pcall(function() hum.Health = antiWaterLastHealth end)
                else
                    antiWaterLastHealth = math.max(antiWaterLastHealth or 0, hum.Health)
                end
            else
                antiWaterLastHealth = hum.Health
            end
        end)
    end

    local function stopAntiWaterHealthGuard()
        if antiWaterHealthConnection then antiWaterHealthConnection:Disconnect(); antiWaterHealthConnection=nil end
        if antiWaterHealthChanged then pcall(function() antiWaterHealthChanged:Disconnect() end); antiWaterHealthChanged=nil end
        if antiWaterCharacterConnection then antiWaterCharacterConnection:Disconnect(); antiWaterCharacterConnection=nil end
        antiWaterLastHealth=nil
    end

    isInTerrainWater = function(root)
        if not root then return false end
        local p = root.Position
        local ok, materials = pcall(function()
            local region = Region3.new(
                p - Vector3.new(2, 2.5, 2),
                p + Vector3.new(2, 2.5, 2)
            ):ExpandToGrid(4)
            return Terrain:ReadVoxels(region, 4)
        end)
        if not ok or not materials then return false end

        for x = 1, #materials do
            for y = 1, #materials[x] do
                for z = 1, #materials[x][y] do
                    if materials[x][y][z] == Enum.Material.Water then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function stopWaterWalk()
        if waterWalkConnection then
            waterWalkConnection:Disconnect()
            waterWalkConnection = nil
        end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, true) end)
            if hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics then
                pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
            end
        end
        waterWalkState = nil
    end

    local function startWaterWalk()
        stopWaterWalk()
        local waterWalkAccumulator = 0
        waterWalkConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            waterWalkAccumulator += dt
            if waterWalkAccumulator < 0.08 then return end
            waterWalkAccumulator = 0
            if not S.antiWaterEnabled or not S.waterWalkEnabled then return end

            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

            local inWater = isInTerrainWater(root)
            if inWater then
                if not waterWalkState then
                    waterWalkState = true
                    pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, false) end)
                end

                local move = hum.MoveDirection
                local speed = tonumber(hum.WalkSpeed) or 16
                local horizontal = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z) * speed
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(horizontal.X, 0, horizontal.Z)
                pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
            elseif waterWalkState then
                waterWalkState = nil
                pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, true) end)
            end
        end)
    end

    function setWaterWalk(enabled)
        S.waterWalkEnabled = enabled == true
        if S.waterWalkEnabled and S.antiWaterEnabled then
            startWaterWalk()
        else
            stopWaterWalk()
        end
    end

    function setAntiWater(enabled)
        S.antiWaterEnabled = enabled == true
        if S.antiWaterEnabled then
            startAntiWaterHealthGuard()
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(analyzeMaps)
                protectPier()
                if S.waterWalkEnabled then startWaterWalk() end
            end)
        else
            stopWaterWalk()
            stopAntiWaterHealthGuard()
            clearInjectedWater()
        end
    end

    -- Keep the map-specific behavior from the supplied anti_water.lua.
    antiWaterConnections.childRemoved = workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
        if child.Name == "Yacht" or child.Name == "Pier" or child:IsA("Model") then
            for i = #antiWaterZones, 1, -1 do
                local zone = antiWaterZones[i]

                if zone.mapa == child.Name or not zone.parteFalsa or not zone.parteFalsa.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        Terrain:FillBlock(zone.cframe, zone.size, Enum.Material.Air)
                    end)

                    if zone.parteVisual and zone.parteVisual.Parent then
                        zone.parteVisual:Destroy()
                    end

                    table.remove(antiWaterZones, i)
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    antiWaterConnections.childAdded = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if S.antiWaterEnabled and (child.Name == "Yacht" or child.Name == "Pier") then
            task.delay(1, analyzeMaps)
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.20) do
            if not S.antiWaterEnabled then continue end
            pcall(protectPier)
            local char=LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                pcall(function()
                    if hum:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
                        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        if S.antiWaterEnabled then
            startAntiWaterHealthGuard()
            pcall(analyzeMaps)
            protectPier()
            if S.waterWalkEnabled then
                pcall(startWaterWalk)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- FLING
do
    local t = Sect:Tab({Title="Fling", Icon="zap"})
    t:Section({Title="Fling Players", TextSize=18})

    -- Shows the names of players currently on the server.
    -- Selecting one immediately flings only that player.
    local flingNames = {}
    local flingByName = {}

    for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
        if pl ~= LocalPlayer then
            local displayName = pl.Name
            if pl.DisplayName and pl.DisplayName ~= pl.Name then
                displayName = pl.Name .. "  (" .. pl.DisplayName .. ")"
            end
            table.insert(flingNames, displayName)
            flingByName[displayName] = pl
        end
    end

    table.sort(flingNames, function(a, b)
        return a:lower() < b:lower()
    end)

    if #flingNames == 0 then
        flingNames = {"No players"}
    end

    t:Dropdown({
        Flag="FlingPlayer",
        Title="Fling Player",
        Values=flingNames,
        Value=flingNames[1],
        Search=true,
        Callback=function(value)
            local selected = flingByName[tostring(value)]
            if selected and selected ~= LocalPlayer and selected.Parent == Players then
                task.spawn(function()
                    Fling.execute(selected)
                end)
                U.notify("Fling", "Flinging " .. selected.Name, "zap", 3)
            else
                U.notify("Fling", "Player is no longer on the server", "x-circle", 3)
            end
        end
    })

    t:Section({
        Title="Select a player to run the action only on that player",
        TextSize=12,
        TextTransparency=0.25
    })

    t:Space()
    t:Button({
        Title="Fling Murder",
        Icon="skull",
        Color=S.C.Blood,
        Justify="Center",
        Callback=function() task.spawn(Fling.murderer) end
    })

    t:Space()
    t:Button({
        Title="Fling Sheriff",
        Icon="shield",
        Color=S.C.RoyalBlue,
        Justify="Center",
        Callback=function() task.spawn(Fling.sheriff) end
    })

    t:Space()
    t:Toggle({
        Flag="ClickFling",
        Title="Click Fling",
        Default=false,
        Callback=function(v) S.clickFlingEnabled = v end
    })

    t:Space()
    t:Toggle({
        Flag="TouchFling",
        Title="Touch Fling",
        Default=false,
        Callback=function(v) S.touchFlingEnabled = v end
    })

    -- Keep the player-name lookup valid when players leave/rejoin.
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(pl)
        flingByName[pl.Name] = nil
        if pl.DisplayName and pl.DisplayName ~= pl.Name then
            flingByName[pl.Name .. "  (" .. pl.DisplayName .. ")"] = nil
        end
    end)

    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(pl)
        if pl ~= LocalPlayer then
            local displayName = pl.Name
            if pl.DisplayName and pl.DisplayName ~= pl.Name then
                displayName = pl.Name .. "  (" .. pl.DisplayName .. ")"
            end
            flingByName[displayName] = pl
        end
    end)
end

-- SPAWNER
do
    local t = Sect:Tab({Title="Spawner", Icon="package"})
    t:Section({Title="Item Spawner", TextSize=18})
    t:Paragraph({
        Title="Weapon database",
        Content="Search by name or ID. The list is populated from the MM2 item database when available."
    })

    t:Input({
        Flag="SpawnItem",
        Title="Item Name / ID",
        Placeholder="Lightbringer / Chroma Luger",
        Callback=function(v)
            S.currentSpawnItem = tostring(v or "")
        end
    })

    t:Space()

    t:Button({
        Title="Spawn & Equip",
        Icon="package-plus",
        Color=S.C.MidPurple,
        Justify="Center",
        Callback=function()
            Spawner.spawn(S.currentSpawnItem)
        end
    })

    t:Space()

    local function buildWeaponDisplayList()
        local list = {}

        for _, entry in ipairs(Spawner.WeaponsList) do
            if not Spawner.Blocked[entry.ID] then
                local suffix = entry.Rarity and (" [" .. entry.Rarity .. "]") or ""
                table.insert(list, entry.Title .. suffix)
            end
        end

        return list
    end

    local weaponDropdown = t:Dropdown({
        Flag="WeaponList",
        Title="Pick From Database",
        Values=buildWeaponDisplayList(),
        Search=true,
        Callback=function(v)
            local sel = typeof(v)=="table"
                and (v.Title or v.Name)
                or tostring(v or "")

            for _, entry in ipairs(Spawner.WeaponsList) do
                local display = entry.Title
                    .. (entry.Rarity and (" ["..entry.Rarity.."]") or "")

                if display == sel then
                    S.currentSpawnItem = entry.ID
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    })

    -- The reference spawner loads the database asynchronously. Refresh the
    -- dropdown after it becomes ready so dynamically discovered items appear.
    task.spawn(function()
        local deadline = os.clock() + 12

        while not Spawner.Ready and os.clock() < deadline do
            task.wait(0.25)
        end

        pcall(function()
            if weaponDropdown and weaponDropdown.SetValues then
                weaponDropdown:SetValues(buildWeaponDisplayList())
            elseif weaponDropdown and weaponDropdown.SetValue then
                -- Some library builds rebuild dropdown values through SetValue;
                -- leave the initial list intact if SetValues is unavailable.
            end
        end)
    end)

    t:Space()
    t:Section({Title="Bulk Spawner", TextSize=18})

    t:Input({
        Flag="SpawnAmount",
        Title="Amount",
        Value="1",
        Callback=function(v)
            S.spawnAmount = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 1, 1, 100)
        end
    })

    t:Space()

    t:Button({
        Title="Spawn Selected × Amount",
        Icon="copy-plus",
        Color=S.C.MidPurple,
        Justify="Center",
        Callback=function()
            if S.currentSpawnItem == "" then
                U.notify("Spawner", "Select an item first", "x", 3)
                return
            end

            task.spawn(function()
                local sent = Spawner.spawnMany(
                    S.currentSpawnItem,
                    S.spawnAmount or 1
                )

                U.notify(
                    "Spawner",
                    "Sent " .. tostring(sent) .. " spawn request(s)",
                    "package",
                    3
                )
            end)
        end
    })

    t:Space()

    t:Button({
        Title="Spawn High Tier",
        Icon="sparkles",
        Color=S.C.Indigo,
        Justify="Center",
        Callback=function()
            task.spawn(function()
                local high = {
                    Chroma=true,
                    Godly=true,
                    Ancient=true,
                    Classic=true,
                    Legendary=true,
                    Vintage=true
                }

                local ranges = {
                    Chroma={1,2},
                    Godly={1,5},
                    Ancient={2,6},
                    Classic={3,10},
                    Legendary={4,12},
                    Vintage={5,15}
                }

                local count, total = 0, 0

                for _, entry in ipairs(Spawner.WeaponsList) do
                    if not Spawner.Blocked[entry.ID]
                        and high[entry.Rarity] then

                        local amount = tonumber(S.spawnAmount) or 0

                        if amount <= 0 then
                            local r = ranges[entry.Rarity] or {1,3}
                            amount = math.random(r[1], r[2])
                        end

                        local sent = Spawner.spawnMany(entry.ID, amount)

                        if sent > 0 then
                            count += 1
                            total += sent
                        end
                    end
                end

                U.notify(
                    "Spawner",
                    string.format(
                        "Spawned %d types / %d requests",
                        count,
                        total
                    ),
                    "sparkles",
                    4
                )
            end)
        end
    })

    t:Space()

    t:Button({
        Title="Purge Blocked Entries",
        Icon="trash-2",
        Color=S.C.Blood,
        Justify="Center",
        Callback=function()
            Spawner.purgeBlocked()
        end
    })

    t:Space()
    t:Section({Title="Weapon Dupe", TextSize=18})

    t:Input({
        Flag="DupeName",
        Title="Weapon",
        Placeholder="Lightbringer",
        Callback=function(v)
            S.dupeName = tostring(v or "")
        end
    })

    t:Space()

    t:Input({
        Flag="DupeAmt",
        Title="Amount",
        Value="1",
        Callback=function(v)
            S.dupeAmount = tonumber(v) or 1
        end
    })

    t:Space()

    t:Button({
        Title="Start Dupe",
        Icon="layers",
        Color=S.C.Indigo,
        Justify="Center",
        Callback=function()
            if S.dupeName ~= "" then
                task.spawn(function()
                    for _ = 1, math.clamp(
                        tonumber(S.dupeAmount) or 1,
                        1,
                        100
                    ) do
                        pcall(function()
                            Dupe.weapon()
                        end)
                        task.wait(.05)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    })
end

    local function getColor(name)
        return colorMap[name] or colorMap.Cyan
    end

    local function destroySafe(obj)
        if obj then pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
    end

    local function clearHatDrawings()
        for _, pair in ipairs(hatDrawing) do
            for _, d in ipairs(pair) do
                pcall(function() d:Remove() end)
            end
        end
        hatDrawing = {}
    end

    local function buildHatDrawings()
        clearHatDrawings()
        if not Drawing or type(Drawing.new) ~= "function" then return false end
        local count = math.max(3, math.min(300, math.floor(S.xHatSides)))
        for _=1,count do
            local ok1,l = pcall(Drawing.new,"Line")
            local ok2,tr = pcall(Drawing.new,"Triangle")
            if not ok1 or not ok2 or not l or not tr then
                clearHatDrawings()
                return false
            end
            l.ZIndex=2; l.Thickness=2
            tr.ZIndex=1; tr.Filled=true
            table.insert(hatDrawing,{l,tr})
        end
        return true
    end

    local function removeHatClassic()
        destroySafe(hatPart)
        hatPart=nil
    end

    local function addHatClassic()
        removeHatClassic()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local head=char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        local hat=Instance.new("Part")
        hat.Name="qhChineseHat"
        hat.Transparency=S.xHatTransparency
        hat.Color=getColor(S.xHatColor)
        hat.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
        hat.CanCollide=false
        hat.CanQuery=false
        hat.CanTouch=false
        hat.Massless=true
        hat.Reflectance=S.xHatReflectance
        local mesh=Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        mesh.MeshId="rbxassetid://1033714"
        mesh.Scale=Vector3.new(S.xHatRadius,S.xHatHeight,S.xHatRadius)
        mesh.Parent=hat
        local weld=Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        weld.Part0=head; weld.Part1=hat; weld.Parent=hat
        hat.CFrame=head.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,1.1,0)
        hat.Parent=char
        hatPart=hat
    end

    local function updateHatClassic()
        if not hatPart or not hatPart.Parent then return end
        hatPart.Transparency=S.xHatTransparency
        hatPart.Reflectance=S.xHatReflectance
        hatPart.Color=S.xHatRainbow and Color3.fromHSV((tick()%math.max(S.xHatRainbowSpeed,1))/math.max(S.xHatRainbowSpeed,1),1,1) or getColor(S.xHatColor)
        local mesh=hatPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
        if mesh then mesh.Scale=Vector3.new(S.xHatRadius,S.xHatHeight,S.xHatRadius) end
    end

    local function updateHatDrawing()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local head=char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local cam=workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not (head and cam and S.xHatEnabled and S.xHatStyle=="Drawing") then
            for _,pair in ipairs(hatDrawing) do pair[1].Visible=false; pair[2].Visible=false end
            return
        end
        if #hatDrawing ~= math.max(3, math.min(300, math.floor(S.xHatSides))) then
            if not buildHatDrawings() then return end
        end
        local radius=S.xHatRadius
        local base=head.Position+Vector3.new(0,0.75,0)
        local topWorld=base+Vector3.new(0,0.75,0)
        local top=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(topWorld)
        local tau=math.pi*2
        for i,pair in ipairs(hatDrawing) do
            local a=(i/#hatDrawing)*tau
            local b=((i+1)/#hatDrawing)*tau
            local wa=base+Vector3.new(math.cos(a),0,math.sin(a))*radius
            local wb=base+Vector3.new(math.cos(b),0,math.sin(b))*radius
            local sa=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(wa)
            local sb=cam:WorldToViewportPoint(wb)
            local col=S.xHatRainbow and Color3.fromHSV((tick()%math.max(S.xHatRainbowSpeed,1))/math.max(S.xHatRainbowSpeed,1)-(i/#hatDrawing),0.65,1) or getColor(S.xHatColor)
            pair[1].From=Vector2.new(sa.X,sa.Y); pair[1].To=Vector2.new(sb.X,sb.Y); pair[1].Color=col; pair[1].Transparency=1-S.xHatTransparency; pair[1].Visible=true
            pair[2].PointA=Vector2.new(top.X,top.Y); pair[2].PointB=pair[1].From; pair[2].PointC=pair[1].To; pair[2].Color=col; pair[2].Transparency=0.35; pair[2].Visible=true
        end
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.toggleHat(v)
        S.xHatEnabled=v
        if not v then
            removeHatClassic(); clearHatDrawings()
            if hatDrawingConnection then hatDrawingConnection:Disconnect(); hatDrawingConnection=nil end
            return
        end
        if S.xHatStyle=="Classic" then
            addHatClassic()
            if hatDrawingConnection then hatDrawingConnection:Disconnect(); hatDrawingConnection=nil end
        else
            removeHatClassic()
            if not buildHatDrawings() then
                U.notify("Hat","Drawing API unavailable; Classic mode used","alert-triangle",3)
                S.xHatStyle="Classic"
                addHatClassic()
                return
            end
            if hatDrawingConnection then hatDrawingConnection:Disconnect() end
            hatDrawingConnection=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(updateHatDrawing)
        end
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.setHatStyle(style)
        S.xHatStyle=style
        if S.xHatEnabled then ExtraVisuals.toggleHat(false); task.defer(function() ExtraVisuals.toggleHat(true) end) end
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.toggleTrail(v)
        S.xTrailEnabled=v
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        if not v or not char then
            destroySafe(trailObj); trailObj=nil; destroySafe(trailA0); destroySafe(trailA1); trailA0=nil; trailA1=nil
            return
        end
        local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        destroySafe(trailObj); destroySafe(trailA0); destroySafe(trailA1)
        trailA0=Instance.new("Attachment",root); trailA0.Name="qhExtraTrail0"; trailA0.Position=Vector3.new(0,2,0)
        trailA1=Instance.new("Attachment",root); trailA1.Name="qhExtraTrail1"; trailA1.Position=Vector3.new(0,-2,0)
        trailObj=Instance.new("Trail")
        trailObj.Name="qhExtraTrail"
        trailObj.Attachment0=trailA0; trailObj.Attachment1=trailA1
        trailObj.Lifetime=S.xTrailLifetime
        trailObj.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,S.xTrailTransparency),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1))
        trailObj.LightEmission=0.2; trailObj.Enabled=true
        trailObj.Parent=char
        ExtraVisuals.updateTrail()
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.updateTrail()
        if not trailObj then return end
        trailObj.Lifetime=S.xTrailLifetime
        trailObj.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,S.xTrailTransparency),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1))
        if S.xTrailGradient then
            trailObj.Color=ColorSequence.new(getColor(S.xTrailGradient1),getColor(S.xTrailGradient2))
        elseif S.xTrailRainbow then
            local c=Color3.fromHSV((tick()%5)/5,1,1)
            trailObj.Color=ColorSequence.new(c)
        else
            trailObj.Color=ColorSequence.new(getColor(S.xTrailColor))
        end
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.toggleAuraTrailer(v)
        S.xAuraTrailerEnabled=v
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        for _,obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj.Name==auraTrailerNames[1] or obj.Name==auraTrailerNames[2] or obj.Name==auraTrailerNames[3] then destroySafe(obj) end
        end
        if not v then return end
        for _,part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part~=root then
                local trail=Instance.new("Trail")
                trail.Name=auraTrailerNames[1]
                trail.Texture="rbxassetid://1390780157"
                local a0=Instance.new("Attachment",part); a0.Name=auraTrailerNames[2]
                local a1=Instance.new("Attachment",root); a1.Name=auraTrailerNames[3]
                trail.Attachment0=a0; trail.Attachment1=a1
                trail.Color=ColorSequence.new(getColor(S.xAuraTrailerColor))
                trail.Lifetime=S.xAuraTrailerLifetime
                trail.Parent=part
            end
        end
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.updateAuraTrailer()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        for _,v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("Trail") and v.Name==auraTrailerNames[1] then
                v.Color=ColorSequence.new(getColor(S.xAuraTrailerColor)); v.Lifetime=S.xAuraTrailerLifetime
            end
        end
    end

    local function clearForceField(char)
        if forceFieldOriginal[char] then
            for part,data in pairs(forceFieldOriginal[char]) do
                if part and part.Parent then pcall(function() part.Color=data.Color; part.Material=data.Material end) end
            end
        end
        forceFieldOriginal[char]=nil
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.toggleForceField(v)
        S.xForceFieldEnabled=v
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        if not v then clearForceField(char); return end
        clearForceField(char)
        forceFieldOriginal[char]={}
        for _,part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name~="HumanoidRootPart" then
                forceFieldOriginal[char][part]={Color=part.Color,Material=part.Material}
                part.Material=Enum.Material.ForceField
                part.Color=getColor(S.xForceFieldColor)
            end
        end
        ExtraVisuals.updateForceField()
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.updateForceField()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        if not (char and S.xForceFieldEnabled) then return end
        for _,part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Material==Enum.Material.ForceField then
                part.Color=S.xForceFieldRainbow and Color3.fromHSV((tick()%5)/5,1,1) or getColor(S.xForceFieldColor)
            end
        end
    end

    local function loadCached(cache,id)
        if cache[id] then return cache[id]:Clone() end
        local obj=nil
        pcall(function()
            local objects=game:GetObjects(id)
            obj=objects[1]
        end)
        if not obj then return nil end
        cache[id]=obj
        cache[id].Parent=nil
        return obj:Clone()
    end

    local function clearActiveAuras()
        if classicActive then
            for _,v in ipairs(classicActive) do destroySafe(v) end
            classicActive=nil
        end
        if particleActive then
            for _,v in ipairs(particleActive) do destroySafe(v) end
            particleActive=nil
        end
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.refreshClassicAura()
        if classicActive then for _,v in ipairs(classicActive) do destroySafe(v) end; classicActive=nil end
        if not S.xClassicAuraEnabled then return end
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local id=classicIds[S.xClassicAura]
        if not (char and id) then return end
        local model=loadCached(classicCache,id)
        if not model then return end
        classicActive={}
        for _,obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
            if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                local clone=obj:Clone()
                local parentName=obj.Parent and obj.Parent.Name
                local target=char:FindFirstChild(parentName) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                if target then clone.Parent=target; table.insert(classicActive,clone) else clone:Destroy() end
            end
        end
        model:Destroy()
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.refreshParticleAura()
        if particleActive then for _,v in ipairs(particleActive) do destroySafe(v) end; particleActive=nil end
        if not S.xParticleAuraEnabled then return end
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local id=particleIds[S.xParticleAura]
        if not (char and id) then return end
        local template=loadCached(particleCache,id)
        if not template then return end
        particleActive={}
        local parts={}
        for _,c in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("BasePart") then parts[c.Name]=c end end
        for _,part in ipairs(template:GetChildren()) do
            local target=parts[part.Name]
            if target then
                for _,child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
                    local inst=child:Clone()
                    if inst:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then inst.Color=ColorSequence.new(getColor(S.xParticleAuraColor)) end
                    inst.Name="qhParticleAura"
                    inst.Parent=target
                    table.insert(particleActive,inst)
                end
            end
        end
        template:Destroy()
    end

    local function restoreNebula()
        for _,name in ipairs({"qhNebulaBloom","qhNebulaCC","qhNebulaAtm"}) do destroySafe(Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)) end
        if nebulaAmbient ~= nil then
            Lighting.Ambient=nebulaAmbient
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=nebulaOutdoorAmbient
            Lighting.FogStart=nebulaFogStart
            Lighting.FogEnd=nebulaFogEnd
            Lighting.FogColor=nebulaFogColor
        end
        nebulaAmbient=nil
        nebulaOutdoorAmbient=nil
        nebulaFogStart=nil
        nebulaFogEnd=nil
        nebulaFogColor=nil
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.toggleNebula(v)
        S.xNebulaEnabled=v
        if not v then restoreNebula(); return end
        if nebulaAmbient == nil then
            nebulaAmbient=Lighting.Ambient
            nebulaOutdoorAmbient=Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
            nebulaFogStart=Lighting.FogStart
            nebulaFogEnd=Lighting.FogEnd
            nebulaFogColor=Lighting.FogColor
        end
        restoreNebula()
        local b=Instance.new("BloomEffect",Lighting); b.Name="qhNebulaBloom"; b.Intensity=0.7; b.Size=24; b.Threshold=1
        local c=Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect",Lighting); c.Name="qhNebulaCC"; c.Saturation=0.5; c.Contrast=0.2; c.TintColor=getColor(S.xNebulaColor)
        local a=Instance.new("Atmosphere",Lighting); a.Name="qhNebulaAtm"; a.Density=0.4; a.Offset=0.25; a.Glare=1; a.Haze=2; a.Color=getColor(S.xNebulaColor); a.Decay=Color3.fromRGB(173,216,230)
        Lighting.Ambient=getColor(S.xNebulaColor); Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=getColor(S.xNebulaColor); Lighting.FogStart=100; Lighting.FogEnd=500; Lighting.FogColor=getColor(S.xNebulaColor)
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.updateNebula()
        if not S.xNebulaEnabled then return end
        local c=Lighting:FindFirstChild("qhNebulaCC"); if c then c.TintColor=getColor(S.xNebulaColor) end
        local a=Lighting:FindFirstChild("qhNebulaAtm"); if a then a.Color=getColor(S.xNebulaColor) end
        Lighting.Ambient=getColor(S.xNebulaColor); Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=getColor(S.xNebulaColor); Lighting.FogColor=getColor(S.xNebulaColor)
    end
