    local function makeAnimeDraggable(img)
        local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
        img.Active = true
        img.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = img.Position
            end
        end)
        img.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                img.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.toggleAnime(v)
        S.xAnimeImage=v
        destroySafe(animeGui); animeGui=nil
        if not v then return end

        animeGui=Instance.new("ScreenGui",CoreGui)
        animeGui.Name="qhAnimeImage"
        animeGui.ResetOnSpawn=false
        animeGui.IgnoreGuiInset=true
        animeGui.DisplayOrder=120

        local img=Instance.new("ImageLabel",animeGui)
        img.Name="AnimeImage"

        local function resolveImageTexture(assetId)
            assetId = tostring(assetId or "")
            if assetId == "" then return "" end

            -- First: resolve the Creator Store asset as a Decal/Image object
            -- and use the actual Texture value. This is more reliable than
            -- feeding the catalog asset id directly to ImageLabel.Image.
            local ok, objects = pcall(function()
                return game:GetObjects(assetId)
            end)

            if ok and type(objects) == "table" then
                for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
                    if obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
                        local texture = obj.Texture
                        pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                        if texture and texture ~= "" then
                            return texture
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                        local texture = obj.Image
                        pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                        if texture and texture ~= "" then
                            return texture
                        end
                    end
                end
                for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
                    pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                end
            end

            -- Fallback: use the supplied ID directly for legacy decals.
            return assetId
        end

        img.Image=resolveImageTexture(
            ANIME_IMAGES[S.xAnimeImageStyle] or ANIME_IMAGES["Quantom Original"]
        )
        img.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(380,430)
        img.Position=S.xAnimeImagePosition or UDim2.new(1,-25,0,10)
        img.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,0)
        img.BackgroundTransparency=1
        img.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        img.Visible=false

        task.spawn(function()
            local loaded=false
            pcall(function()
                game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({img})
                loaded=(img.Image~="")
            end)

            if animeGui and img.Parent then
                img.Visible=true
                if not loaded then
                    img.Image=ANIME_IMAGES["Quantom Original"]
                    pcall(function()
                        game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({img})
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)

        makeAnimeDraggable(img)

        local function savePos()
            S.xAnimeImagePosition = img.Position
        end
        img:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(savePos)
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.setAnimeImageStyle(name)
        name = tostring(name or "Quantom Original")
        if not ANIME_IMAGES[name] then name = "Quantom Original" end
        S.xAnimeImageStyle = name
        if S.xAnimeImage then
            ExtraVisuals.toggleAnime(false)
            task.defer(function() ExtraVisuals.toggleAnime(true) end)
        end
    end

    local function ensureVariants()
        if variantsReady then return end
        for name,data in pairs(textureVariants) do
            pcall(function()
                local v=MaterialService:FindFirstChild(name)
                if not v then v=Instance.new("MaterialVariant"); v.Name=name; v.Parent=MaterialService end
                v.BaseMaterial=data[1]; v.ColorMap=data[2]; v.MetalnessMap=data[2]; v.NormalMap=data[2]; v.RoughnessMap=data[2]; v.MaterialPattern=Enum.MaterialPattern.Regular; v.StudsPerTile=5
            end)
        end
        variantsReady=true
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.toggleTextures(v)
        v = v == true
        S.xMinecraftTextures = v
        local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")

        if v then
            if texturePackActive then return end
            texturePackActive = true
            ensureVariants()

            if terrain and next(originalTerrainColors) == nil then
                for mat in pairs(terrainColors) do
                    local ok, col = pcall(function() return terrain:GetMaterialColor(mat) end)
                    if ok then originalTerrainColors[mat] = col end
                end
            end
            if terrain then
                for mat, col in pairs(terrainColors) do
                    pcall(function() terrain:SetMaterialColor(mat, col) end)
                end
            end

            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local model = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                    local isPlayer = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
                    local parent = obj.Parent
                    if not isPlayer and not (parent and (parent:IsA("Tool") or parent:IsA("Accessory"))) then
                        if not textureState[obj] then
                            textureState[obj] = {Color=obj.Color, Material=obj.Material, Variant=obj.MaterialVariant}
                        end
                        local vName = materialToVariant[obj.Material]
                        if vName then pcall(function() obj.MaterialVariant = vName end) end
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            texturePackActive = false
            for part, state in pairs(textureState) do
                if part and part.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        part.Color = state.Color
                        part.Material = state.Material
                        part.MaterialVariant = state.Variant or ""
                    end)
                end
            end
            table.clear(textureState)
            if terrain then
                for mat, col in pairs(originalTerrainColors) do
                    pcall(function() terrain:SetMaterialColor(mat, col) end)
                end
            end
            table.clear(originalTerrainColors)
            for name in pairs(textureVariants) do
                local variant = MaterialService:FindFirstChild(name)
                if variant and variant:IsA("MaterialVariant") then
                    pcall(function() variant:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
            variantsReady = false
        end
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.setTimeEnabled(v)
        S.xTimeEnabled=v
        if not v then return end
        Lighting.ClockTime=S.xTimeValue
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.setFullBright(v)
        S.xFullBright=v
        if v then
            Lighting.Brightness=3
            Lighting.GlobalShadows=false
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        else
            Lighting.Brightness=originalBrightness
            Lighting.GlobalShadows=originalShadows
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=originalOutdoor
        end
    end

    -- Safe cosmetic body prop: a configurable non-sexual front accessory.
    local bodyProp = nil
    local bodyPropWeld = nil

    local function clearBodyProp()
        if bodyPropWeld then
            pcall(function() bodyPropWeld:Destroy() end)
            bodyPropWeld = nil
        end
        if bodyProp then
            pcall(function() bodyProp:Destroy() end)
            bodyProp = nil
        end
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.updateBodyProp()
        if not bodyProp then return end
        local scale = math.clamp(tonumber(S.xBodyPropScale) or 1, 0.6, 2.5)
        bodyProp.Size = Vector3.new(0.8 * scale, 0.8 * scale, 2.8 * scale)
        bodyProp.Color = getColor(S.xBodyPropColor)
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.toggleBodyProp(enabled)
        S.xBodyPropEnabled = enabled == true
        clearBodyProp()
        if not S.xBodyPropEnabled then return end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end

        bodyProp = Instance.new("Part")
        bodyProp.Name = "qhCosmeticBodyProp"
        bodyProp.Anchored = false
        bodyProp.CanCollide = false
        bodyProp.CanTouch = false
        bodyProp.CanQuery = false
        bodyProp.Massless = true
        bodyProp.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        bodyProp.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        bodyProp.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 2.8, 0.8)
        bodyProp.Color = getColor(S.xBodyPropColor)
        bodyProp.Parent = char

        bodyPropWeld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        bodyPropWeld.Part0 = root
        bodyPropWeld.Part1 = bodyProp
        bodyPropWeld.Parent = bodyProp

        -- angled front-side placement; intentionally a generic cosmetic accessory.
        bodyProp.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.9, -0.2, -1.15) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        ExtraVisuals.updateBodyProp()
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.setBodyPropColor(name)
        S.xBodyPropColor = tostring(name or "Cyan")
        ExtraVisuals.updateBodyProp()
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.setBodyPropScale(v)
        S.xBodyPropScale = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 1, 0.6, 2.5)
        ExtraVisuals.updateBodyProp()
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- ARCHIVE VISUAL PACK
    -- Juju Healing Aura + Walk Steps. These are native Roblox
    -- ParticleEmitters so they do not require a local .rbxm file.
    -- ============================================================
    local function clearJujuAura()
        for _, e in ipairs(jujuEmitters) do destroySafe(e) end
        table.clear(jujuEmitters)
        destroySafe(jujuAttachment)
        jujuAttachment=nil
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.toggleJujuAura(enabled)
        S.xJujuAuraEnabled = enabled == true
        clearJujuAura()
        if not S.xJujuAuraEnabled then return end
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local root=char and (char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
        if not root then return end

        jujuAttachment=Instance.new("Attachment")
        jujuAttachment.Name="qhJujuHealingAura"
        jujuAttachment.Parent=root

        local c=getColor("Purple")
        local function makeEmitter(name, texture, lifetime, rate, speed, size, spread, light)
            local e=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            e.Name=name
            e.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(lifetime,lifetime)
            e.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(spread,spread)
            e.LockedToPart=true
            e.LightEmission=light
            e.Color=ColorSequence.new(S.xJujuAuraColor or c)
            e.VelocitySpread=spread
            e.Speed=NumberRange.new(speed*.65,speed)
            e.Brightness=8
            e.Size=NumberSequence.new(size,size*.65)
            e.Rate=rate
            e.Texture=texture
            e.Rotation=NumberRange.new(-180,180)
            e.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-180,180)
            e.Parent=jujuAttachment
            table.insert(jujuEmitters,e)
            return e
        end

        makeEmitter("Healing Wave 1","rbxassetid://8047533775",1.5,20,6,2.8,10,0.4)
        makeEmitter("Healing Wave 2","rbxassetid://8047796070",1.5,20,5,2.5,10,1)
        makeEmitter("Sparks","rbxassetid://8611887361",1.25,40,15,.42,180,1)
        makeEmitter("Star Sparks","rbxassetid://8611887703",1.5,25,10,.68,180,1)
        ExtraVisuals.updateJujuAura()
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.updateJujuAura()
        if not S.xJujuAuraEnabled then return end
        for _,e in ipairs(jujuEmitters) do
            if e and e.Parent then
                e.Color=ColorSequence.new(S.xJujuAuraColor)
                local intensity=math.clamp(tonumber(S.xJujuAuraIntensity) or 1,.1,1)
                e.Rate=math.max(1,math.floor(e.Rate*intensity))
            end
        end
    end

    local function clearWalkSteps()
        destroySafe(walkEmitter)
        walkEmitter=nil
        destroySafe(walkAttachment)
        walkAttachment=nil
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.toggleWalkSteps(enabled)
        S.xWalkStepsEnabled=enabled==true
        clearWalkSteps()
        if not S.xWalkStepsEnabled then return end
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        walkAttachment=Instance.new("Attachment")
        walkAttachment.Name="qhWalkSteps"
        walkAttachment.Position=Vector3.new(0,-2.5,0)
        walkAttachment.Parent=root
        walkEmitter=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        walkEmitter.Name="Indicator"
        walkEmitter.Texture="rbxassetid://8611887361"
        walkEmitter.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.35,.65)
        walkEmitter.Rate=S.xWalkStepsRate
        walkEmitter.Speed=NumberRange.new(.2,.8)
        walkEmitter.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180)
        walkEmitter.Drag=4
        walkEmitter.LightEmission=.8
        walkEmitter.Color=ColorSequence.new(S.xWalkStepsColor)
        local size=math.clamp(S.xWalkStepsSize,.5,8)
        walkEmitter.Size=NumberSequence.new(size*.1,size)
        walkEmitter.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.05),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
        walkEmitter.Parent=walkAttachment
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.updateWalkSteps()
        if not (S.xWalkStepsEnabled and walkEmitter) then return end
        walkEmitter.Rate=math.clamp(tonumber(S.xWalkStepsRate) or 12,1,40)
        local size=math.clamp(tonumber(S.xWalkStepsSize) or 2.5,.5,8)
        walkEmitter.Size=NumberSequence.new(size*.1,size)
        walkEmitter.Color=ColorSequence.new(S.xWalkStepsColor)
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.setJujuColor(c)
        S.xJujuAuraColor=c or S.xJujuAuraColor
        ExtraVisuals.updateJujuAura()
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.setWalkStepsColor(c)
        S.xWalkStepsColor=c or S.xWalkStepsColor
        ExtraVisuals.updateWalkSteps()
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.setWalkStepsRate(v)
        S.xWalkStepsRate=math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 12,1,40)
        ExtraVisuals.updateWalkSteps()
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.setWalkStepsSize(v)
        S.xWalkStepsSize=math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 2.5,.5,8)
        ExtraVisuals.updateWalkSteps()
    end

    function ExtraVisuals.characterRefresh()
        if S.xHatEnabled then ExtraVisuals.toggleHat(false); task.defer(function() ExtraVisuals.toggleHat(true) end) end
        if S.xTrailEnabled then ExtraVisuals.toggleTrail(false); task.defer(function() ExtraVisuals.toggleTrail(true) end) end
        if S.xAuraTrailerEnabled then ExtraVisuals.toggleAuraTrailer(false); task.defer(function() ExtraVisuals.toggleAuraTrailer(true) end) end
        if S.xForceFieldEnabled then ExtraVisuals.toggleForceField(false); task.defer(function() ExtraVisuals.toggleForceField(true) end) end
        if S.xBodyPropEnabled then ExtraVisuals.toggleBodyProp(false); task.defer(function() ExtraVisuals.toggleBodyProp(true) end) end
        if S.xClassicAuraEnabled then task.defer(ExtraVisuals.refreshClassicAura) end
        if S.xParticleAuraEnabled then task.defer(ExtraVisuals.refreshParticleAura) end
        if S.xJujuAuraEnabled then task.defer(function() ExtraVisuals.toggleJujuAura(true) end) end
        if S.xWalkStepsEnabled then task.defer(function() ExtraVisuals.toggleWalkSteps(true) end) end
    end

    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(0.06) do
            if S.xHatEnabled and S.xHatStyle=="Classic" then updateHatClassic() end
            if S.xTrailEnabled then ExtraVisuals.updateTrail() end
            if S.xAuraTrailerEnabled then ExtraVisuals.updateAuraTrailer() end
            if S.xForceFieldEnabled then ExtraVisuals.updateForceField() end
            if S.xNebulaEnabled then ExtraVisuals.updateNebula() end
            if S.xJujuAuraEnabled then ExtraVisuals.updateJujuAura() end
            if S.xWalkStepsEnabled then ExtraVisuals.updateWalkSteps() end
            if S.xTimeEnabled then Lighting.ClockTime=S.xTimeValue end
            if S.xFullBright then
                Lighting.Brightness=3; Lighting.GlobalShadows=false; Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
            end
        end
    end)

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.4)
        ExtraVisuals.characterRefresh()
    end)
end

-- EXTRA COSMETIC VISUALS
-- NEW VISUAL AURAS
-- Source-derived visual set: Ambient, Nimb and Tornado.
-- Angelic is intentionally omitted because QuantomHub already has Angel/Wings Aura.
local NewVisualAuras = {}
do
    local attachments = {}
    local particles = {}

    local function clear()
        for _, obj in ipairs(attachments) do
            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
        end
        attachments = {}
        particles = {}
    end

    local function trackAttachment(obj)
        attachments[#attachments + 1] = obj
        return obj
    end

    local function trackParticle(obj)
        obj.Color = ColorSequence.new(S.newAuraColor or Color3.fromRGB(133,220,255))
        particles[#particles + 1] = obj
        return obj
    end

    local function createAmbient()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not hrp then return end
        local attachment=trackAttachment(Instance.new('Attachment'))
        attachment.CFrame=CFrame.new(0,-2.75,0)
        attachment.Parent=hrp

        local emitter1=trackParticle(Instance.new('ParticleEmitter'))
        emitter1.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(2,2); emitter1.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(.001,.001)
        emitter1.LockedToPart=true; emitter1.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(0,1)
        emitter1.LightEmission=1; emitter1.VelocitySpread=.001; emitter1.Squash=NumberSequence.new(0)
        emitter1.Speed=NumberRange.new(.001,.001); emitter1.Brightness=2
        emitter1.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.3,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.6,2.5),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.8,4),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,6)})
        emitter1.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-600,600)
        emitter1.Texture='https://assetgame.roblox.com/asset/?id=12713358087&assetName=crescent'
        emitter1.Orientation=Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular; emitter1.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360); emitter1.Parent=attachment

        local emitter2=trackParticle(Instance.new('ParticleEmitter'))
        emitter2.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(2,2); emitter2.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(.001,.001); emitter2.LockedToPart=true
        emitter2.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.6,.2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
        emitter2.LightEmission=1; emitter2.VelocitySpread=.001; emitter2.Squash=NumberSequence.new(0,2)
        emitter2.Speed=NumberRange.new(.001,.001); emitter2.Brightness=2
        emitter2.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.3,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.6,2.5),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.8,4),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,6)})
        emitter2.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-30,30); emitter2.Texture='rbxassetid://7216849325'
        emitter2.Orientation=Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular; emitter2.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360); emitter2.Parent=attachment

        local emitter3=trackParticle(Instance.new('ParticleEmitter'))
        emitter3.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(2,2); emitter3.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(.001,.001); emitter3.LockedToPart=true
        emitter3.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.2,.3),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
        emitter3.LightEmission=1; emitter3.VelocitySpread=.001; emitter3.Squash=NumberSequence.new(0)
        emitter3.Speed=NumberRange.new(.001,.001); emitter3.Brightness=2
        emitter3.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.3,2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.6,5),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.8,8),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,12)})
        emitter3.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-40,40); emitter3.Texture='rbxassetid://7216855136'
        emitter3.Orientation=Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular; emitter3.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360); emitter3.Parent=attachment
    end

    local function createNimb()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local head=char and char:FindFirstChild('Head')
        if not head then return end
        local attachment=trackAttachment(Instance.new('Attachment'))
        attachment.CFrame=CFrame.new(-.25,.933,.259,.469,-.25,-.847,-.117,.933,-.34,.875,.259,.408)
        attachment.Parent=head
        for _,spec in ipairs({
            {NumberSequence.new(2.5,3),'rbxassetid://8819682608'},
            {NumberSequence.new(2,3),'rbxassetid://8819682608'},
        }) do
            local emitter=trackParticle(Instance.new('ParticleEmitter'))
            emitter.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(1,1); emitter.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(5,5); emitter.LockedToPart=true
            emitter.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.2,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.8,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
            emitter.LightEmission=1; emitter.VelocitySpread=5; emitter.Speed=NumberRange.new(.001,.001); emitter.Brightness=2
            emitter.Size=spec[1]; emitter.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(-400,400); emitter.Rate=7; emitter.Texture=spec[2]
            emitter.Orientation=Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular; emitter.Rotation=NumberRange.new(0,360); emitter.Parent=attachment
        end
    end

    local function createTornado()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not hrp then return end
        local attachment=trackAttachment(Instance.new('Attachment'))
        attachment.CFrame=CFrame.new(0,-3,0); attachment.Parent=hrp
        local emitter=trackParticle(Instance.new('ParticleEmitter'))
        emitter.LightInfluence=1; emitter.LockedToPart=true; emitter.LightEmission=1
        emitter.Speed=NumberRange.new(.01,.01); emitter.Size=NumberSequence.new(6,10)
        emitter.RotSpeed=NumberRange.new(360,360); emitter.Rate=1
        emitter.Texture='http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=8553497052'
        emitter.Orientation=Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular; emitter.Parent=attachment
    end

    local function refresh()
        clear()
        if S.newAmbientAuraEnabled then createAmbient() end
        if S.newNimbAuraEnabled then createNimb() end
        if S.newTornadoAuraEnabled then createTornado() end
    end

    function NewVisualAuras.setColor(c)
        if typeof(c)~='Color3' then return end
        S.newAuraColor=c
        for _,p in ipairs(particles) do if p and p.Parent then p.Color=ColorSequence.new(c) end end
    end
    function NewVisualAuras.refresh() refresh() end

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(.45)
        refresh()
    end)
end

-- VISUAL FX
do
    local folder=nil
    local connection=nil
    local wingAssetId=90816193741219
    local wingScale=0.34
    local wingTemplate=S._angelWingTemplate
    local wingPreloadBusy=false
    local wingPreloadDone=false
    local auraAngle=0
    local auraAttachments={}
    local auraEmitters={}

    local function destroySafe(x) if x then pcall(function() x:Destroy() end) end end

    local function root()
        local c=LocalPlayer.Character
        return c and (c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso") or c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    end

    local function clear()
        if connection then connection:Disconnect(); connection=nil end
        table.clear(auraAttachments)
        table.clear(auraEmitters)
        if folder then folder:Destroy(); folder=nil end
        local c=LocalPlayer.Character
        if c then
            for _,d in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
                if d.Name=="KitagawaAura_Angel" or d.Name=="qhNeonAura" then destroySafe(d) end
            end
            for _,d in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("Attachment") and d.Name:sub(1,22)=="KitagawaAuraAtt_Angel_" then destroySafe(d) end
            end
        end
    end

    local function scaleEmitter(e,scale)
        if not e or not e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then return end
        local k={}; for _,kp in ipairs(e.Size.Keypoints) do k[#k+1]=NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time,kp.Value*scale,kp.Envelope*scale) end
        e.Size=NumberSequence.new(k); e.Speed=NumberRange.new(e.Speed.Min*scale,e.Speed.Max*scale)
        if typeof(e.Acceleration)=="Vector3" then e.Acceleration=e.Acceleration*scale end
    end

    local function preloadWing()
        if wingPreloadDone or wingPreloadBusy or wingTemplate then wingPreloadDone=wingTemplate~=nil; return end
        wingPreloadBusy=true
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok,obj=pcall(function()
                local objects=game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://"..tostring(wingAssetId))
                local candidate
                for _,x in ipairs(objects) do
                    if x:IsA("Model") or x:IsA("Folder") or x:IsA("Tool") then candidate=x; break end
                end
                candidate=candidate or objects[1]
                return candidate,objects
            end)
            if ok and obj then
                local candidate,objects=obj
                wingTemplate=candidate
                if wingTemplate then wingTemplate.Parent=nil end
                for _,x in ipairs(objects or {}) do if x~=wingTemplate then destroySafe(x) end end
            end
            if not wingTemplate then
                pcall(function() wingTemplate=game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(wingAssetId) end)
                if wingTemplate then wingTemplate.Parent=nil end
            end
            wingPreloadDone=true
            wingPreloadBusy=false
            if S.angelAuraEnabled then task.defer(VisualFX.build) end
        end)
    end

    local function updateAuraColors()
        local col=S.angelAuraColor
        for _,e in ipairs(auraEmitters) do if e and e.Parent then pcall(function() e.Color=ColorSequence.new(col); e.Brightness=math.clamp(S.angelAuraIntensity*2,0,2) end) end end
        local h=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("AngelGlow")
        if h then h.FillColor=col; h.OutlineColor=col; h.FillTransparency=math.clamp(0.82-(S.angelAuraIntensity*0.3),0.42,0.82) end
    end

    local function addFastAura(character,rootPart)
        folder=Instance.new("Folder"); folder.Name="qhVisualFX"; folder.Parent=rootPart
        if S.angelAuraEnabled then
            local h=Instance.new("Highlight"); h.Name="AngelGlow"; h.Adornee=character; h.FillColor=S.angelAuraColor; h.OutlineColor=S.angelAuraColor; h.FillTransparency=0.58; h.OutlineTransparency=0.12; h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop; h.Parent=folder
            -- lightweight fallback is visible immediately while the wing asset finishes preloading
            for i=1,4 do
                local a=Instance.new("Attachment"); a.Name="AngelQuick_"..i; a.Position=Vector3.new(math.cos((i-1)*math.pi/2)*2.2,1.3,math.sin((i-1)*math.pi/2)*2.2); a.Parent=rootPart
                local e=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter"); e.Name="AngelQuickEmitter"; e.Texture="rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"; e.Rate=8; e.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.35,.75); e.Speed=NumberRange.new(.1,.8); e.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(160,160); e.LightEmission=1; e.Color=ColorSequence.new(S.angelAuraColor); e.Size=NumberSequence.new(.22,.05); e.Transparency=NumberSequence.new(0.15,1); e.Parent=a; auraEmitters[#auraEmitters+1]=e; auraAttachments[#auraAttachments+1]=a
            end
        end
    end

    local function buildWings(character,r)
        if not wingTemplate then preloadWing(); return false end
        -- Remove the fast fallback emitters now that the real aura is ready.
        for _,a in ipairs(auraAttachments) do
            if a and a.Name:sub(1,11)=="AngelQuick_" then destroySafe(a) end
        end
        for _,a in ipairs(auraAttachments) do destroySafe(a) end; table.clear(auraAttachments); table.clear(auraEmitters)
        local auraFolder=Instance.new("Folder"); auraFolder.Name="KitagawaAura_Angel"; auraFolder.Parent=r
        local descendants=wingTemplate:GetDescendants(); descendants[#descendants+1]=wingTemplate
        local emitterCount=0
        for _,obj in ipairs(descendants) do
            if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
                emitterCount+=1
                local att=Instance.new("Attachment"); att.Name="KitagawaAuraAtt_Angel_"..emitterCount
                local parent=obj.Parent
                if parent and parent:IsA("Attachment") then att.CFrame=parent.CFrame elseif parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then att.CFrame=r.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(parent.CFrame) end
                att.Parent=r; auraAttachments[#auraAttachments+1]=att
                local e=obj:Clone(); scaleEmitter(e,wingScale); e.Rate=math.max(3,e.Rate*.55); e.Enabled=S.angelAuraParticles; e.Color=ColorSequence.new(S.angelAuraColor); e.LightEmission=1; e.Parent=att; auraEmitters[#auraEmitters+1]=e
            end
            -- Do not clone the asset's BaseParts. Some aura assets contain
            -- invisible proxy geometry that becomes a giant square/box on certain clients.
            -- The visual effect only needs the emitters above.
        end
        updateAuraColors()
        return emitterCount>0
    end

    function VisualFX.build()
        clear()
        local character=LocalPlayer.Character; local r=root()
        if not character or not r then return end
        if not (S.angelAuraEnabled or S.localGlowEnabled) then return end
        addFastAura(character,r)
        if S.localGlowEnabled then
            local h=folder:FindFirstChild("AngelGlow") or Instance.new("Highlight")
            h.Name="LocalGlow"; h.Adornee=character; h.FillColor=S.localGlowColor; h.OutlineColor=S.localGlowColor; h.FillTransparency=S.localGlowTransparency; h.OutlineTransparency=.25; h.Parent=folder
        end
        if S.angelAuraEnabled then
            preloadWing()
            if wingTemplate then buildWings(character,r) end
        end
        connection=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not folder or not folder.Parent then return end
            local glow=folder:FindFirstChild("AngelGlow"); if glow then glow.FillColor=S.angelAuraColor; glow.OutlineColor=S.angelAuraColor; glow.FillTransparency=math.clamp(.82-(S.angelAuraIntensity*.3),.42,.82) end
            for _,e in ipairs(auraEmitters) do if e and e.Parent then e.Enabled=S.angelAuraParticles end end
        end)
    end

    function VisualFX.refresh() task.defer(VisualFX.build) end
    function VisualFX.setParticles(enabled) for _,e in ipairs(auraEmitters) do if e and e.Parent then e.Enabled=enabled end end end
    function VisualFX.setColor(c) S.angelAuraColor=c; updateAuraColors() end

    preloadWing()
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(.2); if S.angelAuraEnabled or S.localGlowEnabled then VisualFX.build() end end)
end

-- FAST NEON ORBIT AURA
do
    local parts={}
    local angle=0
    local conn
    local colors=S.neonAuraColor
    local function clear() for _,p in ipairs(parts) do if p and p.Parent then p:Destroy() end end; table.clear(parts); if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn=nil end end
    local function build()
        clear(); if not S.neonAuraEnabled then return end
        local c=LocalPlayer.Character; local root=c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso")); if not root then return end
        for i=1,(S._visualQuality and S._visualQuality.neonNodes or 8) do local p=Instance.new("Part"); p.Name="qhNeonAura"; p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball; p.Size=Vector3.new(.34,.34,.34); p.Material=Enum.Material.Neon; p.Color=S.neonAuraColor; p.Transparency=.05; p.CanCollide=false; p.CanQuery=false; p.CanTouch=false; p.Massless=true; p.Anchored=true; p.Parent=c; parts[#parts+1]=p end
        conn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not S.neonAuraEnabled or not root.Parent then clear(); return end
            angle=(angle+dt*1.8)%(math.pi*2); local radius=2.15; local y=1.15
            for i,p in ipairs(parts) do local a=angle+(i-1)*(math.pi*2/#parts); p.Color=S.neonAuraColor; p.Size=Vector3.new(.28+.16*S.neonAuraIntensity,.28+.16*S.neonAuraIntensity,.28+.16*S.neonAuraIntensity); p.CFrame=CFrame.new(root.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*radius, y+math.sin(a*2)*.35, math.sin(a)*radius)) end
        end)
    end
    function NeonAuraToggle(v) S.neonAuraEnabled=v; if v then build() else clear() end end
    function NeonAuraColor(c) S.neonAuraColor=c; for _,p in ipairs(parts) do if p and p.Parent then p.Color=c end end end
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(.25); if S.neonAuraEnabled then build() end end)
end

-- PROCEDURAL BEAUTIFUL AURAS
-- ============================================================
do
    local AuraFX={}
    local nodes={}
    local conn=nil
    local phase=0
    local styles={"Star Halo","Heart Orbit","Comet Ring","Crystal Orbit","Pulse Rings","Butterfly Swirl","Spark Crown"}
    local function clear()
        if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn=nil end
        for _,obj in ipairs(nodes) do if obj and obj.Parent then obj:Destroy() end end
        table.clear(nodes)
    end
    local function rootPart()
        local c=LocalPlayer.Character
        return c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
    end
    local function makeOrb(parent,size,color)
        local p=Instance.new("Part")
        p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball; p.Size=Vector3.new(size,size,size); p.Material=Enum.Material.Neon; p.Color=color
        p.Anchored=true; p.CanCollide=false; p.CanQuery=false; p.CanTouch=false; p.Massless=true; p.Transparency=.08; p.Parent=parent
        nodes[#nodes+1]=p
        return p
    end
    local function makeRingPart(parent,color,thickness,size)
        local p=Instance.new("Part")
        p.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder; p.Size=Vector3.new(thickness,size,size); p.Material=Enum.Material.Neon; p.Color=color
        p.Anchored=true; p.CanCollide=false; p.CanQuery=false; p.CanTouch=false; p.Massless=true; p.Transparency=.18; p.Parent=parent
        nodes[#nodes+1]=p
        return p
    end
    local function build()
        clear(); if not S.proceduralAuraEnabled then return end
        local r=rootPart(); if not r then return end
        local color=S.proceduralAuraColor
        for i=1,12 do makeOrb(r.Parent,.18+.10*S.proceduralAuraIntensity,color) end
        if S.proceduralAuraStyle=="Pulse Rings" or S.proceduralAuraStyle=="Crystal Orbit" then
            for i=1,3 do makeRingPart(r.Parent,color,.12,3.2+i*1.15) end
        end
        conn=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not S.proceduralAuraEnabled or not r.Parent then clear(); return end
            phase=(phase+dt*1.65)%(math.pi*2)
            local col=S.proceduralAuraColor
            local count=#nodes
            if S.proceduralAuraStyle=="Star Halo" then
                for i,p in ipairs(nodes) do local a=phase+(i-1)*math.pi*2/count; local rr=2.1; p.Color=col; p.CFrame=CFrame.new(r.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*rr,1.35+math.sin(a*2)*.32,math.sin(a)*rr)); p.Size=Vector3.new(.16+.12*S.proceduralAuraIntensity,.16+.12*S.proceduralAuraIntensity,.16+.12*S.proceduralAuraIntensity) end
            elseif S.proceduralAuraStyle=="Heart Orbit" then
                for i,p in ipairs(nodes) do local t=(i-1)/count*math.pi*2+phase; local x=1.8*math.sin(t)^3; local y=1.6+1.3*math.cos(t)-.5*math.cos(2*t)-.25*math.cos(3*t)-.12*math.cos(4*t); local z=.7*math.sin(t); p.Color=col; p.CFrame=CFrame.new(r.Position+Vector3.new(x,y,z)); p.Size=Vector3.new(.14+.11*S.proceduralAuraIntensity,.14+.11*S.proceduralAuraIntensity,.14+.11*S.proceduralAuraIntensity) end
            elseif S.proceduralAuraStyle=="Comet Ring" then
                for i,p in ipairs(nodes) do local a=phase+(i-1)*math.pi*2/count; local rr=2.7; local trail=1-(i-1)/(count-1); p.Color=col; p.Transparency=.03+trail*.7; p.CFrame=CFrame.new(r.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*rr,.8+math.sin(a*1.7)*.5,math.sin(a)*rr)); p.Size=Vector3.new(.10+.18*trail,.10+.18*trail,.10+.18*trail) end
            elseif S.proceduralAuraStyle=="Crystal Orbit" then
                for i,p in ipairs(nodes) do local a=phase*.75+(i-1)*math.pi*2/count; local rr=2.35+math.sin(phase*2+i)*.18; p.Color=col; p.CFrame=CFrame.new(r.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*rr,1.1+math.sin(i)*.5,math.sin(a)*rr))*CFrame.Angles(a,phase,math.sin(i)) end
                for j=1,3 do local p=nodes[12+j]; if p then p.Color=col; p.CFrame=CFrame.new(r.Position+Vector3.new(0,.35*j,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,phase*.5+j*.5,math.rad(90)) end end
            elseif S.proceduralAuraStyle=="Pulse Rings" then
                for i=1,12 do local p=nodes[i]; local a=phase+(i-1)*math.pi*2/12; local rr=1.9; local wave=(math.sin(phase*2+(i%3)*1.7)+1)*.5; p.Color=col; p.CFrame=CFrame.new(r.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*rr,1.15+wave*.45,math.sin(a)*rr)); p.Size=Vector3.new(.14+.20*wave,.14+.20*wave,.14+.20*wave) end
                for i=1,3 do local p=nodes[12+i]; if p then local s=3.0+i*.85+math.sin(phase*2+i)*.28; p.Size=Vector3.new(.10,s,s); p.CFrame=CFrame.new(r.Position+Vector3.new(0,.45+i*.25,0))*CFrame.Angles(0,phase*.7+i*.6,math.rad(90)); p.Color=col end end
            elseif S.proceduralAuraStyle=="Butterfly Swirl" then
                for i,p in ipairs(nodes) do local t=(i-1)/count*math.pi*2+phase; local x=1.55*math.sin(t); local z=.9*math.sin(2*t); local y=1.2+.75*math.cos(t); p.Color=col; p.CFrame=CFrame.new(r.Position+Vector3.new(x,y,z)); p.Size=Vector3.new(.14+.15*S.proceduralAuraIntensity,.14+.15*S.proceduralAuraIntensity,.14+.15*S.proceduralAuraIntensity) end
            else -- Spark Crown
                for i,p in ipairs(nodes) do local a=phase+(i-1)*math.pi*2/count; local rr=1.85; local y=1.9+math.sin(phase*2+i)*.25; p.Color=col; p.CFrame=CFrame.new(r.Position+Vector3.new(math.cos(a)*rr,y,math.sin(a)*rr)); p.Size=Vector3.new(.12+.18*S.proceduralAuraIntensity,.12+.18*S.proceduralAuraIntensity,.12+.18*S.proceduralAuraIntensity) end
            end
            for _,p in ipairs(nodes) do if p and p.Parent then p.Color=col end end
        end)
    end
    function AuraFX.toggle(v) S.proceduralAuraEnabled=v==true; if v then build() else clear() end end
    function AuraFX.setStyle(v) S.proceduralAuraStyle=tostring(v or "Star Halo"); if S.proceduralAuraEnabled then build() end end
    function AuraFX.setColor(c) S.proceduralAuraColor=c; for _,p in ipairs(nodes) do if p and p.Parent then p.Color=c end end end
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(.12); if S.proceduralAuraEnabled then build() end end)
    _G.__QHAuraFX=AuraFX
end

-- Restore integrated cosmetic toggles from the current state.
task.defer(function()
    if _G.__QH_AURA_MENU then
        local A=_G.__QH_AURA_MENU
        A.enabled.angel=S.qhAuraAngelEnabled==true
        A.enabled.heavenly=S.qhAuraHeavenlyEnabled==true
        A.enabled.ribbon=S.qhAuraRibbonEnabled==true
        A.enabled.sakura=S.qhAuraSakuraEnabled==true
        A.enabled.wind=S.qhAuraWindEnabled==true
        A.enabled.flow=S.qhAuraFlowEnabled==true
        if A.enabled.angel or A.enabled.heavenly or A.enabled.ribbon
            or A.enabled.sakura or A.enabled.wind or A.enabled.flow then
            pcall(A.apply)
        end
    end
    if _G.__QH_VISUAL_BADGE then pcall(_G.__QH_VISUAL_BADGE.toggle,S.visualBadgeEnabled==true) end
    pcall(NewVisualAuras.setColor,S.newAuraColor)
    pcall(NewVisualAuras.refresh)
    if S.tradeHelperEnabled and TradeHelper and type(TradeHelper.toggle)=="function" then
        pcall(TradeHelper.toggle,true)
    end
end)

-- CHARACTER
do
    local t = Sect:Tab({Title="Character", Icon="user-cog"})

    -- ============================================================
    -- OUTFIT CHANGER
    -- Based on the supplied outfit changer.txt asset set.
    -- ============================================================
    do
        local OutfitState = {applied = {}, generation = 0}
        local OUTFIT = {
            Back = {6036968674},
            Face = {139513356521014},
            Head = {8923152393, 10932842994, 18614035623},
            Torso = {73206245679321, 100442338591833},
        }

        local function findAttachment(rootPart, name)
            if not rootPart then return nil end
            for _, obj in ipairs(rootPart:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("Attachment") and obj.Name == name then return obj end
            end
        end

        local function addAccessory(assetId, parentPart, generation)
            if generation ~= OutfitState.generation or not assetId or not parentPart then return end
            local ok, objects = pcall(function()
                return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
            end)
            if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" or not objects[1] then return end
            local accessory = objects[1]
            accessory.Name = "QH_Outfit_" .. tostring(assetId)
            accessory.Parent = workspace

            local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle", true)
            if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
                local attachment = handle:FindFirstChildOfClass("Attachment")
                local parentAttachment = attachment and findAttachment(parentPart, attachment.Name)

                local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
                weld.Name = "QH_OutfitWeld"
                weld.Part0 = parentPart
                weld.Part1 = handle
                if parentAttachment and attachment then
                    weld.C0 = parentAttachment.CFrame
                    weld.C1 = attachment.CFrame
                else
                    handle.CFrame = parentPart.CFrame
                    weld.C0 = CFrame.new()
                    weld.C1 = CFrame.new()
                end
                weld.Parent = parentPart
            end

            accessory.Parent = LocalPlayer.Character
            OutfitState.applied[#OutfitState.applied + 1] = accessory
        end

        local function clearOutfit()
            OutfitState.generation += 1
            for i = #OutfitState.applied, 1, -1 do
                local obj = OutfitState.applied[i]
                if obj and obj.Parent then pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) end
                OutfitState.applied[i] = nil
            end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                    if tostring(obj.Name):sub(1,10) == "QH_Outfit_" then
                        pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function applyOutfit()
            clearOutfit()
            local gen = OutfitState.generation
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then return end
            task.spawn(function()
                local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                local torso = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
                if head then
                    for _, id in ipairs(OUTFIT.Head) do addAccessory(id, head, gen); task.wait() end
                    for _, id in ipairs(OUTFIT.Face) do addAccessory(id, head, gen); task.wait() end
                end
                if torso then
                    for _, id in ipairs(OUTFIT.Torso) do addAccessory(id, torso, gen); task.wait() end
                    for _, id in ipairs(OUTFIT.Back) do addAccessory(id, torso, gen); task.wait() end
                end
            end)
        end

        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            if S.outfitChangerEnabled then task.delay(0.35, applyOutfit) end
        end)

        t:Section({Title="Outfit Changer", TextSize=18})
        t:Toggle({
            Flag="OutfitChanger",
            Title="Outfit Changer",
            Desc="Applies the outfit from the supplied script and reapplies it after respawn",
            Default=false,
            Callback=function(v)
                S.outfitChangerEnabled = v == true
                if S.outfitChangerEnabled then applyOutfit() else clearOutfit() end
            end
        })
        t:Space()
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- CLICK TP
    -- Ctrl + Left Mouse Button -> teleport to mouse hit position.
    -- ============================================================
    do
        local clickTPConnection
        local function setClickTP(v)
            if clickTPConnection then clickTPConnection:Disconnect(); clickTPConnection=nil end
            if not v then return end
            clickTPConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
                if processed or not S.clickTPEnabled then return end
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
                if not (UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)) then return end
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
                if not root or not mouse or typeof(mouse.Hit.Position) ~= "Vector3" then return end
                local p = mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                pcall(function()
                    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(p)
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
            end)
        end

        t:Section({Title="Movement", TextSize=18})
        t:Toggle({
            Flag="ClickTP",
            Title="Click TP",
            Desc="Hold Ctrl and click Left Mouse Button to teleport",
            Default=false,
            Callback=function(v)
                S.clickTPEnabled = v == true
                setClickTP(S.clickTPEnabled)
            end
        })
        t:Space()
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- FLY + KEYBIND
    -- ============================================================
    do
        local flyConnection, flyBV, flyBG
        local function stopFly()
            if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect(); flyConnection=nil end
            if flyBV then pcall(function() flyBV:Destroy() end); flyBV=nil end
            if flyBG then pcall(function() flyBG:Destroy() end); flyBG=nil end
            local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand=false; hum.AutoRotate=true end) end
        end

        local function startFly()
            stopFly()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not root or not hum or not cam then return end

            flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            flyBV.Name = "QH_FlyVelocity"
            flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e6,1e6,1e6)
            flyBV.P = 9000
            flyBV.Parent = root

            flyBG = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            flyBG.Name = "QH_FlyGyro"
            flyBG.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e6,1e6,1e6)
            flyBG.P = 6000
            flyBG.D = 400
            flyBG.Parent = root

            hum.PlatformStand = true
            hum.AutoRotate = false

            flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if not S.flyEnabled or not root.Parent then stopFly(); return end
                local cf = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame or cam.CFrame
                local forward = Vector3.new(cf.LookVector.X,0,cf.LookVector.Z)
                local right = Vector3.new(cf.RightVector.X,0,cf.RightVector.Z)
                if forward.Magnitude > 0 then forward=forward.Unit end
                if right.Magnitude > 0 then right=right.Unit end

                local move = Vector3.zero
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move += forward end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move -= forward end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move += right end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move -= right end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move += Vector3.yAxis end
                if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move -= Vector3.yAxis end
                if move.Magnitude > 1 then move=move.Unit end

                flyBV.Velocity = move * math.clamp(tonumber(S.flySpeed) or 70, 10, 200)
                flyBG.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + cf.LookVector)
            end)
        end

        LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            if S.flyEnabled then task.delay(0.35, startFly) end
        end)

        t:Toggle({
            Flag="Fly",
            Title="Fly",
            Desc="WASD + Space/Ctrl flight",
            Default=false,
            Callback=function(v)
                S.flyEnabled = v == true
                if S.flyEnabled then startFly() else stopFly() end
            end
        })
        t:Space()
        t:Keybind({
            Flag="FlyKey",
            Title="Fly Keybind",
            Value="V",
            Mode="Toggle",
            Callback=function()
                S.flyEnabled = not S.flyEnabled
                if S.flyEnabled then startFly() else stopFly() end
            end
        })
        t:Space()
        t:Slider({
            Flag="FlySpeed",
            Title="Fly Speed",
            Step=5,
            Value={Min=10,Max=200,Default=70},
            Callback=function(v) S.flySpeed = tonumber(v) or 70 end
        })
        t:Space()
    end

    -- ============================================================
    -- ROUND SCREEN FADE REMOVER
    -- Keeps MM2 round start/end transitions from covering the screen.
    -- It also watches newly-created GUI objects because the fade can be
    -- created after the RoundStart/RoundEnd event.
    -- ============================================================
    local QH_FadeState = {
        enabled = true,
        saved = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        connections = {},
        playerGuiConnection = nil,
    }

    local function qhIsRoundFadeObject(obj)
        if not obj then return false end

        local n = tostring(obj.Name or ""):lower()

        -- Known/common MM2 transition names.
        if n:find("fade", 1, true)
            or n:find("transition", 1, true)
            or n:find("blackout", 1, true)
            or n:find("blackscreen", 1, true)
            or n == "black"
            or n == "roundendfade"
        then
            return true
        end

        -- Fallback for an unnamed full-screen black frame.
        if obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            local parent = obj.Parent
            if parent and parent:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                local fullSize =
                    obj.Size.X.Scale >= 0.99
                    and obj.Size.Y.Scale >= 0.99

                if fullSize then
                    if obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        local c = obj.BackgroundColor3
                        local almostBlack =
                            c.R < 0.08 and c.G < 0.08 and c.B < 0.08
                        local opaque = obj.BackgroundTransparency <= 0.08

                        if almostBlack and opaque then
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return false
    end

    local function qhHideFadeObject(obj)
        if not QH_FadeState.enabled or not obj then return end

        pcall(function()
            if obj:IsA("GuiObject") then
                if QH_FadeState.saved[obj] == nil then
                    QH_FadeState.saved[obj] = obj.Visible
                end
                obj.Visible = false
            elseif obj:IsA("ScreenGui")
                and obj.Name ~= "QuantomHub"
                and obj.Name ~= "QuantomHubLoader"
            then
                if QH_FadeState.saved[obj] == nil then
                    QH_FadeState.saved[obj] = obj.Enabled
                end
                obj.Enabled = false
            end
        end)
    end

    local function qhScanRoundFade()
        if not QH_FadeState.enabled then return end

        local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not playerGui then return end

        for _, obj in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
            if qhIsRoundFadeObject(obj) then
                qhHideFadeObject(obj)
            end
        end
    end

    local function qhConnectFadeWatcher()
        for i = #QH_FadeState.connections, 1, -1 do
            pcall(function()
                QH_FadeState.connections[i]:Disconnect()
            end)
            QH_FadeState.connections[i] = nil
        end

        if QH_FadeState.playerGuiConnection then
            pcall(function()
                QH_FadeState.playerGuiConnection:Disconnect()
            end)
            QH_FadeState.playerGuiConnection = nil
        end

        local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
        if not playerGui then
            return
        end

        QH_FadeState.playerGuiConnection =
            playerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if not QH_FadeState.enabled then return end

                -- Only inspect the object that was actually added. The previous
                -- implementation rescanned the entire PlayerGui for every
                -- DescendantAdded event, which can explode during round transitions
                -- when MM2 creates many UI objects at once.
                if qhIsRoundFadeObject(obj) then
                    qhHideFadeObject(obj)
                end
            end)

        qhScanRoundFade()
    end

    local function qhClearRoundFade()
        if not QH_FadeState.enabled then return end
        qhScanRoundFade()
    end

    local function qhSetRoundFadeRemover(state)
        QH_FadeState.enabled = state == true

        if QH_FadeState.enabled then
            qhConnectFadeWatcher()

            -- Catch the transition immediately and again shortly after
            -- because MM2 may animate/create the overlay asynchronously.
            task.defer(qhScanRoundFade)
            task.delay(0.25, qhScanRoundFade)
        else
            for obj, oldVisible in pairs(QH_FadeState.saved) do
                if obj and obj.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        if obj:IsA("GuiObject") then
                            obj.Visible = oldVisible == true
                        elseif obj:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                            obj.Enabled = oldVisible == true
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end

            table.clear(QH_FadeState.saved)

            if QH_FadeState.playerGuiConnection then
                pcall(function()
                    QH_FadeState.playerGuiConnection:Disconnect()
                end)
                QH_FadeState.playerGuiConnection = nil
            end

            for i = #QH_FadeState.connections, 1, -1 do
                pcall(function()
                    QH_FadeState.connections[i]:Disconnect()
                end)
                QH_FadeState.connections[i] = nil
            end
        end
    end

    _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_CLEAR = qhClearRoundFade
    _G.__QH_ROUND_FADE_SET = qhSetRoundFadeRemover

    LocalPlayer.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child:IsA("PlayerGui") then
            task.defer(function()
                if QH_FadeState.enabled then
                    qhConnectFadeWatcher()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    t:Section({Title="Round Transition", TextSize=18})
    t:Toggle({
        Flag="RemoveRoundFade",
        Title="Remove Round Screen Fade",
        Desc="Removes the black screen when a round starts or ends",
        Default=true,
        Callback=function(v)
            qhSetRoundFadeRemover(v)
        end
    })

    -- Obsidian can initialize a Default value without firing Callback on
    -- some library builds, so explicitly enable the feature after creation.
    task.defer(function()
        qhSetRoundFadeRemover(true)
    end)

    -- ============================================================
    -- CHARACTER FPS BOOST
    -- Reversible local character render optimization.
    -- ============================================================
    local QH_CharacterFPS = {
        enabled = false,
        saved = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
        connections = {},
        quality = nil,
        qualityCaptured = false,
        worldSaved = {
            globalShadows = nil,
            terrainDecoration = nil,
            technology = nil,
        },
        postEffects = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
    }

    local function qhFPSIsProtectedVisual(obj)
        if not obj then return false end

        -- Keep Angel Aura and the entire QuantomHub visual container alive.
        local current = obj
        while current do
            local n = tostring(current.Name or "")
            if n == "qhVisualFX"
                or n == "KitagawaAura_Angel"
                or n == "AngelGlow"
                or n:sub(1, 11) == "AngelQuick_"
                or n:sub(1, 19) == "KitagawaAuraAtt_Angel_"
            then
                return true
            end
            current = current.Parent
        end

        return false
    end

    local function qhFPSRemember(obj, key, value)
        local record = QH_CharacterFPS.saved[obj]
        if not record then
            record = {}
            QH_CharacterFPS.saved[obj] = record
        end
        if record[key] == nil then
            record[key] = value
        end
    end

    local function qhFPSOptimize(obj)
        if not obj or not QH_CharacterFPS.enabled then return end
        if qhFPSIsProtectedVisual(obj) then return end

        pcall(function()
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                qhFPSRemember(obj, "CastShadow", obj.CastShadow)
                qhFPSRemember(obj, "Material", obj.Material)
                qhFPSRemember(obj, "Reflectance", obj.Reflectance)
                obj.CastShadow = false
                obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                obj.Reflectance = 0

            elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
                or obj:IsA("Trail")
                or obj:IsA("Beam")
                or obj:IsA("Smoke")
                or obj:IsA("Fire")
                or obj:IsA("Sparkles")
            then
                qhFPSRemember(obj, "Enabled", obj.Enabled)
                obj.Enabled = false

            elseif obj:IsA("Highlight")
                or obj:IsA("PointLight")
                or obj:IsA("SpotLight")
                or obj:IsA("SurfaceLight")
            then
                qhFPSRemember(obj, "Enabled", obj.Enabled)
                obj.Enabled = false
            end
        end)
    end

    local function qhFPSScan(character)
        if not character or not QH_CharacterFPS.enabled then return end
        for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            qhFPSOptimize(obj)
        end
    end

    local function qhFPSRestore()
        for obj, values in pairs(QH_CharacterFPS.saved) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    if values.CastShadow ~= nil then obj.CastShadow = values.CastShadow end
                    if values.Material ~= nil then obj.Material = values.Material end
                    if values.Reflectance ~= nil then obj.Reflectance = values.Reflectance end
                    if values.Enabled ~= nil then obj.Enabled = values.Enabled end
                end)
            end
        end

        table.clear(QH_CharacterFPS.saved)

        if QH_CharacterFPS.qualityCaptured then
            pcall(function()
                settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = QH_CharacterFPS.quality
            end)
        end

        pcall(function()
            local lighting = Lighting
            if QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.globalShadows ~= nil then
                lighting.GlobalShadows = QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.globalShadows
            end
            if QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.technology ~= nil then
                lighting.Technology = QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.technology
            end

            local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
            if terrain and QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.terrainDecoration ~= nil then
                terrain.Decoration = QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.terrainDecoration
            end
        end)

        for obj, enabled in pairs(QH_CharacterFPS.postEffects) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                pcall(function() obj.Enabled = enabled end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(QH_CharacterFPS.postEffects)

        QH_CharacterFPS.quality = nil
        QH_CharacterFPS.qualityCaptured = false
        QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.globalShadows = nil
        QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.terrainDecoration = nil
        QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.technology = nil
    end

    local function qhSetCharacterFPS(state)
        state = state == true
        QH_CharacterFPS.enabled = state
        S.characterFpsBoostEnabled = state

        for i = #QH_CharacterFPS.connections, 1, -1 do
            pcall(function()
                QH_CharacterFPS.connections[i]:Disconnect()
            end)
            QH_CharacterFPS.connections[i] = nil
        end

        if not state then
            qhFPSRestore()
            if S.angelAuraEnabled and VisualFX and VisualFX.refresh then
                task.defer(function()
                    pcall(VisualFX.refresh)
                end)
            end
            U.notify("Character", "FPS Boost disabled", "refresh-cw", 2)
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            local rendering = settings().Rendering
            if not QH_CharacterFPS.qualityCaptured then
                QH_CharacterFPS.quality = rendering.QualityLevel
                QH_CharacterFPS.qualityCaptured = true
            end
            rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
        end)

        -- Potato mode: cut expensive world-side lighting/post effects as well.
        -- Angel Aura remains untouched because it lives under qhVisualFX.
        pcall(function()
            local lighting = Lighting

            if QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.globalShadows == nil then
                QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.globalShadows = lighting.GlobalShadows
            end
            lighting.GlobalShadows = false

            if QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.technology == nil then
                QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.technology = lighting.Technology
            end
            pcall(function()
                lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
            end)

            local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
            if terrain then
                if QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.terrainDecoration == nil then
                    QH_CharacterFPS.worldSaved.terrainDecoration = terrain.Decoration
                end
                terrain.Decoration = false
            end

            for _, obj in ipairs(lighting:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("PostEffect") then
                    if QH_CharacterFPS.postEffects[obj] == nil then
                        QH_CharacterFPS.postEffects[obj] = obj.Enabled
                    end
                    obj.Enabled = false
                end
            end
        end)

        -- Keep Angel Aura visible even in the lowest visual-quality mode.
        if S.angelAuraEnabled and VisualFX and VisualFX.refresh then
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(VisualFX.refresh)
            end)
        end

        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if character then
            qhFPSScan(character)
            table.insert(
                QH_CharacterFPS.connections,
                character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                    task.defer(qhFPSOptimize, obj)
                end)
            )
        end

        table.insert(
            QH_CharacterFPS.connections,
            LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
                if not QH_CharacterFPS.enabled then return end
                task.wait(0.12)
                qhFPSScan(newCharacter)

                table.insert(
                    QH_CharacterFPS.connections,
                    newCharacter.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                        task.defer(qhFPSOptimize, obj)
                    end)
                )
            end)
        )

        U.notify("Character", "FPS Boost enabled", "zap", 2)
    end

    _G.__QH_CHARACTER_FPS_BOOST = qhSetCharacterFPS
