    t:Section({Title="Map Vote Helper", TextSize=18})

    -- Detects the physical map-vote choices in the current lobby. Different
    -- MM2 builds use slightly different names, so this intentionally looks
    -- at model/part names and visible TextLabel text instead of hard-coding
    -- one hierarchy.
    local MapVote = {
        enabled=false,
        _uiFlag=false,
        target="Auto Detect",
        wantedVotes=9999,
        completedVotes=0,
        busy=false,
        generation=0,
        choices={},
        currentPad=1,
        pads={},
        maxPads=3,
        knownMaps={
            "Bank 2", "Bio Lab", "Factory", "Hospital 3", "Hotel 2", "House 2",
            "Mansion 2", "Mil Base", "Office 3", "Police Station", "Research Facility",
            "Workplace", "Pier", "Beach Resort", "Yacht",
        },
    }

    local function qhNormalizeMapName(v)
        v=tostring(v or ""):lower()
        v=v:gsub("[%s_%-%.]","")
        v=v:gsub("map","")
        return v
    end

    local function qhMapTextOf(inst)
        local best=tostring(inst.Name or "")
        if inst:IsA("TextLabel") or inst:IsA("TextButton") then
            local tx=tostring(inst.Text or "")
            if tx~="" then best=tx end
        end
        for _,d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
                local tx=tostring(d.Text or "")
                if tx~="" and #tx<=64 then best=tx; break end
            end
        end
        return best
    end

    local function qhHasVoteInteractor(inst)
        if not inst then return false end
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            if inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter")
                or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
                or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector",true) then return true end
        end
        for _,d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") and (
                d:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter")
                or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
                or d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector",true)
            ) then return true end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function qhAncestors(inst, limit)
        local list={}
        local cur=inst
        for _=1,(limit or 8) do
            if not cur then break end
            list[#list+1]=cur
            cur=cur.Parent
        end
        return list
    end

    local function qhPadNumber(inst)
        if not inst then return nil end
        for _,a in ipairs(qhAncestors(inst,10)) do
            local all=(tostring(a.Name or "").." "..qhMapTextOf(a)):lower()
            local n=all:match("pad[%s_%-]*(%d)")
                or all:match("vote[%s_%-]*(%d)")
                or all:match("choice[%s_%-]*(%d)")
            if n then
                local num=tonumber(n)
                if num and num>=1 and num<=3 then return num end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function qhCandidateScore(root)
        if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return -math.huge end

        local score=0
        local allParts={}
        for _,a in ipairs(qhAncestors(root,9)) do
            local n=tostring(a.Name or ""):lower()
            local tx=qhMapTextOf(a):lower()
            local all=n.." "..tx
            allParts[#allParts+1]=all

            if all:find("elevator",1,true) or all:find("lift",1,true) then
                score -= 200
            end
            if all:find("vote",1,true) or all:find("voting",1,true) or all:find("mapvote",1,true) then
                score += 70
            end
            if all:find("pad",1,true) then
                score += 60
            end
            if all:find("choice",1,true) or all:find("select",1,true) then
                score += 35
            end
            if all:find("map",1,true) then
                score += 20
            end
        end

        local n=qhPadNumber(root)
        if n then score += 40 end

        local textBlob=table.concat(allParts," ")
        for _,mapName in ipairs(MapVote.knownMaps) do
            local nm=qhNormalizeMapName(mapName)
            if nm~="" and qhNormalizeMapName(textBlob):find(nm,1,true) then
                score += 45
                break
            end
        end

        -- Explicitly reject common non-vote interactors.
        local rootName=tostring(root.Name or ""):lower()
        if rootName:find("seat",1,true) or rootName:find("door",1,true)
            or rootName:find("button",1,true) and score < 40 then
            score -= 80
        end

        return score
    end

    local function qhPadRoot(inst)
        if not inst then return nil end
        local best=nil
        local bestScore=-math.huge

        local candidates={}
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then candidates[1]=inst end
        for _,d in ipairs(inst:GetDescendants()) do
            if d:IsA("BasePart") then candidates[#candidates+1]=d end
        end

        for _,d in ipairs(candidates) do
            local hasTouch=d:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter")
            local hasPrompt=d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
            local hasClick=d:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector",true)
            if hasTouch or hasPrompt or hasClick then
                local s=qhCandidateScore(d)
                if s>bestScore then
                    bestScore=s
                    best=d
                end
            end
        end

        return best,bestScore
    end

    local function qhDetectMapChoices()
        local scored={}
        local seen={}
        local explicitModels={}

        -- Prefer containers whose names/text explicitly describe map voting.
        for _,root in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if root:IsA("Model") or root:IsA("Folder") or root:IsA("BasePart") then
                local all=(tostring(root.Name or "").." "..qhMapTextOf(root)):lower()
                if all:find("mapvote",1,true)
                    or all:find("map vote",1,true)
                    or all:find("mapvoting",1,true)
                    or all:find("vote pads",1,true)
                    or all:find("voting",1,true) and all:find("map",1,true)
                then
                    explicitModels[#explicitModels+1]=root
                end
            end
        end

        local function scanRoot(container)
            local candidates = {}
            if container:IsA("BasePart") then candidates[#candidates+1] = container end
            for _,root in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
                candidates[#candidates+1] = root
            end
            for _,root in ipairs(candidates) do
                if root:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local hasTouch=root:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter")
                    local hasPrompt=root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
                    local hasClick=root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector",true)
                    if hasTouch or hasPrompt or hasClick then
                        local num=qhPadNumber(root)
                        local score=qhCandidateScore(root)
                        if num or score>=70 then
                            local key=root:GetDebugId()
                            if not seen[key] then
                                seen[key]=true
                                scored[#scored+1]={root=root,index=num,score=score,name=qhMapTextOf(root)}
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for _,container in ipairs(explicitModels) do
            scanRoot(container)
        end

        if #scored<3 then
            -- Controlled global fallback: only explicit Pad/Vote/Map candidates,
            -- never loose interactors such as elevators.
            for _,root in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if root:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local name=(tostring(root.Name or "").." "..qhMapTextOf(root)):lower()
                    local hasTouch=root:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter")
                    local hasPrompt=root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
                    local hasClick=root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector",true)
                    if (hasTouch or hasPrompt or hasClick)
                        and (name:find("pad",1,true) or name:find("vote",1,true) or name:find("choice",1,true))
                    then
                        local num=qhPadNumber(root)
                        local score=qhCandidateScore(root)
                        if score>0 then
                            local key=root:GetDebugId()
                            if not seen[key] then
                                seen[key]=true
                                scored[#scored+1]={root=root,index=num,score=score,name=qhMapTextOf(root)}
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        table.sort(scored,function(a,b)
            if (a.index and b.index) and a.index~=b.index then
                return a.index<b.index
            end
            return a.score>b.score
        end)

        local byIndex={}
        local found={}
        for _,entry in ipairs(scored) do
            if entry.index and not byIndex[entry.index] then
                byIndex[entry.index]=entry
                found[#found+1]=entry
            end
        end

        if #found<3 then
            for _,entry in ipairs(scored) do
                if #found>=3 then break end
                local duplicate=false
                for _,x in ipairs(found) do
                    if x.root==entry.root then duplicate=true break end
                end
                if not duplicate then
                    found[#found+1]=entry
                end
            end
        end

        table.sort(found,function(a,b)
            return (a.index or 99) < (b.index or 99)
        end)

        MapVote.pads=found
        MapVote.choices=found
        return found
    end

    local function qhGetPad(index)
        local pads=qhDetectMapChoices()
        if #pads==0 then return nil end
        for _,entry in ipairs(pads) do
            if entry.index == index then return entry end
        end
        return pads[((index-1)%math.min(#pads,3))+1]
    end

    local function qhIsVotePadLimited(choice)
        local root=choice and choice.root
        if not root then return true end
        local text=qhMapTextOf(root):lower()
        local limited = text:find("limit",1,true)
            or text:find("full",1,true)
            or text:find("reached",1,true)
            or text:find("closed",1,true)
            or text:find("disabled",1,true)
        return limited ~= nil
    end

    local function qhActivateVote(choice)
        local voteRoot=choice and choice.root
        if not voteRoot then return false end
        if qhIsVotePadLimited(choice) then return false end
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return false end

        local targetCF=voteRoot.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,2.25,0)
        pcall(function() hrp.CFrame=targetCF end)
        task.wait(.22)

        local ok=false
        local touch=voteRoot:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter")
        if touch and firetouchinterest then
            ok=pcall(function()
                firetouchinterest(hrp,voteRoot,0)
                task.wait(.08)
                firetouchinterest(hrp,voteRoot,1)
            end)
        end
        if not ok then
            local prompt=voteRoot:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
            if prompt and fireproximityprompt then ok=pcall(function() fireproximityprompt(prompt) end) end
        end
        if not ok then
            local click=voteRoot:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector",true)
            if click and fireclickdetector then ok=pcall(function() fireclickdetector(click) end) end
        end
        return ok
    end

    local function qhResetAfterVote()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not char or not hum then return false end
        pcall(function() hum.Sit=false; hum.PlatformStand=false; hum.Health=0 end)
        task.wait(.25)
        if LocalPlayer.Character==char and char.Parent then pcall(function() char:BreakJoints() end) end
        return true
    end

    local function qhWaitForRespawn(oldCharacter,timeout)
        local deadline=tick()+(timeout or 12)
        while MapVote.enabled and tick()<deadline do
            local c=LocalPlayer.Character
            if c and c~=oldCharacter then
                local h=c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local r=c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if h and r and h.Health>0 then return true end
            end
            task.wait(.1)
        end
        return false
    end

    local function qhRunMapVote()
        if MapVote.busy then return end
        MapVote.busy=true
        MapVote.generation+=1
        local generation=MapVote.generation
        task.spawn(function()
            local failedThisCycle=0
            local attemptedInCycle=0
            local noProgressCycles=0
            while MapVote.enabled and generation==MapVote.generation
                and MapVote.completedVotes < math.max(1,MapVote.wantedVotes) do
                local padIndex=MapVote.currentPad
                local choice=qhGetPad(padIndex)
                if not choice then
                    failedThisCycle+=1
                    attemptedInCycle+=1
                    U.notify("Map Vote","Pad "..tostring(padIndex).." unavailable","search",1.5)
                else
                    local oldCharacter=LocalPlayer.Character
                    local selected=qhActivateVote(choice)
                    attemptedInCycle+=1
                    if selected then
                        MapVote.completedVotes+=1
                        failedThisCycle=0
                        U.notify("Map Vote","Pad "..tostring(padIndex).." selected • reset", "check",2)
                        qhResetAfterVote()
                        local respawned=qhWaitForRespawn(oldCharacter,12)
                        if not respawned then
                            U.notify("Map Vote","Respawn not detected","x-circle",2)
                            task.wait(1)
                        end
                    else
                        failedThisCycle+=1
                        U.notify("Map Vote","Pad "..tostring(padIndex).." rejected / limit reached","x-circle",1.5)
                    end
                end

                MapVote.currentPad=MapVote.currentPad+1
                if MapVote.currentPad>3 then
                    MapVote.currentPad=1
                    if attemptedInCycle>=3 then attemptedInCycle=0 end
                end

                -- A failed cycle means the pads were not interactable yet or their
                -- current vote limit blocked the click. Re-scan and keep cycling
                -- until the configured vote count is actually completed or every
                -- discovered pad explicitly reports that voting is closed/full.
                if failedThisCycle>=3 then
                    noProgressCycles += 1
                    local padsNow=qhDetectMapChoices()
                    local allExplicitlyLimited=(#padsNow>=3)
                    if allExplicitlyLimited then
                        for i=1,3 do
                            if not qhIsVotePadLimited(padsNow[i]) then
                                allExplicitlyLimited=false
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if allExplicitlyLimited then
                        MapVote.enabled=false
                        U.notify("Map Vote","All pads are full / closed", "check-circle",3)
                        break
                    end
                    if noProgressCycles % 4 == 0 then
                        U.notify("Map Vote","Re-scanning pads…", "refresh-cw",1.5)
                    end
                    failedThisCycle=0
                    attemptedInCycle=0
                    task.wait(1.2)
                else
                    noProgressCycles=0
                    task.wait(.55)
                end
            end
            if generation==MapVote.generation then
                MapVote.busy=false
                if MapVote.completedVotes>=math.max(1,MapVote.wantedVotes) then
                    MapVote.enabled=false
                    U.notify("Map Vote","Vote cycle limit reached", "check-circle",3)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local mapDropdown
    local mapNames = {"Auto Detect"}
    local function qhRefreshMapDropdown()
        local choices = qhDetectMapChoices()
        mapNames = {"Auto Detect"}
        local seen = {}
        for _, c in ipairs(choices) do
            local name = tostring(c.name)
            local key = qhNormalizeMapName(name)
            if key ~= "" and not seen[key] then
                seen[key] = true
                table.insert(mapNames, name)
            end
        end
        -- Keep only the current 2026 pool as fallback entries. If a future/event
        -- map is actually detected, it will still be added dynamically above.
        for _, name in ipairs(MapVote.knownMaps) do
            local key = qhNormalizeMapName(name)
            if not seen[key] then
                seen[key] = true
                table.insert(mapNames, name)
            end
        end
        if mapDropdown and mapDropdown.SetValues then
            pcall(function() mapDropdown:SetValues(mapNames) end)
        end
        return mapNames
    end

        Callback=function(v) MapVote.currentPad=math.clamp(tonumber(tostring(v or ""):match("%d+")) or 1,1,3) end
