-- WALL HOP
do
    local t = Sect:Tab({Title="WallHop", Icon="move-3d"})
    t:Section({Title="Wall Hop", TextSize=18})

    local wallHopEnabled = false
    local wallHopConn = nil
    local wallHopKey = S.Keybinds.WallHop or Enum.KeyCode.V
    local lastWallHop=0
    S._wallHopEnabled=false

    local function wallHopStep()
        local char=LocalPlayer.Character
        local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hum or not root or hum.Health<=0 then return end
        if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude<0.1 then return end
        if not UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then return end

        local now=os.clock()
        if now-lastWallHop<0.16 then return end

        local params=RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances={char}

        local origin=root.Position
        local right=root.CFrame.RightVector
        local leftHit=workspace:Raycast(origin,-right*2.0,params)
        local rightHit=workspace:Raycast(origin,right*2.0,params)
        local hit=leftHit or rightHit
        if not hit then return end

        local vel=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        -- Small, rate-limited impulse: never force Y to 55 every frame.
        if vel.Y>20 then return end

        local normal=Vector3.new(hit.Normal.X,0,hit.Normal.Z)
        if normal.Magnitude>0 then normal=normal.Unit end
        local forward=Vector3.new(hum.MoveDirection.X,0,hum.MoveDirection.Z)
        if forward.Magnitude>0 then forward=forward.Unit end

        local horizontal=Vector3.new(vel.X,0,vel.Z)
        local boosted=horizontal:Lerp((forward*math.max(horizontal.Magnitude,10))+normal*3,0.20)
        if boosted.Magnitude>34 then boosted=boosted.Unit*34 end

        lastWallHop=now
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(boosted.X,math.max(vel.Y,28),boosted.Z)
        pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end)
    end

    local function setWallHop(v)
        wallHopEnabled=v==true
        S._wallHopEnabled=wallHopEnabled
        if wallHopConn then wallHopConn:Disconnect(); wallHopConn=nil end
        lastWallHop=0
        if wallHopEnabled then
            wallHopConn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(wallHopStep)
            U.notify("WallHop", "Enabled • hold Space near a wall", "move", 2)
        else
            U.notify("WallHop", "Disabled", "x", 2)
        end
    end

    getgenv().__QHWallHopToggle = function()
        setWallHop(not wallHopEnabled)
    end

    t:Toggle({
        Flag="WallHopEnabled",
        Title="Wall Hop",
        Desc="Wall hop movement based on the WallHop from ruz (1).luau",
        Default=false,
        Callback=setWallHop
    })
    t:Space()
    t:Keybind({
        Flag="WallHopKey",
        Title="Wall Hop Key",
        Value=wallHopKey.Name,
        Callback=function(k)
            wallHopKey = typeof(k)=="EnumItem" and k or normalizeKey(k, Enum.KeyCode.V)
            S.Keybinds.WallHop = wallHopKey
        end
    })

    -- Mobile WallHop button ---------------------------------------------------
    -- Separate on-screen control for touch devices; the PC keybind remains above.
    local mobileGui, mobileButton
    local mobileButtonEnabled = true

    local function destroyMobileWallHopButton()
        if mobileGui then
            pcall(function() mobileGui:Destroy() end)
            mobileGui = nil
            mobileButton = nil
        end
    end

    local function createMobileWallHopButton()
        destroyMobileWallHopButton()
        if not UIS.TouchEnabled then return end

        mobileGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        mobileGui.Name = "QuantomHubWallHopMobile"
        mobileGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        mobileGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        mobileGui.DisplayOrder = 999998
        mobileGui.Parent = CoreGui

        mobileButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
        mobileButton.Name = "WallHopButton"
        mobileButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        mobileButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.84, 0, 0.72, 0)
        mobileButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(82, 82)
        mobileButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 43)
        mobileButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
        mobileButton.Text = "WALL\nHOP"
        mobileButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 238, 255)
        mobileButton.TextSize = 14
        mobileButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        mobileButton.AutoButtonColor = false
        mobileButton.Active = true
        mobileButton.ZIndex = 10
        mobileButton.Parent = mobileGui

        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        corner.Parent = mobileButton

        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Thickness = 2
        stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(145, 105, 255)
        stroke.Transparency = 0.15
        stroke.Parent = mobileButton

        local function refreshMobileVisual()
            if not mobileButton then return end
            if wallHopEnabled then
                mobileButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 45, 125)
                mobileButton.Text = "WALL\nHOP\nON"
            else
                mobileButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 43)
                mobileButton.Text = "WALL\nHOP"
            end
        end

        mobileButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            setWallHop(not wallHopEnabled)
            refreshMobileVisual()
        end)

        -- Drag support for touch and mouse; click still toggles when not dragged.
        local dragging = false
        local dragStart, startPos
        local moved = false

        mobileButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                dragging = true
                moved = false
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = mobileButton.Position
            end
        end)

        mobileButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                local connection
                connection = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(changed)
                    if not dragging then
                        if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
                        return
                    end
                    if changed.UserInputType ~= input.UserInputType and changed.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
                    local delta = changed.Position - dragStart
                    if delta.Magnitude > 8 then moved = true end
                    mobileButton.Position = UDim2.new(
                        startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                        startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                    )
                end)
            end
        end)

        mobileButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)

        refreshMobileVisual()
    end

    t:Toggle({
        Flag="WallHopMobileButton",
        Title="Mobile WallHop Button",
        Desc="Show an on-screen WallHop button on touch devices",
        Default=true,
        Callback=function(v)
            mobileButtonEnabled = v == true
            if mobileButtonEnabled then
                createMobileWallHopButton()
            else
                destroyMobileWallHopButton()
            end
        end
    })

    task.defer(function()
        if mobileButtonEnabled then createMobileWallHopButton() end
    end)
end


-- TELEPORT
do
    local t = Sect:Tab({Title="Teleport", Icon="navigation"})
    t:Section({Title="Teleport to Player", TextSize=18})

    local tpPlayerNames = {}
    local tpPlayerMap = {}
    local tpPlayerDropdown

    local function qhRefreshTeleportPlayers()
        tpPlayerNames = {}
        tpPlayerMap = {}
        for _, plr in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                local label = plr.Name
                if plr.DisplayName and plr.DisplayName ~= plr.Name then
                    label = plr.Name .. "  (" .. plr.DisplayName .. ")"
                end
                table.insert(tpPlayerNames, label)
                tpPlayerMap[label] = plr
            end
        end
        table.sort(tpPlayerNames, function(a,b) return a:lower() < b:lower() end)
        if #tpPlayerNames == 0 then tpPlayerNames = {"No players"} end
        if tpPlayerDropdown and tpPlayerDropdown.SetValues then
            pcall(function() tpPlayerDropdown:SetValues(tpPlayerNames) end)
        end
    end

    local function qhTeleportToPlayer(plr)
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetChar = plr and plr.Character
        local targetRoot = targetChar and targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myRoot or not targetRoot then
            U.notify("Teleport", "Player or character not available", "x-circle", 2)
            return false
        end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            myRoot.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame + targetRoot.CFrame.LookVector * -3 + Vector3.new(0,1.5,0)
        end)
        if ok then
            U.notify("Teleport", "Teleported to " .. tostring(plr.Name), "navigation", 2)
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    qhRefreshTeleportPlayers()
    tpPlayerDropdown = t:Dropdown({
        Flag="TeleportPlayer", Title="Player", Values=tpPlayerNames, Value=tpPlayerNames[1],
        Callback=function(v) S.teleportTargetPlayer = tostring(v or "") end
    })
    S.teleportTargetPlayer = S.teleportTargetPlayer or tpPlayerNames[1]

    t:Space()
    t:Button({Title="Teleport to Player", Icon="navigation", Color=S.C.MidPurple, Justify="Center",
        Callback=function()
            qhRefreshTeleportPlayers()
            local selected = tpPlayerMap[S.teleportTargetPlayer or ""]
            if not selected then
                for label, plr in pairs(tpPlayerMap) do
                    if tostring(plr.Name):lower() == tostring(S.teleportTargetPlayer or ""):lower() then
                        selected = plr
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if selected then qhTeleportToPlayer(selected) else U.notify("Teleport", "Select a player first", "x-circle", 2) end
        end})

    t:Space()
    t:Button({Title="Teleport to Murderer", Icon="skull", Color=S.C.Murder, Justify="Center",
        Callback=function()
            local m = Roles.getMurderer()
            if m then qhTeleportToPlayer(m) else U.notify("Teleport", "Murderer not found", "x-circle", 2) end
        end})

    t:Space()
    t:Button({Title="Teleport to Sheriff", Icon="shield", Color=S.C.RoyalBlue, Justify="Center",
        Callback=function()
            local sh = Roles.getSheriff()
            if sh then qhTeleportToPlayer(sh) else U.notify("Teleport", "Sheriff not found", "x-circle", 2) end
        end})

    t:Space()
    t:Button({Title="Refresh Players", Icon="refresh-cw", Callback=qhRefreshTeleportPlayers})

    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(2) do
            if tpPlayerDropdown then qhRefreshTeleportPlayers() end
        end
    end)
end


-- ANTI-AIM
-- Reworked: the old version wrote an extreme velocity every Heartbeat and then
-- restored it immediately with task.defer(), so the server/client could see
-- almost no useful state change. Keep the player's real movement velocity and
-- apply a controlled yaw jitter instead.
local antiAimConnection = nil
local antiAimCharConnection = nil
local antiAimLast = 0
local antiAimSide = 1
local antiAimYaw = 0

local function applyAntiAimCharacter(character)
    local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = false end)
    end
end

local function restoreAntiAimCharacter(character)
    local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        pcall(function() hum.AutoRotate = true end)
    end
end

local function startAntiAim()
    if antiAimConnection then return end
    antiAimLast = 0
    antiAimSide = math.random(0, 1) == 0 and -1 or 1

    if antiAimCharConnection then
        antiAimCharConnection:Disconnect()
        antiAimCharConnection = nil
    end
    antiAimCharConnection = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.defer(function()
            if S.antiAimEnabled then
                applyAntiAimCharacter(character)
            end
        end)
    end)

    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        applyAntiAimCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
    end

    antiAimConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not S.antiAimEnabled then return end

        local now = os.clock()
        if now - antiAimLast < 0.08 then return end
        antiAimLast = now

        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

        applyAntiAimCharacter(character)

        -- Alternate a strong left/right fake-facing angle while preserving
        -- the actual movement velocity. This avoids the old velocity overwrite.
        antiAimSide = -antiAimSide
        antiAimYaw = math.rad(110 + math.random(-20, 20)) * antiAimSide

        local pos = hrp.Position
        local look = hrp.CFrame.LookVector
        local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.01 then
            flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        else
            flatLook = flatLook.Unit
        end

        local base = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + flatLook, Vector3.yAxis)
        pcall(function()
            hrp.CFrame = base * CFrame.Angles(0, antiAimYaw, 0)
        end)
    end)
end

local function stopAntiAim()
    if antiAimConnection then
        antiAimConnection:Disconnect()
        antiAimConnection = nil
    end
    if antiAimCharConnection then
        antiAimCharConnection:Disconnect()
        antiAimCharConnection = nil
    end
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        restoreAntiAimCharacter(LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
end

-- ============================================================
-- ANTI-AIM 2
-- Predictive sheriff-shot dodge. Uses several local signals because MM2
-- can create the actual hit ray on the server without exposing a projectile
-- object to the client.
-- ============================================================
local antiAim2Connection = nil
local antiAim2DescendantConnection = nil
local antiAim2CharacterConnection = nil
local antiAim2ActivatedConnections = {}
local antiAim2Tracked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local antiAim2LastDodge = -math.huge
local antiAim2RestoreToken = 0

local function antiAim2DisconnectActivated()
    for i = #antiAim2ActivatedConnections, 1, -1 do
        pcall(function() antiAim2ActivatedConnections[i]:Disconnect() end)
        antiAim2ActivatedConnections[i] = nil
    end
end

local function antiAim2Sheriff()
    local ok, sheriff = pcall(function()
        return Roles and Roles.getSheriff and Roles.getSheriff() or nil
    end)
    return ok and sheriff or nil
end

local function antiAim2Root(player)
    local character = player and player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function antiAim2GetGun(sheriff)
    local character = sheriff and sheriff.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    local gun = character:FindFirstChild("Gun")
    if gun and gun:IsA("Tool") then return gun end
    for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:IsA("Tool") then
            local n = obj.Name:lower()
            if n:find("gun",1,true) or n:find("revolver",1,true) or n:find("pistol",1,true) then
                return obj
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function antiAim2SegmentDistance(point, a, b)
    local ab = b - a
    local denom = ab:Dot(ab)
    if denom <= 1e-6 then return (point - a).Magnitude end
    local t = math.clamp((point - a):Dot(ab) / denom, 0, 1)
    return (point - (a + ab * t)).Magnitude
end

local function antiAim2Threat(origin, direction, maxDistance, radius)
    if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
    if direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then return false end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end

    local dir = direction.Unit
    local finish = origin + dir * math.clamp(maxDistance or 160, 20, 220)
    local distance = antiAim2SegmentDistance(root.Position, origin, finish)
    if distance > radius then return false end

    -- Require the player to be in front of the firing origin rather than
    -- merely close to the infinite line behind the shooter.
    local along = (root.Position - origin):Dot(dir)
    return along > -2 and along <= (maxDistance or 160)
end

local function antiAim2Dodge(reason)
    if not S.antiAim2Enabled then return false end
    local now = os.clock()
    local cooldown = math.clamp(tonumber(S.antiAim2Cooldown) or 0.28, 0.08, 1.0)
    if now - antiAim2LastDodge < cooldown then return false end

    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end

    antiAim2LastDodge = now
    antiAim2RestoreToken += 1
    local token = antiAim2RestoreToken
    local original = hrp.CFrame
    local originalVelocity = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local height = math.clamp(tonumber(S.antiAim2Height) or 7, 2, 14)
    local duration = math.clamp(tonumber(S.antiAim2Duration) or 0.075, 0.02, 0.18)

    -- Keep horizontal movement intact while lifting only vertically.
    pcall(function()
        hrp.CFrame = original + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
            originalVelocity.X,
            math.max(originalVelocity.Y, 0),
            originalVelocity.Z
        )
    end)

    pcall(function()
        U.notify("AntiAim 2", "Shot detected • " .. tostring(reason or "dodge"), "shield", 1)
    end)

    task.delay(duration, function()
        if token ~= antiAim2RestoreToken then return end
        if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end
        local currentHum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not currentHum or currentHum.Health <= 0 then return end
        pcall(function()
            hrp.CFrame = original
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = originalVelocity
        end)
    end)
    return true
end

local function antiAim2CheckSheriffFacing(reason)
    local sheriff = antiAim2Sheriff()
    local sheriffRoot = antiAim2Root(sheriff)
    if not sheriffRoot then return false end

    local gun = antiAim2GetGun(sheriff)
    local origin = gun and (gun:FindFirstChild("Handle") or gun:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
    origin = origin and origin.Position or sheriffRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)

    local direction = sheriffRoot.CFrame.LookVector
    local radius = math.clamp(tonumber(S.antiAim2Radius) or 4.25, 1, 10)
    return antiAim2Threat(origin, direction, 180, radius) and antiAim2Dodge(reason or "sheriff fired")
end

local function antiAim2LooksLikeProjectile(obj)
    if not obj then return false end
    local n = tostring(obj.Name or ""):lower()
    return n:find("bullet",1,true) or n:find("projectile",1,true)
        or n:find("tracer",1,true) or n:find("bullettrail",1,true)
        or n:find("shoot",1,true) or n:find("shot",1,true)
end

local function antiAim2Register(obj)
    if not S.antiAim2Enabled or not obj then return end
    local localCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
    if localCharacter and obj:IsDescendantOf(localCharacter) then return end
    if not (antiAim2LooksLikeProjectile(obj) or obj:IsA("Beam")) then return end

    local sheriff = antiAim2Sheriff()
    local sheriffRoot = antiAim2Root(sheriff)
    if not sheriffRoot then return end

    local origin
    local direction
    if obj:IsA("Beam") then
        local a0, a1 = obj.Attachment0, obj.Attachment1
        if a0 and a1 then
            origin = a0.WorldPosition
            local delta = a1.WorldPosition - origin
            direction = delta.Magnitude > 0.001 and delta.Unit or nil
        end
    elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
        origin = obj.Position
        local v = obj.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.Magnitude > 1 then direction = v.Unit end
    end

    if typeof(origin) == "Vector3" and typeof(direction) == "Vector3" then
        antiAim2Tracked[obj] = {born=os.clock(), origin=origin, direction=direction}
    end
end

local function antiAim2WireSheriff(sheriff)
    antiAim2DisconnectActivated()
    local gun = antiAim2GetGun(sheriff)
    if not gun then return end

    -- Tool.Activated is available on the sheriff's replicated Tool and is a
    -- much more reliable local shot signal than waiting for a visible bullet.
    local ok, conn = pcall(function()
        return gun.Activated:Connect(function()
            if S.antiAim2Enabled then
                task.defer(function()
                    pcall(function() antiAim2CheckSheriffFacing("shot activation") end)
                end)
            end
        end)
    end)
    if ok and conn then table.insert(antiAim2ActivatedConnections, conn) end

    -- Other clients do not reliably receive Tool.Activated. MM2 commonly
    -- replicates the sheriff firing animation, so listen for a fresh weapon
    -- animation as a second, independent shot signal.
    local humanoid = sheriff.Character and sheriff.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then
        local okAnim, animConn = pcall(function()
            return animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
                if not S.antiAim2Enabled then return end
                local name = ""
                pcall(function() name = tostring(track.Animation and track.Animation.AnimationId or "") end)
                local lower = name:lower()
                if lower:find("gun",1,true) or lower:find("shoot",1,true) or lower:find("fire",1,true) then
                    task.defer(function()
                        pcall(function() antiAim2CheckSheriffFacing("sheriff animation") end)
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end)
        if okAnim and animConn then table.insert(antiAim2ActivatedConnections, animConn) end
    end

    local gunServer = gun:FindFirstChild("GunServer")
    local shootStart = gunServer and gunServer:FindFirstChild("ShootStart")
    if shootStart and shootStart:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
        local ok2, c2 = pcall(function()
            return shootStart.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                if S.antiAim2Enabled then
                    task.defer(function()
                        pcall(function() antiAim2CheckSheriffFacing("shoot event") end)
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end)
        if ok2 and c2 then table.insert(antiAim2ActivatedConnections, c2) end
    end
end

local function stopAntiAim2()
    if antiAim2Connection then antiAim2Connection:Disconnect(); antiAim2Connection = nil end
    if antiAim2DescendantConnection then antiAim2DescendantConnection:Disconnect(); antiAim2DescendantConnection = nil end
    if antiAim2CharacterConnection then antiAim2CharacterConnection:Disconnect(); antiAim2CharacterConnection = nil end
    antiAim2DisconnectActivated()
    table.clear(antiAim2Tracked)
    antiAim2RestoreToken += 1
end

local function startAntiAim2()
    stopAntiAim2()
    if not S.antiAim2Enabled then return end

    antiAim2DescendantConnection = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
        pcall(function() antiAim2Register(obj) end)
    end)

    antiAim2CharacterConnection = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            if S.antiAim2Enabled then task.delay(0.15, function()
                pcall(function()
                    local sheriff = antiAim2Sheriff()
                    if sheriff then antiAim2WireSheriff(sheriff) end
                end)
            end) end
        end)
    end)

    antiAim2Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not S.antiAim2Enabled or QH_IsRoundTransition() then return end

        local sheriff = antiAim2Sheriff()
        local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not sheriff or not myRoot then return end

        local currentGun = antiAim2GetGun(sheriff)
        if currentGun then
            -- Rewire only when the actual Gun instance changes.
            if antiAim2Tracked.__gun ~= currentGun then
                antiAim2Tracked.__gun = currentGun
                antiAim2WireSheriff(sheriff)
            end
        end

        local radius = math.clamp(tonumber(S.antiAim2Radius) or 4.25, 1, 10)
        local now = os.clock()
        for obj, record in pairs(antiAim2Tracked) do
            if obj == "__gun" then
                continue
            end
            if not obj.Parent or not record or now - (record.born or now) > 0.30 then
                antiAim2Tracked[obj] = nil
            else
                local a = obj:IsA("Beam") and obj.Attachment0 and obj.Attachment0.WorldPosition or obj.Position
                local b
                if obj:IsA("Beam") then
                    b = obj.Attachment1 and obj.Attachment1.WorldPosition
                else
                    local v = obj.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    if typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.Magnitude > 1 then
                        b = a + v.Unit * math.min(v.Magnitude * 0.18, 200)
                    end
                end
                if a and b and antiAim2SegmentDistance(myRoot.Position, a, b) <= radius then
                    if antiAim2Dodge("projectile trace") then break end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    task.defer(function()
        local sheriff = antiAim2Sheriff()
        if sheriff then antiAim2WireSheriff(sheriff) end
    end)
end

-- Settings UI is provided by the original Settings.lua library loaded earlier.
-- Do not create a second Obsidian Settings tab here.
-- Apply persisted visual quality before Settings callbacks are used.
pcall(function()
    QH_ApplyVisualQuality(S.visualQuality or "High")
end)





-- QUANTOMHUB CHARACTER MEME MORPHS
-- Brainrot / meme model loader
local QH_MemeMorphFolder
local QH_MemeOriginalCharacter
local QH_MemeOriginalTransparency = {}
local QH_MemeHideConnection

local function QH_SetOriginalCharacterHidden(character, hidden)
    if not character then return end

    for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            if hidden then
                if QH_MemeOriginalTransparency[obj] == nil then
                    QH_MemeOriginalTransparency[obj] = obj.LocalTransparencyModifier
                end
                obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
            else
                local old = QH_MemeOriginalTransparency[obj]
                obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = old ~= nil and old or 0
            end
        elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
            if hidden then
                if QH_MemeOriginalTransparency[obj] == nil then
                    QH_MemeOriginalTransparency[obj] = obj.Transparency
                end
                obj.Transparency = 1
            else
                local old = QH_MemeOriginalTransparency[obj]
                if old ~= nil then obj.Transparency = old end
            end
        end
    end

    if not hidden then
        if QH_MemeHideConnection then
            pcall(function() QH_MemeHideConnection:Disconnect() end)
            QH_MemeHideConnection = nil
        end
        table.clear(QH_MemeOriginalTransparency)
        return
    end

    -- Roblox can recreate accessory handles/decals and reset their local
    -- transparency after the character changes. Keep the original character
    -- hidden while the visual replacement is active.
    if QH_MemeHideConnection then
        pcall(function() QH_MemeHideConnection:Disconnect() end)
        QH_MemeHideConnection = nil
    end

    QH_MemeHideConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not QH_MemeOriginalCharacter
            or not QH_MemeOriginalCharacter.Parent
            or QH_MemeOriginalCharacter ~= character
        then
            if QH_MemeHideConnection then
                pcall(function() QH_MemeHideConnection:Disconnect() end)
                QH_MemeHideConnection = nil
            end
            return
        end

        for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                if QH_MemeOriginalTransparency[obj] == nil then
                    QH_MemeOriginalTransparency[obj] = obj.LocalTransparencyModifier
                end
                if obj.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 then
                    obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                end
            elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
                if QH_MemeOriginalTransparency[obj] == nil then
                    QH_MemeOriginalTransparency[obj] = obj.Transparency
                end
                if obj.Transparency ~= 1 then
                    obj.Transparency = 1
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function QH_DestroyMemeMorph(keepState)
    if QH_MemeMorphFolder then
        QH_MemeMorphFolder:Destroy()
        QH_MemeMorphFolder = nil
    end

    local oldWorkspace = workspace:FindFirstChild("QH_MemeMorph")
    if oldWorkspace then
        oldWorkspace:Destroy()
    end

    if QH_MemeOriginalCharacter and QH_MemeOriginalCharacter.Parent then
        QH_SetOriginalCharacterHidden(QH_MemeOriginalCharacter, false)
    end

    QH_MemeOriginalCharacter = nil

    if not keepState then
        S._memeMorphName = nil
        S._memeMorphAssetId = nil
    end
end

local function QH_LoadMemeMorph(name, assetId)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not character or not root then
        U.notify("Character", "Character not found", "x", 3)
        return
    end

    -- Remove previous model but keep the selected state until the new model
    -- has loaded successfully.
    QH_DestroyMemeMorph(true)

    local ok, assets = pcall(function()
        return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
    end)

    if not ok or type(assets) ~= "table" then
        U.notify("Character", "Failed loading " .. tostring(name), "x", 3)
        return
    end

    local model
    for _, obj in ipairs(assets) do
        if obj:IsA("Model") then
            model = obj
            break
        elseif obj:IsA("MeshPart") or obj:IsA("Part") then
            model = Instance.new("Model")
            obj.Parent = model
            break
        end
    end

    if not model then
        U.notify("Character", tostring(name) .. " model not found", "x", 3)
        return
    end

    model.Name = "QH_MemeMorph"

    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "QH_MemeMorph"
    folder.Parent = workspace
    QH_MemeMorphFolder = folder
    model.Parent = folder

    -- The original player remains the real Roblox character for movement,
    -- physics and networking, but is locally invisible. The selected model
    -- is the visible replacement.
    QH_MemeOriginalCharacter = character
    QH_SetOriginalCharacterHidden(character, true)

    -- ============================================================
    -- MODEL NORMALIZATION
    --
    -- Tung Tung Sahur already has the desired size, so it stays at
    -- 100%. The other two assets have very different source scales.
    -- Normalize them to a consistent Roblox-character height.
    -- ============================================================
    local MODEL_PROFILES = {
        ["Tung Tung Sahur"] = {
            TargetHeight = 5.55,
            Yaw = 0,
            Pitch = 0,
            Roll = 0,
        },

        ["Bombardiro Crocodilo"] = {
            -- The source asset is oversized compared with the other
            -- replacements, so give it a smaller target height.
            TargetHeight = 2.35,

            -- The Bombardiro asset's forward axis is reversed. Rotate
            -- the visual replacement 180 degrees so Shift Lock/front
            -- direction matches the real character.
            Yaw = 180,
            Pitch = 0,
            Roll = 0,
        },

        ["Tralalero Tralala"] = {
            TargetHeight = 5.55,
            Yaw = 0,
            Pitch = 0,
            Roll = 0,
        },
    }

    local profile = MODEL_PROFILES[tostring(name)] or {
        TargetHeight = 5.55,
        Yaw = 0,
        Pitch = 0,
        Roll = 0,
    }

    local followOffset = CFrame.new()
    local okNormalize = pcall(function()
        local _, originalSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
        local originalHeight = math.max(originalSize.Y, 0.05)

        -- ScaleTo preserves the model's proportions instead of stretching
        -- X/Y/Z independently.
        local scaleFactor = profile.TargetHeight / originalHeight
        scaleFactor = math.clamp(scaleFactor, 0.08, 4.0)

        if type(model.ScaleTo) == "function" then
            model:ScaleTo(scaleFactor)
        else
            -- Fallback for older environments.
            for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.Size = part.Size * scaleFactor
                end
            end
        end

        -- Apply the asset's visual orientation once, then keep that
        -- orientation while following the real character.
        local rotation = CFrame.Angles(
            math.rad(profile.Pitch),
            math.rad(profile.Yaw),
            math.rad(profile.Roll)
        )

        model:PivotTo(root.CFrame * rotation)

        -- Recalculate the actual bounding box after scaling.
        local boxCf, boxSize = model:GetBoundingBox()
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hip = humanoid and humanoid.HipHeight or 2

        local bottomY = boxCf.Position.Y - boxSize.Y * 0.5
        local targetBottomY = root.Position.Y - hip

        local yOffset = math.clamp(
            targetBottomY - bottomY,
            -20,
            20
        )

        followOffset = rotation * CFrame.new(0, yOffset, 0)
        model:PivotTo(root.CFrame * followOffset)
    end)

    if not okNormalize then
        model:PivotTo(root.CFrame)
    end

    -- Visual replacement: no collision and no physics interference.
    for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.Anchored = true
            part.CanCollide = false
            part.CanTouch = false
            part.CanQuery = false
            part.Massless = true
        end
    end

    -- Do not weld it to the hidden character. Update its pivot every frame
    -- so it visually occupies the player's exact position and orientation.
    task.spawn(function()
        while QH_MemeMorphFolder
            and QH_MemeMorphFolder.Parent
            and model
            and model.Parent
        do
            local currentCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
            local currentRoot = currentCharacter
                and currentCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if currentRoot then
                -- Recalculate from the root each frame. The model is the
                -- visible avatar while the hidden Character handles movement.
                local cf = currentRoot.CFrame

                pcall(function()
                    model:PivotTo(cf * followOffset)
                end)
            end

            task.wait()
        end
    end)

    -- Keep the original character hidden if Roblox replaces individual
    -- body parts during local character updates.
    task.spawn(function()
        while QH_MemeMorphFolder
            and QH_MemeMorphFolder.Parent
            and QH_MemeOriginalCharacter
            and QH_MemeOriginalCharacter.Parent
        do
            QH_SetOriginalCharacterHidden(QH_MemeOriginalCharacter, true)
            task.wait(0.25)
        end
    end)

    S._memeMorphName = tostring(name)
    S._memeMorphAssetId = tostring(assetId)

    U.notify(
        "Models",
        tostring(name) .. " is now your visible character",
        "check",
        3
    )
end


-- ============================================================
-- ANIMATION / EMOTE SOURCE
-- Integrated from the supplied anim&bundle source.
--
-- Emotes:
--   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7yd7/sniper-Emote/refs/heads/test/EmoteSniper.json
--
-- Animations / Bundles:
--   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7yd7/sniper-Emote/refs/heads/test/AnimationSniper.json
--   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7yd7/sniper-Emote/refs/heads/test/AnimationSniperoffsale.json
-- ============================================================
do
    local AnimationTab = Sect:Tab({
        Title = "Animation",
        Icon = "person-standing",
    })

    local SourceBox = AnimationTab._page:AddLeftGroupbox("Emote / Animation", "sparkles")
    local ControlBox = AnimationTab._page:AddRightGroupbox("Playback", "play")

    local QH_AnimState = {
        Mode = "Emote",
        Emotes = {},
        Animations = {},
        SelectedName = nil,
        SelectedData = nil,
        PersistedMode = nil,
        PersistedName = nil,
        PersistedData = nil,
        Search = "",
        Loading = true,
        CurrentTrack = nil,
        EmoteDropdown = nil,
        AnimationDropdown = nil,
        ModeDropdown = nil,
        SearchInput = nil,
        StatusLabel = nil,
    }

    local function qhNotify(title, content, icon)
        pcall(function()
            U.notify(title, content, icon or "check", 3)
        end)
    end

    local function qhGetHumanoid()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then
            return nil
        end
        return character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end

    local function qhStopTrack()
        if QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack then
            pcall(function()
                QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack:Stop(0)
                QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack:Destroy()
            end)
            QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack = nil
        end

        local humanoid = qhGetHumanoid()
        if humanoid then
            pcall(function()
                for _, track in ipairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                    track:Stop(0)
                    track:Destroy()
                end
            end)
        end
        QH_AnimState.PersistedMode = nil
        QH_AnimState.PersistedName = nil
        QH_AnimState.PersistedData = nil
    end

    local function qhResolveEmoteAnimationId(emoteId)
        local fallbackId = tonumber(emoteId)
        if not fallbackId then
            return nil
        end

        local objects
        local ok = false

        for _, url in ipairs({
            "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(fallbackId),
            "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. tostring(fallbackId),
        }) do
            ok, objects = pcall(function()
                return game:GetObjects(url)
            end)

            if ok and type(objects) == "table" and #objects > 0 then
                break
            end
        end

        if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" then
            return fallbackId
        end

        local function findAnimation(obj)
            if obj:IsA("Animation") then
                local id = tostring(obj.AnimationId or ""):match("%d+")
                if id then
                    return tonumber(id)
                end
            end

            for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
                local found = findAnimation(child)
                if found then
                    return found
                end
            end

            return nil
        end

        for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
            local found = findAnimation(obj)
            pcall(function()
                obj:Destroy()
            end)

            if found then
                return found
            end
        end

        return fallbackId
    end

    local function qhPlayAnimationId(animationId, label)
        local humanoid = qhGetHumanoid()
        if not humanoid then
            qhNotify("Animation", "Humanoid not found", "x")
            return false
        end

        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if not animator then
            animator = Instance.new("Animator")
            animator.Parent = humanoid
        end

        qhStopTrack()

        local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
        animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(animationId)

        local ok, track = pcall(function()
            return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
        end)

        if not ok or not track then
            animation:Destroy()
            qhNotify("Animation", "Failed to load " .. tostring(label or animationId), "x")
            return false
        end

        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        track.Looped = true
        track:Play(0.15, 1, 1)

        QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack = track
        QH_AnimState.PersistedMode = "Emote"
        QH_AnimState.PersistedName = tostring(label or animationId)
        QH_AnimState.PersistedData = {id=tonumber(animationId) or animationId, name=tostring(label or animationId)}

        qhNotify(
            "Animation",
            "Playing: " .. tostring(label or animationId),
            "play"
        )

        return true
    end

    local qhBundleResolveCache = {}

    -- Performance-safe bundle resolver. Never resolve hundreds of assets in
    -- one uninterrupted VM slice: this was the main source of hard freezes
    -- when an animation pack was enabled.
    local function qhResolveBundle(bundleData)
        if type(bundleData) ~= "table" or type(bundleData.bundledItems) ~= "table" then
            return {}
        end

        local bundleCacheKey = tostring(bundleData.id or "")
        if bundleCacheKey ~= "" and qhBundleResolveCache[bundleCacheKey] then
            return qhBundleResolveCache[bundleCacheKey]
        end

        local mappings = {}
        local seenAnimations = {}
        local processedAssets = 0
        local MAX_ASSETS = 4
        local MAX_MAPPINGS = 12
        local MAX_DEPTH = 5

        local function addAnimation(child, category, name)
            if #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS then
                return true
            end
            if not child or not child:IsA("Animation") then
                return false
            end
            local animationId = tostring(child.AnimationId or "")
            if animationId == "" then
                return false
            end
            local key = tostring(category) .. "|" .. animationId
            if seenAnimations[key] then
                return false
            end
            seenAnimations[key] = true

            local weightVals = {}
            for _, wChild in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
                if wChild:IsA("NumberValue") and wChild.Name == "Weight" then
                    weightVals[#weightVals + 1] = wChild.Value
                end
            end

            mappings[#mappings + 1] = {
                category = category,
                name = name,
                animationId = animationId,
                weights = weightVals,
            }
            return #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS
        end

        local function searchTree(parent, parentPath, depth)
            if not parent or depth > MAX_DEPTH or #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS then
                return
            end

            for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Animation") then
                    local pathParts = (parentPath .. "." .. child.Name):split(".")
                    local category = pathParts[#pathParts - 1] or "Animation"
                    if addAnimation(child, category, pathParts[#pathParts]) then
                        return
                    end
                elseif #child:GetChildren() > 0 then
                    searchTree(child, parentPath .. "." .. child.Name, depth + 1)
                    if #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS then
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for _, assetIds in pairs(bundleData.bundledItems) do
            if type(assetIds) == "table" then
                for _, assetId in pairs(assetIds) do
                    if processedAssets >= MAX_ASSETS or #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS then
                        break
                    end

                    processedAssets += 1
                    -- Yield before every potentially expensive asset load.
                    task.wait()

                    local id = tostring(assetId):match("%d+")
                    if id then
                        local success, objects = pcall(function()
                            return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. id)
                        end)

                        if success and type(objects) == "table" then
                            for _, obj in ipairs(objects) do
                                searchTree(obj, obj.Name, 0)
                                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                                if #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS then
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    -- Give rendering/input a chance after each asset.
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
            if processedAssets >= MAX_ASSETS or #mappings >= MAX_MAPPINGS then
                break
            end
        end

        if bundleCacheKey ~= "" and #mappings > 0 then
            qhBundleResolveCache[bundleCacheKey] = mappings
        end

        return mappings
    end

    local function qhSetAnimationObject(animObj, animationId, weights)
        if not animObj or not animObj:IsA("Animation") then
            return
        end

        animObj.AnimationId = animationId

        if weights then
            for _, child in ipairs(animObj:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("NumberValue") and child.Name == "Weight" then
                    child:Destroy()
                end
            end

            for _, weight in ipairs(weights) do
                local value = Instance.new("NumberValue")
                value.Name = "Weight"
                value.Value = weight
                value.Parent = animObj
            end
        end
    end

    local QH_AnimateBackup = nil
    local QH_AnimateCharacter = nil

    local function qhStopAllAnimationTracks(humanoid)
        if not humanoid then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            for _, track in ipairs(humanoid:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                track:Stop(0)
                track:Destroy()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function qhFindAnimateFolder(animate, category)
        if not animate then
            return nil
        end

        local wanted = tostring(category):lower()

        -- Normalize common bundle names to Roblox Animate folder names.
        local aliases = {
            idle = "idle",
            walk = "walk",
            run = "run",
            jump = "jump",
            fall = "fall",
            freefall = "fall",
            climb = "climb",
            swim = "swim",
            swimidle = "swimidle",
            toolnone = "toolnone",
            toolslash = "toolslash",
            toollunge = "toollunge",
        }

        wanted = aliases[wanted] or wanted

        -- Do not require Folder here. The original animation source uses
        -- Animate:FindFirstChild(category) directly because Roblox versions
        -- can expose the animation holder as a different Instance type.
        for _, child in ipairs(animate:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name:lower() == wanted then
                return child
            end
        end

        -- Some sources use "SwimIdle" while Animate uses another casing.
        local compactWanted = wanted:gsub("[%s_%-]", "")

        for _, child in ipairs(animate:GetChildren()) do
            local compactName =
                child.Name:lower():gsub("[%s_%-]", "")

            if compactName == compactWanted then
                return child
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function qhBackupAnimate(animate)
        if QH_AnimateBackup and QH_AnimateCharacter == LocalPlayer.Character then
            return
        end

        QH_AnimateBackup = {}
        QH_AnimateCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character

        for _, folder in ipairs(animate:GetChildren()) do
            if folder:GetChildren() then
                local entry = {
                    Name = folder.Name,
                    Animations = {},
                }

                for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("Animation") then
                        table.insert(entry.Animations, {
                            Name = child.Name,
                            AnimationId = child.AnimationId,
                            Weights = (function()
                                local weights = {}

                                for _, value in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
                                    if value:IsA("NumberValue")
                                        and value.Name == "Weight"
                                    then
                                        table.insert(weights, value.Value)
                                    end
                                end

                                return weights
                            end)(),
                        })
                    end
                end

                QH_AnimateBackup[folder.Name:lower()] = entry
            end
        end
    end

    local function qhClearAnimateFolder(folder)
        for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Animation") then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end

    local function qhRestoreAnimate(animate)
        if not QH_AnimateBackup then
            return
        end

        -- Remove everything currently installed by a previous bundle.
        for _, folder in ipairs(animate:GetChildren()) do
            if folder:GetChildren() then
                qhClearAnimateFolder(folder)
            end
        end

        -- Restore exactly the original animation objects.
        for folderName, entry in pairs(QH_AnimateBackup) do
            local folder = animate:FindFirstChild(entry.Name)

            if folder then
                for _, saved in ipairs(entry.Animations) do
                    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
                    animation.Name = saved.Name
                    animation.AnimationId = saved.AnimationId
                    animation.Parent = folder

                    for _, weight in ipairs(saved.Weights) do
                        local value = Instance.new("NumberValue")
                        value.Name = "Weight"
                        value.Value = weight
                        value.Parent = animation
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function qhInstallSingleAnimation(folder, mapping)
        if not folder or not mapping then
            return
        end

        -- Reuse an existing animation whenever possible. Destroying and
        -- recreating the entire folder causes a large render/animation spike.
        local animation
        for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Animation") then
                animation = child
                break
            end
        end
        if not animation then
            animation = Instance.new("Animation")
            animation.Name = tostring(mapping.name or "QH_Animation")
            animation.Parent = folder
        end
        animation.AnimationId = tostring(mapping.animationId)
    end

    local qhAnimationApplyBusy = false

    local function qhApplyAnimationBundle(bundleData)
        if qhAnimationApplyBusy then
            return false
        end
        if type(bundleData) ~= "table" then
            return false
        end

        qhAnimationApplyBusy = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, err = xpcall(function()
                local character = LocalPlayer.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local animate = character and character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
                if not character or not humanoid or not animate then
                    qhNotify("Animation", "Animate/Humanoid not found", "x")
                    return
                end

                local mappings = qhResolveBundle(bundleData)
                if #mappings == 0 then
                    qhNotify("Animation", "No animations found in this bundle", "x")
                    return
                end

                qhBackupAnimate(animate)
                qhStopAllAnimationTracks(humanoid)

                -- Do NOT destroy/recreate every Animate object and do NOT
                -- toggle the controller twice. Reuse one existing Animation
                -- per category whenever possible; this removes the huge
                -- frame-time spike from animation pack activation.
                local byCategory = {}
                for _, mapping in ipairs(mappings) do
                    local category = tostring(mapping.category or ""):lower()
                    category = category:gsub("[%s_%-]", "")
                    if category ~= "" and not byCategory[category] then
                        byCategory[category] = mapping
                    end
                end

                local installed = 0
                for category, mapping in pairs(byCategory) do
                    local folder = qhFindAnimateFolder(animate, category)
                    if folder then
                        local existing
                        for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                            if child:IsA("Animation") then
                                existing = child
                                break
                            end
                        end

                        if existing then
                            existing.AnimationId = tostring(mapping.animationId)
                        else
                            local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
                            animation.Name = "QH_" .. category
                            animation.AnimationId = tostring(mapping.animationId)
                            animation.Parent = folder
                        end
                        installed += 1
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end

                QH_AnimState.ActiveMappings = mappings
                QH_AnimState.PersistedMode = "Animation"
                QH_AnimState.PersistedName = QH_AnimState.SelectedName
                QH_AnimState.PersistedData = bundleData

                -- Do not toggle Animate here. Rebuilding its controller during
                -- a bundle switch is a major frame-time spike in Roblox.
                qhStopAllAnimationTracks(humanoid)

                if installed == 0 then
                    qhNotify("Animation", "No matching Animate categories found", "x")
                    return
                end

                qhNotify(
                    "Animation",
                    "Applied " .. tostring(installed) .. " categories",
                    "check"
                )
            end, debug.traceback)

            if not ok then
                warn("[QuantomHub Animation] apply recovered: " .. tostring(err))
            end
            qhAnimationApplyBusy = false
        end)

        return true
    end

    local function qhPlaySelected()
        local data = QH_AnimState.SelectedData

        if not data then
            qhNotify("Animation", "Select an item first", "x")
            return
        end

        if QH_AnimState.Mode == "Emote" then
            local animationId = qhResolveEmoteAnimationId(data.id)
            if animationId then
                qhPlayAnimationId(animationId, data.name)
            end
            return
        end

        -- Animation bundles are full movement packs. Do not play only the
        -- first mapping (which is normally Idle); apply every category so
        -- Roblox can use Walk/Run/Jump/Fall/etc. automatically.
        qhApplyAnimationBundle(data)
    end

    local function qhBuildNames(list)
        local names = {}

        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            table.insert(names, tostring(item.name))
        end

        table.sort(names, function(a, b)
            return a:lower() < b:lower()
        end)

        return names
    end

    local function qhFindByName(list, name)
        if not name then
            return nil
        end

        for _, item in ipairs(list) do
            if tostring(item.name) == tostring(name) then
                return item
            end
        end

        return nil
    end

    local function qhRefreshItemDropdown()
        local list

        if QH_AnimState.Mode == "Emote" then
            list = QH_AnimState.Emotes
        else
            list = QH_AnimState.Animations
        end

        local names = qhBuildNames(list)

        if #names == 0 then
            names = {"Loading..."}
        end

        local dropdown = QH_AnimState.EmoteDropdown

        if QH_AnimState.Mode == "Animation" then
            dropdown = QH_AnimState.AnimationDropdown
        end

        if dropdown then
            local ok = pcall(function()
                dropdown:SetValues(names)
            end)

            if not ok then
                pcall(function()
                    dropdown.Values = names
                end)
            end
        end

        if QH_AnimState.StatusLabel then
            pcall(function()
                QH_AnimState.StatusLabel:SetText(
                    tostring(#list) .. " " .. string.lower(QH_AnimState.Mode) .. "s loaded"
                )
            end)
        end
    end

    QH_AnimState.ModeDropdown = SourceBox:AddDropdown("QH_AnimationMode", {
        Text = "Type",
        Values = {"Emote", "Animation"},
        Default = "Emote",
        AllowNull = false,
        Callback = function(value)
            QH_AnimState.Mode = tostring(value)

            if QH_AnimState.Mode == "Emote" then
                QH_AnimState.SelectedData = nil
                QH_AnimState.SelectedName = nil
                qhRefreshItemDropdown()
            else
                QH_AnimState.SelectedData = nil
                QH_AnimState.SelectedName = nil
                qhRefreshItemDropdown()
            end
        end,
    })

    QH_AnimState.EmoteDropdown = SourceBox:AddDropdown("QH_EmoteSelect", {
        Text = "Emote",
        Values = {"Loading..."},
        Default = "Loading...",
        AllowNull = false,
        Callback = function(value)
            if QH_AnimState.Mode ~= "Emote" then
                return
            end

            QH_AnimState.SelectedName = tostring(value)
            QH_AnimState.SelectedData =
                qhFindByName(QH_AnimState.Emotes, QH_AnimState.SelectedName)
        end,
    })

    QH_AnimState.AnimationDropdown = SourceBox:AddDropdown("QH_AnimationSelect", {
        Text = "Animation / Bundle",
        Values = {"Loading..."},
        Default = "Loading...",
        AllowNull = false,
        Callback = function(value)
            if QH_AnimState.Mode ~= "Animation" then
                return
            end

            QH_AnimState.SelectedName = tostring(value)
            QH_AnimState.SelectedData =
                qhFindByName(QH_AnimState.Animations, QH_AnimState.SelectedName)
        end,
    })

    SourceBox:AddInput("QH_AnimationSearch", {
        Text = "Search",
        Default = "",
        PlaceholderText = "Name...",
        Finished = false,
        Callback = function(value)
            QH_AnimState.Search = tostring(value or ""):lower()

            local source = QH_AnimState.Mode == "Emote"
                and QH_AnimState.Emotes
                or QH_AnimState.Animations

            local filtered = {}

            for _, item in ipairs(source) do
                if QH_AnimState.Search == ""
                    or tostring(item.name):lower():find(QH_AnimState.Search, 1, true)
                then
                    table.insert(filtered, item)
                end
            end

            local names = qhBuildNames(filtered)
            if #names == 0 then
                names = {"No results"}
            end

            local dropdown = QH_AnimState.Mode == "Emote"
                and QH_AnimState.EmoteDropdown
                or QH_AnimState.AnimationDropdown

            if dropdown then
                pcall(function()
                    dropdown:SetValues(names)
                end)
            end
        end,
    })

    QH_AnimState.StatusLabel = SourceBox:AddLabel("Loading source...")

    ControlBox:AddButton({
        Text = "Play Selected",
        Func = qhPlaySelected,
    })

    ControlBox:AddButton({
        Text = "Apply Animation Set",
        Func = function()
            if QH_AnimState.Mode ~= "Animation" then
                qhNotify("Animation", "Select Animation mode first", "x")
                return
            end

            if not QH_AnimState.SelectedData then
                qhNotify("Animation", "Select an animation bundle first", "x")
                return
            end

            qhApplyAnimationBundle(QH_AnimState.SelectedData)
        end,
    })

    ControlBox:AddButton({
        Text = "Stop Animation",
        Func = qhStopTrack,
    })

    ControlBox:AddLabel("Source: 7yd7 Animation / Emote lists")
    ControlBox:AddLabel("Emote = Roblox emote animation")
    ControlBox:AddLabel("Animation = bundle animation")

    local function qhLoadSource()
        QH_AnimState.Loading = true

        task.spawn(function()
            local okEmotes, emoteResult = pcall(function()
                local raw = game:HttpGet(
                    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7yd7/sniper-Emote/refs/heads/test/EmoteSniper.json"
                )
                local decoded = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
                return decoded.data or {}
            end)

            if okEmotes and type(emoteResult) == "table" then
                for _, item in ipairs(emoteResult) do
                    local id = tonumber(item.id)
                    if id and id > 0 then
                        table.insert(QH_AnimState.Emotes, {
                            id = id,
                            name = tostring(item.name or ("Emote_" .. id)),
                        })
                    end
                end
            end

            local function loadAnimationUrl(url)
                local ok, result = pcall(function()
                    local raw = game:HttpGet(url)
                    local decoded = HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
                    return decoded.data or {}
                end)

                return ok and type(result) == "table" and result or {}
            end

            local seen = {}

            local normal = loadAnimationUrl(
                "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7yd7/sniper-Emote/refs/heads/test/AnimationSniper.json"
            )

            for _, item in ipairs(normal) do
                local id = tonumber(item.id)
                if id and id > 0 and not seen[id] then
                    seen[id] = true
                    table.insert(QH_AnimState.Animations, {
                        id = id,
                        name = tostring(item.name or ("Animation_" .. id)),
                        bundledItems = item.bundledItems,
                    })
                end
            end

            local offsale = loadAnimationUrl(
                "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/7yd7/sniper-Emote/refs/heads/test/AnimationSniperoffsale.json"
            )

            for _, item in ipairs(offsale) do
                local id = tonumber(item.id)
                if id and id > 0 and not seen[id] then
                    seen[id] = true
                    table.insert(QH_AnimState.Animations, {
                        id = id,
                        name = tostring(item.name or ("Animation_Offsale_" .. id)),
                        bundledItems = item.bundledItems,
                    })
                end
            end

            table.sort(QH_AnimState.Emotes, function(a, b)
                return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
            end)

            table.sort(QH_AnimState.Animations, function(a, b)
                return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower()
            end)

            QH_AnimState.Loading = false
            qhRefreshItemDropdown()

            pcall(function()
                QH_AnimState.StatusLabel:SetText(
                    tostring(#QH_AnimState.Emotes) .. " emotes / "
                    .. tostring(#QH_AnimState.Animations) .. " animations loaded"
                )
            end)

            qhNotify(
                "Animation",
                tostring(#QH_AnimState.Emotes) .. " emotes and "
                    .. tostring(#QH_AnimState.Animations) .. " animations loaded",
                "check"
            )
        end)
    end

    local function qhResetAnimationPack()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local animate = character and character:FindFirstChild("Animate")

        if humanoid then
            qhStopAllAnimationTracks(humanoid)
        end

        if animate and QH_AnimateBackup and QH_AnimateCharacter == character then
            pcall(function()
                animate.Disabled = true
                qhRestoreAnimate(animate)
                animate.Disabled = false
            end)

            -- Force Roblox Animate to rebuild its movement state after the
            -- round transition/reset.
            task.defer(function()
                if animate and animate.Parent then
                    pcall(function()
                        animate.Disabled = true
                        task.wait()
                        animate.Disabled = false
                    end)
                end

                local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then
                    qhStopAllAnimationTracks(hum)
                end
            end)
        end

        QH_AnimState.ActiveMappings = nil
        QH_AnimState.SelectedData = nil
        QH_AnimState.SelectedName = nil
        QH_AnimateBackup = nil
        QH_AnimateCharacter = nil
        QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack = nil
    end

    _G.__QH_RESET_ANIMATION_PACK = qhResetAnimationPack

    -- CharacterRemoving captures the selected emote/animation before Roblox
    -- destroys the old character. The selection is reapplied to the next one.
    LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(character)
        QH_BeginRoundTransition()
        if QH_AnimState.SelectedData then
            QH_AnimState.PersistedMode = QH_AnimState.Mode
            QH_AnimState.PersistedName = QH_AnimState.SelectedName
            QH_AnimState.PersistedData = QH_AnimState.SelectedData
        end
        pcall(function()
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then qhStopAllAnimationTracks(humanoid) end
        end)
        QH_AnimateBackup = nil
        QH_AnimateCharacter = nil
        QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack = nil
        QH_AnimState.ActiveMappings = nil
    end)

    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        QH_EndRoundTransition()
        pcall(function()
            if QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack then
                QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack:Stop(0)
                QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack:Destroy()
            end
        end)

        QH_AnimateBackup = nil
        QH_AnimateCharacter = nil
        QH_AnimState.CurrentTrack = nil
        QH_AnimState.ActiveMappings = nil
        QH_AnimState.SelectedData = QH_AnimState.PersistedData
        QH_AnimState.SelectedName = QH_AnimState.PersistedName
        if QH_AnimState.PersistedMode then
            QH_AnimState.Mode = QH_AnimState.PersistedMode
        end

        task.defer(function()
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if humanoid then
                pcall(function()
                    humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
                        QH_BeginRoundTransition()
                    end)
                end)
            end
            task.wait(1.0)
            if QH_AnimState.PersistedData then
                if QH_AnimState.PersistedMode == "Animation" then
                    pcall(qhApplyAnimationBundle, QH_AnimState.PersistedData)
                elseif QH_AnimState.PersistedMode == "Emote" and QH_AnimState.PersistedData.id then
                    pcall(qhPlayAnimationId, QH_AnimState.PersistedData.id, QH_AnimState.PersistedData.name)
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    task.spawn(qhLoadSource)
end

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    -- Roblox may replace the Character after a reset. The new real character
    -- becomes the hidden movement character, while the selected model is
    -- recreated as the visible replacement.
    local savedName = S._memeMorphName
    local savedAsset = S._memeMorphAssetId

    if savedName and savedAsset then
        task.delay(0.65, function()
            if LocalPlayer.Character == newCharacter then
                pcall(QH_LoadMemeMorph, savedName, savedAsset)
            end
        end)
    end
end)

    Title="Disable Models",
    Icon="x",
    Color=S.C.Red or Color3.fromRGB(255,80,80),
    Justify="Center",
    Callback=function()
        if QH_MemeMorphFolder or QH_MemeOriginalCharacter then
            QH_DestroyMemeMorph(false)
            U.notify("Models", "Original character restored", "check", 3)
        else
            U.notify("Models", "No active model", "x", 3)
        end
    end
})

-- SETTINGS
-- Native Obsidian settings page: configs/themes are shown directly in this tab.
-- No secondary "Open Settings" button/window is used.
do
    local settingsTab = Sect:Tab({Title="Settings", Icon="settings"})
    local page = settingsTab._page

    -- Obsidian's own Menu/Config/Theme UI lives directly on this tab.
    pcall(function()
        local menu = page:AddLeftGroupbox("Menu", "wrench")

        menu:AddToggle("QH_AutoShowUI", {
            Text = "Auto Show UI",
            Default = true,
        })

        menu:AddToggle("QH_ShowCustomCursor", {
            Text = "Custom Cursor",
            Default = ObsidianLibrary.ShowCustomCursor == true,
            Callback = function(value)
                ObsidianLibrary.ShowCustomCursor = value == true
            end,
        })

        menu:AddDropdown("QH_NotificationSide", {
            Values = {"Left", "Right"},
            Default = "Right",
            Text = "Notification Side",
            Callback = function(value)
                pcall(function() ObsidianLibrary:SetNotifySide(value) end)
            end,
        })
    end)

    -- Reliable QuantomHub hybrid config/theme UI.
    do
        local cfg = page:AddLeftGroupbox("Configuration", "folder-cog")
        local themeBox = page:AddRightGroupbox("Themes", "palette")
        ConfigSystem.nativeSaveManager = ObsidianSaveManager

        local configInput = cfg:AddInput("QH_ConfigName", {
            Text = "Config name",
            Default = S.activeConfig or "default",
        })
        local configList = cfg:AddDropdown("QH_ConfigList", {
            Text = "Saved configs",
            Values = ConfigSystem.list(),
            AllowNull = true,
            Multi = false,
        })
        local function refreshConfigList()
            pcall(function() configList:SetValues(ConfigSystem.list()) end)
            local auto=ConfigSystem.getAutoload()
            if auto then pcall(function() configList:SetValue(auto) end) end
        end
        local function notifyCfg(text,ok)
            U.notify("Configs",text,ok and "check" or "x",3)
        end

        cfg:AddButton({Text="Save config",Func=function()
            local name=tostring(configInput.Value or "default")
            local ok,err=ConfigSystem.saveCombined(name)
            notifyCfg(ok and ("Saved ALL: "..name) or ("Save failed: "..tostring(err)),ok)
            refreshConfigList()
        end})
        cfg:AddButton({Text="Load config",Func=function()
            local name=tostring(configList.Value or configInput.Value or "default")
            local ok,err=ConfigSystem.loadCombined(name)
            notifyCfg(ok and ("Loaded ALL: "..name) or ("Load failed: "..tostring(err)),ok)
        end})
        cfg:AddButton({Text="Overwrite config",Func=function()
            local name=tostring(configList.Value or configInput.Value or "default")
            local ok,err=ConfigSystem.saveCombined(name)
            notifyCfg(ok and ("Overwritten ALL: "..name) or ("Overwrite failed: "..tostring(err)),ok)
            refreshConfigList()
        end})
        cfg:AddButton({Text="Delete config",Func=function()
            local name=tostring(configList.Value or configInput.Value or "")
            if name=="" then return end
            local ok=ConfigSystem.delete(name)
            notifyCfg(ok and ("Deleted: "..name) or "Delete failed",ok)
            refreshConfigList()
        end})
        cfg:AddButton({Text="Set autoload",Func=function()
            local name=tostring(configList.Value or configInput.Value or "default")
            local ok,err=ConfigSystem.setAutoload(name)
            notifyCfg(ok and ("Autoload: "..name) or ("Autoload failed: "..tostring(err)),ok)
        end})
        cfg:AddButton({Text="Clear autoload",Func=function()
            local ok=ConfigSystem.clearAutoload()
            notifyCfg(ok and "Autoload cleared" or "Clear autoload failed",ok)
        end})
        cfg:AddButton({Text="Refresh",Func=refreshConfigList})
        cfg:AddLabel("Hybrid: ALL UI controls + runtime state",true)
        cfg:AddLabel("Path: "..ConfigSystem.folder,true)

        local hudThemes={"Neon","Emerald","Ocean","Rose","Gold","Mono"}
        themeBox:AddDropdown("QH_HudTheme",{
            Text="HUD / Watermark theme", Values=hudThemes, Default=S.hudTheme or "Neon",
            Callback=function(v)
                S.hudTheme=tostring(v or "Neon")
                pcall(function() if HUD and HUD.applyTheme then HUD.applyTheme(S.hudTheme) end end)
                pcall(function() if HUD and HUD.applyAccent then HUD.applyAccent(S.hudAccentMode or "Auto") end end)
            end,
        })
        themeBox:AddDropdown("QH_HudAccent",{
            Text="Accent", Values={"Auto","Neutral","Green","Blue","Purple"}, Default=S.hudAccentMode or "Auto",
            Callback=function(v)
                S.hudAccentMode=tostring(v or "Auto")
                pcall(function() if HUD and HUD.applyAccent then HUD.applyAccent(S.hudAccentMode) end end)
            end,
        })
        refreshConfigList()
    end
end

    enabled = true,

    animated = false,
    fps = 0,
