-- ============================================================
--  VISUAL QUALITY CONTROLLER
-- ============================================================
local QH_VisualQualityPresets = {
    Low = {
        effectScale = 0.50,
        neonNodes = 4,
        hudInterval = 0.55,
        particles = false,
    },
    Medium = {
        effectScale = 0.75,
        neonNodes = 6,
        hudInterval = 0.35,
        particles = true,
    },
    High = {
        effectScale = 1.00,
        neonNodes = 8,
        hudInterval = 0.25,
        particles = true,
    },
}

local function QH_ApplyVisualQuality(name)
    name = tostring(name or "High")
    local q = QH_VisualQualityPresets[name] or QH_VisualQualityPresets.High
    if not QH_VisualQualityPresets[name] then name = "High" end

    S.visualQuality = name
    S._visualQuality = q

    if HUD then
        pcall(function()
            HUD.setQuality(name)
        end)
    end

    -- Respect the user's particle toggle, but let Low quality suppress particles.
    if VisualFX and VisualFX.setParticles then
        pcall(function()
            VisualFX.setParticles(S.angelAuraParticles == true and (q.particles or S.characterFpsBoostEnabled))
        end)
    end

    -- Rebuild dynamic visual systems so the new node budget takes effect immediately.
    if S.neonAuraEnabled and type(NeonAuraToggle)=="function" then
        pcall(function()
            NeonAuraToggle(false)
            task.defer(function()
                if S.neonAuraEnabled then NeonAuraToggle(true) end
            end)
        end)
    end

    if AuraFX and AuraFX.refresh then
        pcall(AuraFX.refresh)
    end
end

-- Apply persisted visual quality before Settings callbacks are used.
pcall(function()
    QH_ApplyVisualQuality(S.visualQuality or "High")
end)

task.spawn(function() while true do task.wait(math.max(10,S.configAutoSaveInterval)); if S.configAutoSave and not ConfigSystem.busy then pcall(function() ConfigSystem.saveCombined(S.activeConfig or "default") end) end end end)

-- ============================================================
--  ESP LOOP
-- ============================================================
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        pcall(function()
            if S.espEnabled then
                -- Refresh replicated MM2 role data even while the round is not active.
                Roles.refreshData(false)
                local m    = Roles.getMurderer()
                local s    = Roles.getSheriff()
                local lHrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                for _, pl in ipairs(QH_Players()) do
                    if pl ~= LocalPlayer and pl.Character then
                        local hum  = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                        local head = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                            local hl = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("RoleHighlight")
                            if hl then hl:Destroy() end
                            if head and head:FindFirstChild("RoleESP") then head.RoleESP:Destroy() end
                        else
                            local role = Roles.getRole(pl) or "Innocent"
                            -- Explicit role-data wins over tool detection.
                            if pl == m then role = "Murderer" elseif pl == s then role = "Sheriff" end
                            local show = false
                            if S.espMode == "All" then show = true
                            elseif S.espMode == "Sheriff" then show = (role == "Sheriff")
                            elseif S.espMode == "Murder"  then show = (role == "Murderer")
                            elseif S.espMode == "Both"    then show = (role == "Sheriff" or role == "Murderer") end
                            -- If a non-Sheriff player has picked up the dropped sheriff gun,
                            -- immediately mark that player with the dedicated yellow ESP color.
                            -- The check is intentionally local and cheap: Character/Backpack only.
                            -- The dropped sheriff gun itself remains cyan; only its carrier becomes gold.
                            local backpack = pl:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                            local hasGun = (pl.Character:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil)
                                or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") ~= nil)
                            local gunCarrier = hasGun and role ~= "Sheriff"

                            local col
                            if gunCarrier then
                                col = S.C.Gold or Color3.fromRGB(255,215,0)
                            else
                                col = role == "Murderer" and S.C.Blood or (role == "Sheriff" and S.C.RoyalBlue or S.C.Innocent)
                            end

                            -- Keep the normal ESP mode semantics, but let the player
                            -- carrying the dropped gun remain visible in All/Both.
                            if gunCarrier and (S.espMode == "All" or S.espMode == "Both") then
                                show = true
                            end

                            if show then
                                local hl = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("RoleHighlight")
                                if not hl then
                                    hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                                    hl.Name = "RoleHighlight"
                                    hl.FillTransparency = 0.28
                                    hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.05
                                    hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                                    hl.Adornee = pl.Character
                                    hl.Parent  = pl.Character
                                end
                                hl.FillColor = col
                                if S.espShowNames and head then
                                    local esp = head:FindFirstChild("RoleESP")
                                    if not esp then
                                        esp = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                                        esp.Name = "RoleESP"
                                        esp.Size = UDim2.new(0,220,0,56)
                                        esp.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3.8,0)
                                        esp.MaxDistance = 1000
                                        esp.AlwaysOnTop = true
                                        esp.LightInfluence = 0
                                        esp.Parent = head
                                        local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                                        tl.Name = "Text"
                                        tl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                                        tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                                        tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                                        tl.TextSize = 15
                                        tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                                        tl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
                                        tl.TextWrapped = false
                                        tl.Parent = esp
                                    end
                                    local dist = "?"
                                    if S.espShowDistance and lHrp then
                                        local er = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                        if er then dist = tostring(math.floor((lHrp.Position - er.Position).Magnitude)) end
                                    end
                                    local espRoleText = gunCarrier and "[GUN]" or "["..role.."]"
                                    esp.Text.Text = pl.Name.."\n"..espRoleText..(S.espShowDistance and " ["..dist.." studs]" or "")
                                    esp.Text.TextColor3 = col
                                elseif head and head:FindFirstChild("RoleESP") then
                                    head.RoleESP:Destroy()
                                end
                            else
                                local hl = pl.Character:FindFirstChild("RoleHighlight")
                                if hl then hl:Destroy() end
                                if head and head:FindFirstChild("RoleESP") then head.RoleESP:Destroy() end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if S.gunEspEnabled then
                for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if desc.Name == "GunDrop" and desc:IsA("BasePart") and not desc:FindFirstChild("GunHighlight") then
                        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        hl.Name = "GunHighlight"
                        hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,255)
                        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                        hl.FillTransparency = 0.4
                        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
                        hl.Adornee = desc hl.Parent = desc
                        local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                        bg.Name = "GunLabel" bg.Adornee = desc
                        bg.Size = UDim2.new(0,120,0,40)
                        bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2,0)
                        bg.AlwaysOnTop = true bg.Parent = desc
                        local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bg)
                        tl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
                        tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        tl.Text = "GUN"
                        tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,255)
                        tl.TextSize = 14 tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                        tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        task.wait(S._QHPerf and S._QHPerf.wait(S.visualQuality=="Low" and 1.5 or (S.visualQuality=="Medium" and .9 or .6)) or (S.visualQuality=="Low" and 1.5 or (S.visualQuality=="Medium" and .9 or .6)))
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
--  CLICK / TOUCH FLING + TARGET HIGHLIGHT
-- ============================================================
do
    local UIS = UserInputService
    local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
    local hoverHighlight, hoverPlayer, hoverCharacter
    local lastTouchFlingAt = 0

    local function playerFromTarget(target)
        if not target then return nil end
        local model = target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if not model then return nil end
        local pl = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
        if pl == LocalPlayer then return nil end
        return pl
    end

    local function clearHover()
        if hoverHighlight then
            pcall(function() hoverHighlight:Destroy() end)
        end
        hoverHighlight, hoverPlayer, hoverCharacter = nil, nil, nil
    end

    local function setHoverPlayer(pl)
        if not S.clickFlingEnabled or not pl or pl == LocalPlayer or not pl.Character then
            clearHover()
            return
        end
        if hoverPlayer == pl and hoverCharacter == pl.Character and hoverHighlight and hoverHighlight.Parent then
            return
        end
        clearHover()
        hoverPlayer, hoverCharacter = pl, pl.Character
        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "QH_ClickFling_Target"
        hl.Adornee = pl.Character
        hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,45,45)
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,90,90)
        hl.FillTransparency = 0.72
        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.05
        hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
        hl.Parent = pl.Character
        hoverHighlight = hl
    end

    local function targetAtScreenPosition(pos)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera or not pos then return nil end
        local ray = camera:ViewportPointToRay(pos.X, pos.Y)
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character}
        local hit = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 2000, params)
        return hit and playerFromTarget(hit.Instance) or nil
    end

    local function flingTarget(pl)
        if not pl or pl == LocalPlayer or not pl.Character then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function() Fling.execute(pl) end)
        end)
    end

    -- Use the current mouse position + a camera ray instead of mouse.Target.
    -- This is more reliable in executors where Mouse.Button1Down/Target can
    -- be swallowed or remain stale while a UI is open.
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not S.clickFlingEnabled then return end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            setHoverPlayer(targetAtScreenPosition(UIS:GetMouseLocation()))
        end
    end)

    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if processed then return end
        if not S.clickFlingEnabled then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
        local pl = targetAtScreenPosition(UIS:GetMouseLocation())
        if pl then flingTarget(pl) end
    end)

    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if processed or not S.touchFlingEnabled then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local now = tick()
        if now - lastTouchFlingAt < 0.15 then return end
        lastTouchFlingAt = now
        local pl = targetAtScreenPosition(input.Position)
        if pl then flingTarget(pl) end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while game:IsDescendantOf(game) do
            task.wait(0.08)
            if not S.clickFlingEnabled then
                if hoverHighlight then clearHover() end
            elseif hoverPlayer then
                if hoverPlayer.Parent ~= Players or hoverPlayer.Character ~= hoverCharacter or not hoverCharacter.Parent then
                    clearHover()
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
--  INPUT
-- ============================================================
-- ============================================================
--  ROBUST KEYBOARD INPUT
-- ============================================================
do
    local function normalizeKey(value, fallback)
        if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" and value.EnumType == Enum.KeyCode then
            return value
        end

        if type(value) == "string" then
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                return Enum.KeyCode[value]
            end)
            if ok and result then
                return result
            end
        end

        return fallback
    end

    local function isKeyboardInput(input)
        return input
            and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
            and input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
    end

    local function textBoxFocused()
        local focused = UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
        return focused ~= nil
    end

    local function fireShoot()
        if S.shootKeyBusy then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            Combat.shootMurderer()
        end)
    end

    local function fireFling()
        if S.flingKeyBusy then return end

        S.flingKeyBusy = true
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                Fling.murderer()
            end)
            S.flingKeyBusy = false
        end)
    end

    -- Keep the values normalized even if the custom UI gives the callback a string.
    S.Keybinds.ShootMurder = normalizeKey(
        S.Keybinds.ShootMurder,
        Enum.KeyCode.F
    )

    S.Keybinds.FlingMurderer = normalizeKey(
        S.Keybinds.FlingMurderer,
        Enum.KeyCode.H
    )

    S.Keybinds.WallHop = normalizeKey(
        S.Keybinds.WallHop,
        Enum.KeyCode.V
    )
    S.Keybinds.Invincible = normalizeKey(
        S.Keybinds.Invincible,
        Enum.KeyCode.I
    )

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if not isKeyboardInput(input) then return end

        -- GameProcessed is true for UI/chat.  The important exception is a
        -- non-text UI event: if no text box is focused, allow the configured
        -- combat hotkeys to work even when the overlay consumed the input.
        if gameProcessed and textBoxFocused() then
            return
        end

        local key = input.KeyCode

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.BombJump, Enum.KeyCode.B) then
            if S.bombJumpEnabled then
                task.spawn(Jumps.bomb)
            end
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.goldJumpKeybind, Enum.KeyCode.N) then
            if S.goldJumpEnabled then
                task.spawn(Jumps.gold)
            end
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.FlingMurderer, Enum.KeyCode.H) then
            fireFling()
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.GrabGun, Enum.KeyCode.J) then
            task.spawn(Grab.gun)
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.ShootMurder, Enum.KeyCode.F) then
            fireShoot()
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.KillAll, Enum.KeyCode.K) then
            Kill.toggle()
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.Emote, Enum.KeyCode.Y) then
            Misc.emote(S.selectedEmote)
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.WallHop, Enum.KeyCode.V) then
            if getgenv().__QHWallHopToggle then
                getgenv().__QHWallHopToggle()
            end
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.Invincible, Enum.KeyCode.I) then
            Move.godMode(not S.godModeEnabled)
            if getgenv().__QHInvincibleMobileRefresh then
                pcall(getgenv().__QHInvincibleMobileRefresh)
            end
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.Invisible or S.invisibleKeybind, Enum.KeyCode.O) then
            Move.invisible(not S.invisibleEnabled)
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.TeleportMurderer, Enum.KeyCode.L) then
            local m = Roles.getMurderer()
            if m and m.Character then
                local h = m.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local mh = LocalPlayer.Character
                    and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if h and mh then
                    mh.CFrame = h.CFrame
                end
            end
            return
        end

        if key == normalizeKey(S.Keybinds.TeleportSheriff, Enum.KeyCode.P) then
            local s = Roles.getSheriff()
            if s and s.Character then
                local h = s.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local mh = LocalPlayer.Character
                    and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if h and mh then
                    mh.CFrame = h.CFrame
                end
            end
            return
        end
    end)

    -- Rebind-safe watchers.  These do not execute the action themselves;
    -- they only keep the stored values valid after a UI keybind change.
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            S.Keybinds.ShootMurder = normalizeKey(
                S.Keybinds.ShootMurder,
                Enum.KeyCode.F
            )

            S.Keybinds.FlingMurderer = normalizeKey(
                S.Keybinds.FlingMurderer,
                Enum.KeyCode.H
            )

            S.Keybinds.WallHop = normalizeKey(
                S.Keybinds.WallHop,
                Enum.KeyCode.V
            )
            S.Keybinds.Invincible = normalizeKey(
                S.Keybinds.Invincible,
                Enum.KeyCode.I
            )
            S.Keybinds.Invisible = normalizeKey(
                S.Keybinds.Invisible or S.invisibleKeybind,
                Enum.KeyCode.O
            )
            S.invisibleKeybind = S.Keybinds.Invisible

            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- ============================================================

Crosshair = {}
do
    local displayGui = nil
    local displayImage = nil
    local spinConn = nil
    local renderConn = nil
    local playerInputConn = nil

    local CURSORS = {
        {name="Neon Cyan",       id="11770890197"},
        {name="Electric Purple", id="11770691141"},
        {name="Precision Dot",   id="10878218308"},
        {name="Aim Cross",       id="10891594349"},
        {name="Blue Spec",       id="11720475063"},
        {name="Circle Dot",      id="10831379335"},
        {name="Green Hit",       id="8375241602"},
    }

    local function isLocked()
        local uis = UserInputService
        return uis and uis.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
    end

    local function mousePosition()
        local ok, pos = pcall(function() return UserInputService:GetMouseLocation() end)
        if ok and pos then return pos end
        return Vector2.new(0, 0)
    end

    local function currentId()
        local wanted = tostring(S.crosshairId or "")
        for _, item in ipairs(CURSORS) do
            if item.id == wanted then
                return item.id
            end
        end
        return wanted ~= "" and wanted or CURSORS[1].id
    end

    local function stopSpin()
        if spinConn then
            pcall(function() spinConn:Disconnect() end)
            spinConn = nil
        end
        if displayImage then
            displayImage.Rotation = 0
        end
    end

    local function startSpin()
        stopSpin()
        if not S.crosshairSpin or not displayImage then
            return
        end
        spinConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if displayImage and displayImage.Parent and displayImage.Visible then
                displayImage.Rotation = displayImage.Rotation + math.max(0.5,(tonumber(S.xArchiveSpinSpeed) or 150)/37.5)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function ensureDisplay()
        if displayGui and displayGui.Parent and displayImage and displayImage.Parent then
            return
        end
        displayGui = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RuzCrosshairDisplay")
        if displayGui then
            local existing = displayGui:FindFirstChild("CrosshairImage")
            if existing and existing:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                displayImage = existing
            end
        end
        if not displayGui then
            displayGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            displayGui.Name = "RuzCrosshairDisplay"
            displayGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            displayGui.DisplayOrder = 25
            displayGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            displayGui.Parent = CoreGui
        end
        if not displayImage or not displayImage.Parent then
            displayImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            displayImage.Name = "CrosshairImage"
            displayImage.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
            displayImage.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0)
            displayImage.Size = UDim2.new(0,42,0,42)
            displayImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            displayImage.ZIndex = 10
            displayImage.Parent = displayGui
        end
        displayImage.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. currentId()
    end

    local function hideGameCrosshair()
        pcall(function()
            local pg = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
            local top = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("GameTopbar")
            local cross = top and top:FindFirstChild("Crosshair")
            if cross then cross.Visible = false end
        end)
    end

    function Crosshair.refresh()
        if not S.customCrosshairEnabled then
            stopSpin()
            if renderConn then
                pcall(function() renderConn:Disconnect() end)
                renderConn = nil
            end
            if playerInputConn then
                pcall(function() playerInputConn:Disconnect() end)
                playerInputConn = nil
            end
            if displayGui then
                pcall(function() displayGui:Destroy() end)
            end
            displayGui = nil
            displayImage = nil
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            return
        end

        ensureDisplay()
        hideGameCrosshair()

        if displayImage then
            displayImage.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. currentId()
            displayImage.Rotation = 0
        end
        startSpin()

        if renderConn then
            pcall(function() renderConn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        renderConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not S.customCrosshairEnabled then return end
            if not displayImage or not displayImage.Parent then return end
            hideGameCrosshair()
            local pos = mousePosition()
            displayImage.Visible = true
            displayImage.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X, pos.Y)
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
            if displayImage.Image == "" then
                displayImage.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. currentId()
            end
        end)

        if playerInputConn then
            pcall(function() playerInputConn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        playerInputConn = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not S.customCrosshairEnabled then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                task.defer(function()
                    if S.customCrosshairEnabled and displayImage then
                        displayImage.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. currentId()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end

    function Crosshair.setEnabled(v)
        S.customCrosshairEnabled = v == true
        Crosshair.refresh()
    end

    function Crosshair.setStyle(v)
        -- Backward-compatible API for old configs/callbacks.
        local value = tostring(v or "")
        for _, item in ipairs(CURSORS) do
            if item.name == value then
                S.crosshairId = item.id
                Crosshair.refresh()
                return
            end
        end
    end

    function Crosshair.openPicker()
        local existing = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RuzCursorPicker")
        if existing then
            existing:Destroy()
            return
        end

        local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        ScreenGui.Name = "RuzCursorPicker"
        ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 60
        ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui

        local Frame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
        Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0,300,0,460)
        Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-150,0.04,0)
        Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10,10,10)
        Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.06
        Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", Frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,12)

        local UIStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", Frame)
        UIStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220,38,38)
        UIStroke.Thickness = 1.5

        local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", Frame)
        title.Size = UDim2.new(1,-44,0,38)
        title.Position = UDim2.new(0,12,0,0)
        title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        title.Text = "QuantomHub V3  —  Cursor Picker"
        title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        title.TextSize = 14
        title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        title.Active = true

        -- Draggable header (mouse + touch)
        local dragging = false
        local dragStart = nil
        local startPos = nil
        local dragConnection = nil

        local function beginDrag(input)
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = Frame.Position
        end

        title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                beginDrag(input)
            end
        end)

        title.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)

        dragConnection = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging then
                return
            end

            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                Frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end)

        local close = Instance.new("TextButton", Frame)
        close.Size = UDim2.new(0,28,0,28)
        close.Position = UDim2.new(1,-34,0,5)
        close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180,30,30)
        close.Text = "X"
        close.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        close.TextSize = 13
        Instance.new("UICorner", close).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)
        close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            dragging = false
            if dragConnection then
                dragConnection:Disconnect()
                dragConnection = nil
            end
            ScreenGui:Destroy()
        end)

        local inputBox = Instance.new("TextBox", Frame)
        inputBox.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,34)
        inputBox.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,44)
        inputBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,25)
        inputBox.Text = ""
        inputBox.PlaceholderText = "Enter custom Cursor ID, press Enter..."
        inputBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        inputBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120,120,120)
        inputBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        inputBox.TextSize = 13
        inputBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
        Instance.new("UICorner", inputBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,6)
        Instance.new("UIStroke", inputBox).Color = Color3.fromRGB(80,80,80)

        inputBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
            local text = tostring(inputBox.Text or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
            if enterPressed and text ~= "" and text:match("^%d+$") then
                S.crosshairId = text
                if displayImage and displayImage.Parent then
                    displayImage.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. text
                end
                U.notify("RuzHub", "Custom cursor applied — active on the main mouse and ShiftLock", "bell", 3)
                inputBox.Text = ""
            end
        end)

        local spinRow = Instance.new("Frame", Frame)
        spinRow.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,30)
        spinRow.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,84)
        spinRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1

        local spinLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", spinRow)
        spinLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1,-64,1,0)
        spinLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        spinLabel.Text = "Spin Crosshair"
        spinLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200)
        spinLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        spinLabel.TextSize = 13
        spinLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

        local spinButton = Instance.new("TextButton", spinRow)
        spinButton.Size = UDim2.new(0,54,0,26)
        spinButton.Position = UDim2.new(1,-54,0.5,-13)
        spinButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
        spinButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        spinButton.TextSize = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", spinButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,8)

        local function refreshSpinButton()
            spinButton.BackgroundColor3 = S.crosshairSpin and Color3.fromRGB(30,160,30) or Color3.fromRGB(80,20,20)
            spinButton.Text = S.crosshairSpin and "ON" or "OFF"
        end
        refreshSpinButton()

        spinButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            S.crosshairSpin = not S.crosshairSpin
            refreshSpinButton()
            Crosshair.refresh()
            U.notify("RuzHub", "Crosshair Spin: " .. (S.crosshairSpin and "ON" or "OFF"), "bell", 3)
        end)

        local divider = Instance.new("Frame", Frame)
        divider.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,1)
        divider.Position = UDim2.new(0,10,0,120)
        divider.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,60,60)
        divider.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", Frame)
        scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1,-14,1,-128)
        scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0,7,0,126)
        scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1

        pcall(function()
            camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
                0,0,0,
                1,0,0,

            )
        end)
    end

-- ============================================================
--  FARM RESPAWN GUARD
-- ============================================================
do
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        task.spawn(function()
            local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 8)
            local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 8)

            if hum and root then
                task.wait(0.25)

                -- The round can replace roundReturnPos during a transition.
                -- Only update it if the round is currently active.
                if S.roundActive and not S.farmResetPending then
                    S.roundReturnPos = root.CFrame
                end
            end

            -- AutoFarm V3 keeps its worker alive across respawns.
            -- Reset is considered complete once the new character exists.
            if S.farmResetPending then
                S.farmResetPending = false
            end
        end)
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
--  EMOTE / ANIMATION PERSISTENCE
-- ============================================================
local QH_AnimPersistence = {
    enabled = true,
    animationId = nil,
    speed = 1,
    looped = true,
    active = false,
    generation = 0,
}

local function QH_NormalizeAnimationId(id)
    local s=tostring(id or "")
    return s:match("(%d+)") or ""
end

local function QH_SaveCurrentActionAnimation(track)
    if not track or not track:IsA("AnimationTrack") then return end
    if track.Priority.Value < Enum.AnimationPriority.Action.Value then return end
    local anim = track.Animation
    local id = anim and QH_NormalizeAnimationId(anim.AnimationId)
    if id == "" then return end

    QH_AnimPersistence.animationId=id
    QH_AnimPersistence.speed=math.clamp(tonumber(track.Speed) or 1,0.05,4)
    QH_AnimPersistence.looped=track.Looped==true
    QH_AnimPersistence.active=track.IsPlaying==true
    QH_AnimPersistence.generation+=1
end

local function QH_ApplySavedActionAnimation()
    if not QH_AnimPersistence.enabled or not QH_AnimPersistence.active then return false end
    local id=QH_AnimPersistence.animationId
    if not id or id=="" then return false end

    local char=LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return false end
    local animator=hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then
        animator=Instance.new("Animator")
        animator.Parent=hum
    end

    -- Give the game's own character controller time to rebuild its default tracks.
    task.wait(.65)

    local anim=Instance.new("Animation")
    anim.AnimationId="rbxassetid://"..id

    local ok,track=pcall(function()
        return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
    end)
    if not ok or not track then
        anim:Destroy()
        return false
    end

    track.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    track.Looped=QH_AnimPersistence.looped
    track:Play(.12,1,QH_AnimPersistence.speed)

    task.delay(30,function()
        if anim and anim.Parent then
            anim:Destroy()
        end
    end)

    return true
end

_G.__QH_ANIM_PERSISTENCE = QH_AnimPersistence

local function QH_BindAnimationPersistence()
    local char=LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    local animator=hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum:WaitForChild("Animator",2)
    if not animator then return end

    pcall(function()
        animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
            task.defer(function()
                if track and track.Priority.Value >= Enum.AnimationPriority.Action.Value then
                    QH_SaveCurrentActionAnimation(track)
                end
            end)
        end)
    end)

    task.defer(function()
        local active=animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
        for _,track in ipairs(active) do
            if track.Priority.Value >= Enum.AnimationPriority.Action.Value and track.IsPlaying then
                QH_SaveCurrentActionAnimation(track)
            end
        end
    end)
end

QH_BindAnimationPersistence()
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    QH_BindAnimationPersistence()
    if QH_AnimPersistence.active then
        task.defer(function()
            QH_ApplySavedActionAnimation()
        end)
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1.5) do
        pcall(QH_StyleActionButtons)
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
--  FARM STATE SANITY LOOP
-- ============================================================
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        pcall(function()
            if not S.autoResetEnabled and S.farmResetPending then
                S.farmResetPending = false
                S.farmCycleBusy = false
            end

            if not (S.coinFarmEnabled or S.candyFarmEnabled) then
                if S.farmCycleBusy and not S.autoResetEnabled then
                    S.farmCycleBusy = false
                end
            end
        end)

        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
--  CONFIG -> UI STATE SYNC
-- ============================================================
_G.__QH_SYNC_CONFIG_UI = function()
    local wrapper = rawget(S.v2 or {}, "_currentWindow")
    local controls = wrapper and wrapper._controls
    if type(controls) ~= "table" then return end

    local function setControl(flag, value)
        local rec = controls[flag]
        local obj = rec and rec.object
        if not obj or type(obj.SetValue) ~= "function" or value == nil then return end
        pcall(function()
            if rec.type == "keybind" then
                if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
                    obj:SetValue({value.Name, "Toggle"})
                else
                    obj:SetValue({tostring(value), "Toggle"})
                end
            else
                obj:SetValue(value)
            end
        end)
    end

    local boolFlags = {
        HighlightESP="espEnabled",
        EspNames="espShowNames",
        EspDist="espShowDistance",
        CoinAutofarm="coinFarmEnabled",
        CandyAutofarm="candyFarmEnabled",
        AutoReset="autoResetEnabled",
        AvoidMurder="farmAvoidMurder",
        AutoFling="autoFlingOnFull",
        Bhop2="bhop2Enabled",
        Invisible="invisibleEnabled",
        WallHopEnabled="_wallHopEnabled",
        AutoMapVote="_mapVoteEnabled",
    }

    for flag, stateKey in pairs(boolFlags) do
        local val = S[stateKey]
        if stateKey == "_wallHopEnabled" then val = S._wallHopEnabled == true end
        if stateKey == "_mapVoteEnabled" then
            val = S._mapVoteEnabled == true
        end
        setControl(flag, val)
    end

    setControl("ESPMode", S.espMode)
    setControl("FarmMode", S.farmMode)
    setControl("Bhop2Speed", S.bhop2Speed)
    setControl("InvisibleKey", S.Keybinds.Invisible)
    setControl("WallHopKey", S.Keybinds.WallHop)
    setControl("AnimeBannerFrame", string.format("%02d", tonumber(S.animeBannerFrame) or 1))
    setControl("AnimeBannerAnimated", S.animeBannerAnimated ~= false)
    setControl("AnimeBannerFPS", S.animeBannerFPS or 6)
end

-- ============================================================
--  QH ACTION BUTTON SKIN
-- ============================================================
local function QH_StyleActionButtons()
    local root=CoreGui
    local keep={"shoot murder","shot murder","shootmurder"}
    for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("TextButton") and obj.Visible then
            local tx=tostring(obj.Text or ""):lower()
            local isShoot=false
            for _,kw in ipairs(keep) do
                if tx:find(kw,1,true) then isShoot=true break end
            end
            if not isShoot and (tx:find("grab gun",1,true) or tx:find("kill all",1,true)
                or tx:find("fling",1,true) or tx:find("copy discord",1,true)
                or tx:find("get key",1,true) or tx:find("refresh",1,true)
                or tx:find("save config",1,true) or tx:find("load config",1,true)
                or tx:find("delete config",1,true) or tx:find("set autoload",1,true)
                or tx:find("clear autoload",1,true))
            then
                pcall(function()
                    obj.AutoButtonColor=false
                    obj.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(18,18,20)
                    obj.BackgroundTransparency=.02
                    obj.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(240,240,245)
                    local st=obj:FindFirstChild("QHButtonStroke")
                    if not st then
                        st=Instance.new("UIStroke")
                        st.Name="QHButtonStroke"
                        st.Color=Color3.fromRGB(232,232,236)
                        st.Transparency=.72
                        st.Thickness=1
                        st.Parent=obj
                    end
                    if not obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") then
                        local c=Instance.new("UICorner")
                        c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,9)
                        c.Parent=obj
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ============================================================
--  POST-INIT RESTORE
-- ============================================================
task.defer(function()
    pcall(function()
        if ConfigSystem and type(ConfigSystem.loadAutoload) == "function" then
            local ok = ConfigSystem.loadAutoload()
            if not ok and ConfigSystem.getAutoload() == nil then
                -- No autoload configured: keep current defaults.
            end
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if S.watermarkEnabled == nil then S.watermarkEnabled = true end
        if S.keybindListEnabled == nil then S.keybindListEnabled = true end
        local pos=ConfigSystem.performancePosition
        if not pos or pos.Y.Offset > 400 or pos.Y.Scale < 0 or pos.Y.Scale > 1 then pos=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16) end
        ConfigSystem.performancePosition=pos
        if HUD and HUD.performanceFrame then HUD.performanceFrame.Position=pos end
        if HUD and HUD.applyTheme then HUD.applyTheme(S.hudTheme or "Neon") end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        if type(_G.__QH_SYNC_CONFIG_UI) == "function" then
            _G.__QH_SYNC_CONFIG_UI()
        end
    end)
    pcall(QH_StyleActionButtons)
    pcall(function() KeybindListUI.setVisible(true) end)
    pcall(function() VisualFX.refresh() end)
    pcall(function() Crosshair.refresh() end)
    pcall(function() if S.antiAim2Enabled then startAntiAim2() else stopAntiAim2() end end)
    pcall(function() if S.proceduralAuraEnabled and _G.__QHAuraFX then _G.__QHAuraFX.toggle(true) end end)
end)

    local function isObstacleName(name)
        if (name == "LavaPart") or (name == "Lava_Stage3") or (name == "MovingWall") then
            return true
        end
        if
            (name == "DoorWall1")
            or (name == "GreenDoorKillPart")
            or (name == "RedDoorKillPart")
            or (name == "YellowDoorKillPart")
            or (name == "DoorWall2")
            or (name == "DoorWall3")
        then
            return true
        end
        if
            (name == "Stage2LocalNPC_Local")
            or (name == "Tumbleweed")
            or (name == "vanilla")
            or (name == "EyesLaser")
            or (name == "Stage11LocalNPC_Local")
            or (name == "Stage14LocalNPC_Local")
        then
            return true
        end
        local num = name:match("^MovingWall(%d+)$")
        if num then
            local n = tonumber(num)
            if n and (n >= 1) and (n <= 15) then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function initGlobalObstacleRemover()
        task.spawn(function()
            local count = 0
            local descendants = workspace:GetDescendants()
            for i = 1, #descendants do
                local obj = descendants[i]
                if obj and obj.Parent then
                    if isObstacleName(obj.Name) then
                        obj:Destroy()
                    end
                end
                count = count + 1
                if (count % 300) == 0 then
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
        end)
        if not godModeConnection then
            godModeConnection = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
                if isObstacleName(descendant.Name) then
                    task.defer(function()
                        if descendant and descendant.Parent then
                            descendant:Destroy()
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    initGlobalObstacleRemover()
    local function setNoClip(state)
        if state then
            if not noClipConnection then
                noClipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
                    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                    if char then
                        for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                                part.CanCollide = false
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        else
            if noClipConnection then
                noClipConnection:Disconnect()
                noClipConnection = nil
            end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                char.HumanoidRootPart.CanCollide = true
            end
        end
    end
    local function getFarmRoot(timeout)
        local deadline = os.clock() + (timeout or 8)
        while autoFarmActive and os.clock() < deadline do
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if char and hum and hum.Health > 0 and hrp then
                return char, hum, hrp
            end
            task.wait(0.15)
        end
        return nil, nil, nil
    end

    local function flyTo(targetPos)
        local deadline = os.clock() + 25
        while autoFarmActive and os.clock() < deadline do
            local char, hum, hrp = getFarmRoot(8)
            if not char or not hum or not hrp then
                task.wait(0.2)
            else
                local body = char
                local segmentDeadline = os.clock() + 15
                while autoFarmActive and os.clock() < segmentDeadline do
                    if LocalPlayer.Character ~= body or hum.Health <= 0 or not hrp.Parent then
                        break
                    end

                    local offset = targetPos - hrp.Position
                    local distance = offset.Magnitude
                    if distance <= 7 then
                        return true
                    end

                    local dt = math.clamp(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.01, 0.05)
                    local step = math.min(distance, math.max(currentSpeed, 40) * dt)
                    local nextPos = hrp.Position + offset.Unit * step
                    body:PivotTo(CFrame.new(nextPos, nextPos + offset.Unit))
                end
                -- Character changed or segment timed out: reacquire and retry the same point.
                task.wait(0.15)
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    local function startAutoFarmLoop()
        if autoFarmLoopRunning then
            return
        end

        autoFarmLoopRunning = true
        autoFarmGeneration += 1
        local myGeneration = autoFarmGeneration

        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, err = xpcall(function()
                while autoFarmActive and myGeneration == autoFarmGeneration do
                local worldData = Waypoints[currentWorld]
                local currentWaypoints = worldData and worldData[currentDistance]

                if currentWaypoints and #currentWaypoints > 0 then
                    setNoClip(true)

                    if currentWorld == "Bbnos World" and currentDistance == "+50k cash" then
                        local args = { [1] = 12, [2] = "wins" }
                        pcall(function()
                            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.RequestCheckpointTp
                                :FireServer(unpack(args))
                        end)
                        task.wait(0.5)
                    end

                    for i, waypoint in ipairs(currentWaypoints) do
                        if not autoFarmActive or myGeneration ~= autoFarmGeneration then
                            break
                        end

                        -- Retry the same waypoint after a death/respawn.
                        local reached = flyTo(waypoint)
                        if not reached and autoFarmActive then
                            task.wait(0.35)
                        end

                        if currentWorld == "Bbnos World"
                            and currentDistance == "+50k cash"
                            and i == #currentWaypoints then
                            task.wait(1)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    -- Waypoints can briefly disappear while a new round loads.
                    -- Do not kill the farm state; simply wait and reacquire them.
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end

                    task.wait(0.05)
                end
            end, debug.traceback)

            if not ok then
                warn("[QuantomHub AutoFarm] loop recovered: " .. tostring(err))
            end

            autoFarmLoopRunning = false
            setNoClip(false)

            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.WalkSpeed = 16
            end
        end)
    end
    UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
        if infJumpEnabled then
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then
                    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    local function toggleManualFly(state)
        flyEnabled = state
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            return
        end
        local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if flyEnabled then
            flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(8999999488, 8999999488, 8999999488)
            flyBV.Parent = hrp
            flyBG = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            flyBG.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(8999999488, 8999999488, 8999999488)
            flyBG.P = 90000
            flyBG.Parent = hrp
            if hum then
                hum.PlatformStand = true
            end
            flyLoop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                if not hum or not hrp then
                    return
                end
                local moveDir = hum.MoveDirection
                if moveDir.Magnitude == 0 then
                    local kbDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                        kbDir = kbDir + cam.CFrame.LookVector
                    end
                    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                        kbDir = kbDir - cam.CFrame.LookVector
                    end
                    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
                        kbDir = kbDir - cam.CFrame.RightVector
                    end
                    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
                        kbDir = kbDir + cam.CFrame.RightVector
                    end
                    if kbDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                        moveDir = kbDir.Unit
                    end
                end
                if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                    flyBV.Velocity = moveDir * flySpeed
                else
                    flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                end
                flyBG.CFrame = cam.CFrame
            end)
        else
            if flyBV then
                flyBV:Destroy()
            end
            if flyBG then
                flyBG:Destroy()
            end
            if flyLoop then
                flyLoop:Disconnect()
            end
            if hum then
                hum.PlatformStand = false
            end
        end
    end

    local function toggleMenu(forceState)
        if forceState ~= nil then
            isMenuOpen = forceState
        else
            isMenuOpen = not isMenuOpen
        end
        if isMenuOpen then
            MainFrame.Visible = true
            if not isMinimized then
                ShadowFrame.Visible = true
            end
            TweenService:Create(
                MainScale,
                TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                { Scale = UI_SCALE }
            ):Play()
            TweenService:Create(
                ShadowScale,
                TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                { Scale = UI_SCALE }
            ):Play()
        else
            local closeTween = TweenService:Create(
                MainScale,
                TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                { Scale = 0.2 }
            )
            TweenService:Create(
                ShadowScale,
                TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                { Scale = 0.2 }
            ):Play()
            closeTween:Play()
            closeTween.Completed:Connect(function()
                if not isMenuOpen then
                    MainFrame.Visible = false
                    ShadowFrame.Visible = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end

            ToggleWidget.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPosT.X.Scale,
                startPosT.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPosT.Y.Scale,
                startPosT.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    local function createTabButton(text, page)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Parent = TabContainer
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28)
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
        btn.Text = text
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170)
        btn.TextSize = 14
        Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            for _, b in ipairs(tabButtons) do
                TweenService
                    :Create(
                        b,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.2),
                        {
                            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 28),
                            TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 170),
                        }
                    )
                    :Play()
            end
            TweenService
                :Create(
                    btn,
                    TweenInfo.new(0.2),
                    { BackgroundColor3 = accentColor, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) }
                )
                :Play()
            AutoFarmPage.Visible = page == AutoFarmPage
            MovementPage.Visible = page == MovementPage
            ThemePage.Visible = page == ThemePage
            AdminPage.Visible = page == AdminPage
        end)
        table.insert(tabButtons, btn)
        return btn
    end

    local function buildDistanceOptions()
        for _, c in ipairs(DropdownList:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("TextButton") then
                c:Destroy()
            end
        end
        local options = {}
        if Waypoints[currentWorld] then
            for d, _ in pairs(Waypoints[currentWorld]) do
                table.insert(options, d)
            end
            table.sort(options, function(a, b)
                return (distSortOrder[a] or 99) < (distSortOrder[b] or 99)
            end)
        end
        if #options == 0 then
            DropdownBtn.Text = "   " .. L("NoPoints") .. " v"
            currentDistance = nil
            UpdateSpeedFarmState()
            return
        end
        for _, opt in ipairs(options) do
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Parent = DropdownList
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 30)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
            btn.Text = "            " .. opt
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
            btn.TextSize = 14
            btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            btn.ZIndex = 51
            Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            local TrophyIcon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
            TrophyIcon.Parent = btn
            TrophyIcon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            TrophyIcon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -12)
            TrophyIcon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
            TrophyIcon.Image = "rbxassetid://85025550755267"
            TrophyIcon.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
            TrophyIcon.ZIndex = 52
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                currentDistance = opt
                DropdownBtn.Text = "   " .. opt .. " v"
                DropdownList.Visible = false
                UpdateSpeedFarmState()
            end)
        end
        currentDistance = options[1]
        DropdownBtn.Text = "   " .. currentDistance .. " v"
        UpdateSpeedFarmState()
    end
    local function createWorldBtn(text, posXScale, widthScale, index)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Parent = WorldsFrame
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(posXScale, 3, 0, 3)
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(widthScale, -6, 1, -6)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        btn.Text = text
        btn.TextColor3 = ((index == 1) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
            or Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 160)
        btn.TextSize = 14
        if index == 1 then
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
            Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        end
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            currentWorld = text
            WorldLabel.Text = string.format(L("WorldLabel"), text)
            if text == "Bbnos World" then
                BbnosInfoLabel.Visible = true
            else
                BbnosInfoLabel.Visible = false
            end
            for _, b in ipairs(worldButtons) do
                b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 160)
            end
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            buildDistanceOptions()
            local maxSpd = 110
            if currentWorld == "2 World" then
                maxSpd = 190
            elseif currentWorld == "Bbnos World" then
                maxSpd = 300
            end
            if currentSpeed > maxSpd then
                currentSpeed = maxSpd
            end
            SliderLabel.Text = string.format(L("SpeedLabel"), currentSpeed)
            TweenService:Create(
                SliderFillAuto,
                TweenInfo.new(0.2),
                { Size = UDim2.new(currentSpeed / maxSpd, 0, 1, 0) }
            ):Play()
        end)
        table.insert(worldButtons, btn)
    end

    local function render3DWaypoints(pos, index)
        if visualParts[index] then
            visualParts[index]:Destroy()
        end
        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name = "Quantom_WayPoint_" .. index
        part.Position = pos
        part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
        part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        part.Color = accentColor
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.Parent = workspace
        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
        highlight.Parent = part
        highlight.FillColor = accentColor
        highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        highlight.FillTransparency = 0.4
        local bbg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bbg.Parent = part
        bbg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 40)
        bbg.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bbg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Parent = bbg
        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.Text = L("PointPrefix")
            .. " #"
            .. index
            .. "\n"
            .. string.format("%.1f, %.1f, %.1f", pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
        label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        label.TextSize = 11
        visualParts[index] = part
    end
    local function refreshPositionUI()

            end

            if part then
                part:Destroy()
            end
        end
        visualParts = {}
        for i, posStr in ipairs(savedPositions) do
            local coords = string.split(posStr, ", ")
            local x, y, z = tonumber(coords[1]), tonumber(coords[2]), tonumber(coords[3])
            if x and y and z then
                render3DWaypoints(Vector3.new(x, y, z), i)
            end
            local Item = Instance.new("Frame")
            Item.Parent = PosListFrame
            Item.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 26)

            ItemText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -45, 1, 0)
            ItemText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

            ItemText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220)
            ItemText.TextSize = 12
            ItemText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    task.spawn(function()
        local HEARTBEAT_URL = "http://62.233.43.59:8787/api/heartbeat"
        local HEARTBEAT_KEY = "db5cbd688fcc72b4221dd2e8f892cf1dccefd52c47bcdc4e"
        local INTERVAL = 45
        local function doRequest(body)
            local headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["X-Api-Key"] = HEARTBEAT_KEY }
            if syn and (type(syn.request) == "function") then
                return syn.request({ Url = HEARTBEAT_URL, Method = "POST", Headers = headers, Body = body })
            end
            if type(request) == "function" then
                return request({ Url = HEARTBEAT_URL, Method = "POST", Headers = headers, Body = body })
            end
            if http and (type(http.request) == "function") then
                return http.request({ Url = HEARTBEAT_URL, Method = "POST", Headers = headers, Body = body })
            end
            if type(http_request) == "function" then
                return http_request(HEARTBEAT_URL, "POST", headers, body)
            end
            -- Executor-only heartbeat: Roblox client HttpService is not a
            -- reliable fallback for this endpoint and can produce
            -- "no executor HTTP" failures. If no executor request API exists,
            -- silently skip the optional heartbeat instead of treating it as
            -- a loader/module failure.
            return nil
        end
        local function sendHeartbeat()
            if not LocalPlayer then
                return false
            end
            local farm = (getgenv() and getgenv().SpeedKeyboardFarmState) or {}
            local body = string.format(
                '{"userId":"%s","script":"speedkeyboard","autoFarm":%s,"autoFarmActive":%s}',
                tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId),
                (farm.enabled and "true") or "false",
                (farm.active and "true") or "false"
            )
            local res = doRequest(body)
            if not res then
                return false
            end
            local code = res.StatusCode or res.status or (res.Success and 200)
            return code == 200
        end
        task.wait(8)
        while not (getgenv() and getgenv().SpeedKeyboardHeartbeatStop) do
            if not (getgenv() and getgenv().SpeedKeyboardRunning) then
                break
            end
            -- Heartbeat is optional. Do not spam warnings when the current
            -- executor does not expose an HTTP request API.
            sendHeartbeat()
            for _ = 1, INTERVAL do
                if getgenv() and getgenv().SpeedKeyboardHeartbeatStop then
                    break
                end
                task.wait(1)
            end
        end
    end)
    print("[+1 Speed Keyboard] Loaded | Online tracker active")
end

local busy=false
local loaderClosed=false
local launchGeneration=0

local function closeLoader(immediate)
    if loaderClosed then return end
    loaderClosed=true
    if not (gui and gui.Parent) then return end
    if immediate then
        pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
        return
    end
    pcall(function()
        local fadeObjects = {window, glow, dim}
        for _,obj in ipairs(fadeObjects) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                if obj:IsA("Frame") then
                    TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play()
                end
            end
        end
        task.delay(.2, function()
            if gui and gui.Parent then gui:Destroy() end
        end)
    end)
end

local function setStage(label, textValue, progress, accent)
    local p = math.clamp(progress or 0, 0, 1)
    status.Text = tostring(textValue)
    percent.Text = string.format("%d%%", math.floor(p * 100 + 0.5))
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = accent or mmAccent
    TweenService:Create(fill,TweenInfo.new(.34,Enum.EasingStyle.Quart,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Size=UDim2.new(p,0,1,0)}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(glow,TweenInfo.new(.34,Enum.EasingStyle.Sine,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),{BackgroundTransparency=math.max(.88, .96-p*.05)}):Play()
end
