        pct.Text=string.format("%d%%",math.floor(item[2]*100))
        task.wait(.30)
    end
    stage.Text="Script loading... please wait"
    pct.Text="100%"
    task.wait(.35)

    tween(card,TweenInfo.new(.25,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{BackgroundTransparency=1})
    tween(backdrop,TweenInfo.new(.25),{BackgroundTransparency=1})
    tween(logo,TweenInfo.new(.2),{ImageTransparency=1})
    tween(title,TweenInfo.new(.2),{TextTransparency=1})
    tween(stage,TweenInfo.new(.2),{TextTransparency=1})
    task.wait(.28)
    animationAlive = false
    if lg.Parent then lg:Destroy() end

    pcall(function()
        local sg=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        sg.Name="QuantomHubLoadingNotice"
        sg.ResetOnSpawn=false
        sg.DisplayOrder=1000001
        sg.Parent=(gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui
        local n=Instance.new("TextLabel",sg)
        n.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,1)
        n.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-28)
        n.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(420,44)
        n.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(19,12,31)
        n.BackgroundTransparency=.05
        n.Text="QuantomHub  •  Скрипт загружается, подождите 10–20 секундочек..."
        n.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,220,255)
        n.TextSize=11
        n.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        n.TextTransparency=1
        Instance.new("UICorner",n).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)
        local ns=Instance.new("UIStroke",n); ns.Color=Color3.fromRGB(150,90,255); ns.Transparency=.45
        tween(n,TweenInfo.new(.25),{TextTransparency=0})
        task.delay(5,function()
            if n.Parent then tween(n,TweenInfo.new(.25),{TextTransparency=1,BackgroundTransparency=1}); task.wait(.3); sg:Destroy() end
        end)
    end)
end

local function run(src,label,accent)
    if busy then return end
    busy=true
    launchGeneration += 1
    local thisLaunch = launchGeneration
    -- Selection window disappears immediately; a dedicated purple loading animation takes over.
    task.spawn(function() showScriptLoading(label, accent) end)
    task.wait(.05)
    closeLoader()
    print("[QuantomHub Loader] Clicked: "..tostring(label))
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            if type(src)~="string" or src=="" then error("script source is empty") end
            if QH_UNSUPPORTED_EXECUTOR then
                setStage(label,"ERROR  •  "..QH_EXECUTOR_NAME.." is not supported",0.04,Color3.fromRGB(245,95,100))
                warn("[QuantomHub Loader] "..tostring(QH_EXECUTOR_NAME).." is not supported by QuantomHub V3.")
                task.wait(.55)
                error("Executor not supported: "..tostring(QH_EXECUTOR_NAME))
            end
            setStage(label,"PREPARING  •  "..label,0.12,accent)
            task.wait(.18)
            setStage(label,"LOADING SOURCE  •  "..tostring(#src).." chars",0.26,accent)
            task.wait(.16)
            setStage(label,"VERIFYING MODULE  •  "..label,0.36,accent)
            task.wait(.16)
            setStage(label,"COMPILING  •  "..label,0.52,accent)
            local f,compileErr=QH_LoaderCompile(src,"@QuantomHubV3:"..tostring(label))
            if type(f)~="function" then error("compile error: "..tostring(compileErr or "unknown compiler error")) end
            print("[QuantomHub Loader] Compile OK: "..tostring(label))
            setStage(label,"INITIALIZING GAME MODULE  •  "..label,0.66,accent)
            task.wait(.18)
            setStage(label,"STARTING SCRIPT  •  "..label,0.78,accent)
            task.wait(.12)
            f()
            print("[QuantomHub Loader] Entry returned: "..tostring(label))

            -- Interface launch watchdog:
            -- some Obsidian builds finish construction asynchronously. Make the
            -- returned window visible after the module entry point has returned.
            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function()
                    if _G.Win and type(_G.Win) == "table" then
                        local w = _G.Win._window
                        if w and w.Parent and w.Visible ~= nil then
                            w.Visible = true
                        end
                    end

                    -- The adapter stores the active Obsidian window here.
                    -- If AutoShow was ignored by a particular Obsidian build,
                    -- find its main GUI and enable it without touching unrelated UI.
                    for _, root in ipairs({CoreGui, (type(gethui) == "function" and gethui()) or nil}) do
                        if root then
                            for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
                                local n = tostring(obj.Name):lower()
                                if n:find("obsidian", 1, true) and obj:IsA("ScreenGui") then
                                    obj.Enabled = true
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end)

            setStage(label,"FINALIZING UI  •  "..label,0.92,accent)
            task.wait(.25)
            setStage(label,"READY  •  "..label,1.0,accent)
            task.wait(.65)
        end)
        if not ok then
            local msg = tostring(err)
            -- Roblox can print an ad eligibility warning such as
            -- Enum.AdAvailabilityResult.PlayerIneligible. That message is not a
            -- loader/compiler failure, so keep the +1 module running instead of
            -- treating the warning as a launch error.
            local adWarning = msg:find("PlayerIneligible", 1, true) or msg:find("AdAvailabilityResult", 1, true)
            if adWarning and label == "+1 Speed Escape" then
                -- PlayerIneligible/other AdAvailabilityResult values are normal
                -- rewarded-ad eligibility outcomes, not loader/compiler failures.
                setStage(label,"READY  •  +1 Speed Escape",1.0,accent)
                task.wait(0.65)
            else
                setStage(label,"ERROR  •  "..tostring(label),0,Color3.fromRGB(245,95,100))
                warn("[QuantomHub Loader] Launch error "..tostring(label)..": "..msg)

                -- Keep a visible diagnostic after the loader closes. Previously
                -- the error state was written to a destroyed ScreenGui, making
                -- a failed interface launch look like a silent no-op.
                pcall(function()
                    local parent = CoreGui
                    if type(gethui) == "function" then
                        local hui = gethui()
                        if hui then parent = hui end
                    end

                    local oldDiag = parent:FindFirstChild("QuantomHubLaunchError")
                    if oldDiag then oldDiag:Destroy() end

                    local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
                    sg.Name = "QuantomHubLaunchError"
                    sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
                    sg.DisplayOrder = 1000002
                    sg.Parent = parent

                    local card = Instance.new("Frame", sg)
                    card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, 1)
                    card.Position = UDim2.new(.5, 0, 1, -24)
                    card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(520, 86)
                    card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 12, 18)
                    card.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

                    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", card)
                    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 95, 100)
                    stroke.Transparency = .25

                    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
                    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 10)
                    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 20)
                    title.Text = "QuantomHub V3 • launch error"
                    title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 225)
                    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                    title.TextSize = 13
                    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

                    local detail = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
                    detail.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    detail.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 34)
                    detail.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 38)
                    detail.Text = tostring(msg)
                    detail.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 175, 185)
                    detail.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                    detail.TextSize = 10
                    detail.TextWrapped = true
                    detail.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                    detail.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

                    task.delay(8, function()
                        if sg.Parent then sg:Destroy() end
                    end)
                end)

                task.wait(1.0)
            end
        end
        closeLoader()
        if thisLaunch == launchGeneration then
            busy=false
        end
    end)
end

mm.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if busy then return end
    -- Keep the loader visible while MM2 initializes so the legacy custom UI
    -- never flashes on screen during the long source initialization phase.
    task.defer(function() run(MM2_SOURCE,"MM2",mmAccent) end)
end)
sp.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if busy then return end
    task.defer(function() run(SPEED_SOURCE,"+1 Speed Escape",spAccent) end)
end)

    glow.Thickness = 2
    glow.Transparency = 0.2
    glow.Parent = parent
    return glow

    task.spawn(function()
        while object and object.Parent do
            TweenService:Create(object, TweenInfo.new(1), {
                Transparency = math.random(20,60)/100
            }):Play()
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- QuantomHub V4 Archive Feature Pack
-- Integrated from the supplied Shitaro archive.
-- Keeps the existing V3 UI/runtime and adds a unified target,
-- prediction, resolver, backtrack-history and smoothing layer.
-- ============================================================
do
    local ArchiveCombat = {}
    local history = {}
    local lastTarget = nil

    local function validCharacter(character)
        if not character then return false end
        local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        return hum ~= nil and root ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
    end

    local function getPart(character, preferred)
        if not character then return nil end
        local order = {
            preferred,
            "Head",
            "UpperTorso",
            "LowerTorso",
            "HumanoidRootPart",
            "Torso"
        }
        for _, name in ipairs(order) do
            if type(name) == "string" then
                local p = character:FindFirstChild(name)
                if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p end
            end
        end
        return character.PrimaryPart
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.GetPing()
        local ping = 0.085
        pcall(function()
            local p = LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
            if type(p) == "number" then ping = p end
        end)
        if ping > 1 then ping = ping / 1000 end
        return math.clamp(ping, 0.02, 0.30)
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.GetVelocity(player)
        if not player or not player.Character then return Vector3.zero end
        local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return Vector3.zero end
        return root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.IsIgnored(player)
        if not player or player == LocalPlayer then return true end
        if not validCharacter(player.Character) then return true end
        return false
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.IsVisible(part, character)
        if not part then return false end
        local localChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local root = localChar and localChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return true end
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {localChar}
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return workspace:Raycast(root.Position, part.Position - root.Position, params)
        end)
        if not ok or not result then return true end
        return character and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character) or false
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.InFOV(part, radius)
        if not part or not CurrentCamera then return false end
        local point, visible = CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not visible then return false end
        local r = tonumber(radius) or tonumber(S.fovRadius) or 200
        return (Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y) - CurrentCamera.ViewportSize / 2).Magnitude <= r
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.Score(player, part)
        local point = CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local cursor = CurrentCamera.ViewportSize / 2
        local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(point.X, point.Y) - cursor).Magnitude
        local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local worldDistance = root and (root.Position - CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
        local velocity = ArchiveCombat.GetVelocity(player)
        local movementPenalty = math.clamp(velocity.Magnitude * 0.15, 0, 25)
        return screenDistance + worldDistance * 0.01 + movementPenalty
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.GetClosestTarget(options)
        options = options or {}
        local best, bestPart, bestScore = nil, nil, math.huge
        local radius = tonumber(options.fov) or tonumber(S.fovRadius) or 200
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if not ArchiveCombat.IsIgnored(player) then
                local character = player.Character
                local part = getPart(character, options.hitPart)
                if part and ArchiveCombat.InFOV(part, radius) then
                    if options.visible ~= false and not ArchiveCombat.IsVisible(part, character) then
                        if options.allowBlocked ~= true then continue end
                    end
                    local score = ArchiveCombat.Score(player, part)
                    if score < bestScore then
                        best = player
                        bestPart = part
                        bestScore = score
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        lastTarget = best
        return best, bestPart
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.UpdateHistory(player)
        if not player or not validCharacter(player.Character) then return end
        local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        local id = player.UserId or player.Name
        local now = os.clock()
        local bucket = history[id]
        if not bucket then bucket = {}; history[id] = bucket end
        bucket[#bucket + 1] = {
            t = now,
            position = root.Position,
            velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
        }
        while #bucket > 30 or (bucket[1] and now - bucket[1].t > 0.45) do
            table.remove(bucket, 1)
        end
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.GetBacktrack(player, age)
        if not player then return nil end
        local bucket = history[player.UserId or player.Name]
        if not bucket or #bucket == 0 then return nil end
        local wanted = os.clock() - math.clamp(tonumber(age) or 0.08, 0, 0.45)
        local selected = bucket[1]
        for i = #bucket, 1, -1 do
            if bucket[i].t <= wanted then
                selected = bucket[i]
                break
            end
        end
        return selected
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.ResolveVelocity(player)
        local current = ArchiveCombat.GetVelocity(player)
        local old = ArchiveCombat.GetBacktrack(player, 0.08)
        if not old then return current end
        local delta = current - old.velocity
        local acceleration = delta * 0.5
        return current + acceleration
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.Predict(player, part, strength)
        if not player or not part then return nil end
        local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return part.Position end
        local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local ping = ArchiveCombat.GetPing()
        local velocity = ArchiveCombat.ResolveVelocity(player)
        local move = hum and hum.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
        local speed = velocity.Magnitude
        local lead = tonumber(strength) or 0.18
        lead = lead + ping * 0.95
        lead = lead + math.clamp(speed / 80, 0, 0.16)
        local predicted = part.Position
            + velocity * Vector3.new(0.82, 0.55, 0.82) * lead
            + move * lead * 0.35
        local delta = predicted - part.Position
        local maxDistance = math.clamp(2.5 + speed * lead * 1.35, 2.5, 16)
        if delta.Magnitude > maxDistance then
            predicted = part.Position + delta.Unit * maxDistance
        end
        return predicted
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.Smooth(from, to, amount)
        if typeof(from) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(to) ~= "Vector3" then return to end
        local alpha = math.clamp(tonumber(amount) or 1, 0, 1)
        return from:Lerp(to, alpha)
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.GetAimPosition(player, options)
        options = options or {}
        local character = player and player.Character
        if not validCharacter(character) then return nil end
        local part = getPart(character, options.hitPart or "Head")
        if not part then return nil end
        if options.backtrack then
            local bt = ArchiveCombat.GetBacktrack(player, options.backtrackAge)
            if bt then
                return bt.position
            end
        end
        return ArchiveCombat.Predict(player, part, options.prediction)
    end

    function ArchiveCombat.Clear(player)
        if not player then return end
        history[player.UserId or player.Name] = nil
    end

    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        ArchiveCombat.Clear(player)
    end)

    local archiveAccumulator = 0
    if RunService and RunService.Heartbeat then
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if QH_IsRoundTransition() then return end
        archiveAccumulator += dt
        if archiveAccumulator < 0.10 then return end
        archiveAccumulator = 0

        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                pcall(ArchiveCombat.UpdateHistory, player)
            end
        end
    end)
    end

    -- Keep the Combat.aimV2 implementation from QuantomHub's Osiris-compatible
    -- layer untouched. The archive predictor is exposed separately so it cannot
    -- overwrite the supplied 0.165 prediction formula and make aim less stable.
    pcall(function()
        print("[QuantomHub] Osiris aim layer: 0.165 prediction / archive override disabled")
    end)

    getgenv().__QuantomHubArchive = ArchiveCombat
    getgenv().__QuantomHubArchiveReady = true

    pcall(function()
        if game:GetService("StarterGui") then
            game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "наш дискорд",
                Text = "https://discord.gg/B7m98p8rp",
                Duration = 3
            })
        end
    end)
end

-- QuantomHub round-transition safety: stop expensive history/dodge work briefly
-- while MM2 tears down the old round and constructs the next character/UI.
local QH_RoundTransitionSafety = LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
    QH_BeginRoundTransition()
    task.delay(1.35, function()
        if QH_RoundTransition.active then
            QH_RoundTransition.active = false
        end
    end)
end)

local QH_RoundTransitionSafety2 = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.delay(0.25, QH_EndRoundTransition)
end)

-- QuantomHub startup watchdog
task.spawn(function()
    task.wait(3)
    pcall(function()
        print("[QuantomHub] Loaded")
    end)
end)


-- QuantomHub AntiAim 2 cleanup guard
pcall(function()
    if game and game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer then
        game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
            pcall(stopAntiAim2)
        end)
    end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- QUANTOMHUB AIM STABILITY PATCH V3
-- ============================================================
do
    local AimStable = { history = {}, final = {} }

    local function qhGetTargetPart(character)
        if not character then return nil end
        return character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    end

    local function qhEstimate(target, root, part)
        local key = target.UserId or target.Name
        local now = os.clock()
        local pos = root.Position
        local measured = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
        local partVel = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
        local h = AimStable.history[key]
        local dt = h and math.clamp(now - h.t, 1/240, 0.09) or 1/60
        local displacement = h and ((pos - h.p) / dt) or measured
        if h then
            local maxDelta = math.max(10, measured.Magnitude * dt * 2.2 + 5)
            if (pos - h.p).Magnitude > maxDelta then displacement = measured end
        end
        local vel = Vector3.new(
            displacement.X * 0.62 + measured.X * 0.23 + partVel.X * 0.15,
            measured.Y * 0.78 + partVel.Y * 0.22,
            displacement.Z * 0.62 + measured.Z * 0.23 + partVel.Z * 0.15
        )
        vel = Vector3.new(math.clamp(vel.X,-180,180), math.clamp(vel.Y,-180,180), math.clamp(vel.Z,-180,180))
        local accel = Vector3.zero
        if h and h.v then
            accel = (vel - h.v) / dt
            accel = Vector3.new(accel.X, 0, accel.Z)
            if accel.Magnitude > 220 then accel = accel.Unit * 220 end
        end
        AimStable.history[key] = {p=pos, v=vel, t=now}
        return vel, accel
    end

    local function qhHorizon(target, velocity)
        local ping = 0
        pcall(function() ping = Combat.getPingSeconds() end)
        ping = math.clamp(tonumber(ping) or 0, 0, 0.45)
        local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
        local lead = 0.050 + ping * 0.52 + math.clamp(speed * 0.00115, 0, 0.10)
        local hum = target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then lead += 0.018 end
        return math.clamp(lead, 0.045, 0.285)
    end

    local function qhPredict(target, preferred)
        if not target or not target.Character then return nil end
        local ch = target.Character
        local root = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return nil end
        local part = (preferred and ch:FindFirstChild(preferred)) or qhGetTargetPart(ch)
        if not part then return nil end
        local velocity, accel = qhEstimate(target, root, part)
        local lead = qhHorizon(target, velocity)
        local base = part.Position
        local projected = base + velocity * lead + accel * (0.5 * lead * lead)
        projected = Vector3.new(projected.X, base.Y + velocity.Y * (lead * 0.58), projected.Z)
        local key = target.UserId or target.Name
        local previous = AimStable.final[key]
        if previous then
            local jump = (projected - previous).Magnitude
            projected = previous:Lerp(projected, jump > 7 and 0.82 or 0.68)
        end
        local hSpeed = Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
        local maxLeadDistance = math.clamp(2.5 + hSpeed * lead * 1.65, 2.5, 14)
        local delta = projected - base
        if delta.Magnitude > maxLeadDistance then projected = base + delta.Unit * maxLeadDistance end
        if projected.X ~= projected.X or projected.Y ~= projected.Y or projected.Z ~= projected.Z then projected = base end
        AimStable.final[key] = projected
        return projected
    end

    -- Replace only the prediction functions; no extra per-frame connection is added.
    task.defer(function()
        if not Combat then return end
        function Combat.aimV2(target)
            return qhPredict(target, "UpperTorso") or qhPredict(target, "Torso") or qhPredict(target, "Head") or qhPredict(target)
        end
        function Combat.stdPred(target)
            if not target or not target.Character then return nil end
            local ch = target.Character
            local root = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local part = qhGetTargetPart(ch)
            if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not part then return nil end
            local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
            local ping = 0
            pcall(function() ping = Combat.getPingSeconds() end)
            ping = math.clamp(tonumber(ping) or 0, 0, 0.45)
            local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X,0,velocity.Z).Magnitude
            local lead = math.clamp(0.045 + ping * 0.48 + math.clamp(speed * 0.001,0,0.075), 0.04, 0.24)
            return part.Position + Vector3.new(velocity.X * lead, velocity.Y * lead * 0.55, velocity.Z * lead)
        end
    end)

    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        local key = player and (player.UserId or player.Name)
        if key then AimStable.history[key] = nil; AimStable.final[key] = nil end
    end)
end

getgenv().__QH_FIXED_TABS_CHARACTER_AIMV3 = true
